SOURCE_SHA256=9787df1d0983957589fc407cb0f2cdc0a89fcde7100c022a4741b8abfeedfa81
METADATA ONLY (not on-screen evidence): {'logline': "Lady Juliana arrives at the cathedral in her late mother's bridal gown, only to suffer the ultimate betrayal when her fiancé Gerald abandons her at the altar for her cruel sister Clarissa with her family's full blessing.", 'continuity_notes': "First episode of the series. Establishes Juliana's humiliation and abandonment by her betrothed, Gerald, and her noble family in favor of her sister, Clarissa."}
SOURCE WARNINGS=['sc_001: incomplete source coverage; gaps are unavailable']
SCENE sc_001 0-138000 INT. CATHEDRAL – DAY
EP01:E1 0-4800 CAMERA: Symmetrical framing on the heavy church doors as they slowly part, pushing in slightly as Juliana stands framed in the light, dressed in an elegant white silk gown.
EP01:E2 1000-4800 ACTION: Juliana pauses at the threshold, her expression bright with joyful anticipation, wearing her mother's vintage gown and an oval pendant necklace.
EP01:E3 4800-6800 CAMERA: High wide tracking shot following behind Juliana as she steps into the grand cathedral nave, facing the distant altar flanked by seated guests.
EP01:E4 6800-9800 CAMERA: Close-up on Juliana's face as her warm smile begins to falter into confusion.
EP01:E5 7200-9800 ACTION: Juliana's eyes widen slightly in bewilderment as she notices something amiss at the altar.
EP01:E6 9800-11000 CAMERA: Medium profile shot at the altar showing Gerald in his dark tailcoat holding the gloved hand of the Lady in Gold Gown, with Juliana visible walking down the distant aisle.
EP01:E7 11000-13200 CAMERA: Medium shot as Juliana stops midway down the aisle, confronted by a haughty matriarch in black velvet stepping into the foreground.
EP01:E8 11300-13100 MATRIARCH [Cold, Commanding]: "You should turn around, Juliana."
EP01:E9 13500-14300 LADY JULIANA [Confused, Breathless]: "Why?"
EP01:E10 14300-17800 CAMERA: Over-the-shoulder medium close-up past the Matriarch to Juliana, looking past her toward the altar.
EP01:E11 15500-17500 LADY JULIANA [Desperate, Unbelieving]: "Gerald is waiting for me."
EP01:E12 17800-20500 CAMERA: Close-up on the Matriarch wearing an ornate tiara and sapphire jewelry, gazing down with merciless disdain.
EP01:E13 18000-19400 MATRIARCH [Blunt, Unforgiving]: "Not anymore."
EP01:E14 20500-23600 CAMERA: Close-up on Juliana's stricken face as the weight of the words sinks in.
EP01:E15 21800-23500 LADY JULIANA [Trembling, Pleading]: "What do you mean?"
EP01:E16 23600-25800 CAMERA: Medium shot of the Matriarch gesturing dismissively toward the altar.
EP01:E17 23800-25500 MATRIARCH [Dismissive]: "Look for yourself."
EP01:E18 25600-29800 ACTION: Juliana walks forward past the Matriarch, her breath hitching as she approaches the altar steps, looking up in shock.
EP01:E19 25800-29800 CAMERA: Medium front tracking shot moving backward ahead of Juliana as she advances down the center aisle.
EP01:E20 29800-32800 CAMERA: Panning shot across the seated wedding guests whispering and casting judging glances from the wooden pews.
EP01:E21 32800-33700 CAMERA: Low-angle shot from behind Juliana looking up at Gerald and the Lady in Gold Gown standing proudly before the altar.
EP01:E22 33700-35300 CAMERA: Close-up on Juliana's trembling lips and shocked, tearful blue eyes.
EP01:E23 33800-35000 LADY JULIANA [Shaken, Whispering]: "Gerald?"
EP01:E24 35400-37700 LADY JULIANA [Heartbroken]: "Why are you holding her hand?"
EP01:E25 36500-39000 CAMERA: Close-up insert of Gerald's fingers firmly interlocked with the white-gloved hand of the Lady in Gold Gown.
EP01:E26 39000-41500 CAMERA: Close-up on the Lady in Gold Gown beaming with cruel triumph.
EP01:E27 39100-41200 LADY IN GOLD GOWN [Gloating, Smug]: "Because he is marrying me."
EP01:E28 41500-43900 CAMERA: Close-up on Juliana as tears spill over her eyelashes.
EP01:E29 41700-43100 LADY JULIANA [Gasping, Devastated]: "No..."
EP01:E30 43900-46800 CAMERA: Wide profile shot showing Juliana standing below the altar platform, looking up at Gerald and her sister.
EP01:E31 46800-50400 CAMERA: Close-up on Juliana clutching her chest, her sorrow turning into burning outrage.
EP01:E32 46800-50000 LADY JULIANA [Outraged, Accusing]: "You knew this before I walked through those doors!"
EP01:E33 50400-52000 CAMERA: Medium shot of Gerald standing stoic and impassive next to the smug Lady in Gold Gown.
EP01:E34 52000-54600 CAMERA: Close-up on Juliana's hands desperately clenching fistfuls of her white dress fabric.
EP01:E35 52800-54600 LADY JULIANA [Choking on Tears]: "You let me come here..."
EP01:E36 54600-57600 CAMERA: Close-up on Juliana's tear-streaked face as she shakes with grief.
EP01:E37 54700-56900 LADY JULIANA [Crushed, Shaking]: "You let me dress in my mother's gown..."
EP01:E38 57000-60000 LADY JULIANA [Crying Out]: "You let me believe I was walking toward my husband!"
EP01:E39 57600-60100 CAMERA: Medium shot on Gerald stepping forward, cold and indifferent, with the Lady in Gold Gown lingering in soft focus behind him.
EP01:E40 60100-63000 CAMERA: Tight close-up on Gerald's hardened profile as he glances down.
EP01:E41 60100-61800 THE FORMER GROOM [Cold, Callous]: "I changed my mind."
EP01:E42 63000-66000 CAMERA: Extreme close-up on Juliana's furious, weeping face.
EP01:E43 63400-65600 LADY JULIANA [Betrayed, Piercing]: "You swore you loved me!"
EP01:E44 66000-68800 CAMERA: Close-up on the Lady in Gold Gown smiling condescendingly.
EP01:E45 66500-68800 LADY IN GOLD GOWN [Mocking]: "People change their minds, sister."
EP01:E46 68800-72400 CAMERA: Medium profile shot of the Lady in Gold Gown turning her head subtly toward Gerald with satisfied malice.
EP01:E47 69100-70400 LADY JULIANA [Horrified]: "And you knew?"
EP01:E48 70600-72100 LADY IN GOLD GOWN [Unapologetic, Cheerful]: "Of course I knew."
EP01:E49 72400-74600 CAMERA: Close-up on Juliana, stunned by the callous depth of the conspiracy.
EP01:E50 73100-74300 LADY JULIANA [Trembling]: "How long?"
EP01:E51 74600-79000 CAMERA: Medium two-shot of the Lady in Gold Gown and Gerald looking together down at Juliana.
EP01:E52 75000-78500 LADY IN GOLD GOWN [Cruel, Poised]: "Long enough to know he was never going to marry you."
EP01:E53 79000-81000 ACTION: Juliana turns abruptly toward the first row of pews, where her elderly father sits gripping an ornate brass cane.
EP01:E54 79000-81400 CAMERA: Close-up on the father's hand tightly gripping the gold curved handle of his walking cane.
EP01:E55 80100-81200 LADY JULIANA [Desperate]: "Father..."
EP01:E56 81400-83700 CAMERA: Wide shot showing Juliana dropping to her knees beside her seated father, pleading with him.
EP01:E57 81400-83600 LADY JULIANA [Begging]: "Tell them this is a mistake."
EP01:E58 83700-86000 CAMERA: Close-up on the father's weathered face, looking fixedly at the floor, refusing to meet her gaze.
EP01:E59 86000-89500 CAMERA: Close-up on Juliana looking up at him, tears streaming uncontrollably down her cheeks.
EP01:E60 86000-88900 LADY JULIANA [Choking, Broken]: "Father... please look at me."
EP01:E61 89500-90800 ACTION: The father tightens his jaw and stony expression, refusing to offer a single word or look.
EP01:E62 89500-90800 CAMERA: Profile close-up of the father staring blankly forward.
EP01:E63 90800-95800 CAMERA: Low-angle shot looking up at the Matriarch commanding the space with regal severity.
EP01:E64 90900-91900 MATRIARCH [Stern, Resolute]: "Enough!"
EP01:E65 92100-95500 MATRIARCH [Disgusted]: "You have embarrassed this family long enough."
EP01:E66 95800-98600 CAMERA: Close-up on Juliana as she rises, stung by the utter betrayal.
EP01:E67 96200-98200 LADY JULIANA [Incredulous]: "Embarrassed you?"
EP01:E68 98600-102500 CAMERA: Medium shot of the Matriarch gesturing toward Clarissa, who stands elegantly in gold.
EP01:E69 98800-101500 MATRIARCH [Haughty]: "Clarissa knows how to carry herself."
EP01:E70 101600-105000 MATRIARCH [Proud]: "She has beauty, connections, and a future worth protecting."
EP01:E71 102500-105300 CAMERA: Medium profile two-shot of the Matriarch confronting Juliana face to face.
EP01:E72 105300-107400 CAMERA: Close-up on Juliana, demanding answers in spite of her humiliation.
EP01:E73 105400-107300 LADY JULIANA [Raw, Painful]: "And I am what?"
EP01:E74 107400-110000 CAMERA: Medium tracking shot showing the Lady in Gold Gown stepping past Juliana toward the center.
EP01:E75 107500-110800 LADY IN GOLD GOWN [Viciously Calm]: "You are the daughter people tolerate because they have to."
EP01:E76 110000-113000 CAMERA: Close-up on Juliana absorbing the venomous words, her breathing shallow.
EP01:E77 111100-113000 LADY IN GOLD GOWN [Gloating]: "I am the daughter they choose."
EP01:E78 113000-115200 CAMERA: Medium shot of the Lady in Gold Gown smiling warmly at Gerald beside the altar candles.
EP01:E79 113300-115700 MATRIARCH [O.S.) (Firm]: "Clarissa is the jewel of this family."
EP01:E80 115200-117000 CAMERA: Close two-shot of the Matriarch and Juliana standing side by side in profile.
EP01:E81 117000-119500 CAMERA: Medium shot framing Juliana looking directly at Gerald, who towers over her coldly.
EP01:E82 117000-119000 LADY JULIANA [Trembling, Dignified]: "So that is what I was worth to you?"
EP01:E83 119500-122500 CAMERA: Close-up on Gerald's sharp jawline as he looks down at her without an ounce of remorse.
EP01:E84 119800-122300 THE FORMER GROOM [Scornful, Hard]: "You have nothing to offer me anymore."
EP01:E85 122500-124200 CAMERA: Extreme close-up on Juliana's eye as a single tear rolls down her cheek.
EP01:E86 124200-128500 CAMERA: Full shot tracking Gerald as he turns his back on Juliana and walks back toward Clarissa and the altar.
EP01:E87 124200-127500 THE FORMER GROOM [Arrogant, Dismissive]: "I cannot marry a woman of such plainness and low value..."
EP01:E88 128500-131300 CAMERA: Close-up on Clarissa's radiant, conceited smile basking in Gerald's words.
EP01:E89 128500-131200 THE FORMER GROOM [Reverent toward Clarissa]: "...when Clarissa is the true jewel of the county."
EP01:E90 131300-133800 ACTION: Juliana's hand clenches fiercely into the folds of her mother's silk bridal gown, knuckles whitening with suppressed fury.
EP01:E91 131300-133800 CAMERA: Tight insert on Juliana's white-knuckled hand clutching the gown fabric.
EP01:E92 133800-137000 CAMERA: Push-in close-up on Juliana's tearful face. Her trembling mouth straightens, her tear-filled blue eyes hardening from sheer devastation into cold, resolute defiance.
EP01:E93 133800-137000 ACTION: Juliana breathes through the agony, refusing to break down further in front of the congregation.
EP01:E94 135000-137500 SOUND: Solemn low-pitched string drone swells to an ominous cliffhanger peak.
EP01:E95 137000-138000 CAMERA: Cut to black.

EP=ep_002; timestamps are integer milliseconds
SOURCE_SHA256=f0bdb98b40cdd1cd1458e4dbae99ee51c55130e75cd676e06a12ce04a9cbb111
METADATA ONLY (not on-screen evidence): {'logline': "Publicly cast aside at the altar by Gerald for her sister Clarissa and abandoned by her own family, Juliana stands tall and turns her public humiliation into an unyielding indictment of Gerald's honor.", 'continuity_notes': "Picks up directly from Episode 1's cliffhanger. Gerald has turned away from Juliana at the altar, leaving her devastated before the entire aristocratic congregation."}
SOURCE WARNINGS=[]
SCENE sc_001 0-110000 INT. CATHEDRAL – CONTINUOUS
EP02:E1 0-2800 CAMERA: Medium low-angle shot on Gerald at the altar steps, looking down dismissively, while Clarissa in her shimmering gold gown stands behind him gloating.
EP02:E2 0-2500 THE FORMER GROOM [Cold, Callous]: "I cannot marry you, Juliana."
EP02:E3 2800-4600 CAMERA: Medium close-up on Juliana trembling in disbelief, her hands clasped tightly to her chest.
EP02:E4 2800-4600 ACTION: Juliana gasps softly in heartbreak, her eyes wide and brimming with tears.
EP02:E5 4600-6600 CAMERA: Medium shot returning to Gerald, sneering down at Juliana.
EP02:E6 4700-6500 THE FORMER GROOM [Cruel, Derisive]: "You are far too plain..."
EP02:E7 6600-9500 CAMERA: Close-up on Juliana's tear-streaked face, crushed under his biting words.
EP02:E8 6800-9500 THE FORMER GROOM [Off-screen) (Dismissive]: "...far too silent..."
EP02:E9 9500-12000 CAMERA: Medium shot on Gerald turning slightly toward Clarissa as she smiles admiringly at him.
EP02:E10 9600-12000 THE FORMER GROOM [Arrogant, Conceited]: "...and completely beneath the future I deserve."
EP02:E11 12000-15800 CAMERA: Wide shot down the aisle as Juliana takes an agonizing step forward toward the altar, extending a trembling hand.
EP02:E12 12400-15500 LADY JULIANA [Desperate, Pleading]: "Gerald... Look at me."
EP02:E13 15800-18000 CAMERA: Close-up on Gerald's cold, merciless face staring ahead unblinkingly.
EP02:E14 18000-20700 CAMERA: Tight insert on Juliana's hand clutching the heirloom amethyst pendant resting against her gown.
EP02:E15 18200-20600 LADY JULIANA [Trembling, Betrayed]: "You gave me your word before both our families."
EP02:E16 20700-23800 CAMERA: Medium two-shot of Gerald and Clarissa standing side by side before the priest.
EP02:E17 20900-23700 THE FORMER GROOM [Indifferent, Unapologetic]: "Promises change when a better choice appears."
EP02:E18 23800-27600 CAMERA: Medium close-up on Juliana clutching her chest, her voice quivering with disbelief.
EP02:E19 24000-27400 LADY JULIANA [Shattered, Disbelieving]: "A better choice? Is that what she is?"
EP02:E20 27600-30600 CAMERA: Wide shot from behind Juliana looking up the altar stairs at Gerald with Clarissa linked to his arm.
EP02:E21 27800-30500 THE FORMER GROOM [Resolute, Harsh]: "She is what I should have chosen from the beginning."
EP02:E22 30600-32400 CAMERA: Medium shot of Juliana's father seated prominently in the family pew, clutching his gold-topped cane.
EP02:E23 30900-32400 LADY JULIANA [Off-screen) (Vulnerable, Begging]: "Father..."
EP02:E24 32400-34200 CAMERA: Close-up of the father's stern, unyielding face.
EP02:E25 34200-37200 CAMERA: Medium shot of Juliana turning toward her father in the pews, imploring him.
EP02:E26 34300-37100 LADY JULIANA [Choked with Tears]: "Surely you will not let him humiliate me like this?"
EP02:E27 37200-42500 CAMERA: Medium shot tracking in on Juliana's father as he leans firmly upon his cane, looking down coldly.
EP02:E28 37500-42300 BLOND NOBLEMAN [Stern, Cold]: "Gerald has made his choice. Accept it, Juliana."
EP02:E29 42500-44800 CAMERA: Close-up on the father's hardening eyes, entirely unsympathetic.
EP02:E30 42500-44700 BLOND NOBLEMAN [Severely, Harsh]: "Do not disgrace us further."
EP02:E31 44800-47600 CAMERA: Extreme close-up on Juliana's tear-drenched eyes as the sting of her father's rejection lands.
EP02:E32 45300-47400 LADY JULIANA [Whispering, Crushed]: "You won't even look at me."
EP02:E33 47600-51500 CAMERA: Medium shot on Clarissa, beaming smugly as she clings to Gerald's arm.
EP02:E34 47800-51400 LADY IN GOLD GOWN [Mocking, Spiteful]: "Why are you surprised, sister? Look at you."
EP02:E35 51500-53400 CAMERA: Tight insert on Clarissa's gloved fingers contemptuously pinching the satin folds of Juliana's gown.
EP02:E36 51600-53200 LADY IN GOLD GOWN [Off-screen) (Scornful]: "That plain, old-fashioned gown."
EP02:E37 53400-56700 CAMERA: Medium shot of Clarissa smiling radiantly, condescendingly gesturing at Juliana.
EP02:E38 53500-56700 LADY IN GOLD GOWN [Taunting, Giggling]: "You look like a kitchen maid who wandered into the wrong wedding."
EP02:E39 56700-58200 CAMERA: Close-up on Juliana, whose tearful expression begins to tighten with quiet indignation.
EP02:E40 56800-58200 LADY IN GOLD GOWN [Off-screen) (Snide]: "And that quiet little face."
EP02:E41 58200-58600 CAMERA: Wide over-the-shoulder shot from behind Clarissa and Gerald, framing Juliana standing solitary down the center aisle.
EP02:E42 58600-60500 CAMERA: Medium shot returning to Clarissa laughing at Juliana's expense.
EP02:E43 58700-60500 LADY IN GOLD GOWN [Conceited, Spiteful]: "Gerald needs a real lady..."
EP02:E44 60500-63500 CAMERA: Close-up on Juliana staring straight ahead as Clarissa insults her mother's memory.
EP02:E45 60600-63500 LADY IN GOLD GOWN [Off-screen) (Vicious]: "...not a dull creature who hides in her mother's apothecary herbs."
EP02:E46 63500-66000 CAMERA: High-angle wide shot of the grand cathedral aisle as a matriarch dressed in an ornate black velvet gown glides toward Juliana.
EP02:E47 63500-66000 ACTION: The matriarch steps into the center aisle, glaring down at Juliana with cold superiority.
EP02:E48 63600-65800 OFF-SCREEN VOICE [Cold, Scolding]: "Oh, don't look so wounded, Juliana."
EP02:E49 66000-69300 CAMERA: Medium profile two-shot of the matriarch confronting Juliana face-to-face.
EP02:E50 66100-69300 OFF-SCREEN VOICE [Dismissive, Condescending]: "You should be grateful you're at least allowed to attend the wedding."
EP02:E51 69300-72800 CAMERA: Medium shot of Gerald stepping forward on the altar steps, impatiently gesturing Juliana toward the church exit.
EP02:E52 69400-72700 THE FORMER GROOM [Impatient, Commanding]: "Go home quietly, Juliana. At least leave this chapel with some dignity."
EP02:E53 72800-74200 CAMERA: Profile close-up of Juliana turning her face back toward the altar, tears still shimmering on her cheeks.
EP02:E54 74200-76500 CAMERA: Direct close-up on Juliana's face as a steely, defiant smile emerges through her pain.
EP02:E55 74400-76400 LADY JULIANA [Bitter, Defiant]: "Dignity?"
EP02:E56 76500-79000 CAMERA: Full shot of Juliana standing tall, her posture completely transforming into regal composure before the seated guests.
EP02:E57 76500-79000 LADY JULIANA [Clear, Accusing]: "You abandoned a woman who trusted you..."
EP02:E58 79000-81800 CAMERA: Medium profile close-up on Gerald's hardening jawline, Clarissa blurred in the background.
EP02:E59 79200-82500 LADY JULIANA [Off-screen) (Sharp, Piercing]: "...because another woman promised you greater beauty and wealth."
EP02:E60 81800-82800 CAMERA: Closer angle on Gerald's uneasy expression as Juliana's voice commands the room.
EP02:E61 82800-86700 CAMERA: Medium wide shot framing Juliana confronting Gerald from the foot of the altar stairs.
EP02:E62 83000-86500 LADY JULIANA [Steely, Resolute]: "Do not mistake my heartbreak for your victory, Gerald."
EP02:E63 86700-90800 CAMERA: Medium close-up push-in on Juliana, her blue eyes shining with fierce conviction.
EP02:E64 86800-93000 LADY JULIANA [Powerful, Unyielding]: "You wanted this entire chapel to believe that I was not worthy of you. But you have shown them something far more valuable."
EP02:E65 90800-93200 CAMERA: Medium profile on Juliana looking up at Gerald, holding the entire hall spellbound.
EP02:E66 93200-96800 CAMERA: Close-up on Juliana's face, calm, dignified, and unwavering.
EP02:E67 93400-96600 LADY JULIANA [Decisive, Scathing]: "You have shown them exactly what your word is worth."
EP02:E68 96800-98200 CAMERA: Medium shot on Gerald standing frozen on the altar steps, stunned and speechless under her public rebuke.
EP02:E69 98200-102800 CAMERA: Low-angle wide shot of the grand cathedral nave, framing Juliana in pristine white at the center of the vaulted aisle.
EP02:E70 98200-102800 ACTION: Juliana lifts her chin high, commanding the space with unassailable dignity.
EP02:E71 98500-102400 LADY JULIANA [Resolute, Proud]: "I may leave this chapel without a husband..."
EP02:E72 102800-110000 CAMERA: Dramatic medium close-up holding steadily on Juliana's radiant, proud face as she delivers her final proclamation.
EP02:E73 103000-107400 LADY JULIANA [Defiant, Triumphant in Spirit]: "...but I will not leave it believing I was the one who should be ashamed."
EP02:E74 107400-110000 ACTION: Juliana breathes with steady resolve, holding her head high as the solemn orchestral score swells into the final beat.

messages.content:
EP=ep_003; timestamps are integer milliseconds
SOURCE_SHA256=2a1df4c96f178a4784aef81dd6fe82e3a9d226d2443fe98629cfbc0c95dc14df
METADATA ONLY (not on-screen evidence): {'logline': "Banished from her mother's chapel and seized by guards at her family's command, Juliana is rescued by an imposing, scarred stranger who intervenes with lethal grace—and drops to one knee with a proposal that shocks high society.", 'continuity_notes': "Follows directly from Episode 2's confrontation at the altar, where Juliana publicly exposed Gerald's dishonor before the entire aristocratic congregation."}
SOURCE WARNINGS=[]
SCENE sc_001 0-22800 INT. CATHEDRAL NAVE – DAY
EP03:E1 0-3500 CAMERA: Medium shot on Lady Juliana standing abandoned near the altar in her white gown, clutching her mother's medallion to her chest.
EP03:E2 2100-4200 LADY IN GOLD GOWN [Mocking, Spiteful]: "Look at you..."
EP03:E3 3500-6100 CAMERA: Medium shot on the Lady in Gold Gown, smiling smugly in her gold gown beside Gerald.
EP03:E4 3600-8200 LADY IN GOLD GOWN [Gloating, Scornful]: "...still clinging to that little locket as if it can make you worthy of a place here."
EP03:E5 6100-8500 CAMERA: Close-up profile of Juliana's hand tightly clutching the jeweled silver locket against her breast, tears welling in her eyes.
EP03:E6 8500-11100 CAMERA: Medium close-up on Juliana looking across at her sister with wounded pride.
EP03:E7 8800-10800 LADY JULIANA [Hurt, Bitter]: "You stole my wedding."
EP03:E8 11100-13600 CAMERA: Medium two-shot of Gerald and the Lady in Gold Gown standing together at the front of the nave.
EP03:E9 11200-13400 LADY JULIANA [Defiant]: "Don't pretend you've earned anything."
EP03:E10 13600-16400 CAMERA: Close-up of the Lady in Gold Gown smirking derisively.
EP03:E11 13800-16300 LADY IN GOLD GOWN [Smug, Malicious]: "I didn't steal what was never truly yours."
EP03:E12 16400-18600 CAMERA: Close-up on Juliana's trembling lips, refusing to break down.
EP03:E13 16600-18400 LADY JULIANA [Trembling, Resolute]: "This was my wedding."
EP03:E14 18600-20500 CAMERA: Side medium shot of Gerald looking away impassively as the Lady in Gold Gown leans back against him.
EP03:E15 18700-20400 LADY IN GOLD GOWN [Taunting, Cruel]: "It was supposed to be."
EP03:E16 20500-22800 CAMERA: Close-up of the Lady in Gold Gown beaming triumphantly.
EP03:E17 20600-22500 LADY IN GOLD GOWN [Vindictive]: "Now it is mine."
SCENE sc_002 22800-64500 INT. CATHEDRAL – CONTINUOUS
EP03:E18 22800-25800 CAMERA: Low-angle wide shot of an imperious Noble Matriarch in a lavish black velvet gown and jeweled tiara stepping forward.
EP03:E19 23100-25500 NOBLE MATRIARCH [Harsh, Authoritative]: "Enough, Juliana."
EP03:E20 25800-28000 CAMERA: Medium close-up of the Noble Matriarch glaring down with icy contempt.
EP03:E21 25900-28000 NOBLE MATRIARCH [Cold, Disgusted]: "You have humiliated this family enough for one day."
EP03:E22 28000-30300 CAMERA: Close-up on Juliana, tears shimmering in her eyes as betrayal strikes deep.
EP03:E23 30300-35500 CAMERA: Medium shot on Juliana as she speaks out against her family's injustice.
EP03:E24 30400-33200 LADY JULIANA [Pained, Betrayed]: "I was humiliated by your family."
EP03:E25 33300-35600 LADY JULIANA [Accusing]: "And my father said nothing."
EP03:E26 35500-38200 CAMERA: Medium close-up on the Noble Matriarch, completely unsympathetic.
EP03:E27 36500-38400 NOBLE MATRIARCH [Brutal, Dismissive]: "Your father has made his choice."
EP03:E28 38200-40400 CAMERA: Close-up on Juliana's stricken, vulnerable face.
EP03:E29 38500-40400 LADY JULIANA [Choked, Vulnerable]: "And what happens to me?"
EP03:E30 40400-42000 CAMERA: Close-up of the Noble Matriarch delivering her verdict.
EP03:E31 40500-41900 NOBLE MATRIARCH [Cold, Heartless]: "You leave."
EP03:E32 42000-43300 CAMERA: Close-up on Juliana blinking in disbelief.
EP03:E33 42100-43300 LADY JULIANA [Disbelieving]: "Leave where?"
EP03:E34 43300-45900 CAMERA: Medium shot of the Noble Matriarch looking down her nose in disdain.
EP03:E35 43400-46000 NOBLE MATRIARCH [Cruel, Scornful]: "Wherever a discarded daughter belongs."
EP03:E36 45900-48800 CAMERA: Low-angle close-up focusing on Juliana's neck as her fingers desperately clutch the oval locket.
EP03:E37 46400-48600 LADY JULIANA [Fierce, Choked]: "This is my mother's church."
EP03:E38 48800-51200 CAMERA: Close-up on Juliana's face, teeth clenched in desperate defiance.
EP03:E39 48900-51100 LADY JULIANA [Defiant, Firm]: "I have every right to stand here."
EP03:E40 51200-53000 CAMERA: Tight close-up of the Noble Matriarch leaning in with vicious delight.
EP03:E41 51300-53000 NOBLE MATRIARCH [Venomous]: "Not anymore."
EP03:E42 53000-56200 CAMERA: Medium shot on the Noble Matriarch gesturing expansively to the filled cathedral nave behind her.
EP03:E43 53300-56200 NOBLE MATRIARCH [Stern, Final]: "Your father has chosen his family..."
EP03:E44 56200-58200 CAMERA: Close-up profile of the Noble Matriarch's piercing eyes glaring directly at Juliana.
EP03:E45 56300-58200 NOBLE MATRIARCH [Coldly Severing]: "...and it isn't you."
EP03:E46 58200-59800 ACTION: The Noble Matriarch turns sharply toward the back of the chapel and barks an order.
EP03:E47 58300-60000 NOBLE MATRIARCH [Shouting, Imperious]: "Guards! Remove her!"
EP03:E48 60000-62000 CAMERA: Medium shot as two royal guards in red uniforms and bearskin caps step in behind Juliana and seize her arms.
EP03:E49 60500-62500 ACTION: The guards forcefully grab Juliana by both shoulders and drag her backwards.
EP03:E50 60600-62300 LADY JULIANA [Screaming, Resisting]: "Let me go!"
EP03:E51 62000-63200 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana's hand frantically grabbing the wooden rim of a pew, knuckles white with strain.
EP03:E52 62400-63500 LADY JULIANA [Desperate, Begging]: "Please! Someone!"
EP03:E53 63000-64500 ACTION: The guards tear her grip away from the pew.
EP03:E54 63000-64500 SOUND: Muffled scuffle, rustle of heavy silk and frantic gasps echoing off cathedral stone.
SCENE sc_003 64500-145750 INT. CATHEDRAL AISLE – CONTINUOUS
EP03:E55 64500-66000 CAMERA: High wide shot down the vaulted cathedral aisle showing the entire congregation watching in stunned silence as the guards drag Juliana.
EP03:E56 66000-68100 CAMERA: Wide eye-level shot looking down the petal-strewn marble aisle. A tall, rugged man in a worn dark trench coat—The Bearded Stranger—emerges into the center of the nave.
EP03:E57 66000-68100 ACTION: The Bearded Stranger steps deliberately into the aisle, his heavy boots echoing.
EP03:E58 68100-70500 CAMERA: Close-up on the Noble Matriarch freezing in utter shock and outrage.
EP03:E59 69900-72100 THE BEARDED STRANGER [Low, Thunderous, Imposing]: "Take your hands off her."
EP03:E60 70500-72800 CAMERA: Medium tracking shot front-on as The Bearded Stranger marches down the flower-strewn aisle with resolute purpose.
EP03:E61 72800-75100 CAMERA: Medium shot on the Noble Matriarch stepping forward on the altar steps, furiously pointing a finger at him.
EP03:E62 73000-76800 NOBLE MATRIARCH [Indignant, Screeching]: "And who are you to give orders in my family's chapel?!"
EP03:E63 75100-77000 CAMERA: High wide shot of the magnificent vaulted hall as The Bearded Stranger walks steadily forward, dwarfing the aisle.
EP03:E64 77000-79000 CAMERA: Medium shot on the lead royal guard squaring his shoulders, barring the stranger's advance while Juliana stands behind him.
EP03:E65 77200-78900 ROYAL GUARD [Aggressive, Threatening]: "Stand aside, stranger!"
EP03:E66 79000-81000 CAMERA: Medium close-up profile on The Bearded Stranger, eyes burning with quiet, lethal resolve.
EP03:E67 79300-80900 THE BEARDED STRANGER [Quiet, Deadly]: "I said..."
EP03:E68 81000-84000 CAMERA: Close-up on The Bearded Stranger's intense, scarred face.
EP03:E69 81800-83900 THE BEARDED STRANGER [Dangerous, Uncompromising]: "...let her go."
EP03:E70 84000-85500 CAMERA: Medium action shot as the guard charges toward The Bearded Stranger.
EP03:E71 84000-85500 ACTION: The Bearded Stranger effortlessly blocks the guard's strike and drives a devastating strike into him, dropping the armed guard instantly to the floor.
EP03:E72 84500-85400 SOUND: A heavy, bone-rattling punch followed by the clatter and thud of the guard collapsing onto the stone floor.
EP03:E73 85500-88100 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Gerald turning frantically to the remaining guards and congregation, panicking.
EP03:E74 85600-88000 THE FORMER GROOM [Frantic, Shouting]: "What are you waiting for?! He's only one man!"
EP03:E75 88100-89300 CAMERA: Medium shot on The Bearded Stranger standing unmoved over the fallen guard, turning his gaze toward Juliana.
EP03:E76 89300-91700 CAMERA: Two-shot profile of The Bearded Stranger stepping up to Lady Juliana, who gazes up at him in stunned breathlessness.
EP03:E77 90400-91600 THE BEARDED STRANGER [Gentle, Protective]: "Are you hurt?"
EP03:E78 91700-94000 CAMERA: Close-up on Juliana's tear-streaked face as she shakes her head gently, overwhelmed with wonder.
EP03:E79 91800-93600 ACTION: Juliana softly shakes her head 'no', her wide blue eyes locked onto him.
EP03:E80 94000-96500 CAMERA: Close-up profile of The Bearded Stranger casting a sharp, menacing glance toward the other guard.
EP03:E81 94100-96300 THE BEARDED STRANGER [Firm, Menacing]: "Good. Then don't touch her again."
EP03:E82 96500-98400 CAMERA: Medium close-up on the Noble Matriarch shrieking in exasperation from the altar steps.
EP03:E83 96500-98500 NOBLE MATRIARCH [Furious, Hysterical]: "You cannot interfere in a family matter!"
EP03:E84 98400-100800 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana's elderly father looking down, gripping his hands nervously with profound guilt.
EP03:E85 98800-100800 THE BEARDED STRANGER [O.S.) (Deep, Resonant]: "I can..."
EP03:E86 100800-103000 CAMERA: Medium shot of guests in the pews whispering and reacting in hushed shock.
EP03:E87 100800-103800 THE BEARDED STRANGER [O.S.) (Stern, Accusing]: "...when your family is dragging a defenseless woman from a church."
EP03:E88 103000-105900 CAMERA: Two-shot profile of The Bearded Stranger and Lady Juliana framed against the illuminated stained-glass rose window.
EP03:E89 104200-107400 THE BEARDED STRANGER [Solemn, Gentle]: "You shouldn't have to beg anybody..."
EP03:E90 105900-108800 CAMERA: Close-up on Juliana looking up into his eyes, moved to the core.
EP03:E91 107400-109000 THE BEARDED STRANGER [O.S.) (Affirming, Sincere]: "...to remember your worth."
EP03:E92 108800-110800 CAMERA: Close-up on The Bearded Stranger's rugged, bearded face looking down at her with tender reverence.
EP03:E93 110800-112500 CAMERA: Close-up on Juliana, her lips parting in quiet astonishment.
EP03:E94 110900-112500 LADY JULIANA [Whispering, Bewildered]: "Why are you doing this?"
EP03:E95 112500-114200 CAMERA: Close-up on The Bearded Stranger, completely unfazed.
EP03:E96 112800-114100 THE BEARDED STRANGER [Simple, Certain]: "Because I want to."
EP03:E97 114200-116000 CAMERA: Close-up on Juliana's father wringing his gold ring, eyes heavy with regret.
EP03:E98 116000-117900 CAMERA: Medium shot on The Bearded Stranger slipping his hand into his coat pocket.
EP03:E99 117900-119200 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana watching him with rapt, trembling anticipation.
EP03:E100 119200-121000 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of The Bearded Stranger's rugged fingers holding up a simple, polished silver band.
EP03:E101 119800-122100 THE BEARDED STRANGER [O.S.) (Honorable, Earnest]: "You came here to become a wife."
EP03:E102 121000-123200 CAMERA: Medium shot on The Bearded Stranger extending the ring toward Juliana.
EP03:E103 122500-124200 THE BEARDED STRANGER [Quiet, Resolute]: "They took that from you."
EP03:E104 123200-125100 CAMERA: Over-the-shoulder medium shot past The Bearded Stranger onto Gerald standing petrified and humiliated in the aisle.
EP03:E105 125100-127400 CAMERA: Medium close-up on The Bearded Stranger presenting the ring directly to Juliana.
EP03:E106 125300-127300 THE BEARDED STRANGER [Earnest, Sincere]: "I am offering it back."
EP03:E107 127400-130200 CAMERA: Close-up on Juliana glancing down at the ring, breathless and overwhelmed.
EP03:E108 127700-129900 LADY JULIANA [Soft, Hesitant]: "You don't even know me."
EP03:E109 130200-132700 CAMERA: Close-up on The Bearded Stranger's warm, piercing gaze.
EP03:E110 130400-132000 THE BEARDED STRANGER [Quiet, Steady]: "I know enough."
EP03:E111 132700-135500 CAMERA: Full wide profile shot as The Bearded Stranger slowly and respectfully drops onto one knee before Lady Juliana.
EP03:E112 133200-135500 ACTION: The Bearded Stranger sinks to one knee on the cathedral aisle, offering the silver ring up to Juliana.
EP03:E113 134800-136200 SOUND: A collective, stunned gasp rippling across the entire congregation.
EP03:E114 135500-137300 CAMERA: Medium shot of the Noble Matriarch, Gerald, and the Lady in Gold Gown frozen in sheer, jaw-dropped bewilderment.
EP03:E115 137300-140500 CAMERA: Low-angle medium close-up of The Bearded Stranger on his knee, holding the silver ring high with steady dignity.
EP03:E116 137500-140300 THE BEARDED STRANGER [Solemn, Devoted]: "Lady Juliana... accept my hand."
EP03:E117 140500-145750 CAMERA: Close-up on Juliana looking down at him, fresh tears trailing down her flushed cheeks as a soft, trembling smile of hope touches her lips into a slow fade.
EP03:E118 140500-145750 ACTION: Juliana gazes down at her rugged savior, overcome with emotion as the swelling score holds on the cliffhanger.

messages.content:
EP=ep_004; timestamps are integer milliseconds
SOURCE_SHA256=65f7f9c356a21c86dddfd4808bbdbc65dcd22f0ce220cc2de2cbcdc0371fc51b
METADATA ONLY (not on-screen evidence): {'logline': "Defying Gerald and Clarissa's cruel mockery, Juliana accepts the mysterious scarred warrior's solemn proposal and is officially wed, choosing exile and dignity over her family's cruelty as they walk out into the light together.", 'continuity_notes': "Picks up directly from Episode 3's cliffhanger where the Mysterious Bearded Man dropped to one knee before the altar, presenting a ring to Lady Juliana."}
SOURCE WARNINGS=['sc_001: incomplete source coverage; gaps are unavailable']
SCENE sc_001 0-151400 INT. CHAPEL – CONTINUOUS
EP04:E1 0-1500 CAMERA: Close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man's scarred hand holding out the silver band ring.
EP04:E2 1500-3200 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana, staring down in disbelief at the offered ring.
EP04:E3 1500-3200 ACTION: Juliana's eyes widen, stunned breath catching in her throat.
EP04:E4 3200-5000 CAMERA: Medium shot of Gerald stepping forward from his pew with a smug, sneering grin.
EP04:E5 3400-4900 GERALD [Mocking, Arrogant]: "Look at him."
EP04:E6 5000-7500 CAMERA: Tight close-up of Gerald's venomous, self-satisfied face.
EP04:E7 5000-7500 GERALD [Scornful]: "A penniless nobody for a discarded bride."
EP04:E8 7600-10500 CAMERA: Medium shot of Clarissa covering her mouth with her gloved hand, bursting into cruel laughter.
EP04:E9 7800-9500 ACTION: Clarissa giggles spitefully, lowering her gloved hand to gloat.
EP04:E10 9000-10500 CLARISSA [Gleeful, Condescending]: "How fitting."
EP04:E11 10500-12000 CAMERA: Two-shot of Clarissa and Gerald standing proudly side-by-side in their pew as Clarissa points mocking fingers.
EP04:E12 10600-14200 CLARISSA [Taunting]: "You have finally found a man as worthless as everyone thinks you are."
EP04:E13 12000-15000 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana's side profile, hurt glistening in her eyes as the insult cuts deep.
EP04:E14 15000-17500 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana looking up toward the high arches of the chapel, drawing inward strength.
EP04:E15 15500-17500 ACTION: Juliana closes her eyes briefly and releases a steadying breath.
EP04:E16 17500-21800 CAMERA: Low-angle shot looking past the kneeling Mysterious Bearded Man up at Juliana.
EP04:E17 20000-21800 JULIANA [Vulnerable, Trembling]: "You don't even know me."
EP04:E18 21900-23400 CAMERA: Close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man gazing upward with unwavering earnestness.
EP04:E19 23400-25800 CAMERA: Tight close-up of Juliana's anguished face.
EP04:E20 23500-25800 JULIANA [Conflicted, Pained]: "You heard what they think I am."
EP04:E21 25800-27900 CAMERA: Medium shot looking down as Juliana addresses the kneeling stranger directly.
EP04:E22 25900-27700 JULIANA [Searching]: "Why would you offer me your name?"
EP04:E23 27900-30500 CAMERA: Low-angle close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man.
EP04:E24 28000-30200 MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN [Grave, Certain]: "Because I know what I see."
EP04:E25 30500-32000 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana reacting with a mix of suspicion and wonder.
EP04:E26 32000-33800 CAMERA: Intimate tight shot framing Juliana's profile beside his dark silhouette.
EP04:E27 32100-33700 JULIANA [Quiet, Hesitant]: "And what do you see?"
EP04:E28 33800-36000 CAMERA: Medium close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man.
EP04:E29 34000-36000 MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN [Firm, Sincere]: "A woman who was betrayed."
EP04:E30 36000-38900 CAMERA: Over-the-shoulder shot past the bearded warrior toward Gerald watching nervously from the family pew.
EP04:E31 36500-38800 MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN [Resolute]: "Not a woman who deserves to be discarded."
EP04:E32 38900-41500 CAMERA: Low-angle medium shot of Juliana bending slightly forward, shaken by his words.
EP04:E33 41500-45000 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana.
EP04:E34 42000-44800 JULIANA [Soft, Bitter]: "You don't know what my family has done to me."
EP04:E35 45000-49800 CAMERA: Low-angle shot of the Mysterious Bearded Man still on one knee, framed against the stained-glass window.
EP04:E36 46000-48800 MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN [Solemn]: "I know they have made you stand alone."
EP04:E37 49800-52800 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of the ring held in his weathered fingers, Juliana's white silk gown blurred in background.
EP04:E38 50000-52500 MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN [Gentle]: "You don't have to stand alone now."
EP04:E39 52800-55800 CAMERA: Medium shot of Juliana, her pride flaring through her sadness.
EP04:E40 53600-55800 JULIANA [Defiant, Dignified]: "If this is pity, take back your ring."
EP04:E41 55800-59000 CAMERA: Tight close-up on Juliana's face, a tear clinging to her cheek.
EP04:E42 56800-58800 JULIANA [Fierce]: "I will not become anyone's charity."
EP04:E43 59000-62800 CAMERA: Medium close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man holding her gaze directly.
EP04:E44 59500-62500 MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN [Earnest]: "It is not pity, Lady Juliana."
EP04:E45 62800-65800 CAMERA: Intense tight close-up on his piercing blue-green eyes and facial scars.
EP04:E46 63500-65500 MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN [Deep, Absolute]: "It is a vow."
EP04:E47 65800-67500 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana, completely disarmed by the gravity of his promise.
EP04:E48 66000-68000 JULIANA [V.O.]: "I don't know this man."
EP04:E49 67500-69500 CAMERA: Medium shot of Lady Ashcroft, Clarissa, and Lord Ashcroft seated coldly in the family pew.
EP04:E50 68000-69600 JULIANA [V.O.]: "I don't know what waits beyond these doors."
EP04:E51 69500-71800 CAMERA: Side profile close-up of Juliana looking toward her estranged family, then turning back.
EP04:E52 69800-72000 JULIANA [V.O.]: "But he looked at me when everyone else turned away."
EP04:E53 71800-74800 CAMERA: Medium shot of Juliana facing down at him, a faint, tender smile breaking across her lips.
EP04:E54 72800-74500 JULIANA [Resolved]: "Then I accept."
EP04:E55 74800-76200 CAMERA: Wide shot of the altar with the high cathedral stained glass overhead as the Priest looks on between them.
EP04:E56 76200-79000 CAMERA: Medium shot of the Mysterious Bearded Man rising smoothly to his feet before Juliana.
EP04:E57 76200-79000 ACTION: The Mysterious Bearded Man stands tall, extending his scarred hand toward Juliana.
EP04:E58 79000-81800 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana's slender hand resting gently into his large, weathered palm.
EP04:E59 79200-81500 ACTION: He folds his fingers over hers, holding her hand with protective firmness.
EP04:E60 81800-84000 CAMERA: Medium close-up of the Priest holding his open liturgical book, bewildered and trembling.
EP04:E61 82000-83800 THE PRIEST [Hesitant, Anxious]: "My- My Lady..."
EP04:E62 84000-86000 CAMERA: Tight close-up of the Priest's alarmed, questioning eyes.
EP04:E63 84000-85800 THE PRIEST [Tentative]: "Are you certain?"
EP04:E64 86000-88800 CAMERA: Medium shot of Lord Ashcroft seated in his pew, gripping his cane, bowed in grim silence.
EP04:E65 88800-91500 CAMERA: Close-up profile of Juliana, her expression clear and unshakable.
EP04:E66 89800-91000 JULIANA [Unwavering]: "I am."
EP04:E67 91500-94800 CAMERA: Medium close-up of the Priest swallowing hard and looking down at his book.
EP04:E68 92000-94500 THE PRIEST [Resigned, Solemn]: "Then... let us proceed."
EP04:E69 94800-97800 CAMERA: Close two-shot of the Mysterious Bearded Man and Juliana gazing intimately into each other's eyes.
EP04:E70 95800-98000 MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN [Low, Reassuring]: "You need not say anything you do not mean."
EP04:E71 97800-100200 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana smiling softly up at him.
EP04:E72 98200-100000 JULIANA [Warm, Sincere]: "I truly mean it."
EP04:E73 100200-102200 CAMERA: Close-up shot of his hands sliding the silver ring over her ring finger.
EP04:E74 100200-102200 ACTION: The Mysterious Bearded Man carefully slides the band onto Juliana's finger.
EP04:E75 102200-105000 CAMERA: Medium close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man holding her hands tenderly.
EP04:E76 102500-104200 MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN [Solemn]: "You have my protection."
EP04:E77 105000-107800 CAMERA: Tight shot of the warrior's face, his eyes full of devotion.
EP04:E78 105200-107000 MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN [Steadfast]: "You have my respect."
EP04:E79 107800-110000 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of his intense gaze.
EP04:E80 107800-109800 MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN [Grave]: "And you have my word."
EP04:E81 110000-112800 CAMERA: Medium three-shot with the Priest standing between them, raising both hands in blessing over their joined hands.
EP04:E82 110000-113000 THE PRIEST [Ceremonial]: "By the authority entrusted to me, I now pronounce you..."
EP04:E83 112800-114800 CAMERA: High wide establishing shot looking down from the ceiling vaults of the cathedral onto the altar.
EP04:E84 113000-114800 THE PRIEST [Off-Screen, Booming]: "...husband and wife!"
EP04:E85 114000-115200 SOUND: Dramatic musical chord swelling.
EP04:E86 114800-116800 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Gerald lunging forward, pointing an enraged finger.
EP04:E87 115000-116800 GERALD [Furious, Shouting]: "You have thrown yourself away!"
EP04:E88 116800-119000 CAMERA: Tight close-up of Gerald, face contorted in rage.
EP04:E89 117000-119000 GERALD [Livid]: "For a penniless nobody!"
EP04:E90 119000-122800 CAMERA: Medium two-shot of Juliana standing tall before Gerald in the chapel aisle, her husband standing guard behind her.
EP04:E91 120500-122800 JULIANA [Calm, Cutting]: "I would rather choose my own life..."
EP04:E92 122800-125800 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana, her jaw set with unshakable pride.
EP04:E93 123000-125500 JULIANA [Firm, Final]: "...than spend another moment begging for yours."
EP04:E94 125800-127400 CAMERA: Tight close-up of Gerald, eyes wide with speechless shock and wounded pride.
EP04:E95 126000-127400 ACTION: Gerald recoils slightly, mouth agape.
EP04:E96 127400-131500 CAMERA: Wide shot of Lady Ashcroft rising abruptly from the front pew, pointing an accusatory hand toward the doors.
EP04:E97 127500-131500 LADY ASHCROFT [Imperious, Shouting]: "Do not bring this man anywhere near Ashcroft Manor!"
EP04:E98 131500-134800 CAMERA: Tight close-up of Lady Ashcroft, eyes blazing with cold malice.
EP04:E99 132000-134500 LADY ASHCROFT [Venomous]: "You are disowned!"
EP04:E100 134800-136000 CAMERA: Medium shot of Lord Ashcroft bowing his head deeply over his cane in shame.
EP04:E101 136000-138800 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana. Tears brim in her eyes at the formal rejection, but she does not break.
EP04:E102 138800-140800 CAMERA: Medium two-shot as the Mysterious Bearded Man turns gently to Juliana, reaching his hand out once more.
EP04:E103 139500-140800 MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN [Soft, Protective]: "Come, Lady Juliana."
EP04:E104 140800-142800 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana placing her hand securely into his, gripping his scarred hand.
EP04:E105 142800-144800 CAMERA: Wide tracking shot behind Juliana and the warrior as they begin walking down the central aisle toward the chapel doors.
EP04:E106 144800-146500 CAMERA: Medium three-shot of Gerald, Clarissa, and Lady Ashcroft watching in stunned silence and disbelief.
EP04:E107 145000-146500 ACTION: Clarissa gapes in shock while Lady Ashcroft exhales in exasperation.
EP04:E108 146500-151400 CAMERA: Wide shot from the back of the chapel as the massive oak doors swing wide open, revealing bright daylight and the courtyard outside.
EP04:E109 147500-151400 ACTION: Juliana and the Mysterious Bearded Man walk hand-in-hand through the towering doors into the sunlight together, turning their backs on the ruined wedding as the screen fades out.
EP04:E110 147000-149000 SOUND: Heavy oak doors creaking open, followed by a triumphant musical swell fading out into silence.

messages.content:
EP=ep_005; timestamps are integer milliseconds
SOURCE_SHA256=0dc648aeee02b1eebdd200144e70386f1dd101e820f96e3a5da65b527a43c9db
METADATA ONLY (not on-screen evidence): {'logline': "Formally disowned and stripped of her inheritance, Juliana is publicly humiliated when her stepmother throws her late mother's treasured ledger into the mud, but her rugged new husband defends her dignity and guides her away from her callous family.", 'continuity_notes': "Follows directly from Episode 4's ending where Juliana and the Mysterious Bearded Man walked out of the chapel doors into the daylight after completing their wedding vows."}
SOURCE WARNINGS=['sc_001: incomplete source coverage; gaps are unavailable']
SCENE sc_001 0-110500 EXT. CATHEDRAL STEPS – DAY
EP05:E1 0-2500 CAMERA: Close-up on Lady Juliana's hands clutching an ancient, brass-bound leather ledger against the skirt of her white wedding gown as she walks.
EP05:E2 0-2500 ACTION: Juliana grips the heirloom ledger tightly against her waist, her posture resolute despite the tension.
EP05:E3 2500-6000 CAMERA: Wide shot tracking Juliana and the Mysterious Bearded Man descending the grand stone steps of the cathedral courtyard. Behind them, Lord Ashcroft emerges from the vaulted doorway leaning on his cane.
EP05:E4 4200-5800 LORD ASHCROFT [Stern, Commanding]: "Miss Ashcroft."
EP05:E5 5500-6600 ACTION: Juliana and the Mysterious Bearded Man pause on the stone steps, turning slightly back toward Lord Ashcroft.
EP05:E6 6600-10500 CAMERA: Close-up of Lord Ashcroft, his weathered face rigid with aristocratic pride and disgust.
EP05:E7 6800-10400 LORD ASHCROFT [Cold, Condemnatory]: "You will not leave this church carrying the Ashcroft name."
EP05:E8 10500-15800 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana looking up at her father. Her hand rises to touch the amethyst heirloom pendant resting at her throat.
EP05:E9 11700-15500 JULIANA [Defiant, Steadfast]: "The vows are spoken, Father. I am his wife now."
EP05:E10 15800-20800 CAMERA: Medium shot of Lord Ashcroft standing rigid outside the chapel archway, unforgiving and unyielding.
EP05:E11 16000-18000 LORD ASHCROFT [Harsh, Final]: "Then leave as his wife."
EP05:E12 18500-20800 LORD ASHCROFT [Harsh, Final]: "You leave as no daughter of mine."
EP05:E13 20800-25000 CAMERA: Low-angle shot tracking Lord Ashcroft's polished black boots as he slowly descends the stone steps toward them.
EP05:E14 21000-23000 LORD ASHCROFT [O.S. / Continues]: "Your dowry is revoked."
EP05:E15 23100-25100 LORD ASHCROFT [O.S. / Continues]: "Your inheritance is revoked."
EP05:E16 25000-29000 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana, her eyes wide with shock and heartbreak as she holds the ledger close against her chest.
EP05:E17 25400-28900 LORD ASHCROFT [O.S. / Continues]: "From this moment, you are dead to the Ashcroft family."
EP05:E18 29500-33400 JULIANA [Shaking, Tearful]: "You truly mean it? You are my father!"
EP05:E19 33500-36500 CAMERA: Close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man, observing Lord Ashcroft with an unblinking, quietly threatening stare.
EP05:E20 33800-36800 LORD ASHCROFT [O.S.]: "And you have chosen to become a stranger."
EP05:E21 36500-41500 CAMERA: Profile medium two-shot of Juliana and Lord Ashcroft standing face-to-face against the backdrop of the towering gothic facade.
EP05:E22 37600-41500 JULIANA [Quietly Resolute]: "No, Father. You chose that long before today."
EP05:E23 41500-46000 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Lady Ashcroft, resplendent in navy velvet and jewels, stepping forward with a smirk of malicious authority.
EP05:E24 42500-44200 LADY ASHCROFT [Sharply Dismissive]: "Enough sentiment."
EP05:E25 44300-45800 LADY ASHCROFT [Cold, Demanding]: "And the ledger..."
EP05:E26 46000-48800 CAMERA: Medium shot as Lady Ashcroft approaches Juliana menacingly.
EP05:E27 46800-48800 LADY ASHCROFT [Venomous]: "...that belongs to this family."
EP05:E28 49000-51800 JULIANA [Alarmed, Protective]: "It belonged to my mother! It is all I have left of her."
EP05:E29 51800-54000 CAMERA: Close-up of Lady Ashcroft laying a jeweled hand firmly on the bound book.
EP05:E30 52000-54000 LADY ASHCROFT [Cruel]: "Then you should have guarded it better."
EP05:E31 54000-57800 CAMERA: Close-up on the ledger as Lady Ashcroft violently wrenches it out of Juliana's grip.
EP05:E32 54500-57500 ACTION: Lady Ashcroft snatches the heavy book away and flings it disdainfully into the rain-soaked courtyard.
EP05:E33 55500-56800 JULIANA [Screaming, Desperate]: "Barbara, don't!"
EP05:E34 57000-58200 SOUND: A heavy wet slap as the leather-bound book crashes into the puddle-slicked stone pavement.
EP05:E35 57800-63000 CAMERA: Medium shot of Clarissa and Gerald standing together on the cathedral steps. Clarissa clasps a gloved hand to her mouth in mock shock before bursting into gleeful laughter.
EP05:E36 59000-62500 CLARISSA [Gleeful, Mocking]: "Even your mother's precious legacy has been cast into the dirt!"
EP05:E37 62400-64600 GERALD [Smug, Cruel]: "Perhaps that is where it belongs."
EP05:E38 63000-66500 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana looking down at the ground, tears streaming down her pale cheeks.
EP05:E39 65500-68500 ACTION: Juliana drops to her knees onto the wet courtyard pavement, oblivious to the dirt soaking through her white bridal gown.
EP05:E40 66500-69000 CAMERA: Low-angle close-up of Juliana's trembling hand reaching toward the leather ledger resting in the puddle.
EP05:E41 69000-72500 CAMERA: Wide shot of Juliana kneeling on the damp ground as the tall Mysterious Bearded Man strides purposefully into frame toward her.
EP05:E42 70500-74500 ACTION: The Mysterious Bearded Man bends his knees and kneels down beside Juliana, extending his scarred hand to retrieve the fallen ledger.
EP05:E43 74500-76000 CAMERA: Close-up of his large, weathered hands gently lifting the wet, embossed leather book from the ground.
EP05:E44 76000-80000 CAMERA: Medium two-shot as he holds out the retrieved ledger and places it into Juliana's trembling hands.
EP05:E45 77800-79000 MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN [Low, Gentle]: "Here you go."
EP05:E46 80000-85500 CAMERA: Close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man looking warmly down at Juliana, his rugged face full of quiet sincerity.
EP05:E47 80500-82000 JULIANA [Choked, Weeping]: "They destroyed it."
EP05:E48 82500-85400 MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN [Calm, Grounded]: "They dirtied it. That is not the same thing."
EP05:E49 85500-91000 CAMERA: Medium two-shot of Juliana pressing the soiled book tightly against her chest, weeping softly.
EP05:E50 86500-87800 JULIANA [Broken]: "It was my mother's."
EP05:E51 87900-89000 MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN [Gentle, Protective]: "Then keep it."
EP05:E52 88500-91000 ACTION: The Mysterious Bearded Man reaches out with both hands, clasping his strong hands tenderly over hers and the book.
EP05:E53 89400-91000 MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN [Firm, Comforting]: "Let them keep everything else."
EP05:E54 91000-96500 CAMERA: Low-angle shot of Gerald standing high on the stone steps, grinning arrogantly as he points an accusatory finger down at them.
EP05:E55 91500-92800 GERALD [Mocking, Arrogant]: "Look at you."
EP05:E56 93000-96500 GERALD [Scornful, Spiteful]: "A noblewoman reduced to a beggar's wife!"
EP05:E57 96500-101500 CAMERA: Over-the-shoulder shot behind the Mysterious Bearded Man looking up toward Gerald on the stairs. Gerald's arrogant grin slowly wavers.
EP05:E58 98000-100800 MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN [Low, Lethally Cold]: "Choose your next words carefully."
EP05:E59 101500-105500 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man's scarred hand completely covering and protecting Juliana's hands where they clasp the book.
EP05:E60 104200-105200 MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN [Soft, Reassuring]: "Come."
EP05:E61 105500-110500 CAMERA: High wide shot from above the courtyard archway. Juliana, holding her mother's book, and the Mysterious Bearded Man, holding her hand firmly, walk together down the wet cobblestone path and through the towering iron gates into the misty rain, leaving her former family behind as the screen fades out.
EP05:E62 106000-110500 SOUND: Rain gently pattering on cobblestones beneath a sweeping, melancholic orchestral swell that slowly fades to black.

messages.content:
EP=ep_006; timestamps are integer milliseconds
SOURCE_SHA256=11131c5019b2c7021f376b17cfd99d6c876b8594da0ea4fe5abffda6f4db19de
METADATA ONLY (not on-screen evidence): {'logline': "Seeking shelter from the cold rain, Juliana arrives at her new husband's modest woodland cottage and discovers an unexpected sense of peace beside the hearth.", 'continuity_notes': 'Picks up immediately from Episode 5, as Juliana and her mysterious new husband leave the Ashcroft estate behind and venture out into the rainy countryside.'}
SOURCE WARNINGS=[]
SCENE sc_001 0-33700 EXT. WOODLAND PATH – NIGHT
EP06:E1 0-2300 CAMERA: Medium full tracking shot of Juliana and the Mysterious Bearded Man trudging along a muddy, rain-soaked path in the dark woods.
EP06:E2 0-3400 ACTION: Juliana lifts the hem of her white satin wedding gown to keep it out of the pooling mud, shivering under her dark hooded cloak.
EP06:E3 2300-3500 CAMERA: Close-up on Juliana's wet hand clutching her muddy dress.
EP06:E4 2300-6500 SOUND: Heavy rain pouring through dense tree canopies with steady footfalls on wet earth.
EP06:E5 3500-4200 CAMERA: Upward shot through the dripping, silhouetted branches into the stormy night sky.
EP06:E6 4200-7100 CAMERA: Medium two-shot framing Juliana and the Mysterious Bearded Man as they pause in the misty woods.
EP06:E7 4500-7100 ACTION: Juliana turns back toward him, water glistening on her face and hair.
EP06:E8 7100-9900 CAMERA: Close-up on the Mysterious Bearded Man, his dark hair soaked and rain running down the scars on his cheek.
EP06:E9 7200-9850 MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN [Solemn, Gentle]: "I know this is not the life you came from."
EP06:E10 9900-14900 CAMERA: Close-up on Juliana looking up into the rain, exhaling a soft breath of resignation.
EP06:E11 10100-11200 JULIANA [Quiet, Melancholic]: "No."
EP06:E12 11300-13000 ACTION: Juliana looks upward into the canopy, gathering herself with a faint nod.
EP06:E13 13400-14600 JULIANA [Resigned, Soft]: "It isn't."
EP06:E14 14900-17200 CAMERA: Medium close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man, gazing down at her with quiet remorse.
EP06:E15 15200-18200 MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN [Guilt-ridden]: "You should not have had to walk through this rain tonight."
EP06:E16 17200-18300 CAMERA: Close-up on Juliana's bodice and mother's pendant as she gathers her cloak closer.
EP06:E17 18300-21000 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana's face, offering a wistful, comforting smile.
EP06:E18 18500-20900 JULIANA [Faintly Ironic, Resilient]: "I suppose the day was already ruined."
EP06:E19 21000-24000 CAMERA: Extreme close-up on the Mysterious Bearded Man's piercing eyes, touched by her lack of bitterness.
EP06:E20 24000-26100 CAMERA: Wide establishing shot through tree branches showing a secluded, rustic stone cottage nestled among the misty trees.
EP06:E21 24500-26100 ACTION: They walk forward toward the cottage emerging from the dark woods.
EP06:E22 26100-27900 CAMERA: Medium close-up on Juliana's face, wide-eyed with realization.
EP06:E23 26500-27700 JULIANA [Surprised, Hesitant]: "That is it?"
EP06:E24 27900-29200 CAMERA: Medium close-up on the Mysterious Bearded Man.
EP06:E25 28100-29000 MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN [Low]: "Yes."
EP06:E26 29200-30100 CAMERA: Upward shot of rain pelting through the thick treetops.
EP06:E27 29200-30500 SOUND: Sudden distant rumble of thunder echoing across the forest.
EP06:E28 30100-33000 CAMERA: Medium shot as Juliana hikes her skirt and begins walking briskly toward the cottage door.
EP06:E29 30150-33150 JULIANA [Determined, Defiant]: "At least no one there will be waiting to humiliate me."
EP06:E30 33000-33700 CAMERA: Close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man watching her march ahead, his expression solemn and deeply reflective.
SCENE sc_002 33700-115000 INT. WOODEN CABIN – CONTINUOUS
EP06:E31 33700-36700 ACTION: The heavy wooden cottage door creaks open. Juliana steps across the threshold into the dark, barren room.
EP06:E32 33800-36500 SOUND: Door hinges groaning open followed by the hollow thump of footsteps on wet wood floorboards.
EP06:E33 36700-37700 CAMERA: Close-up overhead shot of a wooden bucket catching raindrops dripping steadily from a leak in the ceiling.
EP06:E34 36700-40000 SOUND: Rhythmic water drips plinking into the metal-rimmed wooden bucket.
EP06:E35 37700-40000 CAMERA: Medium wide shot past the drip bucket as the Mysterious Bearded Man closes the door behind them.
EP06:E36 40000-42000 CAMERA: Medium close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man standing in the dim light by the door.
EP06:E37 40700-41900 MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN [Humble, Apologetic]: "I am sorry."
EP06:E38 42000-43300 CAMERA: Medium shot of Juliana gazing around the rustic interior, taking in the sparse surroundings.
EP06:E39 43300-46400 CAMERA: Medium close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man looking at her with somber honesty.
EP06:E40 43600-45000 MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN [Grave, Sincere]: "You came from comfort."
EP06:E41 45100-47300 MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN [Grave, Sincere]: "This is all I can give you now."
EP06:E42 46400-48800 CAMERA: Medium shot of Juliana undoing the ribbon tie of her black cloak and letting it slide off her shoulders.
EP06:E43 46600-49000 ACTION: Juliana removes her dark cloak, revealing her damp white bridal dress underneath.
EP06:E44 48800-51100 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana's hand pressing against the cold, condensation-fogged windowpane.
EP06:E45 51100-54800 CAMERA: Side profile shot of Juliana looking out the rain-streaked window into the quiet forest.
EP06:E46 51300-52700 JULIANA [Gentle, Peaceful]: "It is quiet."
EP06:E47 53300-54600 JULIANA [Gentle, Peaceful]: "Very quiet."
EP06:E48 54800-56200 CAMERA: Over-the-shoulder shot from behind Juliana looking at the Mysterious Bearded Man watching her attentively.
EP06:E49 56200-58200 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana turning back toward him, a soft, genuine smile illuminating her face.
EP06:E50 56400-58000 JULIANA [Earnest, Content]: "I think I like that."
EP06:E51 58200-59800 CAMERA: Close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man, slightly surprised by her reaction.
EP06:E52 58400-60000 MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN [Incredulous]: "You are not disappointed?"
EP06:E53 59800-61300 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana meeting his gaze honestly.
EP06:E54 60300-61300 JULIANA [Direct, Soft]: "I am."
EP06:E55 61300-64100 CAMERA: Over-the-shoulder shot behind Juliana as the Mysterious Bearded Man listens intently.
EP06:E56 61900-64100 JULIANA [Warm, Reassuring]: "But not because of you."
EP06:E57 64100-66600 CAMERA: Medium shot as Juliana grabs a rag from the rustic wooden table and begins briskly scrubbing the damp surface.
EP06:E58 64300-66800 JULIANA [Determined, Practical]: "If this is our home, I want it clean."
EP06:E59 66600-67800 CAMERA: Medium shot of the Mysterious Bearded Man stepping forward to intervene gently.
EP06:E60 66700-68700 MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN [Caring, Tender]: "You don't have to do that tonight."
EP06:E61 67800-69500 CAMERA: Close-up on Juliana's hands vigorously scrubbing grime from the wooden tabletop.
EP06:E62 69500-72100 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana's face, her voice catching with raw, suppressed emotion as she scrubs.
EP06:E63 70100-73200 JULIANA [Vulnerable, Trembling]: "If I stop now, I will think about everything I lost."
EP06:E64 72100-74300 CAMERA: Full shot of the Mysterious Bearded Man standing motionless, his gaze filled with empathy and understanding.
EP06:E65 74300-76800 ACTION: Instead of stopping her, the Mysterious Bearded Man kneels beside the table and begins inspecting and adjusting the wobbly table leg to help.
EP06:E66 74300-76800 CAMERA: Medium low shot of the Mysterious Bearded Man kneeling beside Juliana as she wipes the table.
EP06:E67 76800-77800 ACTION: Juliana picks up a straw broom and sweeps the stone floor in front of the stone hearth.
EP06:E68 76800-77800 CAMERA: Wide shot of Juliana sweeping dust toward the large stone fireplace.
EP06:E69 77800-81000 ACTION: The Mysterious Bearded Man carries a heavy wooden log across the room and places it onto the iron grate in the hearth.
EP06:E70 77800-81000 CAMERA: Tracking shot following the Mysterious Bearded Man as he sets the firewood into the stone fireplace.
EP06:E71 81000-83800 ACTION: He strikes flint and steel together over dry kindling, igniting bright sparks that catch into a flickering flame.
EP06:E72 81000-83800 CAMERA: Extreme close-up on hands striking flint, sparks showering onto the twigs and catching fire.
EP06:E73 83800-85000 CAMERA: Medium close-up of vibrant orange flames rapidly spreading across the dry logs, crackling warmly.
EP06:E74 83800-90000 SOUND: Crisp crackling and snapping of dry wood catching fire in the hearth.
EP06:E75 85000-87500 CAMERA: Medium shot of Juliana standing by the table, broom resting against her hip, bathed in the amber firelight.
EP06:E76 87500-89800 ACTION: The Mysterious Bearded Man stands up from the hearth, dusting his hands on his coat.
EP06:E77 87500-89800 CAMERA: Medium shot of the Mysterious Bearded Man rising before the blazing fireplace.
EP06:E78 89000-89800 MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN [Relieved]: "There."
EP06:E79 89800-91700 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana looking at him with radiant gratitude and a gentle smile.
EP06:E80 91700-93800 CAMERA: Medium close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man gesturing faintly to the modest room.
EP06:E81 92100-93600 MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN [Quiet, Modest]: "It is not much."
EP06:E82 93800-95800 CAMERA: Medium shot of Juliana kneeling on the stone floor before the blazing hearth, wrapping her dark cloak around her shoulders.
EP06:E83 94200-96200 JULIANA [Soft, Comforted]: "It is enough for tonight."
EP06:E84 95800-98200 CAMERA: Wide shot framing the roaring hearth fire between them as the Mysterious Bearded Man crouches down beside her on the stone floor.
EP06:E85 98200-101000 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana pulling her cloak tighter, her face glowing warmly in the firelight.
EP06:E86 98400-100400 JULIANA [V.O.) (Reflective, Vulnerable]: "I lost my home today."
EP06:E87 100600-101800 JULIANA [V.O.) (Reflective, Vulnerable]: "My family."
EP06:E88 101000-103000 CAMERA: Close-up of the glowing embers and dancing flames inside the fireplace.
EP06:E89 102000-104800 JULIANA [V.O.) (Reflective, Vulnerable]: "Everything I thought my life would be."
EP06:E90 103000-104300 CAMERA: Close-up on the Mysterious Bearded Man's scarred, work-worn hands resting quietly on his knees.
EP06:E91 104300-106000 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana looking down into the flames, a peaceful serenity washing over her features.
EP06:E92 105000-106000 JULIANA [V.O.) (Gentle, Surprised]: "And yet..."
EP06:E93 106000-109000 CAMERA: Extreme close-up on the Mysterious Bearded Man's profile, his scarred cheek illuminated by the amber glow as he watches over her protectively.
EP06:E94 106200-109000 JULIANA [V.O.) (Tender, Safe]: "Sitting here with him, I don't feel afraid."
EP06:E95 109000-111500 CAMERA: Close-up on Juliana looking up into the room with quiet hope in her blue eyes.
EP06:E96 111500-115000 CAMERA: Close-up on the crackling flames and glowing embers of the fireplace, slowly fading to black as the music swells warmly.
EP06:E97 111500-115000 SOUND: Warm hearth crackles blending with gentle string music fading out.

EP=ep_007; timestamps are integer milliseconds
SOURCE_SHA256=d6125d1e308e9ea7993e1e22a4452e1f940bc384a13b621acdb5b3709bf96494
METADATA ONLY (not on-screen evidence): {'logline': "When Gerald and his spiteful companion arrive at the woodland cottage to mock Juliana's fallen status, her stoic new husband returns from the forest to silently send them fleeing.", 'continuity_notes': 'Follows Episode 6, where Juliana found refuge and warmth beside the hearth with her mysterious husband; morning brings unwelcome visitors from her former life to their humble doorstep.'}
SOURCE WARNINGS=['sc_003: incomplete source coverage; gaps are unavailable']
SCENE sc_001 0-69500 EXT. WOODLAND COTTAGE - DAY
EP07:E1 0-4800 CAMERA: Medium shot of Juliana kneeling on the cold, damp ground outside the stone cottage, pulling weeds from the dirt with her bare hands.
EP07:E2 0-4800 ACTION: Juliana, dressed in her simple grey long-sleeved gown, works tirelessly with soil caked beneath her fingernails.
EP07:E3 4800-11800 CAMERA: Low-angle tracking shot as an ornate black-and-gold carriage with crest emblazoned on the door rolls to a stop on the muddy path outside the gate.
EP07:E4 5000-11500 SOUND: Heavy carriage wheels grinding in mud, horse snorts, and rhythmic hoofbeats halting.
EP07:E5 11800-15000 CAMERA: Medium shot as Aristocratic Woman steps out of the carriage into the misty air, shielding herself under an intricate lace parasol in an elegant lavender gown.
EP07:E6 15000-19500 CAMERA: Gerald steps down from the carriage behind her, looking immaculate in a high-collared navy frock coat, white waistcoat, and dark cravat.
EP07:E7 19500-21000 ACTION: Aristocratic Woman smirks cruelly as she surveys the humble stone cottage.
EP07:E8 21000-24000 ACTION: Juliana rinses the heavy mud from her hands in a cold rainwater puddle and rises to her feet, holding her head high.
EP07:E9 22000-24500 ARISTOCRATIC WOMAN [Mocking, Condescending]: "This is where you live now?"
EP07:E10 24500-29800 CAMERA: Medium shot of Gerald standing beside Aristocratic Woman, sneering disdainfully.
EP07:E11 25000-29800 GERALD [Arrogant, Scornful]: "A fitting home for a woman who threw away everything for a penniless soldier."
EP07:E12 29800-32800 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana, defiant and unflinching despite her soiled dress and damp hair.
EP07:E13 30000-32600 JULIANA [Sharp, Unintimidated]: "You came all this way just to insult my home?"
EP07:E14 32800-37500 CAMERA: Close-up of Aristocratic Woman erupting into high-pitched, malicious laughter beneath her parasol.
EP07:E15 33200-37800 ARISTOCRATIC WOMAN [Gloating, Mocking]: "Home? Look at your hands, Juliana."
EP07:E16 37800-39800 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana's mud-stained palms held open against her apron.
EP07:E17 38200-39800 ARISTOCRATIC WOMAN [O.S.) (Cruel]: "You look like a servant."
EP07:E18 39800-41000 CAMERA: Close-up of Gerald's smug expression watching Juliana.
EP07:E19 41000-45000 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana lifting her chin with unwavering dignity.
EP07:E20 41200-44800 JULIANA [Proud, Resolute]: "I work with my hands. There is no shame in that."
EP07:E21 45000-47000 CAMERA: Close-up on Gerald's tightening jaw.
EP07:E22 45200-46800 GERALD [Biting, Condescending]: "You were born a lady."
EP07:E23 47000-50800 CAMERA: Close-up on Juliana's clear blue eyes, shining with unbroken pride.
EP07:E24 48800-50400 JULIANA [Firm, Unapologetic]: "And I remain one."
EP07:E25 50800-54800 CAMERA: Wide shot framing Juliana facing off against Gerald and Aristocratic Woman in the bleak courtyard.
EP07:E26 51500-54600 GERALD [Bitter, Sneering]: "You chose that scarred beggar over a life of comfort."
EP07:E27 54800-61500 CAMERA: Two-shot profile of Juliana looking straight into Gerald's eyes without flinching.
EP07:E28 57800-61000 JULIANA [Passionate, Defiant]: "I chose a man who stood beside me when you walked away."
EP07:E29 61500-65200 CAMERA: Intense close-up of Juliana dismissing him with utter contempt.
EP07:E30 61800-64800 JULIANA [Cold, Commanding]: "You have no authority here. Leave."
EP07:E31 65200-69500 CAMERA: Close-up of Gerald lunging forward, aggressively pointing his finger into Juliana's face.
EP07:E32 65600-68500 GERALD [Furious, Threatening]: "I have enough influence to make a beggar disappear."
EP07:E33 68600-69500 GERALD [Spiteful, Boastful]: "And your husband?"
SCENE sc_002 69500-75500 EXT. FOREST PATH - CONTINUOUS
EP07:E34 69500-74000 CAMERA: Wide shot down a dark, fog-drenched forest path. A towering, shadowed figure walks steadily forward through the mist.
EP07:E35 69500-71200 GERALD [V.O.) (Snarl]: "Where is that beggar husband?"
EP07:E36 70000-75500 ACTION: The Scarred Bearded Man marches purposefully toward the cottage, carrying a heavy bundle of chopped firewood bound tightly with hemp cord.
EP07:E37 74000-75500 CAMERA: Medium tracking shot pushing in on the Scarred Bearded Man's stern, rugged face as he approaches the gate.
SCENE sc_003 75500-116000 EXT. WOODLAND COTTAGE - CONTINUOUS
EP07:E38 75500-78500 CAMERA: Low shot of the Scarred Bearded Man bending down and dropping the bundle of logs by the stone wall.
EP07:E39 76200-77500 SOUND: A dull, heavy thud of timber striking the mud.
EP07:E40 78500-81000 CAMERA: Medium full shot as the Scarred Bearded Man straightens to his full imposing height and steps directly toward Gerald.
EP07:E41 81000-83500 CAMERA: Two-shot framing the Scarred Bearded Man towering menacingly over Gerald, staring down at him with unyielding intensity.
EP07:E42 81500-84000 ACTION: Gerald freezes, his arrogant bravado instantly vanishing as cold dread overtakes his face.
EP07:E43 83500-88000 CAMERA: Low-angle close-up of Gerald looking up in sheer terror, his adam's apple bobbing nervously.
EP07:E44 86500-88500 ARISTOCRATIC WOMAN [O.S.) (Urgent, Annoyed]: "Gerald, don't let him frighten you."
EP07:E45 88600-90000 GERALD [Trembling, Trying to Save Face]: "What are you staring at?"
EP07:E46 90000-91500 ACTION: Gerald rapidly turns on his heel toward the carriage, unwilling to face another second of the silent glare.
EP07:E47 90100-91400 GERALD [Nervous, Hurried]: "We are leaving."
EP07:E48 91500-93800 CAMERA: Medium shot of Aristocratic Woman, shocked and indignant as Gerald flees past her.
EP07:E49 92000-93800 ARISTOCRATIC WOMAN [Outraged, Flustered]: "Leaving? Gerald!"
EP07:E50 93800-96500 ACTION: Aristocratic Woman scrambles back into the carriage, hiking up her gown in a fluster before slamming the door shut.
EP07:E51 95000-96000 SOUND: Carriage door slamming shut.
EP07:E52 96000-99000 CAMERA: Wide shot of the carriage rapidly jolting forward and disappearing down the misty road away from the cottage.
EP07:E53 99000-103500 CAMERA: Medium profile two-shot of Juliana turning toward the Scarred Bearded Man, her eyes gleaming with genuine admiration.
EP07:E54 100800-103200 JULIANA [Impressed, Softly Amused]: "You didn't say a word."
EP07:E55 103500-107500 CAMERA: Close-up on the Scarred Bearded Man looking down at her, his rugged features softening with quiet affection.
EP07:E56 106000-107800 SCARRED BEARDED MAN [Low, Gentle, Confident]: "I didn't need to."
EP07:E57 107500-111500 CAMERA: Medium shot as the Scarred Bearded Man stoops down, scoops up the heavy bundle of firewood in one arm, and walks calmly past Juliana toward their door.
EP07:E58 111500-116000 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana looking after him, a radiant and grateful smile blooming across her face as the scene fades out.

EP=ep_008; timestamps are integer milliseconds
SOURCE_SHA256=e2482244be533ae60b42cae3032208cf0bede3b2427639797a6323995dafeccb
METADATA ONLY (not on-screen evidence): {'logline': "As Juliana inspects her late mother's weathered herbal grimoire, Alexander bonds with her over rustic medicinal knowledge and war-worn memories, gently altering her perception of what true wealth means.", 'continuity_notes': 'Picks up after Episode 7, where Alexander chased off Gerald and the mocking aristocratic visitors; quiet and intimacy now return inside the woodland cottage as evening approaches.'}
SOURCE WARNINGS=[]
SCENE sc_001 0-78000 INT. WOODLAND COTTAGE – DAY
EP08:E1 0-3200 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana seated at a rustic wooden table beside a daylight-lit window, gently touching an aged leather-bound book.
EP08:E2 0-3200 ACTION: Juliana delicately runs her fingertips across the embossed leather cover of the worn botanical volume, noticing its weathered state.
EP08:E3 200-3200 JULIANA [Gentle, Somber]: "Some of the pages are ruined. Careful."
EP08:E4 3200-5100 CAMERA: Close-up on Juliana's hands carefully unlatching the metal clasp on the leather book.
EP08:E5 3400-4500 SOUND: Soft metallic click of the book clasp loosening.
EP08:E6 5100-7800 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana tenderly opening the cover and turning the brittle parchment pages.
EP08:E7 5100-7800 JULIANA [Reflective, Reverent]: "Mother spent years writing this."
EP08:E8 7800-10500 CAMERA: Medium shot as Alexander enters the dim room behind Juliana, quietly stepping up to the rustic table.
EP08:E9 8500-10500 ACTION: Alexander gently sets down a fresh bundle of small white herbal flowers tied with twine beside the open book.
EP08:E10 10500-11900 CAMERA: Low-angle medium close-up of Juliana looking up toward Alexander in pleasant surprise.
EP08:E11 10500-11800 JULIANA [Curious, Recognizing]: "Yarrow."
EP08:E12 11900-15000 CAMERA: Close-up of Alexander looking down at her, the firelight catching the rugged scar across his face.
EP08:E13 12000-14600 ALEXANDER [Calm, Knowledgeable]: "Good for wounds. Fever, too."
EP08:E14 15000-16300 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana looking up at him with genuine curiosity.
EP08:E15 15100-16100 JULIANA [Inquiring, Soft]: "How do you know that?"
EP08:E16 16300-19300 CAMERA: Close-up of Alexander speaking in a steady, measured tone.
EP08:E17 16300-18900 ALEXANDER [Somber, Matter-of-Fact]: "Soldiers learn quickly which plants keep a man alive."
EP08:E18 19300-21500 CAMERA: Insert shot of Juliana's hands gently arranging several tied bundles of dried yarrow sprigs on the tabletop.
EP08:E19 19400-21800 JULIANA [Observant, Lightly Teasing]: "You know more about healing than you let on."
EP08:E20 21500-24300 CAMERA: Close-up of Alexander, bathed in warm hearth embers, offering a subtle, knowing half-smile.
EP08:E21 22800-24200 ALEXANDER [Quiet, Gritty]: "Enough to survive."
EP08:E22 24300-26500 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana setting down a bunch of flowers and looking intently at his rugged visage.
EP08:E23 25000-26800 JULIANA [Hesitant, Soft]: "Your hair and beard..."
EP08:E24 26500-28100 CAMERA: Medium shot of Alexander standing tall over her, looking down patiently.
EP08:E25 28100-31900 CAMERA: Medium two-shot as Juliana rises from her stool to stand close in front of him, reaching an affectionate hand toward his temple.
EP08:E26 30100-31900 JULIANA [Gentle, Tender]: "I could trim them for you."
EP08:E27 31900-33200 CAMERA: Close-up of Alexander's large, rough hand firmly but gently catching Juliana's wrist in midair.
EP08:E28 33200-35500 CAMERA: Medium two-shot profile of Alexander holding her wrist, his piercing gaze locked onto hers.
EP08:E29 33200-34500 ALEXANDER [Firm, Low]: "Not yet."
EP08:E30 35500-37300 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana looking into his eyes, her brow lightly furrowed in bemused question.
EP08:E31 35800-36900 JULIANA [Puzzled, Curious]: "Not yet?"
EP08:E32 37300-39600 CAMERA: Close-up of Alexander, still maintaining his gentle hold on her arm.
EP08:E33 37700-38900 ALEXANDER [Grounded, Steady]: "Let them grow."
EP08:E34 39600-42300 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana smiling with playful warmth.
EP08:E35 39900-42000 JULIANA [Playful, Amused]: "You prefer looking like a forest hermit?"
EP08:E36 42300-44900 CAMERA: Intimate two-shot as Alexander slowly lowers her hand, his expression softening.
EP08:E37 43700-44900 ALEXANDER [Dry, Droll]: "It has advantages."
EP08:E38 44900-46900 CAMERA: Medium shot of Juliana chuckling quietly as she steps back toward the table.
EP08:E39 45500-46800 JULIANA [Fond, Resigned]: "Very well."
EP08:E40 46900-48000 CAMERA: Close-up of Alexander watching her with deep, affectionate attention.
EP08:E41 48000-50000 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana grinning with sparkling eyes.
EP08:E42 48100-49600 JULIANA [Teasing, Determined]: "But one day, I am trimming that beard."
EP08:E43 50000-51300 CAMERA: Close-up of Alexander lowering his head slightly with a faint smirk.
EP08:E44 50100-51200 ALEXANDER [Low, Amused]: "We'll see."
EP08:E45 51300-53300 CAMERA: Medium two-shot of both sitting back down at the table together, Alexander turning a brittle page of the herb book.
EP08:E46 53300-57100 CAMERA: Close-up insert of Alexander's weathered finger pointing directly at a delicate botanical illustration of a flowering stem.
EP08:E47 53300-57000 ALEXANDER [Instructional, Calm]: "That one grows near the northern stream. Crushed leaves ease swelling."
EP08:E48 57100-59800 CAMERA: Wide side-profile two-shot of Juliana and Alexander seated across from each other at the rustic table, the stone fireplace roaring warmly behind them.
EP08:E49 58700-60200 JULIANA [Soft, Nostalgic]: "My mother wrote the same thing."
EP08:E50 59800-63000 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana looking across at his battle-marked features with empathy.
EP08:E51 60500-62800 JULIANA [Hesitant, Compassionate]: "And the scars... were they from the war?"
EP08:E52 63000-64300 CAMERA: Close-up of Alexander looking downward, memories clouding his eyes.
EP08:E53 63200-64200 ALEXANDER [Quiet, Subdued]: "Some were."
EP08:E54 64300-66500 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana, her eyes filled with gentle understanding.
EP08:E55 64900-66300 JULIANA [Tender, Aching]: "It must have been terrible."
EP08:E56 66500-68500 CAMERA: Close-up of Alexander lifting his gaze, heavy with past battles.
EP08:E57 66700-67600 ALEXANDER [Heavy, Somber]: "It was."
EP08:E58 68500-70900 CAMERA: Medium two-shot of Juliana smiling tenderly at him across the open book.
EP08:E59 69000-72100 JULIANA [Reflective, Vulnerable]: "I thought losing wealth meant losing everything."
EP08:E60 70900-73200 CAMERA: Wide shot framing the warm silhouette of the two companions sitting peacefully beside the blazing stone hearth.
EP08:E61 73200-78000 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Juliana's radiant face illuminated by firelight, a peaceful, contented smile spreading across her lips as she looks at him until the shot gently fades out.
EP08:E62 73200-75300 JULIANA [Quiet, Transformed]: "Perhaps I was wrong."
EP08:E63 75300-78000 ACTION: Juliana maintains her warm, peaceful gaze across the table as soft firelight flickers over her face into fade out.
