EP=ep_009; timestamps are integer milliseconds
SOURCE_SHA256=faea423ecdc00a4677d0cfe44deea27f2353120a682104faf07c073e99589e9e
METADATA ONLY (not on-screen evidence): {'logline': "When a frantic mother brings her critically ill child to the woodland cottage, Juliana successfully cures him with her mother's herbal remedies, unknowingly igniting dangerous rumors that reach the ears of the Blond Nobleman.", 'continuity_notes': 'Picks up immediately after Episode 8, continuing the peaceful evening inside the cottage before an urgent knock shatters the calm.'}
SOURCE WARNINGS=['sc_001: incomplete source coverage; gaps are unavailable']
SCENE sc_001 0-83800 INT. WOODLAND COTTAGE – NIGHT
EP09:E1 0-2800 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana at the wooden table by candlelight, grinding dried herbs with a pestle inside a stone mortar.
EP09:E2 0-2800 ACTION: Juliana methodically crushes herbs in the mortar beside her open herbal grimoire.
EP09:E3 2000-3500 SOUND: Heavy, frantic pounding echoes against the heavy wooden cottage door.
EP09:E4 2800-4000 ACTION: Juliana stops grinding and lifts her head sharply toward the entrance in alarm.
EP09:E5 3500-5500 CAMERA: Close-up of Alexander turning toward the doorway, his eyes sharp and vigilant.
EP09:E6 3600-5000 ALEXANDER [Authoritative, Protective]: "Stay back. I'll open it."
EP09:E7 4800-6600 ACTION: Alexander steps forward and unlatches the cottage door, opening it into the pouring rain.
EP09:E8 5500-11200 CAMERA: Medium shot framing the doorway as a soaked, distraught peasant mother steps across the threshold clutching a swaddled child.
EP09:E9 6300-11100 PEASANT MOTHER [Frantic, Weeping]: "Please! They told me there was a woman here who knows herbs. My boy is burning with fever!"
EP09:E10 11200-13500 CAMERA: Medium shot of Juliana rushing to the front of the table, extending her arms urgently.
EP09:E11 11400-13300 JULIANA [Urgent, Compassionate]: "Bring him here. Quickly."
EP09:E12 12000-14200 ACTION: The trembling mother gently lays the feverish boy down atop the wooden table as Juliana leans in close.
EP09:E13 13800-15200 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana gently placing her fingers against the boy's burning forehead.
EP09:E14 15200-17800 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana examining the boy's breathing, looking up toward the frantic mother.
EP09:E15 15500-19800 JULIANA [Reassuring, Focused]: "He seems very unwell, but he is resting steadily. How long has he been like this?"
EP09:E16 17800-20000 CAMERA: Medium two-shot of Alexander watching anxiously over the child's shoulder as Juliana tends to him.
EP09:E17 20000-24000 CAMERA: Medium close-up of the peasant mother clutching her shawl, tears running down her cheeks.
EP09:E18 20500-23900 PEASANT MOTHER [Trembling, Anxious]: "Since yesterday morning. He has barely eaten since sunset."
EP09:E19 24000-27500 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana resting two fingers against the boy's wrist, measuring his shallow pulse.
EP09:E20 27200-28800 ACTION: Juliana lifts the weathered herbal book and rapidly browses the handwritten pages.
EP09:E21 28800-31000 CAMERA: Insert close-up of the open page illustrated with botanical drawings labeled 'Feverfew'.
EP09:E22 29000-30800 JULIANA [Muttering, Intent]: "Feverfew... Not alone."
EP09:E23 31000-34000 CAMERA: Profile close-up of Juliana studying the grimoire's remedies intently while the mother weeps in the soft background.
EP09:E24 31800-33800 JULIANA [Determined]: "Chamomile... and willow bark."
EP09:E25 34000-36000 CAMERA: Close-up of Alexander leaning over the table, gazing at her with intense concern.
EP09:E26 34900-35800 ALEXANDER [Grave]: "You're certain?"
EP09:E27 36000-38000 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana looking up into his eyes with resolute conviction.
EP09:E28 36300-37400 JULIANA [Resolute]: "I have to be."
EP09:E29 38000-39800 ACTION: Juliana quickly grabs bundles of dried herbs from the table and turns to Alexander.
EP09:E30 38200-39800 JULIANA [Urgent]: "Alexander, I need hot water."
EP09:E31 39900-40800 ALEXANDER [Prompt]: "I'm on it."
EP09:E32 40800-42500 ACTION: Alexander hurries to the hearth and lifts a boiling iron kettle from the hearth chain, while the mother buries her face in her hands.
EP09:E33 41000-42500 PEASANT MOTHER [Sobbing]: "Please save him."
EP09:E34 42200-43500 ACTION: Alexander returns and pours steaming hot water into the stone mortar as Juliana prepares the remedy.
EP09:E35 43000-46000 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana clasping the mother's trembling hand across the wooden table.
EP09:E36 43800-45600 JULIANA [Gentle, Steadfast]: "He is not beyond saving."
EP09:E37 46000-48000 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana carefully administering the herbal brew with a small wooden spoon into the sick boy's mouth.
EP09:E38 47000-48200 ACTION: The child swallows weakly and lets out a soft cough.
EP09:E39 48000-50500 CAMERA: Close-up of the mother clutching her chest in anxious suspense.
EP09:E40 50500-52500 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana sitting quietly beside the boy, holding two fingers over his wrist to monitor his pulse.
EP09:E41 52500-54000 CAMERA: Over-the-shoulder shot from behind the mother leaning across the table in panic.
EP09:E42 52500-54000 PEASANT MOTHER [Despairing]: "Why isn't it working?"
EP09:E43 54000-56000 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana raising a calm finger, urging patience.
EP09:E44 54300-55200 JULIANA [Quiet, Focused]: "Wait."
EP09:E45 56000-58500 CAMERA: Close-up of the sleeping boy as beads of sweat form on his forehead, his breathing deepening.
EP09:E46 58500-62000 CAMERA: Close-up of the mother gently caressing her son's cheek, sobbing with relief.
EP09:E47 58800-61800 PEASANT MOTHER [Overcome with Emotion]: "His fever... it's breaking."
EP09:E48 62000-64000 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana exhaling a deep breath of relief, smiling gently.
EP09:E49 64000-65600 CAMERA: Close-up of the mother looking up at Juliana with overwhelming gratitude.
EP09:E50 64200-65500 PEASANT MOTHER [Tearful, Grateful]: "You saved him."
EP09:E51 65600-68500 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana grasping the mother's hand with warm modesty.
EP09:E52 65800-68200 JULIANA [Soft, Gracious]: "The herbs did their work. Let him rest."
EP09:E53 68000-70500 ACTION: Juliana places a comforting hand over the mother's hands.
EP09:E54 70500-73000 ACTION: The mother gathers her sleeping son in her arms and steps back toward the rainy doorway.
EP09:E55 71000-74800 CAMERA: Medium shot from inside the cottage framing the mother standing at the open door looking back.
EP09:E56 71200-74800 PEASANT MOTHER [Reverent, Vowing]: "I will tell the village what you did. They will never forget you."
EP09:E57 74500-75500 ACTION: The mother exits into the rainy twilight as Alexander pushes the door shut.
EP09:E58 74800-77500 CAMERA: Close-up of Alexander turning from the door, his expression deeply troubled.
EP09:E59 75100-77500 ALEXANDER [Stern, Warning]: "You cannot let the whole village start talking about you."
EP09:E60 77500-79500 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana placing the mortar back onto the table, unflinching.
EP09:E61 77600-79400 JULIANA [Defiant, Principled]: "A child's life matters more than gossip."
EP09:E62 79500-81700 CAMERA: Close-up of Alexander, his jaw clenched with protective anxiety.
EP09:E63 79600-81600 ALEXANDER [Dark, Cautionary]: "Gossip has a way of becoming dangerous."
EP09:E64 81700-83800 CAMERA: Medium two-shot profile of Juliana stepping directly in front of Alexander, looking steadfastly up into his eyes.
EP09:E65 82000-83800 JULIANA [Committed, Unshakable]: "Then we will face it together."
SCENE sc_002 83800-115500 INT. LORD'S STUDY – NIGHT
EP09:E66 83800-86500 CAMERA: Wide shot of an opulent gothic manor study. The Blond Nobleman sits in a velvet armchair beside a roaring fireplace, reading an open leather-bound book.
EP09:E67 84000-86500 ACTION: The Former Groom, soaked from the rain and clutching his hat, walks nervously through the double doors into the study.
EP09:E68 86500-88000 CAMERA: Medium shot framing the Blond Nobleman in the foreground as The Former Groom halts respectfully behind his chair.
EP09:E69 86600-87400 BLOND NOBLEMAN [Aloof, Without Looking Up]: "What is it?"
EP09:E70 88000-90200 CAMERA: Medium close-up of The Former Groom, damp dark hair plastered to his forehead.
EP09:E71 88000-90300 THE FORMER GROOM [Hesitant, Deferential]: "There is a rumor going around, my Lord."
EP09:E72 90200-92000 CAMERA: Close-up of the Blond Nobleman lowering his book, gazing across with mild annoyance.
EP09:E73 90600-91400 BLOND NOBLEMAN [Coldly Curious]: "What rumor?"
EP09:E74 92000-95000 CAMERA: Close-up of The Former Groom speaking cautiously.
EP09:E75 92100-95100 THE FORMER GROOM [Uneasy]: "About a war veteran. Some say he resembles the late Duke."
EP09:E76 95000-97200 CAMERA: Medium close-up of the Blond Nobleman scoffing dismissively as he closes the book.
EP09:E77 95300-97300 BLOND NOBLEMAN [Mocking, Arrogant]: "People see ghosts whenever they want a story."
EP09:E78 97200-101000 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of The Former Groom's eyes widening with urgent dread.
EP09:E79 97500-101200 THE FORMER GROOM [Tense, Solemn]: "The man is said to have the same kind of scar the Duke carried after the war."
EP09:E80 101000-102200 CAMERA: Close-up of the Blond Nobleman snapping his head around, his smug expression freezing into sudden alarm.
EP09:E81 101400-101900 BLOND NOBLEMAN [Sharp, Demanding]: "Where?"
EP09:E82 102200-104000 CAMERA: Medium close-up of The Former Groom shifting uncomfortably.
EP09:E83 102300-103600 THE FORMER GROOM [Cautious]: "No one seems certain."
EP09:E84 104000-106000 CAMERA: Close-up of the Blond Nobleman composing his features into cold disdain, though tension trembles beneath his tone.
EP09:E85 104200-105900 BLOND NOBLEMAN [Dismissive, Masking Panic]: "Then let it remain a rumor."
EP09:E86 106000-108000 CAMERA: Medium shot as The Former Groom turns and retreats silently out of the study, leaving the doors closed.
EP09:E87 108000-112000 CAMERA: Side profile shot of the Blond Nobleman seated alone before the roaring fire, staring blankly into the flames in creeping paranoia.
EP09:E88 109800-111200 BLOND NOBLEMAN [Whispering, Shaken]: "Impossible."
EP09:E89 112000-115500 CAMERA: Extreme close-up macro shot of the Blond Nobleman's eye, the flickering fireplace flames dancing across his widening iris as dark dread paralyzes him, holding until the screen cuts to black.

EP=ep_010; timestamps are integer milliseconds
SOURCE_SHA256=474a02d035632a75787ddf6796abafcb7a5dac806f9739e25b3de09e0de5841f
METADATA ONLY (not on-screen evidence): {'logline': 'When Alexander returns to the cottage gravely wounded and soaked in blood, Juliana tends to his injuries, leading to an intimate confrontation where their unspoken feelings and scarred pasts finally collide.', 'continuity_notes': 'Follows the ominous revelation from Episode 9 of rumors circulating about a scarred war veteran, cutting directly to the secluded cottage where Alexander arrives bearing fresh wounds.'}
SOURCE WARNINGS=[]
SCENE sc_001 0-94000 INT. WOODLAND COTTAGE – NIGHT
EP10:E1 0-2500 CAMERA: Medium profile shot of Juliana sitting at a wooden table beside the glowing fireplace, reading an old herbal medicine book.
EP10:E2 0-2200 ACTION: Juliana quietly studies the botanical illustrations by firelight, a bundle of fresh dried herbs resting on the table.
EP10:E3 2100-3300 SOUND: A heavy wooden door suddenly creaks and bangs open in the quiet cottage.
EP10:E4 2200-3500 ACTION: Juliana jerks her head up from the book, startled by the sudden intrusion.
EP10:E5 2600-4200 CAMERA: Medium wide shot framing the doorway as Alexander stands framed in the dark threshold, panting heavily, his hand pressed against his blood-soaked chest.
EP10:E6 4200-6800 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana rising swiftly from her chair, shock and terror flashing across her face.
EP10:E7 5100-6600 JULIANA [Alarmed, Breathless]: "Alexander!"
EP10:E8 6800-9100 CAMERA: Close-up of Alexander struggling to breathe, clutching his bloodied coat over his chest.
EP10:E9 7500-9000 ALEXANDER [Gruff, Strained]: "It is nothing."
EP10:E10 9100-11500 CAMERA: Medium shot of Juliana hurriedly stepping toward him across the stone floor.
EP10:E11 9150-11450 JULIANA [Urgent, Worried]: "There is blood running down your arm."
EP10:E12 11500-14200 CAMERA: Medium profile two-shot as Alexander stands rigid while Juliana confronts him.
EP10:E13 11900-14300 ALEXANDER [Stiff, Dismissive]: "A cut from the tenant fields."
EP10:E14 14200-16000 CAMERA: Wide shot of the hearth room as Juliana firmly points toward a wooden armchair beside the fire.
EP10:E15 14500-16000 JULIANA [Commanding, Resolute]: "Sit down."
EP10:E16 16000-17800 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana's determined, unyielding expression.
EP10:E17 16200-17300 JULIANA [Stern]: "Now."
EP10:E18 17800-20000 CAMERA: Medium shot of Alexander reluctantly lowering his heavy frame onto the chair in front of the fire.
EP10:E19 20000-23000 CAMERA: Medium tracking shot following Juliana as she brings a wooden washbowl, fresh cloth, and an earthen jar of ointment to the foot of his chair.
EP10:E20 20900-22900 JULIANA [Gentle, Insistent]: "I need to see the wound."
EP10:E21 23000-25200 CAMERA: Low-angle close-up of Alexander looking up at her stubbornly.
EP10:E22 23200-24900 ALEXANDER [Low, Defiant]: "It is only a scratch."
EP10:E23 25200-28000 CAMERA: Medium shot of Juliana crossing her arms over her chest, eyeing him with quiet defiance.
EP10:E24 25500-28000 JULIANA [Sarcastic, Challenging]: "Then removing your shirt should not trouble you."
EP10:E25 28000-31800 CAMERA: Medium shot as Alexander stares at her for a beat before pushing himself up from the chair and shedding his heavy leather coat.
EP10:E26 31800-33200 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana observing him with guarded anticipation.
EP10:E27 33200-36500 CAMERA: Close-up shot of Alexander pulling his dark shirt over his head, revealing his muscular torso crisscrossed with jagged battle scars and fresh bleeding lacerations.
EP10:E28 36500-38000 CAMERA: Tight pan over the scarred, wounded flesh along his chest and ribs.
EP10:E29 38000-39200 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana's eyes widening in horror and deep pity.
EP10:E30 38100-38900 JULIANA [Whispering, Distressed]: "Dear God."
EP10:E31 39200-43000 CAMERA: Medium wide shot as Alexander sinks back into the chair, exhausted, while Juliana slowly kneels before him on the stone floor.
EP10:E32 43000-45000 CAMERA: Extreme close-up macro shot of Juliana's trembling fingers hovering tenderly over the raised, jagged scar across Alexander's chest.
EP10:E33 45000-47300 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana looking up at him, her eyes softened with profound empathy.
EP10:E34 45300-47100 JULIANA [Soft, Sorrowful]: "You have suffered terribly."
EP10:E35 47300-49500 CAMERA: Close-up of Alexander's weathered, scarred face gazing down at her with quiet stoicism.
EP10:E36 47800-49000 ALEXANDER [Quiet, Somber]: "It is over."
EP10:E37 49500-51500 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana dipping a linen cloth into the water bowl.
EP10:E38 49700-51300 JULIANA [Gentle]: "Your scars disagree."
EP10:E39 51500-54000 CAMERA: Close-up shot of Juliana carefully dabbing the damp cloth against the bloody cut on Alexander's shoulder.
EP10:E40 52000-53300 JULIANA [Tender]: "Does it hurt?"
EP10:E41 54000-55500 CAMERA: Close-up of Alexander trying not to wince under her touch.
EP10:E42 54000-55200 ALEXANDER [Gruff]: "Not much."
EP10:E43 55500-58000 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana smiling softly, amused by his stubborn pride.
EP10:E44 55600-57600 JULIANA [Playful, Whispering]: "You are a terrible liar."
EP10:E45 58000-60000 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Juliana's fingers taking a dollop of green herbal salve and smoothing it gently over his shoulder wound.
EP10:E46 60000-63000 CAMERA: Close-up over Juliana's shoulder looking at Alexander, who stares intently into her face, oblivious to the wound.
EP10:E47 63000-66200 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana looking up from his shoulder into his eyes, sensing the intensity of his gaze.
EP10:E48 63900-66100 JULIANA [Soft, Breathless]: "Why do you look at me like that?"
EP10:E49 66200-68800 CAMERA: Close-up of Alexander, his voice deep and laden with restrained emotion.
EP10:E50 66500-68400 ALEXANDER [Intense, Sincere]: "Because you are looking at me."
EP10:E51 68800-71500 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana looking back down at his shoulder to hide her growing fluster, applying the salve carefully.
EP10:E52 69600-70900 JULIANA [Flustered, Whispering]: "Hold still."
EP10:E53 71500-74500 CAMERA: Medium shot of Alexander leaning closer to her, his breathing heavy.
EP10:E54 72100-74200 ALEXANDER [Low, Husky]: "I am holding still."
EP10:E55 74500-77000 CAMERA: Close-up two-shot of their faces drawing mere inches apart in the warm firelight.
EP10:E56 76800-79000 ALEXANDER [Whispering, Vulnerable]: "Perhaps it is your hand."
EP10:E57 79000-82500 CAMERA: Close-up of Alexander's large, rough hands reaching up and gently enveloping Juliana's slender hands, bringing them against his bare chest over his racing heart.
EP10:E58 82500-86500 CAMERA: Close-up shot of Alexander gazing into Juliana's eyes with raw, unmasked devotion.
EP10:E59 82600-85900 ALEXANDER [Deep, Emotional]: "Your touch is the only medicine that has ever eased my pain."
EP10:E60 86500-94000 CAMERA: Close-up shot holding on Juliana's wide, luminous blue eyes, completely captivated and overwhelmed by his confession, the firelight dancing across their intertwined hands as the scene lingers and fades.

EP=ep_011; timestamps are integer milliseconds
SOURCE_SHA256=839ae70b822b9ae862ea9b0625a372d2a03660757d6556cd2dc1251d876654de
METADATA ONLY (not on-screen evidence): {'logline': 'Gerald and Clarissa arrive at the cottage with an armed constable accusing Alexander of grand theft, culminating in a devastating planted discovery that threatens to tear the newlyweds apart.', 'continuity_notes': 'Picks up immediately after the intimate moment between Juliana and Alexander in Episode 10, interrupted by the ominous arrival of an aristocratic carriage carrying Gerald.'}
SOURCE WARNINGS=['sc_001: incomplete source coverage; gaps are unavailable', 'sc_002: incomplete source coverage; gaps are unavailable']
SCENE sc_001 0-54000 EXT. COTTAGE GROUNDS – DAY
EP11:E1 0-2000 CAMERA: Low-angle tracking shot of heavy carriage wheels churning violently through the muddy, waterlogged track.
EP11:E2 0-2000 SOUND: Squelch of mud and the grinding rattle of carriage wheels under heavy rain.
EP11:E3 2000-4000 CAMERA: Medium two-shot of Juliana and Alexander standing outside the rustic stone cottage, watching the incoming carriage with tense apprehension.
EP11:E4 2000-4000 ACTION: Juliana wrings a damp rag in her hands, her face etched with rising dread, while Alexander stands guard beside her.
EP11:E5 4000-6500 CAMERA: Tight shot tilting up as polished black boots step down directly into the muck, revealing Gerald clad in an opulent burgundy double-breasted coat.
EP11:E6 5500-7000 ACTION: Gerald buttons his coat, smug self-satisfaction radiating from his expression.
EP11:E7 7000-8200 CAMERA: Medium shot of a uniformed Constable descending from the carriage, firmly gripping a wooden truncheon.
EP11:E8 8200-10800 CAMERA: Medium tracking shot as Juliana steps defensively toward Gerald, her face full of shock and anger.
EP11:E9 8300-10700 JULIANA [Startled, Indignant]: "Gerald? What are you doing here?"
EP11:E10 10800-13000 CAMERA: Wide two-shot across the puddle-strewn ground between Gerald and Juliana against the misty landscape.
EP11:E11 11100-13200 GERALD [Arrogant, Smooth]: "I came for something that belongs to me."
EP11:E12 13000-14300 CAMERA: Close-up of Clarissa peering from the carriage window in her violet silk gown, a venomous, triumphant smile curling her lips.
EP11:E13 14300-16800 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana, her anger flaring as she gestures sharply.
EP11:E14 14400-16700 JULIANA [Furious, Defiant]: "You have already taken enough from me. Leave!"
EP11:E15 16800-18500 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Gerald pointing an accusatory finger, his composure snapping into hostile anger.
EP11:E16 16800-18700 GERALD [Aggressive, Snarl]: "Your husband stole my gold pocket watch!"
EP11:E17 18500-20000 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana recoiling in utter disbelief.
EP11:E18 19000-20000 JULIANA [Incredulous, Gasping]: "What? When?"
EP11:E19 20000-22000 CAMERA: Close-up of Gerald narrowing his eyes vindictively.
EP11:E20 20900-22300 GERALD [Cold, Certain]: "The last time I came here."
EP11:E21 22000-24600 CAMERA: Medium shot of Juliana scoffing, stepping forward as Alexander stands motionless behind her.
EP11:E22 23000-24800 JULIANA [Contemptuous, Outraged]: "You never even entered the cottage!"
EP11:E23 24600-26900 CAMERA: Close-up of Gerald smirking with condescending amusement.
EP11:E24 25200-27000 GERALD [Smug, Threatening]: "Then you should have nothing to fear from a search."
EP11:E25 26900-28900 CAMERA: Three-shot of Alexander, Juliana, and Gerald in the bleak drizzle.
EP11:E26 27300-29000 JULIANA [Adamant, Protective]: "Alexander would never steal from you."
EP11:E27 28900-32400 CAMERA: Low-angle shot of Gerald throwing his head back in arrogant, mocking laughter.
EP11:E28 29300-32800 GERALD [Mocking, Spiteful]: "Of course you would defend him. You married a beggar!"
EP11:E29 32400-34900 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Alexander stepping past Juliana, his gaze murderous and jaw rigid.
EP11:E30 33000-34900 ALEXANDER [Low, Menacing]: "Choose your next words carefully."
EP11:E31 34900-37000 CAMERA: Medium shot of Gerald pointing back toward the approaching Constable, feigning alarm.
EP11:E32 35100-37100 GERALD [Shouting, Dramatic]: "You hear that? He threatens me again!"
EP11:E33 37000-39100 CAMERA: Medium shot of the Constable marching into frame between them, holding his truncheon horizontally.
EP11:E34 37400-39200 CONSTABLE [Authoritative, Stern]: "I have received a complaint of theft."
EP11:E35 39100-41000 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Juliana, defiant and resolute.
EP11:E36 39700-41100 JULIANA [Fierce]: "A complaint is not proof."
EP11:E37 41000-43300 CAMERA: Close-up of the Constable gesturing with his truncheon toward the cottage door.
EP11:E38 41400-43300 CONSTABLE [Cold, Procedural]: "Then a search will settle the matter."
EP11:E39 43300-46000 CAMERA: Medium shot of Juliana backing up to the doorway, spreading her arms wide to block the entrance.
EP11:E40 43500-46300 JULIANA [Desperate, Shouting]: "You cannot simply invade our home because this man makes an accusation!"
EP11:E41 46000-47800 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Gerald crossing his arms smugly.
EP11:E42 46800-48300 GERALD [Taunting]: "If he has nothing to hide..."
EP11:E43 47800-50800 CAMERA: Extreme close-up push-in on Alexander's scarred face, his eyes smoldering with lethal restraint.
EP11:E44 48400-50000 GERALD [O.S.) (Smug]: "...let the constable search."
EP11:E45 50100-51000 ALEXANDER [Dark, Grated]: "Search it."
EP11:E46 50800-53600 CAMERA: Medium two-shot of Juliana looking up at Alexander in panicked confusion.
EP11:E47 52800-53600 ALEXANDER [Resigned, Calm]: "Let them."
SCENE sc_002 54000-112750 INT. COTTAGE – CONTINUOUS
EP11:E48 54000-56000 CAMERA: Medium shot looking out the doorway as Juliana steps aside and the Constable barges past into the dimly lit cottage.
EP11:E49 54500-56500 SOUND: Heavy thud of boots entering wooden floorboards, followed by forceful banging of furniture.
EP11:E50 56000-58000 ACTION: The Constable begins violently overturning crates and dumping contents across the floor.
EP11:E51 58000-60000 CAMERA: Medium low-angle shot of Juliana dropping to her knees, frantically trying to salvage bundles of dried herbs scattering across the boards.
EP11:E52 58000-60100 JULIANA [Distressed, Pleading]: "Stop! Those are my mother's medicines!"
EP11:E53 60000-61800 ACTION: The Constable aggressively pulls folded bed linens from a shelf and hurls them onto the damp floor.
EP11:E54 61800-63500 CAMERA: Low-angle close-up of Juliana crawling on the floor, looking up with tears streaming down her cheeks.
EP11:E55 61800-63800 JULIANA [Crying, Desperate]: "Please! There is nothing here!"
EP11:E56 63500-65500 CAMERA: Close-up of the Constable's hands flipping open a small wooden keepsake box on a work table.
EP11:E57 63900-65700 CONSTABLE [Cold, Indifferent]: "Then you have nothing to fear."
EP11:E58 65500-67400 CAMERA: Low-angle close-up of Juliana clutching the fallen linens to her chest, her voice breaking.
EP11:E59 66000-67500 JULIANA [Heartbroken, Sobbing]: "Those are all I have left!"
EP11:E60 67400-71500 CAMERA: Medium shot of Gerald leaning casually against the cottage doorframe, looking around with contemptuous disgust.
EP11:E61 67500-71600 GERALD [Cruel, Condescending]: "Stand aside. Look at this place. A perfect hiding hole for a thief."
EP11:E62 71500-74800 CAMERA: Medium shot of Juliana rising to her feet, clutching the folded cloth, her face contorting with rage.
EP11:E63 72100-75000 JULIANA [Furious, Accusatory]: "You planted this accusation because you cannot bear that I am happy without you!"
EP11:E64 74800-76800 CAMERA: Tight close-up of Gerald's face chilling into a cold sneer.
EP11:E65 75500-76800 GERALD [Scoffing, Sinister]: "Happy?"
EP11:E66 76800-79500 CAMERA: Medium shot of Alexander standing in the cottage shadows, eyes locked onto Gerald.
EP11:E67 79500-81300 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Alexander's right hand slowly tightening into a white-knuckled fist.
EP11:E68 81300-84000 CAMERA: Low-angle close-up of Gerald tilting his chin up, daringly baiting Alexander.
EP11:E69 81300-84000 GERALD [Provoking, Smirking]: "What is it, soldier? Going to strike a gentleman in front of his wife?"
EP11:E70 84200-85000 JULIANA [Whispering, Terrified]: "Don't!"
EP11:E71 85000-86500 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana clutching her dress collar in acute panic.
EP11:E72 86000-87500 ALEXANDER [V.O.) (Haunted, Resolute]: "One blow would end this."
EP11:E73 86500-89800 CAMERA: Medium shot of the Constable stepping up behind Alexander, holding his truncheon firmly across Alexander's chest to restrain him, cutting to a tight close-up of Alexander's smoldering eyes.
EP11:E74 88000-90000 ALEXANDER [V.O.) (Pained, Selfless]: "But one blow would destroy her life."
EP11:E75 89800-92000 CAMERA: Medium shot of the Constable turning to Alexander's heavy trench coat hanging on an iron wall hook by the fireplace.
EP11:E76 91000-92200 ACTION: The Constable grabs the coat by the collar and begins rummaging through its deep pockets.
EP11:E77 92100-93200 JULIANA [Startled, Shouting]: "That is his coat!"
EP11:E78 93200-96800 CAMERA: Close-up of the Constable's hand sliding deep inside the inner coat lining and withdrawing a gleaming gold pocket watch with an attached chain.
EP11:E79 95800-97000 SOUND: Metallic clinking of the gold chain sliding against fabric.
EP11:E80 96800-99200 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Juliana gasping in sheer horror, her eyes welling with shock and shattered disbelief.
EP11:E81 97200-99000 ACTION: Juliana draws a sharp, terrified breath as her face pales completely.
EP11:E82 99200-102000 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Alexander's face hardening into lethal, icy comprehension, realizing the depth of the frame-up.
EP11:E83 102000-106800 CAMERA: Medium close-up push-in on Gerald's face erupting into an ecstatic, wicked grin, bursting into triumphant laughter.
EP11:E84 104200-106600 GERALD [Gloating, Victorious]: "There it is. Ha!"
EP11:E85 106800-112750 CAMERA: Tight macro shot of the gold pocket watch dangling and swaying gently from the Constable's fingers on its long chain, with Gerald blurred in the background grinning with sinister triumph as the scene hangs in a devastating freeze-frame.

EP=ep_012; timestamps are integer milliseconds
SOURCE_SHA256=d3c65e83677b3d1014a1e95dead2ea621ff2a81bf565462084f3ac9f5c0c6305
METADATA ONLY (not on-screen evidence): {'logline': 'When the Constable attempts to arrest Alexander for grand theft, Clarissa offers Juliana a sadistic ultimatum: retrieve a signet ring from frozen, razor-sharp blackthorn briars with her bare hands, or watch her husband hang.', 'continuity_notes': "Picks up directly from Episode 11's cliffhanger where the Constable pulls Gerald's planted gold pocket watch from Alexander's trench coat."}
SOURCE WARNINGS=[]
SCENE sc_001 0-87210 INT. COTTAGE – CONTINUOUS
EP12:E1 0-4600 CAMERA: Medium shot of the Constable raising a set of heavy iron handcuffs, addressing Alexander sternly in front of the stone hearth.
EP12:E2 500-4500 CONSTABLE [Authoritative, Stern]: "Put out your hands, veteran. You are under arrest for theft."
EP12:E3 4600-9100 CAMERA: Medium shot of Juliana swiftly moving in front of Alexander, placing herself defiantly between him and the Constable's outstretched handcuffs.
EP12:E4 4800-6000 ACTION: Juliana steps firmly forward, shielding Alexander with her body.
EP12:E5 5700-8800 JULIANA [Furious, Defiant]: "No! That watch was not in his coat!"
EP12:E6 9100-11800 CAMERA: Close-up of the Constable narrowing his eyes coldly at Juliana.
EP12:E7 10000-11700 CONSTABLE [Blunt, Unyielding]: "I found it there myself."
EP12:E8 11800-13900 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana glaring back with unwavering conviction.
EP12:E9 12300-13900 JULIANA [Passionate, Accusatory]: "Then someone put it there!"
EP12:E10 13900-20800 CAMERA: Medium full shot of Gerald framed in the open cottage doorway holding his riding crop, stepping inside with a patronizing, gloating grin.
EP12:E11 14300-20600 GERALD [Smug, Condescending]: "The proof is in his coat, Juliana. A valuable pocket watch doesn't just walk into a beggar's pocket."
EP12:E12 20800-23700 CAMERA: Close-up of Alexander, his scarred brow furrowed in dark, quiet defiance.
EP12:E13 21600-23600 ALEXANDER [Low, Steady, Dangerous]: "I have never touched your property."
EP12:E14 23700-26900 CAMERA: Medium shot of Gerald pointing his riding crop toward them, with Clarissa hovering behind him in her violet silk gown.
EP12:E15 23700-26800 GERALD [Mocking, Malicious]: "Then perhaps your wife should explain why it was found in your coat."
EP12:E16 26800-28000 ACTION: Juliana lunges a step forward, jabbing an accusing finger toward Gerald.
EP12:E17 26800-27900 JULIANA [Enraged, Shouting]: "You planted it!"
EP12:E18 28000-29800 CAMERA: Medium shot of Clarissa gliding past Gerald, a venomous, amused smile playing upon her lips.
EP12:E19 28100-30000 CLARISSA [Purring, Taunting]: "Oh, dear sister..."
EP12:E20 29800-31000 CAMERA: Tight shot of Alexander's hand clenching into a tight, trembling fist against the glow of the roaring fireplace.
EP12:E21 31000-32400 CAMERA: Close-up of Alexander glaring daggers at Clarissa.
EP12:E22 30000-32400 CLARISSA [O.S.) (Continuing taunt]: "...still defending your broken scrap of a man?"
EP12:E23 32400-35300 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana, her eyes narrowing with sharp perception.
EP12:E24 32400-35200 JULIANA [Steely, Resolute]: "Name your price, Clarissa. I know you."
EP12:E25 35300-40000 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Clarissa smiling with vicious delight.
EP12:E26 35400-40000 CLARISSA [Smooth, Derisive]: "You always were clever, Juliana. Always searching for some way to escape."
EP12:E27 40000-41800 CAMERA: Tight shot of Clarissa smoothing her long purple evening glove along her wrist.
EP12:E28 40100-41500 CLARISSA [Scheming]: "Perhaps I can give you one."
EP12:E29 41800-43700 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana watching her with cautious skepticism.
EP12:E30 42200-43500 JULIANA [Guarded, Cold]: "What do you want?"
EP12:E31 43700-46600 CAMERA: Medium two-shot of Clarissa in the foreground, turning slowly to face Juliana.
EP12:E32 44000-46400 CLARISSA [Cruel, Savoring]: "I want to see you crawl, sister."
EP12:E33 46600-52400 CAMERA: Medium close-up profile tracking shot of Clarissa pacing slowly as she spins her sadistic tale.
EP12:E34 46700-52300 CLARISSA [Theatrical, Vindictive]: "My emerald signet ring fell deep into the frozen blackthorn briars at Ashworth Manor. The thorns have grown over it..."
EP12:E35 52400-56800 CAMERA: Close-up of Clarissa flexing her gloved fingers theatrically in front of her face.
EP12:E36 52400-56700 CLARISSA [Chilling, Sarcastic]: "...sharp as steel. The ground is frozen, like pure ice."
EP12:E37 56800-58000 ACTION: Gerald bursts into a loud, mocking laugh beside the stony Constable.
EP12:E38 56800-60800 CAMERA: Medium two-shot of Clarissa stepping closer to Juliana, peering down into her eyes with a predatory smile.
EP12:E39 57300-60600 CLARISSA [Demanding, Brutal]: "You will retrieve it with your bare hands before the magistrate arrives."
EP12:E40 60800-63200 CAMERA: Medium shot of Gerald tapping his whip against his palm and laughing heartily beside the Constable.
EP12:E41 60800-63100 GERALD [Gleeful, Derisive]: "A lady's hands will be shredded to ribbons!"
EP12:E42 63200-65200 CAMERA: Medium three-shot of Clarissa stepping behind Juliana, as Alexander watches helplessly with dark fury.
EP12:E43 63300-65100 CLARISSA [Cold, Transactional]: "Do it, and we withdraw the charges."
EP12:E44 65200-69500 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Clarissa's mouth leaning directly into Juliana's ear, whispering venomously.
EP12:E45 65400-69200 CLARISSA [Whispering, Menacing]: "Fail, or refuse, and your husband hangs from the gallows."
EP12:E46 69500-74000 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Alexander stepping up beside Juliana, tenderly placing his large hand on her shoulder.
EP12:E47 69600-71200 ACTION: Alexander rests his scarred hand reassuringly on Juliana's shoulder, leaning in toward her.
EP12:E48 69800-73800 ALEXANDER [Desperate, Protective, Urgent]: "Juliana, no. Do not let them hurt you. I can handle the law."
EP12:E49 74000-81800 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana, her eyes glistening with unshed tears, her hand gripping the fabric over her heart in agony and resolve.
EP12:E50 74200-76000 ACTION: Juliana clutches the front of her rustic grey dress, her breathing trembling.
EP12:E51 75300-78200 JULIANA [Fierce, Emotional, Sacrificial]: "I am not letting them take you."
EP12:E52 81500-83000 ACTION: Juliana turns her head sharply back toward Clarissa, her expression hardening with fierce resolution.
EP12:E53 81800-87210 CAMERA: Over-the-shoulder shot past Clarissa onto Juliana's determined face, holding on her fierce, defiant stare as the tension peaks.
EP12:E54 82800-84700 JULIANA [Steely, Resolute]: "Tell me where the garden is."
EP12:E55 84700-87210 ACTION: Juliana locks eyes with Clarissa without flinching as the scene freezes on her brave, sacrificial defiance.

EP=ep_013; timestamps are integer milliseconds
SOURCE_SHA256=b0880fe2f19304409a390837761474a741e366a571f3435abdb40c74a7929a18
METADATA ONLY (not on-screen evidence): {'logline': "Defying Alexander's desperate pleas, Juliana crawls barehanded into the razor-sharp blackthorn garden, enduring brutal lacerations under Clarissa and Gerald's cruel taunts until she unearths the lost emerald signet ring.", 'continuity_notes': "Picks up immediately from Episode 12's climax where Juliana demanded to know where the frozen blackthorn garden was located to save Alexander from the gallows."}
SOURCE WARNINGS=[]
SCENE sc_001 0-45800 EXT. MANOR GROUNDS - BLACKTHORN GARDEN – DUSK
EP13:E1 0-4200 CAMERA: Low-angle macro shot tracking through an impenetrable, menacing thicket of frozen blackthorn briars encrusted with frost.
EP13:E2 0-4000 SOUND: Whistling winter wind and an ominous low brass drone.
EP13:E3 4200-7000 CAMERA: Wide shot looking down from the stone terrace. Gerald and Clarissa stand elevated on the balustrade, while Juliana, Alexander in handcuffs, and the Constable stand before the dense briar garden.
EP13:E4 5100-7000 ACTION: Alexander turns toward Juliana, his manacled hands trembling as he grips her arm.
EP13:E5 5400-10200 ALEXANDER [Pleading, Agonized]: "Juliana, look at those thorns. You cannot do this."
EP13:E6 7000-10800 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Alexander and Juliana facing each other, his chained wrists held between them.
EP13:E7 10800-14200 CAMERA: Close-up on Juliana's hooded face, her eyes filled with resolute sorrow.
EP13:E8 12400-13800 JULIANA [Quiet, Unwavering]: "I must."
EP13:E9 14200-18800 CAMERA: Close-up on Alexander, his combat scar stark against his pained expression.
EP13:E10 14400-17300 ALEXANDER [Terrified for Her]: "They will tear your hands apart."
EP13:E11 18800-21000 CAMERA: Low-angle shot looking up at Gerald and Clarissa leaning over the stone balustrade, smirking down with cruel amusement.
EP13:E12 21000-24200 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana looking up into Alexander's eyes with tender courage.
EP13:E13 22000-23900 JULIANA [Soft, Reassuring]: "I will be fine."
EP13:E14 24200-28400 ALEXANDER [Desperate, Fierce]: "I would rather face the gallows than watch you hurt yourself for me."
EP13:E15 24200-28500 CAMERA: Two-shot framing Alexander leaning down toward Juliana, fighting against his bonds.
EP13:E16 28500-29900 CAMERA: Close-up of Gerald chuckling smugly on the terrace above, crossing his arms.
EP13:E17 29900-36800 CAMERA: Tight close-up of Juliana gently clasping Alexander's handcuffed hands, gazing up at him with unyielding love.
EP13:E18 30800-35800 JULIANA [Emotional, Devoted]: "You stood beside me when everyone else abandoned me. I will not abandon you now."
EP13:E19 36200-39500 ACTION: Juliana releases his hands and turns toward the briar thicket. Alexander stretches out his chained hands, attempting to hold her back, but the Constable restrains him.
EP13:E20 36800-39800 CAMERA: Medium shot behind Juliana as she walks toward the vast expanse of frozen briars.
EP13:E21 37000-38200 CLARISSA [O.S.) (Mocking, Vindictive]: "Careful, sister."
EP13:E22 39800-41600 CAMERA: Low-angle shot of Clarissa smirking down over the carved stone balustrade.
EP13:E23 39900-41500 CLARISSA [Cruel, Sarcastic]: "That garden has swallowed better women than you."
EP13:E24 41600-45800 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Gerald leaning against the balcony beside Clarissa, wearing an arrogant smirk.
EP13:E25 41800-45500 GERALD [Condescending, Arrogant]: "Perhaps the beggar's wife will finally learn what her new life is worth."
SCENE sc_002 45800-118880 EXT. FROZEN BLACKTHORN BRIARS – CONTINUOUS
EP13:E26 45800-47000 ACTION: Juliana drops to her knees in front of the frozen blackthorn branches, steadying her trembling breath.
EP13:E27 45800-47000 CAMERA: Medium shot of Juliana kneeling on the frozen soil at the edge of the briars.
EP13:E28 47000-50000 CAMERA: Medium shot of Alexander lunging forward with chained hands raised high, roaring in fury as the Constable grabs him.
EP13:E29 47200-48800 ALEXANDER [Screaming, Panicked]: "Juliana, stop!"
EP13:E30 47800-49200 SOUND: Rattling of heavy iron chains.
EP13:E31 50000-53000 ACTION: Juliana crawls forward on all fours, lowering her head under the jagged, arching thorns.
EP13:E32 50000-52000 CAMERA: Eye-level shot looking through the thorny thicket at Juliana crawling deeper into the briars.
EP13:E33 51500-52600 ALEXANDER [Strangled, Weeping]: "Please..."
EP13:E34 52000-53500 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Alexander's anguished face as he strains furiously against his handcuffs.
EP13:E35 53500-56000 CAMERA: Ground-level shot of Juliana's bare hands reaching out onto the cracked, frozen ground.
EP13:E36 54000-56500 ACTION: Sharp blackthorn spines rake across Juliana's fingers and knuckles, carving bloody gashes across her skin.
EP13:E37 54500-55800 JULIANA [Gasping in Pain]: "No..."
EP13:E38 56000-58200 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Juliana's hand scraping against the frost-covered stone, bright red blood welling from deep puncture wounds.
EP13:E39 57200-58600 CLARISSA [O.S.) (Gleeful, Derisive]: "Look at her hands."
EP13:E40 58200-62000 CAMERA: Medium shot on the balcony as Clarissa gleefully points down at Juliana, Gerald chuckling beside her.
EP13:E41 58800-61800 CLARISSA [Mocking, Spiteful]: "The lady has finally found something worthy of her."
EP13:E42 62000-64000 ACTION: Gerald leans his hands on the terrace railing, sneering callously.
EP13:E43 62000-67500 CAMERA: Low-angle medium close-up of Gerald shouting down into the garden.
EP13:E44 62200-67000 GERALD [Taunting, Cruel]: "Keep searching, Juliana. Your husband's freedom is somewhere in that garden."
EP13:E45 67500-71200 CAMERA: Macro close-up of a massive blackthorn needle stabbing deep into the back of Juliana's bleeding hand.
EP13:E46 68500-70200 SOUND: Sickening crunch and scrape of thorns slicing through flesh.
EP13:E47 71200-74000 CAMERA: Close-up of Alexander struggling in agony, tears forming in his eyes.
EP13:E48 71400-73800 ALEXANDER [Desperate, Choked]: "Please... enough!"
EP13:E49 74000-78000 CAMERA: Wide tunnel shot through the briars as Juliana crawls deeper into the dark, frozen tangle.
EP13:E50 74500-78000 ACTION: Juliana drags her body across the frozen, cracked soil beneath the dense roof of briars.
EP13:E51 78000-80500 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana's hand getting snagged between two vicious thorns, tearing her sleeve and flesh.
EP13:E52 78500-80500 JULIANA [Screaming in Pain]: "Ah!"
EP13:E53 80500-83000 ACTION: Alexander loses control, violently lunging past the Constable toward the briars.
EP13:E54 80500-83000 CAMERA: Medium tracking shot of Alexander breaking into a desperate charge.
EP13:E55 80800-82200 ALEXANDER [Furious, Booming]: "Stop!"
EP13:E56 83000-86000 ACTION: Juliana continues clawing forward, branches lacerating her arm and cheek.
EP13:E57 83000-86000 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana wincing in agony and screaming through clenched teeth.
EP13:E58 83800-85800 JULIANA [Agonized Scream]: "Ahhh!"
EP13:E59 86000-89000 CAMERA: Medium shot of the Constable forcefully grappling Alexander by his coat collar, slamming him back against the gate.
EP13:E60 86500-88800 ALEXANDER [Roaring in Torment]: "Juliana!"
EP13:E61 89000-94000 CAMERA: Ground-level shot of Juliana frantically digging and scraping at the frozen dirt and dried bramble pods with both bloody hands.
EP13:E62 89200-94000 ACTION: Juliana digs her torn fingers into the frost-hardened earth, turning over rocks and dead vegetation.
EP13:E63 94000-97000 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Alexander struggling against the Constable, his face twisted in grief and rage.
EP13:E64 94800-96400 ALEXANDER [Desperate Shout]: "Juliana!"
EP13:E65 97000-103000 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana lying on her stomach among the thorns, bleeding cuts running down her forehead, cheeks, and bare arms.
EP13:E66 98200-102500 JULIANA [Panting, Praying]: "Please, ring... you have to be here."
EP13:E67 103000-106500 ACTION: Her blood-smeared index finger brushes against a solid metallic object half-buried in the frozen dirt beneath a thorny branch.
EP13:E68 103000-107000 CAMERA: Extreme close-up macro shot of an ornate antique gold ring set with a massive, radiant emerald resting in the frosted soil.
EP13:E69 107000-109000 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana's wide, disbelieving blue eyes as breath catches in her throat.
EP13:E70 109000-112000 ACTION: Juliana reaches out her torn, bloodied hand and wraps her fingers tightly around the emerald ring.
EP13:E71 109000-112000 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of her bloody hand closing around the emerald signet ring.
EP13:E72 112000-113000 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana grimacing in fierce triumph and intense pain as thorns catch her knuckles.
EP13:E73 113000-114000 CAMERA: Brief cut to Alexander staring into the briar patch in suspended terror.
EP13:E74 114000-117200 CAMERA: Close-up on Juliana's sweat- and frost-streaked face as she grinds her teeth, tears pooling in her eyes, fighting through the blinding pain.
EP13:E75 117200-118880 CAMERA: Macro close-up holding on Juliana's bloodied fist firmly gripping the emerald ring against the frozen ground as the episode cuts to black.

EP=ep_014; timestamps are integer milliseconds
SOURCE_SHA256=23e67fb015dbfbf003d1008f2fd5033dfa192100b1eced5d1bb3e28d31c3844d
METADATA ONLY (not on-screen evidence): {'logline': "After Juliana secures Alexander's freedom with the unearthed emerald signet ring, he carries her home to bandage her torn hands, silently swearing that no one will ever harm her again.", 'continuity_notes': "Picks up immediately from Episode 13's cliffhanger where Juliana grasped the emerald ring beneath the razor-sharp blackthorns."}
SOURCE WARNINGS=[]
SCENE sc_001 0-40500 EXT. BLACKTHORN GARDEN – DUSK
EP14:E1 0-5600 CAMERA: Close-up low angle looking through dense, sharp blackthorn branches onto the cracked, frozen soil.
EP14:E2 500-5500 ACTION: Juliana's blood-streaked, mud-caked hand slowly uncurls amidst the thorns, revealing the ornate emerald signet ring resting in her palm.
EP14:E3 1000-5500 SOUND: Eerie cold wind whistling over the briars with deep, atmospheric cello chords.
EP14:E4 5600-9500 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana stepping out from the briar patch, her cloak torn, cheeks scratched, holding the ring outward with unwavering resolve.
EP14:E5 7700-9000 JULIANA [Exhausted, Resolute]: "I found it."
EP14:E6 9500-13500 CAMERA: Wide shot of Juliana holding the ring out toward the austere Police Constable standing guard beside the frozen garden.
EP14:E7 10500-12700 JULIANA [Firm, Commanding]: "Now release my husband."
EP14:E8 12500-13500 ACTION: The Constable takes the ring from her bloodied fingers.
EP14:E9 13500-15500 CAMERA: Tight shot on the iron shackles locking Alexander's wrists together against the thorny backdrop.
EP14:E10 14200-15400 SOUND: Sharp metallic click and clinking rattle of heavy iron handcuffs unlocking and falling away.
EP14:E11 14500-15600 ACTION: The Constable unlocks the cuffs, freeing Alexander's large hands.
EP14:E12 15600-18500 CAMERA: Tracking shot as Alexander lunges forward without hesitation, rushing past the Constable straight to Juliana.
EP14:E13 16800-18000 ALEXANDER [Gasping, Urgent]: "Juliana."
EP14:E14 18500-23000 CAMERA: Close-up on Alexander's rugged hands tenderly grasping Juliana's bloodied, lacerated hands, turning them over with immense care.
EP14:E15 18800-23000 ACTION: Alexander gently turns her palms up, his thumbs trembling as he inspects the deep, bleeding gashes gouged into her skin.
EP14:E16 23000-25500 CAMERA: Close-up on Alexander's agonized, furious expression as he stares at her wounds.
EP14:E17 23100-25000 ALEXANDER [Trembling, Heartbroken]: "What have they done to you?"
EP14:E18 25500-29500 CAMERA: Close-up on Juliana's pale, tear-streaked face looking back into his eyes with tender relief.
EP14:E19 26500-28500 JULIANA [Softly, Stifling Pain]: "Nothing they didn't promise."
EP14:E20 29500-32500 CAMERA: Medium profile two-shot of Alexander and Juliana gazing into each other's eyes amidst the cold mist.
EP14:E21 29800-32000 JULIANA [Faint, Pleading]: "Take me home."
EP14:E22 32500-38500 CAMERA: Low-angle medium shot as Alexander effortlessly scoops Juliana into his arms, gathering her up against his chest.
EP14:E23 33200-37000 ACTION: Alexander lifts Juliana bridal-style, wrapping his strong arms protectively around her as she rests against his shoulder.
EP14:E24 35800-38500 ALEXANDER [Deep, Sorrowful]: "You should never have had to bleed for me."
EP14:E25 38500-40500 CAMERA: Medium tracking shot behind stone balustrades as Alexander carries Juliana past the foggy estate grounds.
SCENE sc_002 40500-43500 EXT. ALEXANDER'S COTTAGE – CONTINUOUS
EP14:E26 40500-43500 CAMERA: Wide establishing shot of the humble stone cottage standing isolated beneath dark, overcast stormy skies on a rain-slicked dirt road.
EP14:E27 40500-43500 SOUND: Gentle patter of rain and cold wind howling in the desolate countryside.
SCENE sc_003 43500-87630 INT. ALEXANDER'S COTTAGE – NIGHT
EP14:E28 43500-47000 CAMERA: Warm interior wide shot in front of a roaring hearth fire. Juliana sits on a wooden chair while Alexander kneels on the floor before her, a washbasin of water between them.
EP14:E29 44000-47000 ACTION: Alexander gently wraps clean linen bandages around Juliana's torn wrist and palm.
EP14:E30 44000-47500 SOUND: Crackling flames and wood popping in the open fireplace.
EP14:E31 47000-50500 CAMERA: Intimate over-the-shoulder close-up looking up into Juliana's face from Alexander's perspective.
EP14:E32 47200-49800 ALEXANDER [Hoarse, Stricken]: "You could have lost your hands."
EP14:E33 50500-55500 CAMERA: Extreme close-up on Juliana's glistening eyes and trembling lips, firelight reflecting softly across her face.
EP14:E34 51800-54000 JULIANA [Whispered, Emotional]: "But I didn't lose you."
EP14:E35 55500-58500 CAMERA: Close-up on Alexander's scarred, weathered fingers wrapping the cloth tightly yet gently around her lacerations.
EP14:E36 58500-60500 CAMERA: Close-up on Alexander looking up at her with profound remorse and affection.
EP14:E37 58500-60000 ALEXANDER [Quiet, Tender]: "I'm sorry."
EP14:E38 60500-63500 CAMERA: Close-up on Juliana smiling faintly through her tears, shaking her head.
EP14:E39 60500-62500 JULIANA [Gentle, Reassuring]: "You didn't hurt me."
EP14:E40 63500-66000 CAMERA: Side profile close-up of Alexander lowering his head solemnly in front of her.
EP14:E41 66000-70500 CAMERA: Medium two-shot as Alexander gently drapes a heavy warm woolen blanket across Juliana's lap and around her shoulders.
EP14:E42 66000-67400 JULIANA [Loving, Earnest]: "You have taken my place today."
EP14:E43 67500-69800 JULIANA [Continuing]: "And you are doing it better than me."
EP14:E44 70500-76000 CAMERA: Medium shot as Juliana rests her cheek against Alexander's chest; he embraces her tightly against him, cradling her head under his chin.
EP14:E45 71000-76000 ACTION: Juliana closes her eyes in exhausted relief, sinking into Alexander's warmth as his broad arm encloses her safely.
EP14:E46 76000-83500 CAMERA: Tight close-up of Alexander holding Juliana against his bearded cheek, kissing the crown of her head before gently cradling her jaw in his scarred hand.
EP14:E47 76500-81000 ALEXANDER [Dark, Solemn Vow]: "No one will ever hurt you for protecting me again."
EP14:E48 81200-83500 ACTION: Alexander strokes her cheek with his thumb, his gaze hardening into deadly, protective conviction.
EP14:E49 83500-87630 CAMERA: Low-angle shot focusing down on two wooden buckets on the stone floor—one filled with dark, blood-soaked wash water reflecting the fireplace.
EP14:E50 84000-87000 ACTION: Alexander's muscular arm drops into frame beside the bloody bucket; his scarred knuckles slowly and tightly clench into an iron fist of brewing vengeance.
EP14:E51 84500-87630 SOUND: Ominous, resonating low bass boom swelling into sudden silence as the screen cuts to black.

EP=ep_015; timestamps are integer milliseconds
SOURCE_SHA256=4820cb5f1dca8b09eb9b111eb828151ea39cb8d15da729b75acb08551f573b27
METADATA ONLY (not on-screen evidence): {'logline': "When ruthless thugs desecrate Juliana's medicinal garden and trample her late mother's herbs, a protective Alexander charges into the night to defend her.", 'continuity_notes': "Follows Episode 14 where Alexander solemnly vowed Juliana would never be hurt again; Juliana's hands remain heavily bandaged from retrieving the emerald ring."}
SOURCE WARNINGS=[]
SCENE sc_001 0-86000 EXT. HERBAL GARDEN - NIGHT
EP15:E1 0-3500 CAMERA: High-angle wide shot of the raised planter beds illuminated by the pale moonlight as three shadowy figures march purposefully down the central stone path.
EP15:E2 0-3500 ACTION: Three menacing thugs, armed with clubs and tools, stalk through the quiet herbal garden surrounded by stone walls.
EP15:E3 3500-5000 CAMERA: Low-angle medium shot focusing on one thug raising a heavy wooden club overhead.
EP15:E4 3600-4900 ACTION: The thug brutally smashes his club down into a wooden planter box, shattering the frame.
EP15:E5 3800-4900 SOUND: A splintering wooden crash echoing through the night air.
EP15:E6 5000-7500 CAMERA: Medium close-up of a bald thug leaning over a lush bed of white medicinal chamomile herbs.
EP15:E7 5100-7400 ACTION: The bald thug roughly rips a massive handful of flowering herbs up by their roots, scattering soil across the path.
EP15:E8 7500-11800 CAMERA: Medium shot framing the open doorway of the stone cottage, bathed in warm interior light against the dark night.
EP15:E9 7600-11800 ACTION: Juliana bursts through the cottage doorway, her hands wrapped in clean white bandages, freezing in horror at the destruction.
EP15:E10 8500-11700 JULIANA [Desperate, Alarmed]: "Stop! What are you doing?!"
EP15:E11 11800-15800 CAMERA: Medium close-up of the Thug with Cap holding the uprooted chamomile bouquet, sneering with cruel amusement.
EP15:E12 13000-15700 THUG WITH CAP [Mocking, Smug]: "We're clearing this rubbish."
EP15:E13 15800-18800 CAMERA: Close-up on Juliana, her face tight with anguish and fury as she clutches her bandaged hands against her chest.
EP15:E14 16400-18700 JULIANA [Furious, Pleading]: "Those are medicinal plants!"
EP15:E15 18800-22500 CAMERA: Low-angle shot tracking down from the bald thug's grinning face to his worn leather boots on the muddy flagstones.
EP15:E16 20000-22300 BALD THUG [Callous]: "They look like weeds to me."
EP15:E17 20500-22500 ACTION: The bald thug flings the bouquet into the mud and grinds his heavy boot directly onto the delicate flowers.
EP15:E18 22500-26800 CAMERA: High-angle two-shot as Juliana rushes forward and drops directly onto her knees in the cold mud before the thug.
EP15:E19 22800-26500 ACTION: Juliana frantically tries to scoop the crushed soil and torn stems back into the bed with her bandaged hands.
EP15:E20 23200-26300 JULIANA [Choked with Tears, Desperate]: "Please! Those plants took months to grow!"
EP15:E21 26800-31500 CAMERA: Medium two-shot of the Tall Thug with the club and the Thug with Cap bursting into raucous laughter under the full moon.
EP15:E22 27500-31200 TALL THUG [Contemptuous, Derisive]: "Months? You actually spend your days growing this filth?"
EP15:E23 31500-34000 CAMERA: Tight close-up of Juliana's bandaged hands trembling as she tenderly gathers the soiled white flowers from the puddles.
EP15:E24 34000-37000 CAMERA: Low-angle medium shot tilting up as Juliana rises from the ground, standing tall despite her trembling frame.
EP15:E25 34800-36800 JULIANA [Defiant, Firm]: "Leave my garden alone."
EP15:E26 37000-40500 CAMERA: Medium close-up of the Thug with Cap scoffing derisively.
EP15:E27 37200-40400 THUG WITH CAP [Sneering, Disdainful]: "A noble lady playing in the dirt. What a joke."
EP15:E28 40500-44200 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana, her eyes blazing with indignation and wounded pride.
EP15:E29 41000-44000 JULIANA [Resolute, Dignified]: "It is my home. You have no right to destroy anything here."
EP15:E30 44200-46500 CAMERA: Tight close-up of the Thug with Cap stepping aggressively into Juliana's personal space, snarling with venom.
EP15:E31 44800-46400 THUG WITH CAP [Menacing Snarl]: "Get out of the way!"
EP15:E32 46500-48000 CAMERA: Extreme close-up on Juliana's piercing blue eyes and set jaw, unflinching.
EP15:E33 46500-47300 JULIANA [Steely, Fearless]: "No."
EP15:E34 47400-49500 ACTION: The Thug with Cap violently shoves Juliana back with both hands; she cries out as she loses her balance and crashes hard onto the wet stone path.
EP15:E35 47800-49000 JULIANA [Gasping Cry]: "Ah!"
EP15:E36 49500-53500 CAMERA: Close-up tracking down to Juliana's hand hitting the mud next to the crushed chamomile flowers.
EP15:E37 50000-53500 ACTION: Juliana crawls forward on her elbows; fresh crimson blood seeps profusely through her white gauze bandages as she reaches for the ruined blossoms.
EP15:E38 53500-56500 CAMERA: Tight close-up on Juliana's mud-streaked, tear-stained face trembling in heartbreaking agony.
EP15:E39 53500-55700 JULIANA [Broken, Sobbing]: "My mother's plants..."
EP15:E40 56500-60000 CAMERA: Low-angle wide shot of the three thugs pointing and laughing hysterically at her kneeling form.
EP15:E41 57300-59800 BALD THUG [Cruel, Laughing]: "Look at her! Crying over weeds!"
EP15:E42 60000-62000 ACTION: The Tall Thug hoists his heavy wooden club above his head to crush the remaining herbs right before Juliana.
EP15:E43 60000-61000 JULIANA [Screaming]: "Stop!"
EP15:E44 62000-63200 CAMERA: Medium close-up of the Thug with Cap suddenly stiffening, his smug smile dropping as footsteps pound in the darkness.
EP15:E45 63200-67500 CAMERA: Medium tracking shot as Alexander charges past the corner of the cottage into the misty moonlight, his dark coat billowing behind him.
EP15:E46 63500-67500 ACTION: Alexander storms forward with lethal intensity, dark hair flying, breath misting in the cold, radiating untamed rage.
EP15:E47 67500-73500 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana looking up through wet lashes, trembling as shock transforms into overwhelming relief.
EP15:E48 70500-72600 JULIANA [Whispered Breath, Stunned]: "Alexander..."
EP15:E49 73500-75500 CAMERA: Wide shot of the three thugs wheeling around to face the dark figure approaching from the mist.
EP15:E50 75500-78500 CAMERA: Low-angle tracking shot from behind Alexander's broad shoulders as he steadily steps past the fallen Juliana, towering over the intruders.
EP15:E51 76000-78500 ACTION: Alexander places himself directly between Juliana and the three thugs, staring them down with cold, deadly intent.
EP15:E52 78500-82800 CAMERA: Medium shot of the three thugs regrouping, the Thug with Cap feigning swagger as he grips his club.
EP15:E53 79000-82400 THUG WITH CAP [Challenging, Arrogant]: "What? You want to fight us, veteran?"
EP15:E54 82800-86000 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana looking up with wide, anxious eyes, breath hitching in suspense as violence hangs on a knife's edge.
EP15:E55 84000-86000 SOUND: Tense, low dramatic cello swell holding into an abrupt cliffhanger cut.

EP=ep_016; timestamps are integer milliseconds
SOURCE_SHA256=f86c26df7397d86091056e44fe613c2f50abe7d221f7e015d8cdd5c4f8775e19
METADATA ONLY (not on-screen evidence): {'logline': "When hired thugs attack Juliana's medicinal garden, Alexander unleashes his combat training to effortlessly overpower them, extracting a shocking confession that unmasks Gerald Harrington as the mastermind.", 'continuity_notes': "Picks up immediately from Episode 15's cliffhanger where Alexander confronted the three thugs in the moonlit garden while Juliana huddled injured on the ground."}
SOURCE WARNINGS=[]
SCENE sc_001 0-83190 EXT. JULIANA'S COTTAGE GARDEN – NIGHT
EP16:E1 0-2100 CAMERA: Wide shot from behind Alexander's trench coat looking toward the three thugs standing across the trampled garden under the full moon.
EP16:E2 0-2100 ACTION: Alexander stands tall and unyielding, blocking the path to Juliana, while the Thug with Cap steps forward clutching an iron pipe.
EP16:E3 2100-4500 CAMERA: Medium close-up of the Thug with Cap, his eyes wide and sneering with false bravado as his bald accomplice watches from behind.
EP16:E4 2100-4200 THUG WITH CAP [Menacing, Goading]: "Move aside, soldier."
EP16:E5 4500-6400 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Alexander's scarred, weathered face, his cold blue-grey eyes fixed intently on his opponent.
EP16:E6 6400-9500 CAMERA: Low-angle medium shot of the Thug with Cap gripping his weapon with both hands and roaring into the night air.
EP16:E7 6400-8800 THUG WITH CAP [Furious, Shouting]: "I said, move!"
EP16:E8 9500-11200 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Alexander remaining completely motionless, his jaw clenched in stoic calm.
EP16:E9 11200-13100 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana kneeling in the mud against the ruined planter, clutching her bandaged hands to her chest in trembling fear.
EP16:E10 11200-12700 JULIANA [Frightened, Whispering]: "Alexander..."
EP16:E11 13100-14300 ALEXANDER [Calm, Protective]: "Stay behind me."
EP16:E12 14300-16000 CAMERA: Medium action shot as the Thug with Cap lunges forward with his weapon raised high.
EP16:E13 14400-15500 THUG WITH CAP [Roaring]: "Aaargh!"
EP16:E14 14400-16800 ACTION: The thug swings the club down with full force, but Alexander catches the weapon mid-air in his bare hand with chilling ease.
EP16:E15 15800-16500 SOUND: Heavy blunt impact of a solid hand gripping wood.
EP16:E16 16800-19500 CAMERA: Close-up of the Thug with Cap staring in wide-eyed terror as Alexander grips the bar and wrenches it away effortlessly.
EP16:E17 19200-21800 ACTION: Alexander strikes the thug across the chest and slams him violently into the muddy ground beside the stone wall.
EP16:E18 19800-21200 SOUND: Heavy thud of a body crashing into soil and wood.
EP16:E19 21800-23000 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana watching in breathless astonishment.
EP16:E20 23000-25800 CAMERA: Medium tracking shot as the Bald Thug charges in with a shout, only for Alexander to pivot and seize him by the neck, hurling him across the garden path.
EP16:E21 23000-23800 BALD THUG [Yelling]: "Aaargh!"
EP16:E22 24200-25500 SOUND: Loud wooden scrape and crunch as the Bald Thug slides across the planks into the fence.
EP16:E23 25800-28500 CAMERA: Medium shot of the Third Thug backing away nervously, raising a blunt rod with trembling arms before lunging.
EP16:E24 25800-27100 THIRD THUG [Desperate, Shouting]: "Stay back!"
EP16:E25 26500-28500 ACTION: Alexander deflects the strike with his forearm, drives a swift counter-blow into the thug's torso, and spins him violently to the ground.
EP16:E26 27000-28200 SOUND: Solid bone-and-fist impact followed by a groaning thud.
EP16:E27 28500-31000 CAMERA: Wide cinematic shot under the full moon. Alexander towers over the three writhing thugs groaning in the mud as Juliana looks up from her knees.
EP16:E28 31000-34500 CAMERA: Low-angle close-up of Juliana looking up at Alexander, tears glistening on her mud-splattered cheeks in profound relief.
EP16:E29 32000-33800 JULIANA [Breathless, Overwhelmed]: "Alexander..."
EP16:E30 34500-38200 CAMERA: Medium shot over Juliana's shoulder as Alexander turns his gaze toward her, his stern demeanor softening with concern.
EP16:E31 36200-37800 ALEXANDER [Gentle, Concerned]: "Are you hurt?"
EP16:E32 38200-40800 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana's trembling, soil-stained hands wrapped in blood-soaked bandages.
EP16:E33 38200-40000 JULIANA [Fragile, Pain-filled]: "Only my hands."
EP16:E34 40800-44200 CAMERA: Medium shot as Alexander suddenly wheels around, strides to the groaning Thug with Cap, and yanks him straight off the ground by his coat collar with one arm.
EP16:E35 41200-44000 ACTION: Alexander lifts the thug onto his tiptoes against the cottage wall, glaring with lethal intensity.
EP16:E36 42500-44000 ALEXANDER [Demanding, Threatening]: "Who sent you?"
EP16:E37 44200-46200 CAMERA: Close-up of the Thug with Cap gagging under Alexander's iron fist.
EP16:E38 44200-45300 THUG WITH CAP [Choking, Defiant]: "No one!"
EP16:E39 46200-48500 CAMERA: Close-up of Alexander, his eyes darkening with lethal fury.
EP16:E40 46300-47400 ALEXANDER [Cold, Ominous]: "Wrong answer."
EP16:E41 48000-50000 ACTION: Alexander tightens his grip on the thug's throat, lifting him higher against the stone wall.
EP16:E42 48800-49600 ALEXANDER [Roaring]: "Who?!"
EP16:E43 49800-52800 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of the terrified thug gasping for air, his eyes bulging.
EP16:E44 49800-52200 THUG WITH CAP [Screaming, Panicked]: "Harrington! Gerald Harrington paid us!"
EP16:E45 52800-55200 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana on the ground, reeling in devastated disbelief as the betrayal hits her.
EP16:E46 53200-54400 JULIANA [Shaken, Heartbroken]: "Gerald..."
EP16:E47 55200-59000 CAMERA: Medium wide shot as Alexander releases the thug, sending him tumbling into the ruined flowerbeds.
EP16:E48 55500-58500 ACTION: The Thug with Cap scrambles to his feet and sprints into the dark woods alongside his two limping accomplices.
EP16:E49 56000-58200 THUG WITH CAP [Shouting, Retreating]: "We were only paid to destroy the garden, that's all!"
EP16:E50 59000-63000 CAMERA: Close-up on Alexander's hand hanging by his coat. Fresh blood trickles from his split knuckles, and he slowly curls his fingers into a tight fist.
EP16:E51 60000-63000 ACTION: Alexander flexes his bleeding hand, showing no sign of pain.
EP16:E52 63000-66500 CAMERA: Medium shot as Juliana gingerly rises to her feet, stepping toward Alexander with deep awe and wonder in her eyes.
EP16:E53 64200-66200 JULIANA [Soft, Astounded]: "You knew exactly what to do."
EP16:E54 66500-70500 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana looking up at him, searching his scarred face.
EP16:E55 67800-70200 JULIANA [Wondering, Intrigued]: "You fought like you've done this a hundred times."
EP16:E56 70500-74200 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Alexander turning his profile away, shadowed by haunted memories of his past.
EP16:E57 71000-74000 ALEXANDER [Somber, Heavy-Hearted]: "A soldier learns things he wishes he could forget."
EP16:E58 74200-76800 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana softening with deep empathy as her eyes drop to his bleeding knuckle.
EP16:E59 74800-75800 JULIANA [Tender, Concerned]: "Are you hurt?"
EP16:E60 76000-77500 ACTION: Juliana reaches out toward his injured hand with delicate concern.
EP16:E61 76800-83190 CAMERA: Medium shot of Alexander and Juliana standing face-to-face in the moonlit garden, framed against the dark night.
EP16:E62 77800-78800 ALEXANDER [Quiet, Steady]: "No."
EP16:E63 78800-83190 ACTION: Alexander and Juliana gaze deeply into each other's eyes, an unspoken bond forming between them as the ruined garden lies silent beneath the moon.
EP16:E64 80000-83190 SOUND: Slow, resonant emotional cello melody swelling to a dramatic cliffhanger hold.

EP=ep_017; timestamps are integer milliseconds
SOURCE_SHA256=25fad86cb46d505849d1247d92836e1176bf732e50699a00b1f34c0e14f28e27
METADATA ONLY (not on-screen evidence): {'logline': "In the aftermath of the brutal attack, Alexander repairs Juliana's devastated garden and swears to protect her with his life, drawing them into a tender, intimate embrace by the hearth.", 'continuity_notes': "Picks up the morning after Episode 16's moonlit confrontation where Alexander defended Juliana and defeated Harrington's hired thugs in her medicinal garden."}
SOURCE WARNINGS=['sc_001: incomplete source coverage; gaps are unavailable']
SCENE sc_001 0-39000 EXT. MEDICINAL GARDEN – DAY
EP17:E1 0-3000 CAMERA: High angle wide shot looking down at the muddy, trampled garden. Broken wooden planters and splintered planks litter the ground as Juliana kneels amidst the ruined soil.
EP17:E2 0-3000 ACTION: Juliana sits on her knees in her dirt-smudged dress, her hands wrapped in clean linen bandages, sorrowfully examining the wreckage. In the distant background, Alexander paces near the perimeter fence.
EP17:E3 3000-7000 CAMERA: Close-up on Juliana's bandaged hand reaching into the dark earth of a battered planter box.
EP17:E4 3000-7000 ACTION: Juliana gently lifts a tiny, delicate white daisy clinging to its exposed roots out of the soil, cupping it in her palm.
EP17:E5 7000-11500 CAMERA: Medium close-up tilting up to Juliana's face, bruised and tear-streaked yet filled with fragile hope.
EP17:E6 9300-11300 JULIANA [Soft, Emotional]: "Some of them survived."
EP17:E7 11500-14000 CAMERA: Low-angle medium shot of Alexander repairing the broken wooden fence with a heavy iron hammer.
EP17:E8 11500-14000 SOUND: Rhythmic, heavy thuds of an iron hammer pounding into weathered wood.
EP17:E9 11500-14000 ACTION: Alexander firmly drives nails into a fractured fence post, his brow furrowed with focused determination.
EP17:E10 14000-16200 CAMERA: Wide shot framing Juliana kneeling on the wet cobblestones in the foreground while Alexander stands by the fence behind her, lowering his hammer.
EP17:E11 14300-15300 JULIANA [Grateful, Sincere]: "Thank you."
EP17:E12 16200-18000 CAMERA: Close-up of Alexander turning toward her, his scarred face stoic and intense.
EP17:E13 16800-17800 ALEXANDER [Gruff, Low]: "For what?"
EP17:E14 18000-21000 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana looking up at him with deep emotional vulnerability, her eyes shimmering with tears.
EP17:E15 18200-20500 JULIANA [Trembling, Heartfelt]: "For standing between me and those men."
EP17:E16 21000-23500 CAMERA: Close-up of Alexander, his piercing blue-grey eyes fixed upon her with absolute conviction.
EP17:E17 21500-23000 ALEXANDER [Unwavering, Firm]: "I would do it again."
EP17:E18 23500-25800 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana, her lips parting as her voice wavers with emotion.
EP17:E19 24000-25700 JULIANA [Whispering, Awed]: "Even if there were ten of them?"
EP17:E20 26000-27700 ALEXANDER [Deep, Resolute]: "As long as I draw breath..."
EP17:E21 26500-30000 CAMERA: Tracking shot following Alexander as he strides across the muddy garden and approaches Juliana.
EP17:E22 28000-31500 ACTION: Alexander drops to one knee before Juliana, gently taking her trembling, bandaged hands into his large, weathered palms.
EP17:E23 28800-31000 ALEXANDER [Gentle, Vowing]: "...no one will hurt you again."
EP17:E24 31500-34500 CAMERA: Close-up on Juliana's tear-filled face, overwhelmed by his fierce devotion.
EP17:E25 32800-34200 JULIANA [Choked Up, Pained]: "You cannot promise that."
EP17:E26 34500-36500 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Alexander's intense, protective gaze locking onto hers.
EP17:E27 34800-35800 ALEXANDER [Quiet, Absolute]: "I just did."
EP17:E28 36500-39000 CAMERA: Close-up of their joined hands, his rugged, scarred fingers wrapping securely around her bandaged fingers.
EP17:E29 36500-39000 ACTION: Alexander squeezes Juliana's hands reassuringly as she rests her fingertips against his skin. The scene fades to black.
SCENE sc_002 39000-118880 INT. COTTAGE HEARTH – NIGHT
EP17:E30 39000-42000 CAMERA: Medium shot in the warm, flickering firelight of the stone cottage. Juliana kneels on the stone floor beside a washbasin of water while Alexander sits quietly in a chair beside the blazing hearth.
EP17:E31 40000-44500 ACTION: Juliana wrings out a clean linen cloth from the basin and tenderly dabs at the fresh cuts and abrasions on the back of Alexander's right hand.
EP17:E32 42000-45000 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana's bandaged hands delicately pressing the white cloth against Alexander's wounded knuckles.
EP17:E33 42800-44700 JULIANA [Tender, Reproachful]: "You were bleeding last night."
EP17:E34 45000-48500 CAMERA: Medium close-up showing Alexander gazing down at her, his expression softening with unspoken affection as he gently takes hold of her wrist.
EP17:E35 46000-47300 ALEXANDER [Quiet, Fond]: "So were you."
EP17:E36 48500-51500 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana looking up into his eyes, a faint, tender smile gracing her lips.
EP17:E37 49000-51500 JULIANA [Softly Teasing]: "You make it very difficult to argue with you."
EP17:E38 51500-54000 CAMERA: Close-up of Alexander ducking his chin, a subtle, bashful smile fleetingly touching his scarred face.
EP17:E39 53500-56000 ACTION: Juliana returns the damp cloth to the ceramic basin, her expression turning somber and reflective.
EP17:E40 54000-58500 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana looking up at him, her vulnerability resurfacing in the warm amber glow.
EP17:E41 56500-58000 JULIANA [Vulnerable, Sincere]: "I was frightened."
EP17:E42 58500-60500 CAMERA: Close-up of Alexander, his brow furrowing with sudden concern.
EP17:E43 58800-59800 ALEXANDER [Questioning]: "Of them?"
EP17:E44 60500-63500 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana gazing directly into his eyes, her heart laid bare.
EP17:E45 60800-62200 JULIANA [Whispering, Earnest]: "Of losing you."
EP17:E46 63500-66000 CAMERA: Close-up of Alexander visibly moved, his gaze softening with profound emotion.
EP17:E47 66000-73500 CAMERA: Medium shot as Alexander stands and pulls Juliana gently to her feet against his broad chest.
EP17:E48 66000-73500 ACTION: Juliana rests her cheek against Alexander's chest, closing her eyes as his strong arms wrap around her shoulders, holding her safe against his frame.
EP17:E49 73500-78000 CAMERA: Close-up on their faces nestled together in the firelight, Alexander resting his bearded chin against her hair.
EP17:E50 77000-81000 ACTION: Juliana nestles deeper into his coat, listening intently to the rapid thudding beneath his chest.
EP17:E51 78500-80000 JULIANA [Soft, Playful]: "Your heart is racing."
EP17:E52 80500-83500 CAMERA: Close-up of Alexander tilting his head down toward her, a tender smile breaking through his rugged beard.
EP17:E53 81200-82500 ALEXANDER [Warm, Whispering]: "So is yours."
EP17:E54 83500-87500 CAMERA: Medium shot framing the couple embraced in front of the roaring, glowing fireplace.
EP17:E55 86500-90000 ACTION: Juliana slowly raises her hand, gently twirling a lock of Alexander's long, unruly dark hair between her fingers.
EP17:E56 87500-90000 CAMERA: Close-up of her delicate fingers running through his thick strands of hair.
EP17:E57 88000-89800 JULIANA [Lighthearted, Teasing]: "This is becoming impossible."
EP17:E58 90000-93000 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana beaming up at him with affectionate humor.
EP17:E59 90400-92500 JULIANA [Smiling]: "Soon birds will start nesting in it."
EP17:E60 93000-96000 CAMERA: Close-up of Alexander regarding her with a subtle, affectionate smirk.
EP17:E61 93500-95200 ALEXANDER [Dry, Amused]: "They have not complained yet."
EP17:E62 95500-97000 ACTION: Juliana lets out a quiet, melodic laugh.
EP17:E63 96000-100000 CAMERA: Medium close-up as Juliana lifts her bandaged hand toward his beard playfully.
EP17:E64 96500-99200 JULIANA [Charming, Tender]: "Then I shall have to save you from the birds."
EP17:E65 99500-102500 ACTION: Alexander gently catches her wrist mid-air, holding her hand firmly against his chest while looking into her eyes with solemn sincerity.
EP17:E66 100300-101500 ALEXANDER [Solemn, Gentle]: "Not yet."
EP17:E67 102500-105000 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana looking up at him, her eyes shining with quiet patience and understanding.
EP17:E68 103000-104200 JULIANA [Sweet, Reassuring]: "Then I will wait."
EP17:E69 105000-108000 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Alexander releasing a quiet breath of gratitude, pulling her closer against his shoulder.
EP17:E70 107000-114000 ACTION: Juliana rests her head against Alexander's collarbone once more, wrapping both arms around him as he cradles her head in his palm.
EP17:E71 108000-112000 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana's peaceful face resting against Alexander's rugged chest.
EP17:E72 108300-111500 JULIANA [V.O.) (Reflective, Resonant]: "I know almost nothing about the man I married."
EP17:E73 112000-118880 CAMERA: Slow pull-back wide shot of Alexander and Juliana locked in a tender, enduring embrace before the radiant, roaring hearth as the fire crackles peacefully.
EP17:E74 112200-116000 JULIANA [V.O.) (Deeply Moved, Loving]: "But every day, he gives me another reason to trust him."
EP17:E75 114000-118880 SOUND: Warm crackle of embers in the hearth blending with swelling, tender orchestral strings holding into the fade-out.
