EP=ep_018; timestamps are integer milliseconds
SOURCE_SHA256=1e1ecab8f43c144862ef126eb707196478303c1af57186357ba1e25ea4c8e529
METADATA ONLY (not on-screen evidence): {'logline': "When their cottage is deliberately set ablaze in the dead of night, Alexander risks his life to rescue Juliana and her mother's cherished ledger from the inferno, vowing relentless vengeance against those responsible.", 'continuity_notes': "Picks up directly from Episode 17's intimate hearthside moment; their peaceful sanctuary is shattered when arsonists trap Juliana and Alexander inside their burning home."}
SOURCE WARNINGS=['sc_002: incomplete source coverage; gaps are unavailable', 'sc_003: incomplete source coverage; gaps are unavailable', 'sc_005: incomplete source coverage; gaps are unavailable']
SCENE sc_001 0-28900 INT. COTTAGE - BEDROOM - NIGHT
EP18:E1 0-2100 CAMERA: Low-angle shot on the wooden floor as bright orange flames crackle beneath the closed bedroom door, thick smoke billowing through the crevices.
EP18:E2 0-2100 SOUND: Muffled crackle and roar of an encroaching blaze.
EP18:E3 2100-5800 CAMERA: Close-up overhead shot of Juliana asleep on her pillow as her eyelids flutter open, gasping and coughing violently from the choking smoke.
EP18:E4 3500-6000 ACTION: Juliana coughs, her eyes widening in immediate alarm as the smell of burning wood fills her lungs.
EP18:E5 6000-9500 ACTION: Juliana bolts upright in bed, tossing off the woolen quilt as she sees the orange glow under the door.
EP18:E6 6500-8500 JULIANA [Screaming, Terrified]: "Alexander!"
EP18:E7 9500-12800 CAMERA: Medium shot as Juliana swings her bare legs out of bed onto the floor, trembling with panic.
EP18:E8 10500-12300 JULIANA [Desperate, Shouting]: "Alexander!"
EP18:E9 12800-16200 CAMERA: Low-angle close shot of the bedroom door glowing intensely, fire licking the wooden floorboards as smoke pours inward.
EP18:E10 16200-20100 ACTION: Juliana sits huddled at the edge of the bed, pressing her bandaged hands against her mouth, coughing and sobbing in fear.
EP18:E11 17800-19800 JULIANA [Muffled, Weeping]: "Alexander..."
EP18:E12 19500-21000 SOUND: A violent crash as the bedroom door is kicked open.
EP18:E13 20100-22800 CAMERA: Framed in the doorway engulfed by blazing orange light, Alexander bursts in, his dark hair flying, looking like an imposing guardian amid the smoke.
EP18:E14 20800-22500 ALEXANDER [Authoritative, Urgency]: "Juliana! Get up!"
EP18:E15 22800-26000 CAMERA: Wide tracking shot as Alexander rushes across the burning, smoke-choked room toward her bed.
EP18:E16 24500-28900 ACTION: Alexander reaches the bed, hoisting Juliana up by her arms into a standing embrace.
EP18:E17 26500-28000 JULIANA [Breathless, Distressed]: "What happened?"
EP18:E18 28100-28900 ALEXANDER [Grim, Urgent]: "Fire."
SCENE sc_002 28900-52500 INT. COTTAGE - HALLWAY - CONTINUOUS
EP18:E19 28900-30800 CAMERA: Over-the-shoulder shot past Alexander toward the blazing threshold of the main room, beams collapsing across the doorway.
EP18:E20 30800-33000 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Alexander wrapping a heavy coat tightly around Juliana's shoulders.
EP18:E21 32500-36500 ACTION: Alexander clutches Juliana against his chest with one strong arm, shielding her face from the sparks.
EP18:E22 33200-35200 ALEXANDER [Firm, Protective]: "Stay close to me."
EP18:E23 36500-39000 CAMERA: Reverse shot from behind them facing the burning door frame as wall-high flames roar, completely sealing their exit.
EP18:E24 38000-41500 ACTION: Juliana recoils from the heat, clutching Alexander's coat tightly.
EP18:E25 39500-41800 JULIANA [Panic-Stricken, Choked]: "We cannot get through!"
EP18:E26 42000-43500 ALEXANDER [Resolute, Calm Under Pressure]: "Then we go another way."
EP18:E27 43500-48800 CAMERA: Tracking shot as Alexander turns, grabbing Juliana's hand, and pulls her quickly through the burning corridors.
EP18:E28 45000-48500 SOUND: Loud wooden groaning and thunderous crash of burning rafters falling behind them.
EP18:E29 48800-52500 CAMERA: Medium tracking shot focusing on Juliana's wide, soot-streaked eyes as they navigate through falling embers.
SCENE sc_003 52500-98500 INT. COTTAGE - PARLOR / WORKROOM - CONTINUOUS
EP18:E30 52500-56200 CAMERA: Close-up of the antique, leather-bound herbal ledger resting on a burning wooden table, the edges of its pages beginning to curl and singe in the heat.
EP18:E31 56200-58500 ACTION: Juliana spots the book and halts abruptly, pointing back toward the burning desk.
EP18:E32 56500-57800 JULIANA [Frantic, Desperate]: "The ledger!"
EP18:E33 57800-60000 ACTION: Alexander firmly grips her arm, pulling her back toward safety.
EP18:E34 58000-59200 ALEXANDER [Stern, Shouting]: "Leave it!"
EP18:E35 59300-62500 JULIANA [Hysterical, Screaming]: "No! No!"
EP18:E36 63000-65500 CAMERA: Low-angle shot pointing up at the ceiling beams overhead, engulfed in roaring fire and splitting down the center.
EP18:E37 65500-68000 ACTION: Alexander points upward with urgency, pulling her under his arm.
EP18:E38 65800-68000 ALEXANDER [Loud, Alarmed]: "Juliana, the ceiling is coming down!"
EP18:E39 68000-70500 ACTION: Juliana wrests her hand from his grasp and charges straight toward the burning desk.
EP18:E40 70500-73500 CAMERA: Wide shot of the room as a massive burning crossbeam collapses into the floorboards with a fiery explosion.
EP18:E41 73500-75500 ALEXANDER [Roaring in Terror]: "Juliana!"
EP18:E42 75000-76800 JULIANA [Defiant, Weeping]: "It's my mother's!"
EP18:E43 76800-81500 ACTION: Juliana snatches the scorched leather ledger from the burning table, pulling it tightly against her chest with both bandaged hands.
EP18:E44 81500-83500 CAMERA: Close-up of the ceiling rafter splitting violently apart above her.
EP18:E45 83500-86500 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana looking up in sheer terror, firelight dancing across her tearful face.
EP18:E46 84000-86200 JULIANA [Screaming, Blood-Curdling]: "Alexander!"
EP18:E47 86500-89500 ACTION: Alexander lunges across the room, tackling her to the wooden floor and covering her body entirely with his own.
EP18:E48 86500-87500 ALEXANDER [Screaming Command]: "Down!"
EP18:E49 87800-90000 SOUND: Massive wooden beam crashes directly where Juliana had been standing, showering them in sparks.
EP18:E50 89500-94000 CAMERA: Ground-level shot of Alexander lying on top of Juliana, his chest shielding her, his face smeared with soot.
EP18:E51 91500-98000 ACTION: Alexander lifts his head slightly, checking her face and cradling her cheek tenderly.
EP18:E52 96500-98200 ALEXANDER [Panting, Reassuring]: "I've got you."
SCENE sc_004 98500-124000 INT. COTTAGE - PARLOR / EXT. COTTAGE - CONTINUOUS
EP18:E53 98500-101500 CAMERA: Wide shot of the walls collapsing in curtains of flame, cutting off all interior hallways.
EP18:E54 101500-104500 ACTION: Alexander scoops Juliana up in his arms, carrying her bridal-style as she clutches the ledger.
EP18:E55 103500-105500 ACTION: Juliana looks toward the side wall and points frantically at the parlor window.
EP18:E56 103800-105000 JULIANA [Urgent, Shouting]: "The window!"
EP18:E57 105200-106800 ALEXANDER [Steely, Determined]: "Hold on to me."
EP18:E58 106800-109500 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Alexander gritting his teeth, holding Juliana securely as she buries her face into his neck.
EP18:E59 109500-114000 CAMERA: Slow-motion shot as Alexander sprints through the burning room toward the framed glass window.
EP18:E60 111500-115500 ACTION: Alexander leaps forward, using his shoulder and back to shatter through the burning window frame, carrying Juliana safely in his arms out into the night.
EP18:E61 112000-115500 SOUND: Loud explosion of shattering window glass and splintering wood.
EP18:E62 115500-119800 CAMERA: Wide interior shot as the entire parlor collapses into an uncontrollable inferno of roaring flames.
EP18:E63 119800-124000 CAMERA: Night exterior shot in the dark grass outside. Juliana sits over Alexander, brushing ashes from his face as he coughs and catches his breath.
SCENE sc_005 124000-192000 EXT. COTTAGE - FRONT YARD - CONTINUOUS
EP18:E64 124000-128500 CAMERA: Wide shot of villagers running toward the cottage carrying wooden water buckets through the smoke-filled darkness.
EP18:E65 128500-134500 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana kneeling in the mud, her face blackened with soot and tears streaming down her cheeks as she clutches the charred ledger.
EP18:E66 134500-140000 CAMERA: Wide shot of the cottage completely consumed by towering flames against the dark night sky.
EP18:E67 136200-138000 JULIANA [Sobbing, Heartbroken]: "Our home..."
EP18:E68 139800-142500 JULIANA [Crying, Shattered]: "Everything we had is gone."
EP18:E69 140500-144000 ACTION: Alexander kneels beside her in the grass, resting a steady, protective hand on her back.
EP18:E70 144000-155000 ACTION: Juliana turns toward Alexander, her hand trembling as she reaches out and touches his chest.
EP18:E71 145800-148500 JULIANA [Voice Breaking, Anguished]: "Why would anyone do this?"
EP18:E72 153200-154800 JULIANA [Whispering, Tearful]: "Alexander..."
EP18:E73 155000-161000 ACTION: Alexander draws her firmly into his arms, wrapping both burly arms around her as she buries her face into his shoulder, weeping uncontrollably.
EP18:E74 158000-160800 ALEXANDER [Cold, Ominous]: "Someone wanted us out."
EP18:E75 163000-165500 JULIANA [Despairing, Weeping]: "We have nowhere to go."
EP18:E76 165500-171000 CAMERA: Slow push-in on Alexander's face over Juliana's shoulder. His expression hardens into a mask of pure, lethal fury.
EP18:E77 171000-179500 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Alexander's piercing eyes and combat scar bathed in the flickering orange glow of the fire.
EP18:E78 171800-177200 ALEXANDER [Cold Fury, Resolute]: "They took our home. I will not let them take anything else now."
EP18:E79 179500-184000 ACTION: Juliana slowly pulls back slightly from his embrace, her tear-filled blue eyes looking up into his hardened features.
EP18:E80 184200-186500 JULIANA [Trembling, Apprehensive]: "What are you going to do?"
EP18:E81 186500-192000 CAMERA: Dramatic hold on Alexander's grim, unyielding profile as he stares into the inferno with unshakeable resolve, the swelling score echoing a vow of vengeance into the final cut to black.

EP=ep_019; timestamps are integer milliseconds
SOURCE_SHA256=45e16ab1556cb4afe16777d1538079263f933b85ecb63e1e44a462d33541fb24
METADATA ONLY (not on-screen evidence): {'logline': 'Standing before the smoldering ash of their home, Juliana and Alexander receive shelter and food from grateful villagers before Alexander meets in secret with a loyal spy, learning that his usurping enemies have imprisoned his mother and claimed his ducal seat.', 'continuity_notes': "Picks up directly from Episode 18's devastating fire; Juliana and Alexander stand amidst the morning ruins of Blackwood cottage with her mother's surviving herbal book before retreating to an abandoned barn."}
SOURCE WARNINGS=['sc_001: incomplete source coverage; gaps are unavailable', 'sc_002: incomplete source coverage; gaps are unavailable']
SCENE sc_001 0-41500 EXT. BLACKWOOD COTTAGE RUINS – DAY
EP19:E1 0-4500 CAMERA: Full shot of Juliana and Alexander standing side by side amidst the charred, smoldering wreckage of their destroyed cottage, thick smoke rising behind them into the overcast sky.
EP19:E2 0-4500 ACTION: Juliana clutches her mother's scorched leather-bound herbal book against her chest, her face streaked with soot as she stares at the ruin in disbelief.
EP19:E3 1800-3500 JULIANA [Sorrowful, Hollow]: "This was our home."
EP19:E4 4500-9500 CAMERA: Close-up of the blackened, heat-damaged leather ledger held in Juliana's linen-bandaged hands.
EP19:E5 5100-8200 JULIANA [Emotional, Fragile]: "My mother's book almost burned with it."
EP19:E6 6500-9200 ACTION: Juliana tenderly lifts a scorched corner of parchment, revealing the surviving botanical drawing of medicinal herbs inside.
EP19:E7 9500-11800 CAMERA: Medium shot of Alexander looking down at Juliana with quiet, stoic concern.
EP19:E8 11800-15500 CAMERA: Medium shot of three villagers approaching through the burnt clearing: an elder villager carrying folded wool blankets, followed by a man and woman holding loaves of baked bread.
EP19:E9 12100-15200 ELDER VILLAGER [Respectful, Sincere]: "My lady. You cannot stay here."
EP19:E10 15500-18500 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana's tearful, soot-stained face as she listens.
EP19:E11 16100-19000 ELDER VILLAGER [O.S.]: "There is an old barn near the village. It is empty."
EP19:E12 18500-20500 ACTION: The elder villager steps closer, resting a gentle, reassuring hand on Juliana's shoulder.
EP19:E13 19400-20400 ELDER VILLAGER [Gentle, Earnest]: "Take it."
EP19:E14 20600-22600 JULIANA [Hesitant, Humble]: "We cannot ask the village to feed us."
EP19:E15 23200-25200 ELDER VILLAGER [Warm, Grateful]: "You saved my son's life."
EP19:E16 25800-28200 CAMERA: Close-up of the elder villager's rough, weathered hands offering a fresh loaf of artisan bread wrapped in cloth against the smoking timber ruins.
EP19:E17 26400-27800 ELDER VILLAGER [O.S.]: "You saved mine, too."
EP19:E18 28200-30800 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana, tears spilling down her cheeks as she smiles through her grief.
EP19:E19 28500-29800 JULIANA [Whispering, Tearful]: "Thank you."
EP19:E20 30800-34500 ACTION: Alexander steps forward and accepts the thick folded blankets and a wooden bucket from the villager.
EP19:E21 31200-33200 ALEXANDER [Deep, Solemn]: "We will not forget this kindness."
EP19:E22 33300-34800 ELDER VILLAGER [Nodding, Earnest]: "Neither will the village."
EP19:E23 34800-38200 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana looking back one last time at the devastated doorway of her ruined sanctuary, hugging the ledger tightly.
EP19:E24 35500-37400 JULIANA [Choked Up, Mournful]: "Goodbye, Blackwood."
EP19:E25 38000-41500 ACTION: Juliana turns her back on the ruins. Wide tracking shot from behind as Alexander and Juliana walk side by side down the stone path, leaving the smoldering ash behind as the scene fades into black.
SCENE sc_002 41500-89500 EXT. MISTY DEEP WOODS – DAY
EP19:E26 41500-44200 CAMERA: Medium shot tracking Alexander from behind as he stands waiting beside a moss-covered ancient tree trunk in the dense, fog-laden forest.
EP19:E27 43000-46000 ACTION: A bald, scarred man dressed in a dark coat emerges from between the trees, immediately coming to a halt and bowing with clasped hands in formal deference.
EP19:E28 44300-45800 INFORMANT [Subservient, Urgent]: "Your Grace."
EP19:E29 46000-49200 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Alexander turning toward his operative, his eyes dark with calculating authority.
EP19:E30 47100-49200 ALEXANDER [Authoritative, Direct]: "Tell me what is happening in Ashburg."
EP19:E31 49500-54800 INFORMANT [Grave, Cautious]: "Lord Sterling's influence has grown since your disappearance. He has men in the county offices, the courts, even among the household staff."
EP19:E32 55300-61400 CAMERA: Slow push-in on Alexander's rugged, scarred face, his jaw tightening with simmering rage as he listens.
EP19:E33 55300-61300 INFORMANT [O.S.]: "Rupert has become the face of Ashburg. He sits in your father's room, signs your estate papers, gives orders as though the title already belongs to him."
EP19:E34 61400-64800 CAMERA: Medium shot of the bald informant standing among the towering trees, reporting solemnly.
EP19:E35 61600-64800 INFORMANT [Earnest]: "And Lady Catherine, she behaves as though she is already the future duchess."
EP19:E36 64800-70600 CAMERA: Close-up of the informant, his voice dropping into urgent, discreet concern.
EP19:E37 65100-70500 INFORMANT [Whispering, Alarmed]: "But they have separated her from the household. She is watched constantly. Every letter she sends is checked. Every visitor is questioned."
EP19:E38 70600-73300 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Alexander's right hand clenching into a powerful, trembling fist at his coat seam, veins bulging with restrained violence.
EP19:E39 70900-73200 INFORMANT [O.S.]: "There are almost no loyal servants left around her."
EP19:E40 73300-76200 CAMERA: Low-angle shot past Alexander toward the informant.
EP19:E41 73500-76400 INFORMANT [Grave]: "The people who served your family for years have been dismissed, frightened away, or replaced."
EP19:E42 76200-78800 ACTION: Alexander lifts his gaze toward the cold forest canopy, his breathing heavy with profound anguish.
EP19:E43 76500-78800 ALEXANDER [Cold, Pained Fury]: "My mother is a prisoner in her own house."
EP19:E44 78800-81200 CAMERA: Close-up of the informant looking steadily at Alexander.
EP19:E45 79000-81000 INFORMANT [Quiet, Solemn]: "And everyone believes you are dead."
EP19:E46 81200-83800 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Alexander's scarred eye and grimly set mouth.
EP19:E47 81500-83700 ALEXANDER [Lethal, Calculating]: "Then let them believe it a little longer."
EP19:E48 84000-85500 INFORMANT [Inquiring, Tense]: "And when we have the proof?"
EP19:E49 85500-89500 CAMERA: Dramatic low-angle push-in on Alexander's commanding silhouette, his combat scar etched sharply against the fog.
EP19:E50 85900-88900 ALEXANDER [Vow of Vengeance, Resolute]: "Then Ashburg will remember who it belongs to."
SCENE sc_003 89500-119630 INT. ABANDONED BARN – NIGHT
EP19:E51 89500-94000 CAMERA: Wide atmospheric shot of the shadowy barn loft. Moonlight filters through vertical wooden slats, illuminating Juliana seated on a pile of straw beside a warm, glowing kerosene lantern.
EP19:E52 94000-96800 CAMERA: Over-the-shoulder close-up of Juliana's bandaged hands tracing the detailed botanical drawing on the charred page of her mother's herbal.
EP19:E53 96800-97800 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana's face, silent tears streaming down her soot-smudged cheeks as her chin quivers.
EP19:E54 97200-100000 ACTION: The heavy wooden barn doors creak open. Alexander steps into the lantern light, carrying a bundle of firewood and a thick blanket under his arm.
EP19:E55 97400-99400 JULIANA [O.S.]: "We have lost everything."
EP19:E56 99900-103000 CAMERA: Medium shot of Juliana breaking down in tears over her open book, struggling to breathe through her weeping.
EP19:E57 100400-102600 JULIANA [Despairing, Broken]: "I don't know what we will do tomorrow."
EP19:E58 103000-106000 ACTION: Alexander steps up behind her and gently drapes the thick woolen blanket over her trembling shoulders, resting his hands reassuringly on her.
EP19:E59 104200-106200 ALEXANDER [Soft, Steadfast]: "Tomorrow, we begin again."
EP19:E60 106000-109800 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana turning her tear-drenched eyes up toward Alexander, her face filled with longing and newfound hope.
EP19:E61 107300-109200 JULIANA [Faint Smile, Emotional]: "You make it sound so simple."
EP19:E62 109800-112500 ACTION: Alexander sits down beside her in the straw. Juliana leans gently against his shoulder, letting her weary head rest against his broad chest.
EP19:E63 112500-119630 CAMERA: Slow cinematic push-in on the couple nestled together in the warm lantern glow. Alexander wraps his arm firmly around Juliana as she closes her eyes in exhausted relief, while his piercing gaze stares resolutely into the darkness, determined to reclaim everything that was stolen.

SOURCE_SHA256=e6389a016e5aa432efca70d3bb2d64ec859200ad0e6aad207fa63a616ce12fa8
METADATA ONLY (not on-screen evidence): {'logline': 'Inside the opulent Ashbury estate, the treacherous Rupert and Catherine plot to seize the ducal title as the Dowager Duchess slowly withers, while in an icy barn, Juliana defiantly prepares remedies to save the fever-stricken villagers.', 'continuity_notes': "Follows Episode 19's night in the barn; as Alexander begins his clandestine fight to reclaim his birthright, Juliana tends to the suffering village while Rupert and Catherine celebrate their anticipated ascension to the ducal throne."}
SOURCE WARNINGS=['sc_002: incomplete source coverage; gaps are unavailable']
SCENE sc_001 0-2800 EXT. ASHBURY MANOR – DAY
EP20:E1 0-2800 CAMERA: Low-angle establishing shot tilting up toward the imposing, grand stone facade of Ashbury Manor against a cold, overcast morning sky, frost dusting the pristine lawn.
SCENE sc_002 2800-56500 INT. ASHBURY MANOR - DRAWING ROOM – CONTINUOUS
EP20:E2 2800-6800 CAMERA: Medium wide shot of the lavish drawing room. CATHERINE, dressed in an ornate lilac regency gown and white satin gloves, gracefully pours hot tea from an ornate silver teapot, while RUPERT stands elegantly by the tall window.
EP20:E3 2900-4400 CATHERINE [Smug, Prim]: "Two lumps of sugar, Rupert?"
EP20:E4 4600-7800 CATHERINE [Taunting, Silkily]: "Or has your sudden climb to power sweetened your taste already?"
EP20:E5 6900-9500 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine stirring her tea with a silver spoon, lifting her gaze with a haughty smirk.
EP20:E6 8200-10800 RUPERT [Flirtatious, Sly]: "Only if it sweetens your disposition, Catherine."
EP20:E7 9600-15200 CAMERA: Medium shot tracking Rupert as he steps forward from the hearth, adjusting his dark leather gloves with an air of absolute triumph.
EP20:E8 10900-12700 RUPERT [Boastful, Confident]: "The estate is practically ours."
EP20:E9 12800-15100 RUPERT [Smug]: "The succession papers are being finalized as we speak."
EP20:E10 15200-20000 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Catherine raising the porcelain teacup to her lips, her expression turning sharp and dismissive.
EP20:E11 15400-18700 CATHERINE [Cold, Haughty]: "'Practically' is a word for beggars. I do not marry a practical Duke."
EP20:E12 18800-20100 CATHERINE [Stern, Ambitious]: "I marry the Lord of Ashbury."
EP20:E13 20000-25500 CAMERA: Medium shot of Rupert striding toward the tea table, leaning forward with predatory conviction.
EP20:E14 20100-21200 RUPERT [Reassuring, Firm]: "And so you shall."
EP20:E15 21300-24200 RUPERT [Dark, Conspiratorial]: "Once my cousin Alexander's death is formally sealed by the Crown..."
EP20:E16 24300-25400 RUPERT [Decisive]: "...the title is mine."
EP20:E17 25500-30200 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine lowering her teacup, her icy blue eyes narrowing in calculated concern.
EP20:E18 25500-28200 CATHERINE [Wary, Inquiring]: "And what of the Dowager? The old woman still breathes."
EP20:E19 28300-30200 CATHERINE [Disdainful]: "Her shadow still hangs over this house."
EP20:E20 30200-34000 CAMERA: Tight close-up of Rupert's face as a sinister grin spreads across his features.
EP20:E21 30200-32800 RUPERT [Quiet, Sinister]: "Her health fails more each day. The physicians are baffled."
EP20:E22 32900-34400 RUPERT [Gloating]: "They call it a wasting of the lungs."
EP20:E23 34100-39200 CAMERA: Close-up side profile of Catherine bringing the teacup to her lips, savoring his words with chilling detachment.
EP20:E24 34200-36800 CATHERINE [Mock-Sympathetic, Cruel]: "How tragic. The slow, quiet decline."
EP20:E25 36900-39100 CATHERINE [Scheming]: "How much longer can the frail thing survive?"
EP20:E26 39300-42500 CAMERA: Medium profile of Rupert looking out the window, hands clasped behind him.
EP20:E27 39400-42400 RUPERT [Cold, Callous]: "Not through the winter. I've ensured her quiet comfort."
EP20:E28 42500-50000 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine turning her head toward the window, her lips curled in venomous disgust.
EP20:E29 42600-44900 CATHERINE [Vindictive]: "Good. The village is already whispering about her."
EP20:E30 45000-48400 CATHERINE [Contemptuous]: "The local peasants are like dogs, barking at every carriage that passes."
EP20:E31 48500-49800 CATHERINE [Disgusted]: "They disgust me."
EP20:E32 50000-56500 CAMERA: Medium two-shot. Rupert stands over Catherine seated at the polished table, placing a gloved hand possessively near her shoulder.
EP20:E33 50200-52500 RUPERT [Dismissive, Arrogant]: "They are nothing. Dirt beneath our boots."
EP20:E34 52800-56000 RUPERT [Authoritative, Promising]: "They will learn their place when you wear the ducal crown."
SCENE sc_003 56500-88200 INT. ABANDONED BARN – DAY
EP20:E35 56500-60300 CAMERA: Medium close-up tilting down on JULIANA kneeling in the straw beside a rustic wooden crate, sorting sprigs of dried lavender and sage into a woven basket. Her hands are bound in linen bandages from the recent fire.
EP20:E36 60000-64500 ACTION: The barn door opens, revealing daylight outside. SEAMUS, an older weathered villager in a waistcoat, carries a wooden bucket inside, his expression etched with deep sorrow and concern.
EP20:E37 60500-62500 SEAMUS [Gentle, Concerned]: "Let me take that basket, Lady Juliana."
EP20:E38 62600-66600 SEAMUS [Empathetic]: "Your palms are still raw from the fire. You shouldn't be working in this freezing draft."
EP20:E39 64800-66800 ACTION: Seamus reaches down to take the handle of the basket from her.
EP20:E40 66800-70500 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana looking up at Seamus, her smudged face fierce with unyielding determination as she holds firmly onto the basket.
EP20:E41 66700-69100 JULIANA [Fierce, Resolute]: "If I stop, Seamus, the lung fever in the valley wins."
EP20:E42 69200-70500 JULIANA [Defiant]: "I do not yield to a cold draft."
EP20:E43 70500-76200 CAMERA: Close-up of Seamus, his face agonizingly strained with grief for her lost status.
EP20:E44 70600-72300 SEAMUS [Desperate, Grieving]: "You are a viscount's daughter!"
EP20:E45 72400-74200 SEAMUS [Pleading]: "Sleeping on straw, sorting weeds!"
EP20:E46 74300-76200 SEAMUS [Frustrated]: "Let the village tend to itself for once!"
EP20:E47 76200-81000 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana, her jaw set with unwavering moral strength.
EP20:E48 76300-79800 JULIANA [Passionate, Unflinching]: "The chapel is gone, Seamus. I am the only healer these people have left."
EP20:E49 79900-81000 JULIANA [Unyielding]: "I keep the basket."
EP20:E50 81000-88200 CAMERA: Medium two-shot of Juliana and Seamus standing facing each other in the barn, the lantern casting a warm amber glow between them.
EP20:E51 82000-84400 SEAMUS [Saddened, Heartbroken]: "They have reduced you to a peasant."
EP20:E52 84800-86500 JULIANA [Proud, Indomitable]: "They have reduced me to myself."
EP20:E53 86600-88000 JULIANA [Steely]: "And I am not finished."
SCENE sc_004 88200-114750 INT. ASHBURY MANOR - DRAWING ROOM – CONTINUOUS
EP20:E54 88200-90000 ACTION: Catherine's gloved hand sets her fine porcelain teacup down onto the silver tray with a delicate clatter.
EP20:E55 88400-89400 SOUND: Sharp porcelain chime of teacup meeting saucer.
EP20:E56 89800-94800 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine looking up, her face twisting into venomous arrogance.
EP20:E57 89900-92400 CATHERINE [Cruel, Callous]: "Let the peasants rot in their barns."
EP20:E58 92600-94500 CATHERINE [Mocking, Spiteful]: "Let them pray to their weeds."
EP20:E59 94800-99200 CAMERA: Medium shot as Rupert steps around the mahogany table and leans close into Catherine's ear, smiling seductively.
EP20:E60 94900-97300 RUPERT [Intimate, Reassuring]: "You have no rival here, Catherine."
EP20:E61 97400-99100 RUPERT [Fawning]: "No one to stand in your way."
EP20:E62 99200-103800 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine looking into Rupert's eyes, her smile turning predatory and cold.
EP20:E63 99300-101400 CATHERINE [Triumphant, Greedy]: "Once the old Duchess is gone..."
EP20:E64 101500-103700 CATHERINE [Possessive]: "...Ashbury will finally belong to us."
EP20:E65 103800-109000 ACTION: Catherine rises from her chair in one regal motion and glides toward the towering window overlooking the vast estate grounds.
EP20:E66 104000-109500 CAMERA: Tracking medium shot following Catherine from behind as she walks gracefully to the window frame, the grey morning light outlining her aristocratic silhouette.
EP20:E67 106800-109200 CATHERINE [Cold, Ruthless]: "This house will only bow to me."
EP20:E68 109500-114750 CAMERA: Tight close-up profile of Catherine gazing out the windowpane, her icy eyes burning with insatiable ambition as dramatic strings swell to a menacing cliffhanger hold.

EP=ep_021; timestamps are integer milliseconds
SOURCE_SHA256=00cb2e6c0b31ed3022212cc30d2fadd006e70516eb33be7d50aed31137d39db9
METADATA ONLY (not on-screen evidence): {'logline': "After defying her own despair to cure a fever-stricken village boy with her mother's herbal remedies, Lady Juliana learns that the Dowager Duchess is secretly withering away from a mysterious illness inside Ashbury Manor.", 'continuity_notes': "Directly follows Episode 20's cliffhanger where Catherine and Rupert plotted to seize Ashbury upon the Dowager Duchess's demise; in the village, Juliana puts aside her grief over her burned cottage to save young Toby, stumbling upon critical intelligence regarding the manor."}
SOURCE WARNINGS=['sc_001: incomplete source coverage; gaps are unavailable']
SCENE sc_001 0-40500 INT. BARN – DAY
EP21:E1 0-3500 CAMERA: Medium shot of Lady Juliana in a rustic grey gown, her wrists wrapped in white bandages, smoothing a blanket over a straw pallet in the dimly lit barn.
EP21:E2 0-3500 ACTION: Lady Juliana gently straightens the grey wool blanket over the hay bed, exhaling a soft, exhausted sigh.
EP21:E3 3500-4800 SOUND: A loud wooden slam as the heavy double barn doors violently fly open.
EP21:E4 3600-8500 CAMERA: Wide shot framing the open doorway against the overcast daylight as Prudence, a young village girl in an apron, rushes inside, frantic and weeping.
EP21:E5 4200-8000 PRUDENCE [Desperate, Panicked]: "Lady Juliana! Please! You have to help me, Toby is dying!"
EP21:E6 8200-10500 ACTION: Lady Juliana hurries over, placing her bandaged hands reassuringly on Prudence's trembling shoulders.
EP21:E7 8500-11200 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Lady Juliana looking into Prudence's tearful face with compassionate urgency.
EP21:E8 8500-11000 LADY JULIANA [Gentle, Urgent]: "Oh dear. Breathe. Tell me what has happened."
EP21:E9 11200-15100 CAMERA: Close-up of Prudence weeping, clutching her hands to her chest in agony.
EP21:E10 11200-15000 PRUDENCE [Sobbing, Breathless]: "My little brother Toby... his chest is burning! He cannot breathe!"
EP21:E11 15100-18200 CAMERA: Close-up of Lady Juliana, her brow furrowing with concern.
EP21:E12 15000-18200 LADY JULIANA [Inquiring, Strained]: "Tell me what the apothecary said. Did he not give you medicine?"
EP21:E13 18200-21800 CAMERA: Close-up of Prudence, her face twisted in bitter anguish as she gestures back toward the rain-soaked outdoors.
EP21:E14 18200-21700 PRUDENCE [Anguished, Resentful]: "He shut the door in my face because we have no silver!"
EP21:E15 21800-25000 CAMERA: Wide shot of Lady Juliana and Prudence facing each other inside the wooden barn, dust motes drifting in the pale light.
EP21:E16 21800-25300 PRUDENCE [Bitter, Tearful]: "The manor doctor laughed! He said village boys are not worth his time!"
EP21:E17 25000-30900 CAMERA: Medium profile shot of Lady Juliana looking down at her bandaged hands, holding Prudence's hand with somber heartache.
EP21:E18 25100-27400 LADY JULIANA [Sorrowful, Dejected]: "We have no clinic now."
EP21:E19 27500-30800 LADY JULIANA [Despondent]: "Our cottage is ashes. I have nothing left but this coltsfoot."
EP21:E20 31000-33000 ACTION: Prudence drops desperately to her knees onto the hay-strewn barn floor, clasping her hands in tearful supplication.
EP21:E21 31100-35800 CAMERA: High-angle looking down at Prudence kneeling before Lady Juliana, pleading upward.
EP21:E22 31000-35800 PRUDENCE [Pleading, Desperate]: "He is only seven! If you do not come, he will die! You are his only hope, Lady Juliana!"
EP21:E23 35800-39500 ACTION: Lady Juliana immediately reaches down and pulls Prudence firmly back to her feet, then turns to snatch her heavy leather-bound herbal ledger from the wooden workbench.
EP21:E24 35900-40500 CAMERA: Medium shot framing the barn entrance as Lady Juliana lifts Prudence up, grabs her book, and leads the way out.
EP21:E25 35900-40400 LADY JULIANA [Resolute, Authoritative]: "Stand up. Sinking to your knees will not save him. Let me grab my ledger. We go now."
SCENE sc_002 40500-42800 EXT. VILLAGE LANE – CONTINUOUS
EP21:E26 40500-42800 CAMERA: Tracking wide shot following Lady Juliana and Prudence running side by side along a muddy, puddled village road past thatched stone cottages under a gloomy, overcast sky.
EP21:E27 40500-42800 ACTION: Lady Juliana clutches the thick book to her chest as she and Prudence sprint swiftly through the village.
SCENE sc_003 42800-114000 INT. PRUDENCE'S COTTAGE – CONTINUOUS
EP21:E28 42800-45500 CAMERA: Low-angle medium shot of seven-year-old Toby lying on a makeshift straw pallet before a roaring fireplace, coughing weakly.
EP21:E29 42800-45500 SOUND: Heavy, raspy chest coughs echoing in the small room, accompanied by crackling hearth fire.
EP21:E30 45500-48000 ACTION: Lady Juliana rushes in, sets the ledger on the rustic wooden table, and quickly flips open the pages.
EP21:E31 45500-48500 CAMERA: Close-up of Lady Juliana rapidly scanning the botanical illustrations and handwritten remedies in the book.
EP21:E32 47300-48800 LADY JULIANA [Alarmed, Focused]: "His skin is burning hot."
EP21:E33 48800-50500 ACTION: Lady Juliana places her bandaged hand against Toby's flushed, sweating forehead as he wheezes painfully.
EP21:E34 48800-51200 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Lady Juliana tending to Toby, with Prudence standing anxiously in the background.
EP21:E35 48900-50800 LADY JULIANA [Commanding]: "Prudence, fetch hot water immediately!"
EP21:E36 51200-54000 CAMERA: Medium shot of Prudence nodding rapidly, rushing toward the stone hearth.
EP21:E37 51200-53000 PRUDENCE [Hurried, Obedient]: "Yes! Right away, I will get it!"
EP21:E38 53000-55000 ACTION: Prudence wraps a cloth around the iron handle of the steaming kettle resting over the hearth fire and lifts it.
EP21:E39 54000-56200 CAMERA: Close-up top-down view of Lady Juliana's bandaged fingers gently touching an ink illustration of chamomile flowers in the open ledger.
EP21:E40 54100-58200 LADY JULIANA [V.O.) (Introspective, Determined]: "I cannot let my own weariness stop me. This boy needs my mother's knowledge."
EP21:E41 58200-60500 ACTION: Lady Juliana crushes dried herbal leaves into a dark wooden bowl between her bandaged hands, then pours steaming water over them from the kettle.
EP21:E42 58500-60800 CAMERA: Close-up of hot water pouring into the bowl, releasing aromatic vapors from the dried herbs.
EP21:E43 60800-64000 ACTION: Lady Juliana sits beside the pallet and brings the steaming herbal bowl close to Toby's face while Prudence cradles his shoulders.
EP21:E44 60800-64500 CAMERA: Medium shot of Lady Juliana, Prudence, and Toby huddled together by the warm glow of the fire.
EP21:E45 61000-64000 LADY JULIANA [Instructive, Calm]: "Lift his shoulders, Prudence. Hold the steam close. Let him inhale."
EP21:E46 64500-66800 CAMERA: Close-up of Prudence supporting Toby's head, whispering tenderly into his ear.
EP21:E47 64500-66600 PRUDENCE [Tearful, Coaxing]: "Like this? Toby, breathe it in, sweet boy."
EP21:E48 66800-70500 CAMERA: Close-up of Lady Juliana gently waving her hand to direct the medicinal steam toward Toby's nose and mouth.
EP21:E49 66800-70400 LADY JULIANA [Encouraging, Reassuring]: "Yes, just like that. Keep breathing, Toby. Let the vapor clear your chest."
EP21:E50 70500-73500 ACTION: Toby's strained wheezing eases into quiet, rhythmic breathing as he slips into peaceful sleep on his pillow.
EP21:E51 70500-72000 CAMERA: Close-up of Toby's face relaxing, his chest falling still and calm.
EP21:E52 72000-76000 CAMERA: Close-up of Prudence covering her mouth in overwhelmed relief, tears streaming down her face.
EP21:E53 72000-75500 PRUDENCE [Overwhelmed, Relieved]: "Oh, thank God! His chest is quiet! The rattling has stopped!"
EP21:E54 75500-79500 ACTION: Lady Juliana pulls the plaid wool blanket snug over Toby's chest, smiling softly with profound relief.
EP21:E55 76000-79800 CAMERA: Medium shot of Lady Juliana sitting on a stool beside Toby's bedside, placing a cup of coltsfoot tea on a small wooden table.
EP21:E56 76000-79600 LADY JULIANA [Gentle, Caring]: "Keep him warm. Give him three drops of this coltsfoot tea every morning."
EP21:E57 79800-87500 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Prudence looking at Lady Juliana with awe and boundless gratitude, her hands clasped in front of her.
EP21:E58 79800-83000 PRUDENCE [Grateful, Choked with Emotion]: "You saved him. The grand doctors left him to choke, but you..."
EP21:E59 83000-87500 PRUDENCE [Fervent, Devoted]: "I have no money, Lady Juliana, but I swear on my life, I will do anything to repay you."
EP21:E60 87500-90800 ACTION: Lady Juliana takes Prudence's trembling hands into hers, smiling with heartfelt warmth.
EP21:E61 87500-91000 CAMERA: Close-up of Lady Juliana comforting Prudence warmly.
EP21:E62 87700-90500 LADY JULIANA [Warm, Sincere]: "Your brother's breath is payment enough for me, Prudence."
EP21:E63 91000-96500 CAMERA: Low-angle shot past sleeping Toby toward Prudence standing in the room, her expression darkening with anger.
EP21:E64 91000-94500 PRUDENCE [Indignant, Resentful]: "At the grand manor, they ignore us. They only care about their own luxury."
EP21:E65 94600-96400 PRUDENCE [Ominous]: "But their gold cannot buy them health."
EP21:E66 96500-98200 ACTION: Lady Juliana turns sharply, her eyes widening with sudden recognition.
EP21:E67 96500-99200 CAMERA: Close-up of Lady Juliana looking directly into Prudence's eyes with startled concern.
EP21:E68 96500-99200 LADY JULIANA [Startled, Curious]: "What do you mean? Is someone ill? The Dowager Duchess?"
EP21:E69 99200-101200 CAMERA: Low-angle cut to Toby sleeping peacefully as the fire crackles behind him.
EP21:E70 99200-101200 PRUDENCE [Solemn, O.S.]: "She is dying, Lady Juliana."
EP21:E71 101200-106800 CAMERA: Close-up of Prudence leaning in close to Lady Juliana, whispering with grave intensity.
EP21:E72 101200-103400 PRUDENCE [Conspiratorial, Grim]: "A strange, mysterious illness is eating her away."
EP21:E73 103500-108400 PRUDENCE [Dark, Chilling]: "Inside that massive house with all their wealth, she is fading to nothing, and no one can stop it."
EP21:E74 106800-108500 CAMERA: Brief cut back to Toby sleeping peacefully on his straw pillow by the warm fireplace.
EP21:E75 108500-114000 ACTION: Lady Juliana sits motionless at the rustic wooden table, her bandaged hands holding open her late mother's leather-bound herbal ledger. Her eyes reflect deep apprehension as the dire truth settles over her.
EP21:E76 108500-114000 CAMERA: Slow push-in on Lady Juliana staring down at the ancient pages, her expression filled with profound realization and growing resolve as dramatic strings swell to a gripping cliffhanger.

SOURCE_SHA256=516bd97dafb3753c10ac4a1a909aa7bccec17367050791e278e4102277cc3cc1
METADATA ONLY (not on-screen evidence): {'logline': 'Disguised as a common scullery maid, Lady Juliana infiltrates Ashbury Manor alongside Prudence and slips into the forbidden West Wing, where she discovers the dying Dowager Duchess suffering from an unnatural, poisoned affliction.', 'continuity_notes': 'Directly follows Episode 21 where Prudence revealed that the Dowager Duchess is dying from a mysterious illness; Juliana sets aside her aristocratic identity to sneak into Ashbury Manor under the guise of domestic help to save her.'}
SOURCE WARNINGS=['Line 102: Event interval outside scene', 'sc_001: incomplete source coverage; gaps are unavailable', 'sc_002: incomplete source coverage; gaps are unavailable']
SCENE sc_001 0-42500 EXT. ASHBURY MANOR – SERVICE COURTYARD – DAY
EP22:E1 0-4000 CAMERA: Wide shot framing the gothic stone archway of Ashbury Manor as other maidservants carrying laundry baskets pass through the damp courtyard.
EP22:E2 0-4000 ACTION: Lady Juliana walks nervously along the stone pavement dressed in a modest dark maid's dress and a plain white apron, looking around cautiously.
EP22:E3 4000-7000 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Lady Juliana adjusting her high buttoned collar, anxious yet determined, against the backdrop of the gloomy coast.
EP22:E4 6500-8500 ACTION: Prudence rushes up behind Lady Juliana, pulling her into the shelter of the stone archway.
EP22:E5 7000-11100 PRUDENCE [Urgent, Whispering]: "Keep your head down. If anyone recognizes you, everything is over."
EP22:E6 11100-14200 CAMERA: Close-up of Lady Juliana leaning back against the rough stone wall, whispering back firmly.
EP22:E7 11200-14200 LADY JULIANA [Resolute, Quiet]: "No one will recognize me dressed like this."
EP22:E8 14200-19000 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Prudence glancing nervously toward the courtyard before fixing her gaze on Juliana.
EP22:E9 14200-19000 PRUDENCE [Nervous, Warning]: "This is Ashburton Manor. The housekeeper watches everyone. Lady Catherine watches everyone, and Lord Rupert..."
EP22:E10 19000-21200 CAMERA: Close-up of Lady Juliana cutting in with fierce, unyielding conviction.
EP22:E11 19100-21000 LADY JULIANA [Determined]: "The Duchess is dying."
EP22:E12 21200-25800 CAMERA: Low-angle shot looking up at Lady Juliana and Prudence standing beneath the looming stone facade of the manor.
EP22:E13 22000-25500 LADY JULIANA [Defiant, Firm]: "I saved Toby. I can save her."
EP22:E14 25800-28100 CAMERA: Close-up on Prudence, her eyes wide with dread.
EP22:E15 26000-28100 PRUDENCE [Fretful]: "And if they discover who you are?"
EP22:E16 28100-31500 CAMERA: Close-up on Lady Juliana holding her gaze steadily.
EP22:E17 28200-31000 LADY JULIANA [Steely, Selfless]: "Then I will face that when she is breathing again."
EP22:E18 31500-36200 CAMERA: Medium two-shot outside the heavy wooden servant entrance door.
EP22:E19 33800-36000 PRUDENCE [Solemn]: "Then forget you were ever a lady."
EP22:E20 36200-39800 CAMERA: Close-up of Lady Juliana swallowing her pride and accepting her perilous disguise.
EP22:E21 37000-39500 LADY JULIANA [Quietly Resolute]: "Today, I am only a maid."
EP22:E22 39800-42500 ACTION: Prudence opens the heavy wooden service door, and both women step inside into the dark servants' corridor as the door shuts firmly behind them.
SCENE sc_002 42500-88500 INT. ASHBURY MANOR – SERVANTS' CORRIDOR – CONTINUOUS
EP22:E23 43000-44200 HOUSEKEEPER [Sharp, Stern, O.S.]: "Prudence."
EP22:E24 43000-46000 CAMERA: Medium shot of the formidable Housekeeper standing in the dim stone hallway with arms folded, ring of keys dangling from her waist.
EP22:E25 44300-45600 HOUSEKEEPER [Suspicious]: "Who is this?"
EP22:E26 46000-49200 CAMERA: Medium shot of Prudence curtsying low with downcast eyes while Lady Juliana stands behind her carrying a heavy wooden water bucket.
EP22:E27 46000-49000 PRUDENCE [Submissive]: "Julian, ma'am. New help for the winter cleaning."
EP22:E28 49200-52200 CAMERA: Close-up profile of the Housekeeper sizing up Juliana critically.
EP22:E29 49500-51800 HOUSEKEEPER [Cold, Skeptical]: "She looks soft."
EP22:E30 51800-53000 ACTION: Close-up on Lady Juliana's hands gripping the iron handle of the wooden wash bucket firmly.
EP22:E31 52800-55200 CAMERA: Close-up on Lady Juliana keeping her eyes dutifully lowered.
EP22:E32 52800-54800 LADY JULIANA [Humble, Steady]: "I can work, ma'am."
EP22:E33 55200-58500 CAMERA: Low-angle shot of the Housekeeper staring down coldly.
EP22:E34 56000-58000 HOUSEKEEPER [Demanding]: "Can you scrub stone?"
EP22:E35 58500-60000 CAMERA: Close-up on Lady Juliana nodding slightly.
EP22:E36 58500-59800 LADY JULIANA [Subdued]: "Yes, ma'am."
EP22:E37 60200-61800 HOUSEKEEPER [Harsh, O.S.]: "Carry coal?"
EP22:E38 60200-62300 CAMERA: Close-up of the Housekeeper's stern face.
EP22:E39 62300-64200 CAMERA: Cut back to Lady Juliana maintaining her meek posture.
EP22:E40 62500-63800 LADY JULIANA [Polite]: "Yes, ma'am."
EP22:E41 64200-69800 CAMERA: Profile medium two-shot as the Housekeeper steps right up into Lady Juliana's face, staring intently into her downcast eyes.
EP22:E42 66000-69500 HOUSEKEEPER [Menacing, Threatening]: "And can you keep your eyes and ears where they belong?"
EP22:E43 69800-73000 CAMERA: Extreme close-up on Lady Juliana's composed, lowered face.
EP22:E44 71200-72600 LADY JULIANA [Subdued, Steady]: "Yes, ma'am."
EP22:E45 73000-78000 CAMERA: Medium shot of the Housekeeper turning and pointing a bony finger toward the servant corridor stairs.
EP22:E46 73200-77500 HOUSEKEEPER [Stern, Dismissive]: "Then prove it. The manor has no use for useless girls."
EP22:E47 77500-81000 ACTION: The Housekeeper turns and stalks away down the corridor. Prudence exhales a trembling breath of relief.
EP22:E48 78500-81800 CAMERA: Wide shot of the dimly lit hallway showing the Housekeeper walking away into the distance.
EP22:E49 79000-81000 PRUDENCE [Relieved, Whispering]: "That was close."
EP22:E50 81800-84600 CAMERA: Close-up on Lady Juliana clutching the wash bucket, her eyes scanning ahead urgently.
EP22:E51 82500-84500 LADY JULIANA [Urgent, Quiet]: "Where is the West Wing?"
EP22:E52 84600-88500 CAMERA: Medium shot of Prudence pointing toward the archway leading toward the grand staircase.
EP22:E53 84800-88000 PRUDENCE [Nervous, Warning]: "Beyond the grand staircase. Few servants go there."
SCENE sc_003 88500-102000 INT. ASHBURY MANOR – GRAND ENTRANCE HALL – CONTINUOUS
EP22:E54 88500-92000 CAMERA: Tracking shot from behind Lady Juliana as she walks out into the vast, opulent marble hall of Ashbury Manor carrying her bucket.
EP22:E55 91500-96000 ACTION: Lady Juliana stops in her tracks and gazes upward in awe at the soaring gilded ceilings and aristocratic crest.
EP22:E56 92000-96000 CAMERA: Low-angle push-in on Lady Juliana looking up at the enormous portrait of the late Duke and Duchess hanging above the gallery.
EP22:E57 94500-96000 LADY JULIANA [Breathless]: "This house..."
EP22:E58 96000-98500 ACTION: Prudence rushes into frame, grabbing Juliana's arm to keep her moving.
EP22:E59 96000-98800 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Prudence whispering frantically into Juliana's ear.
EP22:E60 96000-98500 PRUDENCE [Panicked, Hushed]: "Do not stare. Keep walking."
EP22:E61 98800-102000 CAMERA: Wide tracking shot behind Lady Juliana as she hastens down the long marble gallery toward the secluded West Wing wing.
SCENE sc_004 102000-131000 INT. ASHBURY MANOR – DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER – CONTINUOUS
EP22:E62 102000-105500 CAMERA: Medium shot of Lady Juliana standing outside a massive carved mahogany door, glancing around the empty hallway to ensure she is unobserved.
EP22:E63 105500-108500 ACTION: Lady Juliana reaches out with a trembling hand and quietly turns the ornate brass and glass door knob.
EP22:E64 105500-108500 CAMERA: Close-up of Lady Juliana's hand twisting the latch handle.
EP22:E65 106500-108500 SOUND: Faint, muffled click of the heavy door lock turning.
EP22:E66 108500-113800 CAMERA: Slow tracking shot into the cavernous, shadowy bedchamber. In the center stands an ornate four-poster canopy bed draped in pale silk where a frail, silver-haired figure lies motionless.
EP22:E67 109000-114000 SOUND: Labored, raspy, shallow breathing echoing in the quiet room.
EP22:E68 113800-116000 ACTION: Lady Juliana hurries inside, sets the wooden bucket onto the floor, and rushes to the bedside.
EP22:E69 114000-115500 LADY JULIANA [Gentle, Concerned]: "Your Grace?"
EP22:E70 115500-118200 CAMERA: Close-up of the Dowager Duchess lying propped on pillows, her face gaunt, ashen, and drenched in cold sweat, her eyes half-fluttering.
EP22:E71 118200-120800 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Lady Juliana taking the Duchess's fragile, cold hands into her own.
EP22:E72 118200-119800 LADY JULIANA [Soft, Comforting]: "Do not speak."
EP22:E73 120800-125500 CAMERA: Close-up of Lady Juliana checking the Duchess's pulse and gently pressing her fingertips against the Duchess's chest and neck, her herbalist instincts taking over.
EP22:E74 123000-125800 ACTION: Lady Juliana's eyes widen with sudden, horrifying realization.
EP22:E75 123500-125800 LADY JULIANA [Shocked, Murmuring]: "This isn't ordinary fever."
EP22:E76 125800-127000 ACTION: The Dowager Duchess suddenly gasps violently for breath, convulsing weakly as her eyes snap open in agony.
EP22:E77 125800-127000 CAMERA: Close-up of the Duchess gasping in sudden spasms.
EP22:E78 127000-128800 CAMERA: Intense two-shot as Lady Juliana leans in close, gripping the Duchess's shoulder with urgent desperation.
EP22:E79 127200-128800 LADY JULIANA [Urgent, Alarmed]: "Who has been treating you?"
EP22:E80 128800-131000 CAMERA: Extreme close-up on the Dowager Duchess's terrified, wide eyes staring up as she chokes for air, the haunting realization of poison lingering as dramatic music hits an abrupt, suspenseful cliffhanger.

EP=ep_023; timestamps are integer milliseconds
SOURCE_SHA256=2590fe65b7a4a8b4978992a4a857b46ba3c35d80f65ebdf0906e7f558107f1ca
METADATA ONLY (not on-screen evidence): {'logline': "After examining the dying Dowager Duchess's blackened fingernails and consulting her late mother's remedy journal, Lady Juliana discovers the Duchess is being poisoned with arsenic—only for someone to arrive at the bedroom door just as she begins concocting the antidote.", 'continuity_notes': 'Picks up immediately from the Episode 22 cliffhanger inside the forbidden West Wing of Ashbury Manor, where Lady Juliana crouches beside the bedridden Dowager Duchess, racing against time to determine the source of her fatal illness.'}
SOURCE WARNINGS=[]
SCENE sc_001 0-131500 INT. ASHBURY MANOR - WEST WING BEDCHAMBER – NIGHT
EP23:E1 0-1800 CAMERA: Wide shot through dark draped bed curtains into the shadowy bedchamber, showing Prudence keeping watch with a single candle while Lady Juliana sits beside the grand four-poster bed.
EP23:E2 1800-6500 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Prudence holding a brass candlestick with trembling hands, glancing nervously toward the doorway.
EP23:E3 1800-6000 PRUDENCE [Anxious, Whispering]: "Juliana, we cannot stay for long. Someone will come."
EP23:E4 6500-11800 CAMERA: Medium shot of Lady Juliana gently lifting the frail, trembling hands of the Dowager Duchess resting atop the linen covers.
EP23:E5 7500-11800 ACTION: Juliana cradles the Duchess's frail hands in hers, inspecting her fingers with furrowed brows.
EP23:E6 11800-16800 CAMERA: Close-up of the Duchess's fingertips, revealing pronounced dark, purplish-black discoloration beneath the nails.
EP23:E7 13500-16000 LADY JULIANA [Hushed, Grave]: "How long has she been like this?"
EP23:E8 16800-20000 CAMERA: Medium shot of Prudence leaning against the bedpost, tears glistening in her eyes.
EP23:E9 16800-19500 PRUDENCE [Tearful, Trembling]: "Weeks."
EP23:E10 20000-24000 CAMERA: High-angle two-shot as Lady Juliana leans closer over the gasping Duchess, gently touching her parched lips.
EP23:E11 24000-27500 CAMERA: Close-up on Lady Juliana's concerned face as she withdraws her finger from the Duchess's mouth.
EP23:E12 24000-27500 LADY JULIANA [Solemn]: "Her mouth is terribly dry."
EP23:E13 27500-31500 CAMERA: Medium shot as Lady Juliana presses her fingertips gently against the Duchess's wrist, feeling for a pulse.
EP23:E14 29000-31500 LADY JULIANA [Quiet, Grim]: "Her pulse is weak."
EP23:E15 31500-36000 CAMERA: Close-up of Prudence holding the flickering candle, crying openly in distress.
EP23:E16 32000-36000 PRUDENCE [Despairing, Weeping]: "The physician said her heart is failing."
EP23:E17 36000-38500 CAMERA: Close-up of the Dowager Duchess gasping hoarsely for air, her throat straining as she weakly fights to breathe.
EP23:E18 36000-38500 SOUND: Duchess's raspy, labored inhalation.
EP23:E19 38500-43000 CAMERA: Medium shot of Lady Juliana standing upright, her expression hardening with fierce skepticism.
EP23:E20 40800-43000 LADY JULIANA [Firm, Resolute]: "No."
EP23:E21 43000-46500 CAMERA: Medium shot panning down as Juliana reaches into her deep apron pocket and pulls out a worn, leather-bound notebook.
EP23:E22 43800-46500 LADY JULIANA [Certain, Focused]: "This is not simply old age."
EP23:E23 46500-48000 CAMERA: Quick reaction shot of Prudence staring with wide, bewildered eyes.
EP23:E24 48000-53500 CAMERA: Medium shot of Juliana sitting at the foot of the bed, carefully opening the leather journal across her lap and flipping through hand-annotated botanical pages.
EP23:E25 53500-57500 CAMERA: Close-up overhead of the yellowed parchment, showing botanical sketches of toxic herbs and handwritten diagnostic notes as Juliana's finger traces along the script.
EP23:E26 57500-58500 ACTION: Juliana draws in a sharp, startled breath, her eyes widening in horror.
EP23:E27 58500-60800 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana looking up from the page, stunned by her mother's written words.
EP23:E28 58500-60000 LADY JULIANA [Breathless, Reverent]: "Mother."
EP23:E29 60800-62000 CAMERA: Medium shot of Prudence leaning in, candle trembling.
EP23:E30 60800-62000 PRUDENCE [Urgent, Baffled]: "What is it?"
EP23:E31 62000-69500 CAMERA: Two-shot of Juliana holding the open journal, reciting the matching symptoms to Prudence while the Duchess lies motionless in the background.
EP23:E32 62000-68500 LADY JULIANA [Shocked, Deliberate]: "Weakness. Dry mouth. The discoloration beneath the nails. The slow wasting."
EP23:E33 69500-70500 CAMERA: Close-up of Prudence staring back in stunned disbelief.
EP23:E34 70500-73800 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana speaking with absolute certainty.
EP23:E35 70500-73500 LADY JULIANA [Serious, Chilled]: "I have seen these symptoms before."
EP23:E36 73800-76000 CAMERA: Close-up of Prudence's terrified face.
EP23:E37 73800-75800 PRUDENCE [Panicked, Shaken]: "What are you saying?"
EP23:E38 76000-78500 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana's hands snapping the leather journal shut on the bedside table beside an oil lamp.
EP23:E39 78500-81500 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana resting her hands on the closed journal, looking squarely at Prudence.
EP23:E40 79000-81500 LADY JULIANA [Cold, Deadly Serious]: "Someone is poisoning her."
EP23:E41 81500-84500 CAMERA: Medium shot of Prudence gasping sharply and clamping both hands over her mouth in sheer horror.
EP23:E42 81500-82500 SOUND: Sharp intake of breath from Prudence.
EP23:E43 82000-84000 PRUDENCE [Muffled, Horrified]: "Poison?"
EP23:E44 84500-88000 CAMERA: Extreme close-up pushing in tight on Lady Juliana's eyes as her expression hardens into fury and righteous disgust.
EP23:E45 86000-88000 LADY JULIANA [Venomous, Resolute]: "Arsenic."
EP23:E46 88000-90500 SOUND: Sudden violent coughing and sputtering from the Duchess.
EP23:E47 88000-91000 CAMERA: Medium shot as the Duchess chokes and spasms on the bed; Juliana whips around immediately.
EP23:E48 91000-94500 CAMERA: Medium tracking shot of Juliana rushing to the side table by the window, opening her satchel and setting out glass vials, a bowl, and dried herbal bundles.
EP23:E49 94500-97500 CAMERA: Close-up of Prudence pleading desperately, tears flowing down her cheeks.
EP23:E50 94500-97000 PRUDENCE [Desperate, Begging]: "Can you save her?"
EP23:E51 97500-100500 CAMERA: Medium shot of Juliana uncorking a glass apothecary bottle as the Duchess rests behind her.
EP23:E52 97500-100000 LADY JULIANA [Focused, Resolute]: "I can try."
EP23:E53 100500-104500 CAMERA: Top-down close-up of Juliana's soot-smudged hands pouring powdered activated charcoal from a vial into a stone mortar, then tossing in a pinch of crushed dried leaves.
EP23:E54 104500-107000 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana's hands vigorously grinding the pestle inside the stone mortar.
EP23:E55 104500-112000 SOUND: Heavy, rhythmic scraping of stone pestle grinding charcoal and dried herbs.
EP23:E56 107000-112500 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana grinding intensely, her brow furrowed as she speaks with urgent authority.
EP23:E57 107500-112000 LADY JULIANA [Urgent, Focused]: "The charcoal may help remove what is still inside her. We must act quickly."
EP23:E58 112200-114000 SOUND: Sudden muffled thump and heavy footsteps echoing from the hallway outside the door!
EP23:E59 112500-115000 CAMERA: Wide shot of the bedroom door framed through the bed curtains as the Duchess gasps in the bed.
EP23:E60 115000-116500 CAMERA: Medium shot of Juliana freezing mid-motion, turning her head sharply toward the chamber door.
EP23:E61 116500-118500 CAMERA: Close-up of the ornate brass door handle on the dark carved wooden door.
EP23:E62 118500-124500 CAMERA: Close-up of Prudence staring at the door in utter terror, her face drained of all color.
EP23:E63 118800-124000 PRUDENCE [Terrified, Hoarse Whisper]: "Juliana... someone is coming."
EP23:E64 124500-127500 CAMERA: Quick cut to Juliana looking back toward the bed and then toward the door, trapped with an unfinished cure.
EP23:E65 127500-129500 CAMERA: Tight close-up of Juliana's charcoal-blackened hand clutching the glass medicine vial firmly.
EP23:E66 129200-131200 SOUND: Loud, metallic clack of the door latch turning, followed by the slow creak of wood hinges.
EP23:E67 129500-131500 CAMERA: Close-up on the brass door lever as it slowly rotates downward, and the heavy door cracks open inward into the room—cutting to an intense, heart-stopping cliffhanger.

EP=ep_024; timestamps are integer milliseconds
SOURCE_SHA256=c211a90aef87daaf36182aaee95262b6121e962537fb25b37ef68260e4971259
METADATA ONLY (not on-screen evidence): {'logline': "When an arrogant noblewoman catches Juliana in the poisoned Dowager Duchess's chambers, she strikes Juliana with a riding crop and sentences her to scrub the hearth, unaware that Juliana has secretly hidden the antidote and remedy journal to finish the Duchess's cure.", 'continuity_notes': "Picks up directly from Episode 23's cliffhanger inside the West Wing bedchamber, as the brass latch turns and the door swings open to reveal an unexpected intruder confronting Lady Juliana and Prudence."}
SOURCE WARNINGS=[]
SCENE sc_001 0-48500 INT. DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER – DAY
EP24:E1 0-3500 CAMERA: Close-up of the ornate brass handle turning slowly on the dark wooden chamber door as it swings open.
EP24:E2 200-3000 SOUND: Heavy metallic click of the latch and the ominous low creak of the door hinges.
EP24:E3 3500-6000 CAMERA: Wide shot of the dimly lit, vaulted bedchamber. Lady Juliana and Prudence stand rigid beside the heavy four-poster bed as a haughty blonde noblewoman in an elegant lavender empire-line gown enters, clutching a riding crop.
EP24:E4 4000-6500 ACTION: The noblewoman halts in the center of the chamber, tapping her riding crop against her gloved palm as her cold gaze sweeps across the two maids.
EP24:E5 6000-8500 CAMERA: Medium shot of the noblewoman holding the riding crop upright, regarding Juliana with disdainful authority.
EP24:E6 6800-8400 NOBLEWOMAN [Sharp, Demanding]: "Who are you?"
EP24:E7 8500-12200 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana, her gaze lowered deferentially beside the carved wooden bedpost.
EP24:E8 8500-12000 LADY JULIANA [Humble, Measured]: "Juliana, my lady. I was hired for the winter cleaning."
EP24:E9 12200-16800 CAMERA: Medium shot of the noblewoman, her chin tilted up in icy condescension.
EP24:E10 13000-16400 NOBLEWOMAN [Accusatory, Strict]: "And who gave you permission to enter this chamber?"
EP24:E11 16800-18800 CAMERA: Close-up of the frail Dowager Duchess lying pale and unconscious against the white pillows, gasping weakly for air.
EP24:E12 18800-20500 ACTION: Behind her grey skirt, Juliana quickly slips the small glass remedy vial into her apron pocket with her charcoal-dusted fingers.
EP24:E13 18800-20800 CAMERA: Close-up on Juliana's hand swiftly concealing the medicine bottle.
EP24:E14 20800-22500 CAMERA: Medium shot of Juliana facing the noblewoman, maintaining a calm, protective facade.
EP24:E15 20800-22200 LADY JULIANA [Softly Defiant]: "I heard her. I thought Her Grace needed help."
EP24:E16 22500-26800 CAMERA: Two-shot framing the noblewoman looking down at Juliana, bursting into mocking laughter.
EP24:E17 22500-26500 NOBLEWOMAN [Scoffing, Cruel]: "You thought? A new maid thinks she knows better than the physicians?"
EP24:E18 26800-28800 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana's resolute expression, her eyes flashing with righteous urgency.
EP24:E19 27000-28600 LADY JULIANA [Emphatic, Defiant]: "She is suffering."
EP24:E20 28800-30800 CAMERA: Tight close-up of the noblewoman's face twisting into a malicious sneer.
EP24:E21 29000-30800 NOBLEWOMAN [Vicious, Venomous]: "Then let her suffer."
EP24:E22 30800-32800 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana recoiling slightly in shock at the blatant cruelty.
EP24:E23 31000-32500 LADY JULIANA [Steely, Steadfast]: "I cannot do that."
EP24:E24 32500-34500 ACTION: The noblewoman suddenly rears back her riding crop and strikes Juliana violently across the torso.
EP24:E25 32800-33800 SOUND: A sharp, stinging whip crack as the riding crop makes harsh contact.
EP24:E26 33800-36500 ACTION: Juliana gasps in pain, clutching her stomach and bending over as she absorbs the brutal strike.
EP24:E27 33800-36800 CAMERA: Medium shot of Juliana hunched over in pain, clutching her abdomen.
EP24:E28 35000-36800 NOBLEWOMAN [Cold, Threatening]: "You are a maid."
EP24:E29 36800-38800 CAMERA: Low-angle shot looking past the bedpost toward the Duchess, whose trembling hand reaches out limply.
EP24:E30 37000-38800 NOBLEWOMAN [Cold, Continuing]: "Not a physician. Not a lady."
EP24:E31 38800-43000 CAMERA: Dramatic low-angle wide shot of the noblewoman standing imperiously over the doubled-over Juliana.
EP24:E32 39000-42800 NOBLEWOMAN [Disdainful, Final]: "And certainly not a woman whose opinion matters."
EP24:E33 43000-45500 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana looking down, enduring the humiliation while stifling her breath.
EP24:E34 43200-44800 LADY JULIANA [Subdued, Controlled]: "Yes, my lady."
EP24:E35 45500-48500 CAMERA: Medium shot of the noblewoman turning the crop in her white-gloved hands with smug satisfaction.
EP24:E36 45500-48000 NOBLEWOMAN [Smug, Condescending]: "Good. Perhaps we can teach you your place."
SCENE sc_002 48500-92000 INT. MANOR HEARTH ROOM – CONTINUOUS
EP24:E37 48500-51500 ACTION: The noblewoman leads Juliana and a frightened Prudence down a dark flagstone hallway.
EP24:E38 48500-51500 CAMERA: Low tracking shot down the corridor as the hem of the lilac dress sweeps past, followed by Juliana's swift steps.
EP24:E39 51500-53500 ACTION: Juliana's boots step down into a dark, rustic chamber dominated by an enormous, blackened stone hearth.
EP24:E40 51500-54000 CAMERA: Wide shot of the vast soot-stained stone fireplace. The noblewoman turns back toward Juliana, crop held at her side.
EP24:E41 53600-55200 NOBLEWOMAN [Harsh, Dismissive]: "Clean it."
EP24:E42 54000-56200 CAMERA: Medium shot of the noblewoman extending her gloved hand toward the cavernous, filth-laden hearth.
EP24:E43 56200-57800 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana looking up at the towering, soot-blackened chimney.
EP24:E44 56200-57600 LADY JULIANA [Quiet, Questioning]: "All of it, my lady?"
EP24:E45 57800-63800 CAMERA: Extreme close-up two-shot as the noblewoman steps unnervingly close to Juliana's face, whispering with sadistic relish.
EP24:E46 57800-63500 NOBLEWOMAN [Intimate, Venomous]: "Every stone. Perhaps when your hands are black enough, you will finally remember what you are."
EP24:E47 63800-66000 ACTION: Juliana slowly drops to her knees on the cold flagstones before the soot-filled fireplace.
EP24:E48 63800-66200 CAMERA: Medium shot of Juliana sinking to her knees, her face grim and composed.
EP24:E49 66000-67500 ACTION: Prudence steps toward the noblewoman in distress, her hands clasped tightly.
EP24:E50 66200-67800 CAMERA: Close-up of Prudence's anxious, trembling face.
EP24:E51 66200-67500 PRUDENCE [Desperate, Pleading]: "My lady—"
EP24:E52 67500-69500 ACTION: The noblewoman whips around sharply, thrusting the tip of her riding crop directly into Prudence's face.
EP24:E53 67800-70500 CAMERA: Medium close-up of the noblewoman baring her teeth in rage, aiming the crop threateningly.
EP24:E54 68000-70500 NOBLEWOMAN [Furious, Threatening]: "Do you want the same punishment?"
EP24:E55 70500-72800 CAMERA: Close-up of Prudence flinching in terror, lowering her eyes immediately.
EP24:E56 70600-72400 PRUDENCE [Terrified, Murmuring]: "No, my lady."
EP24:E57 72500-74500 ACTION: Juliana grips a coarse scrubbing brush with both hands and begins vigorously scraping the thick black ash across the hearthstones.
EP24:E58 72800-74800 CAMERA: Close-up shot of Juliana's soot-covered hands fiercely scrubbing the black ash along the stone floor.
EP24:E59 73000-81000 SOUND: Rhythmic, harsh rasping sound of bristles scraping against stone.
EP24:E60 74800-78500 CAMERA: Medium shot of the noblewoman leaning casually against the wooden doorframe, watching Juliana toil with smug condescension.
EP24:E61 75000-78000 NOBLEWOMAN [Smug, Gleeful]: "That is where clever little servants belong."
EP24:E62 78500-81200 CAMERA: Medium profile shot of Juliana kneeling by the hearth in the dim window light, scrubbing steadily.
EP24:E63 78600-81000 LADY JULIANA [V.O.) (Cold, Resolute]: "Let her think I am only a maid."
EP24:E64 81200-85000 ACTION: Juliana pauses scrubbing. Her soot-caked fingers reach into the deep pocket of her apron, carefully feeling the worn leather cover of her mother's remedy journal and the glass dropper bottle securely concealed within.
EP24:E65 81200-85200 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana's soot-stained hand touching the hidden remedy book and the antidote vial inside her apron pocket.
EP24:E66 81500-84800 LADY JULIANA [V.O.) (Determined, Defiant]: "Let her believe I am ignorant."
EP24:E67 85200-91500 ACTION: Juliana raises her head. Smudges of dark soot stain her fair cheek, but her piercing blue eyes burn with unwavering defiance and unyielding resolve as she stares toward the hallway.
EP24:E68 85200-92000 CAMERA: Tight close-up of Juliana's soot-streaked face turning slowly toward the chamber exit, her jaw set firm as dramatic music builds to a powerful crescendo.
EP24:E69 85600-89800 LADY JULIANA [V.O.) (Steely, Unstoppable]: "I will return. You cannot stop the healer."

EP=ep_025; timestamps are integer milliseconds
SOURCE_SHA256=c80b5d5b0e2ddf2033dd07eb15242604859e9dd2fd24c64113a274aa29dd6962
METADATA ONLY (not on-screen evidence): {'logline': 'Deep in the misty forest, Alexander confronts an injured Juliana and uncovers the wound inflicted by Lady Catherine, reacting with fury and protective concern upon learning that someone is systematically poisoning the Dowager Duchess with arsenic.', 'continuity_notes': "Picks up immediately following Juliana's ordeal at Ashburg Manor, where she escaped punishment after hiding the antidote and now encounters Alexander awaiting her on the woodland trail."}
SOURCE WARNINGS=['sc_001: incomplete source coverage; gaps are unavailable']
SCENE sc_001 0-168000 EXT. MISTY FOREST TRAIL – DUSK
EP25:E1 0-4200 CAMERA: Wide tracking shot through a dense, sun-dappled forest as mist curls around towering tree trunks and tangled roots.
EP25:E2 600-4200 ACTION: Juliana walks hurriedly along the leaf-strewn forest path, clutching her dark hooded cloak tightly around her shoulders, breathing heavily.
EP25:E3 4200-7000 CAMERA: Medium low-angle shot panning up as Alexander emerges from behind a moss-covered tree, blocking the trail.
EP25:E4 5100-6400 ALEXANDER [Grave, Alert]: "Juliana."
EP25:E5 7000-8500 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana stopping abruptly, her expression guarded and weary.
EP25:E6 7800-9600 ALEXANDER [Concerned, Suspicious]: "Why are you walking like that?"
EP25:E7 8500-13200 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana clutching the collar of her cloak with trembling fingers.
EP25:E8 10200-12800 JULIANA [Deflective, Breathless]: "I am tired. That is all."
EP25:E9 13200-16000 ACTION: Alexander steps forward and reaches out, his gloved hand firmly grasping her left shoulder. Juliana winces sharply and gasps in sudden pain.
EP25:E10 13200-16200 CAMERA: Two-shot profile of Alexander grabbing Juliana's shoulder as she recoils.
EP25:E11 14900-16100 ALEXANDER [Sharp, Alarmed]: "You're hurt."
EP25:E12 16200-18800 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana gritting her teeth against the pain, shaking her head.
EP25:E13 16800-18500 JULIANA [Strained, Minimizing]: "It is nothing."
EP25:E14 18800-22500 ACTION: Alexander's gloved fingers pull back the torn fabric of her cloak and sleeve, revealing a raw, bloody welt slashing across her bare shoulder.
EP25:E15 18800-22800 CAMERA: Tight close-up of the fresh riding-crop laceration cut across Juliana's shoulder.
EP25:E16 22800-25800 CAMERA: Close-up of Alexander's scarred face darkening with volatile fury, his jaw tightening.
EP25:E17 24000-25500 ALEXANDER [Seething, Dangerous]: "Who did this?"
EP25:E18 25800-29800 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana averting her eyes, her head bowed in quiet resignation.
EP25:E19 27500-29300 JULIANA [Subdued, Weary]: "It does not matter."
EP25:E20 29800-32800 CAMERA: Tight shot of Alexander, his eyes burning with intense anger.
EP25:E21 32800-34500 ACTION: Alexander steps directly into her space, firmly taking her hand in his.
EP25:E22 32800-33800 ALEXANDER [Demanding, Stern]: "Who?"
EP25:E23 34500-38500 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana looking up into his eyes, whispering the truth.
EP25:E24 36000-37800 JULIANA [Quiet, Apprehensive]: "Lady Catherine."
EP25:E25 38500-41200 CAMERA: Close-up of Alexander, his gaze piercing and hard.
EP25:E26 39200-41000 ALEXANDER [Low, Interrogating]: "Where did you meet her?"
EP25:E27 41200-44400 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana recounting the incident.
EP25:E28 41200-44200 JULIANA [Hedged]: "I was in the wrong chamber. I was punished as a maid."
EP25:E29 44400-46800 CAMERA: Close-up of Alexander, pressing her without hesitation.
EP25:E30 44600-46400 ALEXANDER [Incredulous, Demanding]: "What were you doing there?"
EP25:E31 46800-51500 CAMERA: Medium two-shot of Alexander leaning down toward her against the dim forest backdrop.
EP25:E32 47000-51200 ALEXANDER [Fierce, Urgent]: "Juliana... why were you inside Ashburg Manor?"
EP25:E33 51500-54200 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana holding his gaze resolutely.
EP25:E34 52200-54200 JULIANA [Earnest]: "I went there to help someone."
EP25:E35 54400-55200 ALEXANDER [Blunt]: "Who?"
EP25:E36 54500-57500 CAMERA: Medium close-up profile of both of them locked in stillness.
EP25:E37 55600-57200 JULIANA [Solemn]: "The Dowager Duchess."
EP25:E38 57500-63500 CAMERA: Tight close-up of Alexander's face freezing in shock, his eyes widening as the revelation hits him.
EP25:E39 60800-62500 ALEXANDER [Stunned, Disbelieving]: "The Dowager?"
EP25:E40 63500-68500 CAMERA: Medium profile tracking shot as Juliana begins walking slowly along the trail, Alexander following closely by her side.
EP25:E41 66200-68500 JULIANA [Urgent]: "Prudence told me she was dying."
EP25:E42 68500-73800 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana turning toward him, recounting the scene in the bedchamber.
EP25:E43 68800-73800 JULIANA [Fervent]: "She was barely breathing when I found her. The doctor said she was simply growing old."
EP25:E44 73800-76800 CAMERA: Two-shot as Juliana stops and looks up into Alexander's grim expression.
EP25:E45 74200-75800 JULIANA [Chilling, Definite]: "But it wasn't age."
EP25:E46 76800-79500 CAMERA: Medium shot of Alexander staring down at her, waiting for the dark truth.
EP25:E47 77400-78900 ALEXANDER [Grim, Low]: "What did you find?"
EP25:E48 79500-82500 CAMERA: Tight close-up on Juliana's trembling lips.
EP25:E49 80200-81800 JULIANA [Hushed, Horrified]: "Poison."
EP25:E50 82500-86200 CAMERA: Slightly wider close-up as Juliana's eyes well with distress.
EP25:E51 83500-85000 JULIANA [Sober]: "Arsenic."
EP25:E52 86200-90000 ACTION: Alexander's hand drops to his side and clenches into a white-knuckled fist, the thick scar across his hand tightening with intense restraint.
EP25:E53 86200-90200 CAMERA: Close-up on Alexander's fist clenching tightly in fury.
EP25:E54 90200-97800 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana, her voice filled with mounting dread.
EP25:E55 90200-97400 JULIANA [Pained, Troubled]: "Someone has been giving it to her again and again. Small amounts. Enough to make her weaker without killing her quickly."
EP25:E56 97800-100200 CAMERA: Close-up of Alexander processing the sinister calculation behind the poisoning.
EP25:E57 100200-105200 CAMERA: Two-shot as Juliana looks up at him with quiet hope.
EP25:E58 100400-104800 JULIANA [Sincere, Earnest]: "I made her medicine. She was still barely conscious, but her breathing became easier."
EP25:E59 105200-107800 CAMERA: Close-up of Alexander's startled gaze.
EP25:E60 105600-107000 ALEXANDER [Incredulous]: "You treated her?"
EP25:E61 107200-108000 JULIANA [Firm]: "Yes."
EP25:E62 107800-111800 CAMERA: Close-up profile of the two facing each other.
EP25:E63 108400-109400 ALEXANDER [Tense]: "Alone?"
EP25:E64 109800-111200 JULIANA [Soft]: "With Prudence."
EP25:E65 111800-114800 CAMERA: Close-up of Alexander, his brow furrowed with deep protective worry.
EP25:E66 112200-114400 ALEXANDER [Anxious]: "Will you be going there again?"
EP25:E67 114800-117500 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana, her eyes filled with resolute purpose.
EP25:E68 115200-116800 JULIANA [Determined]: "I have to."
EP25:E69 117500-121000 ACTION: Juliana places her gentle hand against Alexander's broad chest, trying to soothe his rising anger.
EP25:E70 117500-121500 CAMERA: Two-shot of Juliana leaning in, her hand resting over Alexander's coat.
EP25:E71 117500-120200 JULIANA [Pleading, Defiant]: "She is still sick. I cannot leave her there."
EP25:E72 121000-125000 ACTION: Alexander takes both of her hands into his own, gripping them tightly.
EP25:E73 121500-125500 CAMERA: Medium two-shot of Alexander holding Juliana's hands in the dusky woods.
EP25:E74 125500-128000 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana looking up into his darkened face with questioning concern.
EP25:E75 125800-127500 JULIANA [Gentle, Perplexed]: "Alexander... why are you so angry?"
EP25:E76 128000-134500 CAMERA: Close-up of Alexander speaking through clenched teeth, barely containing his protective fury.
EP25:E77 128200-133800 ALEXANDER [Fierce, Reproachful]: "Because you were standing inside a house where someone is poisoning a woman... and you never told me."
EP25:E78 134500-137200 CAMERA: Medium shot of Juliana looking down sheepishly before raising her eyes.
EP25:E79 135000-137000 JULIANA [Vulnerable]: "I knew you would worry."
EP25:E80 137200-142000 CAMERA: Tight close-up of Alexander, his voice trembling with terrified passion.
EP25:E81 137400-142400 ALEXANDER [Furious, Tormented]: "Worry? They struck you. They could have killed you."
EP25:E82 142000-145000 CAMERA: Two-shot as Juliana looks up into his eyes, holding firm.
EP25:E83 143200-144600 JULIANA [Defiant, Soothing]: "But they didn't."
EP25:E84 145000-148500 CAMERA: Close-up of their clasped hands, panning up to Alexander's tormented gaze.
EP25:E85 145200-146400 ALEXANDER [Grim, Fearful]: "This time."
EP25:E86 147000-148800 JULIANA [Sincere, Steadfast]: "I am being careful."
EP25:E87 148500-152000 CAMERA: Two-shot as Juliana looks at him earnestly.
EP25:E88 149000-151200 JULIANA [Resolute]: "I cannot abandon her."
EP25:E89 151200-154000 ACTION: Alexander closes his eyes for a brief, agonizing second, exhaling deeply as he yields to her unshakeable conviction.
EP25:E90 152000-156500 CAMERA: Close-up of Alexander opening his piercing eyes, resignation and steadfast devotion washing over his features.
EP25:E91 153800-156200 ALEXANDER [Resigned, Steely]: "Then tell me everything."
EP25:E92 156500-163000 CAMERA: Medium two-shot as Alexander holds her gaze in the twilight shadows.
EP25:E93 157400-159200 ALEXANDER [Low, Uncompromising]: "Everything you saw."
EP25:E94 162500-168000 ACTION: Alexander turns, falling into step beside Juliana. Together, side by side, they begin their quiet walk down the darkening forest path into the twilight.
EP25:E95 163000-168000 CAMERA: Wide tracking shot from behind Alexander and Juliana as their silhouettes disappear into the shadowy, mist-veiled forest as emotional strings swell to a resolving chord.
