SOURCE_SHA256=6ffdcf181c0b1067f4524a1696da17735a23b94498c443f342516aab7fe15966
METADATA ONLY (not on-screen evidence): {'logline': 'While secretly administering a charcoal antidote to the poisoned Dowager Duchess in the dead of night, Juliana is stunned when the Duchess suddenly recognizes a distinctive family ring on her hand and fiercely demands the truth about her identity.', 'continuity_notes': "Following her encounter with Alexander in the forest where she vowed to protect the Duchess, Juliana sneaks into the bedchamber at Ashburg Manor to deliver the remaining antidote before Rupert and Catherine's poison takes full hold."}
SOURCE WARNINGS=[]
SCENE sc_001 0-120880 INT. DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER – NIGHT
EP26:E1 0-5800 CAMERA: Wide shot framed through heavy bed curtains in a dark, candlelit bedchamber. Juliana in her maid's apron sits vigilantly beside the canopied bed where the frail Dowager Duchess lies.
EP26:E2 0-5500 ACTION: Juliana glances nervously back toward the door, ensuring no guards are near, before turning her full attention back to the ailing Duchess.
EP26:E3 5800-10500 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana's hands unscrewing the glass dropper from a small amber medicine bottle filled with dark medicinal liquid.
EP26:E4 6500-9000 SOUND: Tense, atmospheric orchestral score builds softly in the background.
EP26:E5 10500-14200 CAMERA: Close-up of the Dowager Duchess resting against pale pillows as her heavy eyelids slowly open, her gaze weak and disoriented.
EP26:E6 11000-14000 ACTION: The Dowager Duchess blinks against the dim lamplight, turning her head toward Juliana.
EP26:E7 14200-20500 CAMERA: Low-angle medium two-shot looking past Juliana's silhouette down to the Duchess in bed.
EP26:E8 14200-20200 DOWAGER DUCHESS [Weak, Raspy]: "Who are you? Speak to me. I have not seen your face before."
EP26:E9 20500-25800 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana leaning over the bed, holding the dropper bottle carefully toward the Duchess's mouth, her expression urgent yet tender.
EP26:E10 20600-25400 JULIANA [Urgent, Reassuring]: "Please, Your Grace. Drink the last of this antidote. Drink it slowly."
EP26:E11 25800-28500 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of the Duchess taking drops of the dark liquid from the glass bottle onto her lips.
EP26:E12 25800-28400 ACTION: The Duchess swallows the remedy with difficulty as Juliana carefully tilts the amber bottle.
EP26:E13 28500-30800 CAMERA: Medium two-shot as Juliana withdraws the medicine bottle, standing beside the bedside lamp.
EP26:E14 30800-35800 CAMERA: Close-up of the Dowager Duchess observing Juliana with faint recognition through her exhaustion.
EP26:E15 30800-35500 DOWAGER DUCHESS [Faint, Discerning]: "You... you are no common servant. You took Catherine's whip for me the other day."
EP26:E16 35800-40200 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana, her eyes reflecting quiet resolve and pain.
EP26:E17 36000-39800 JULIANA [Humble, Sincere]: "I did what I had to. It does not change my duty."
EP26:E18 40200-43200 CAMERA: Medium two-shot as Juliana leans closer to tuck the blankets securely over the Duchess.
EP26:E19 40300-43000 JULIANA [Gentle, Calming]: "Rest now, Your Grace. You are safe tonight."
EP26:E20 43200-47500 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana looking around the shadowy room, her voice dropping to a tense whisper.
EP26:E21 43500-47000 JULIANA [Hushed, Tense Whisper]: "If the guards hear us, we are both dead."
EP26:E22 47500-50800 CAMERA: Static shot of the heavy carved double doors to the bedchamber, left slightly ajar with a sliver of hallway candlelight gleaming through the gap.
EP26:E23 50800-55800 CAMERA: Close-up of the Dowager Duchess lying back, processing Juliana's warning as dark realization settles into her face.
EP26:E24 52500-55500 ACTION: The Duchess clutches the blanket against her chest, her breathing quickening with dismay.
EP26:E25 55800-62500 CAMERA: Medium close-up of the Duchess looking upward toward Juliana, her voice trembling with tragic certainty.
EP26:E26 56000-62000 DOWAGER DUCHESS [Trembling, Heartbroken]: "Rupert and Catherine want me dead. They are poisoning me in my own bed, aren't they?"
EP26:E27 62500-67000 CAMERA: Medium shot of Juliana leaning over the edge of the mattress, nodding earnestly to soothe her fears.
EP26:E28 62600-66700 JULIANA [Reassuring, Steadfast]: "Yes. But the charcoal is fighting the poison. You are safe now."
EP26:E29 67000-71800 CAMERA: Close-up of the small amber dropper bottle sitting atop the polished wooden bedside table in the dim glow of the lamp.
EP26:E30 71800-79600 CAMERA: Medium shot of the Dowager Duchess looking intently at Juliana from her pillows, studying her bearing.
EP26:E31 73800-79400 DOWAGER DUCHESS [Curious, Searching]: "Then tell me... why is a girl of such noble spirit working as a common maid?"
EP26:E32 79600-86500 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana, her chin lifting with dignified sorrow and quiet defiance.
EP26:E33 80000-85800 JULIANA [Painful, Proud]: "Because my family cast me out to rot. I have nothing left in this world but my honor."
EP26:E34 86500-90800 CAMERA: Medium tracking down Juliana's apron to her hand as she rests it against the bed linens, revealing a distinctive engraved signet ring on her finger.
EP26:E35 87000-90500 ACTION: Juliana rests her right hand against the edge of the bedcover, unwittingly placing the unique ring directly within the Duchess's line of sight.
EP26:E36 90200-92000 SOUND: A sharp, stunned gasp.
EP26:E37 90800-95000 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of the Dowager Duchess gasping sharply, her eyes widening in profound shock as all color drains from her face.
EP26:E38 90800-95000 ACTION: The Duchess's mouth hangs open in pure disbelief as she stares fixedly at Juliana's hand.
EP26:E39 95000-100000 CAMERA: Medium shot of the Duchess pushing herself up against the headboard, trembling as she stretches out her frail hand.
EP26:E40 96000-99800 DOWAGER DUCHESS [Breathless, Shaken]: "Your hand... Let me see your hand."
EP26:E41 100000-105500 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana reacting with confusion and growing concern at the elder woman's sudden frenzy.
EP26:E42 100500-105000 JULIANA [Confused, Alarmed]: "Your Grace? What is wrong? You look as though you've seen a ghost."
EP26:E43 105500-109000 CAMERA: Close-up shot of the Duchess's withered, shaking hand reaching across the blanket toward Juliana's arm.
EP26:E44 106000-109000 ACTION: The Duchess reaches outward with trembling fingers, grasping frantically for Juliana.
EP26:E45 108800-110000 SOUND: A sudden sharp rustle of fabric as her fingers snap tight.
EP26:E46 109000-110800 CAMERA: Tight shot of the Duchess's frail hand clamping down with fierce, unexpected strength onto Juliana's dark sleeve.
EP26:E47 109200-110600 DOWAGER DUCHESS [Stern, Desperate]: "Do not move!"
EP26:E48 110800-115800 CAMERA: Close-up of the Dowager Duchess looking up at Juliana with overwhelming urgency and tears brimming in her wide eyes.
EP26:E49 111000-115500 DOWAGER DUCHESS [Intense, Demanding]: "Where... where... Where did you get this ring? Speak to me!"
EP26:E50 115800-119500 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana frozen in shock, her breath catching as the Duchess's desperate words echo in the silence of the room.
EP26:E51 119500-120880 CAMERA: Tight close-up of the Dowager Duchess's two weathered hands tightly clasping Juliana's hand, holding the signet ring between them as a dramatic orchestral cliffhanger chord swells, cutting sharply to black.

EP=ep_027; timestamps are integer milliseconds
SOURCE_SHA256=1d7ceb00a1cf58e1e97f31213bd40db884f5073f0abfc6b11bb2f6650882b63a
METADATA ONLY (not on-screen evidence): {'logline': "The Dowager Duchess realizes Juliana's wedding ring bears the Ashbourne crest belonging to her lost son, but before Juliana can reveal Alexander's name, Rupert and Catherine storm the bedchamber and frame her for poisoning the Duchess.", 'continuity_notes': "Picks up immediately from Episode 26's cliffhanger where the Dowager Duchess gripped Juliana's hand upon recognizing the family signet ring, frantically questioning her origin."}
SOURCE WARNINGS=['sc_001: incomplete source coverage; gaps are unavailable']
SCENE sc_001 0-150500 INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT
EP27:E1 0-2100 CAMERA: Tight close-up of the Dowager Duchess's aged, trembling hands clutching Juliana's hand, examining the worn metal band on her finger.
EP27:E2 1300-3200 DOWAGER DUCHESS [Shaken, Breathless]: "This ring..."
EP27:E3 2100-5800 CAMERA: Low-angle medium close-up of the Dowager Duchess lying propped against her pillows, gripping Juliana's wrist firmly as she gazes up in desperate demand.
EP27:E4 3400-5800 DOWAGER DUCHESS [Urgent, Demanding]: "Look at me, girl. Who gave this to you?"
EP27:E5 5800-9400 CAMERA: Medium shot of Juliana in her maid's apron, startled and anxious as she answers.
EP27:E6 6400-9300 JULIANA [Hesitant, Sincere]: "My husband. He gave it to me when we wed."
EP27:E7 9400-13200 CAMERA: Low angle on the Dowager Duchess, her eyes burning with intensity.
EP27:E8 9700-12800 DOWAGER DUCHESS [Incredulous, Intense]: "He is no commoner. What does he do?"
EP27:E9 13200-16800 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana, trying to keep her composure.
EP27:E10 13400-16400 JULIANA [Earnest, Defending]: "He is a soldier. A veteran from the Peninsula."
EP27:E11 16800-21600 CAMERA: Medium two-shot as the Duchess leans forward slightly, staring at the ring between their joined hands.
EP27:E12 17200-21200 DOWAGER DUCHESS [Trembling, Revelatory]: "That is no ordinary band. It bears the Ashbourne crest."
EP27:E13 21600-26100 CAMERA: Close-up on Juliana, shaking her head in disbelief and growing confusion.
EP27:E14 21800-25800 JULIANA [Confused, Gentle]: "No. He lives in a barn. He has nothing but his word."
EP27:E15 26100-31800 CAMERA: Low-angle shot on the Duchess, tears welling in her eyes as grief and shock overtake her.
EP27:E16 26600-31400 DOWAGER DUCHESS [Emotionally Strained, Weeping]: "My lost son wore that exact ring. He went to war..."
EP27:E17 31800-34900 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana's eyes widening in stunned revelation.
EP27:E18 32100-34800 JULIANA [Shocked, Breathless]: "Your son? He told me he was only a sergeant."
EP27:E19 34900-37400 CAMERA: Side-angle medium shot of the bed, the Duchess holding onto Juliana's forearm with fierce insistence.
EP27:E20 35200-37600 DOWAGER DUCHESS [Desperate, Clinging]: "My lost son wore that ring!"
EP27:E21 37400-40400 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana looking down with compassionate concern.
EP27:E22 37800-40200 DOWAGER DUCHESS [O.S.) (Pleading]: "Did your husband serve beside him?"
EP27:E23 41000-44200 JULIANA [Soft, Reverent]: "He never spoke of his officers. He only spoke of survival."
EP27:E24 44200-46400 CAMERA: Close-up of the Duchess gazing up at Juliana, her voice barely a whisper.
EP27:E25 44500-46400 DOWAGER DUCHESS [Hushed, Desperate]: "What is your husband's name?"
EP27:E26 46400-48300 SOUND: Loud, violent pounding echoes on the wooden double doors.
EP27:E27 46500-48800 CAMERA: Juliana gasps, snapping her head toward the entrance in alarm.
EP27:E28 48800-51500 ACTION: The heavy mahogany double doors burst open, revealing the Blond Nobleman flanked by Lady Catherine and a royal guard in uniform.
EP27:E29 48800-51500 CAMERA: Wide shot framing the open doorway as the aristocrats step into the dimly lit hallway.
EP27:E30 51500-55600 CAMERA: Medium shot of Lady Catherine in her lavish cream gown and tiara, scowling with arrogant disdain.
EP27:E31 52200-55600 LADY CATHERINE [Sharp, Accusatory]: "What is that maid doing in Her Grace's private chamber?"
EP27:E32 55600-58600 CAMERA: Medium shot of Juliana standing stiffly beside the bed, concealing her hands.
EP27:E33 56800-58400 JULIANA [Calm, Defiant]: "She needed help."
EP27:E34 58600-62000 CAMERA: Close-up of Lady Catherine narrowing her eyes with venomous suspicion.
EP27:E35 60000-61800 LADY CATHERINE [Piercing, Suspicious]: "What are you hiding?"
EP27:E36 62000-64000 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana, her chin raised.
EP27:E37 62200-63500 JULIANA [Firm]: "Nothing."
EP27:E38 64000-66500 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Lady Catherine pointing a white-gloved finger directly at Juliana.
EP27:E39 64800-66400 LADY CATHERINE [Demanding, Harsh]: "Show me your hand."
EP27:E40 66500-70500 CAMERA: Medium shot of the Blond Nobleman stepping forward beside Lady Catherine, clad in a dark tailored coat with black leather gloves.
EP27:E41 66600-70100 BLOND NOBLEMAN [Cold, Authoritative]: "Girl. Show me what you are holding."
EP27:E42 70500-73800 CAMERA: Two-shot of Juliana facing the Blond Nobleman as she slowly extends her palm, revealing the small amber glass dropper bottle.
EP27:E43 72600-73700 BLOND NOBLEMAN [Skeptical]: "What is this?"
EP27:E44 73800-74800 JULIANA [Steady]: "Medicine."
EP27:E45 74800-77800 CAMERA: Close-up of Lady Catherine tapping her gloved finger to her lip, letting out a mocking scoff.
EP27:E46 75200-77800 LADY CATHERINE [Mocking, Condescending]: "Medicine? You are a new maid."
EP27:E47 77800-80800 CAMERA: Medium shot of the Blond Nobleman staring down at the vial, as Catherine sneers from his side.
EP27:E48 78100-80500 LADY CATHERINE [Incredulous, Accusing]: "Who permitted you to give medicine to the Duchess?"
EP27:E49 80800-83000 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana holding her ground.
EP27:E50 81000-82000 JULIANA [Quiet, Resolute]: "No one."
EP27:E51 83000-86500 CAMERA: Close-up of Lady Catherine turning fiercely triumphant.
EP27:E52 83600-86400 LADY CATHERINE [Spiteful, Indignant]: "Then you administered it without permission."
EP27:E53 86500-88000 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana, her voice rising passionately.
EP27:E54 86500-87800 JULIANA [Passionate, Urgent]: "Because she was dying!"
EP27:E55 88000-92800 CAMERA: Medium shot of the Blond Nobleman pacing forward with calculating malice.
EP27:E56 88200-92400 BLOND NOBLEMAN [Cold, Interrogating]: "And you decided you knew better than every physician in this house?"
EP27:E57 92800-95000 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana retorting without hesitation.
EP27:E58 93300-94900 JULIANA [Fierce]: "The physicians were not saving her!"
EP27:E59 95000-97800 CAMERA: Over-the-shoulder shot past the Blond Nobleman looking toward the frail Duchess watching helplessly from the bed.
EP27:E60 95300-97700 BLOND NOBLEMAN [O.S.) (Measured, Menacing]: "My aunt has been wasting away for months."
EP27:E61 97800-103600 CAMERA: Medium shot of the Blond Nobleman turning slowly back toward Juliana, building his trap.
EP27:E62 98800-103400 BLOND NOBLEMAN [Smooth, Threatening]: "And now we find an unknown maid alone beside her bed..."
EP27:E63 103600-107800 CAMERA: Close-up shot of his gloved black leather finger reaching down to tap against the glass dropper bottle in Juliana's open palm.
EP27:E64 104200-107500 BLOND NOBLEMAN [O.S.) (Contemptuous]: "...holding a substance no one authorized her to give."
EP27:E65 107800-110200 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana raising the small bottle high for them to see.
EP27:E66 108300-109800 JULIANA [Unyielding]: "It is an antidote."
EP27:E67 110200-112500 CAMERA: Close-up of Lady Catherine sneering sharply.
EP27:E68 110300-111800 LADY CATHERINE [Sharp, Provocative]: "An antidote to what?"
EP27:E69 112500-113600 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Juliana's focused eyes.
EP27:E70 113200-114300 BLOND NOBLEMAN [O.S.) (Stern, Barked]: "Answer her."
EP27:E71 113600-115000 CAMERA: Close-up on the Blond Nobleman's impatient scowl.
EP27:E72 115000-117200 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana speaking the truth clearly.
EP27:E73 115100-116500 JULIANA [Unyielding, Resolute]: "Poison."
EP27:E74 117200-120000 CAMERA: Close-up on the Blond Nobleman, his expression freezing into a dark scowl.
EP27:E75 118700-119800 BLOND NOBLEMAN [Whispering, Dangerous]: "Poison."
EP27:E76 120000-122800 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana stating the grim reality.
EP27:E77 120400-122600 JULIANA [Urgent]: "Someone has been poisoning Her Grace."
EP27:E78 122800-124600 CAMERA: Medium shot of Lady Catherine turning abruptly to the guard stationed by the open door, pointing with feigned outrage.
EP27:E79 123100-124500 LADY CATHERINE [Shrieking, Feigning Horror]: "You hear that?!"
EP27:E80 124600-128500 CAMERA: Close-up of Lady Catherine twisting Juliana's words with malicious glee.
EP27:E81 124800-128400 LADY CATHERINE [Venomous, Accusing]: "She admits she has been giving the Duchess poison in secret!"
EP27:E82 128500-131000 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana recoiling in shock at the blatant lie.
EP27:E83 128700-130800 JULIANA [Desperate, Outraged]: "That is not what I said!"
EP27:E84 131000-134000 CAMERA: Medium close-up of the Blond Nobleman raising his black-gloved hand, silencing the room.
EP27:E85 131200-132600 BLOND NOBLEMAN [Authoritative, Icy]: "Enough."
EP27:E86 134000-139400 CAMERA: Medium two-shot as the Blond Nobleman steps into Juliana's personal space and plucks the glass dropper vial from her hand.
EP27:E87 134800-138500 ACTION: The Blond Nobleman takes the medicine vial from Juliana's grasp, inspecting it under the candlelight.
EP27:E88 136200-139300 BLOND NOBLEMAN [Cold, Calculating]: "An unknown servant enters a restricted chamber."
EP27:E89 139400-144200 CAMERA: Tight close-up of the Blond Nobleman holding the vial beside his temple, his blue eyes cold and triumphant.
EP27:E90 139600-143800 BLOND NOBLEMAN [Condemning, Vindictive]: "She secretly administers an unidentified substance to a helpless woman."
EP27:E91 144000-144900 BLOND NOBLEMAN [To Guard, Stern]: "Take her."
EP27:E92 144200-147500 CAMERA: Wide shot as the armed guard storms forward, seizing Juliana roughly by both arms.
EP27:E93 145000-148000 ACTION: The guard twists Juliana around and drags her forcibly toward the doorway as she struggles against his grip.
EP27:E94 147500-149200 CAMERA: Medium shot of Juliana being pulled backward, casting a frantic glance back toward the bedridden Duchess.
EP27:E95 149200-150500 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Juliana's wide, terrified eyes as she realizes the deadly trap closing around her, cutting abruptly to black.

EP=ep_028; timestamps are integer milliseconds
SOURCE_SHA256=c16039c9150b946989645a76291309ef7889e05e14a38451ad10630ef7f90d21
METADATA ONLY (not on-screen evidence): {'logline': "Rupert and Catherine frame Juliana for poisoning the Duchess despite the bedridden matriarch's protests, uncovering Juliana's true noble identity and her mother's herbarium before ordering her to the castle dungeons.", 'continuity_notes': 'Picks up directly from Episode 27 as Rupert orders the guard to seize Juliana, ignoring the waking Duchess.'}
SOURCE WARNINGS=[]
SCENE sc_001 0-138500 INT. DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER – DAY
EP28:E1 0-2300 CAMERA: Medium shot as the guard drags Juliana toward the doorway, wrestling her backward.
EP28:E2 0-2100 ACTION: Juliana struggles against the guard's grip; the leather-bound herbarium slips from her apron pocket and falls to the stone floor.
EP28:E3 1800-3200 SOUND: Heavy thud of the leather journal hitting the polished floor.
EP28:E4 2300-4700 CAMERA: Low-angle close-up of the leather-bound herbarium on the floor as Catherine's silk slipper steps down hard upon its embossed cover.
EP28:E5 3200-4600 ACTION: Catherine plants her embroidered shoe deliberately atop the fallen book.
EP28:E6 4700-10000 CAMERA: Medium two-shot tracking Catherine as she strides gracefully across the chamber toward Juliana, Rupert standing stoically behind her near the bed.
EP28:E7 4900-6300 CATHERINE [Mocking, Cruel]: "Look at her, Rupert."
EP28:E8 6600-8100 CATHERINE [Scoffing]: "Soot on her face..."
EP28:E9 8200-12600 CAMERA: Over-the-shoulder shot from behind Catherine as she faces Juliana, who is pinned in the doorway by the guard.
EP28:E10 8400-10000 CATHERINE [Accusing, Smug]: "...herbs in her pockets..."
EP28:E11 10200-12300 CATHERINE [Cold]: "...a secret medicine in her hand."
EP28:E12 12600-15200 CAMERA: Tight close-up of Catherine's smiling face, her eyes gleaming with vindictive pleasure.
EP28:E13 12700-15000 CATHERINE [Venomous]: "She looks exactly like a poisoner."
EP28:E14 15200-18500 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana glaring back in fierce indignation, breathing heavily as she resists the guard's arm across her shoulder.
EP28:E15 15300-18400 JULIANA [Furious, Defiant]: "I did not poison her! Look at her eyes, the fever has broken!"
EP28:E16 18500-22800 CAMERA: Medium full shot of Rupert standing beside the four-poster bed, calmly pulling on his black leather gloves.
EP28:E17 18900-20300 BLOND NOBLEMAN [Sardonic, Chilling]: "A clever story, girl."
EP28:E18 20400-22700 BLOND NOBLEMAN [Threatening]: "But the guards know how to extract the truth."
EP28:E19 22800-26700 CAMERA: Medium close-up of the Dowager Duchess stirring against her pillows, lifting her trembling head with visible effort.
EP28:E20 24800-26500 DOWAGER DUCHESS [Weak, Straining]: "Rupert..."
EP28:E21 26700-28400 CAMERA: Medium shot of Rupert pausing mid-stride as he hears his mother's voice, slowly turning his head toward the bed.
EP28:E22 26700-28200 DOWAGER DUCHESS [O.S.) (Commanding]: "Stop this!"
EP28:E23 28400-32800 CAMERA: Wide shot of the bedchamber framed through the bed curtains as the Duchess props herself up on one elbow and points an accusing finger.
EP28:E24 28800-30300 DOWAGER DUCHESS [Desperate, Firm]: "She is innocent."
EP28:E25 30800-32400 DOWAGER DUCHESS [Adamant]: "She saved me!"
EP28:E26 32800-34900 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana, tears of relief welling in her eyes.
EP28:E27 33200-34600 JULIANA [Breathless, Relieved]: "Your Grace..."
EP28:E28 34900-37700 CAMERA: Close-up of the Duchess clutching at her nightgown, her face twisted in mounting fury and horror.
EP28:E29 35000-37400 DOWAGER DUCHESS [Trembling, Shouting]: "I know what happened to me!"
EP28:E30 37700-43000 CAMERA: Medium low-angle shot past the Duchess pointing directly at Rupert, who stands rigid and expressionless.
EP28:E31 38200-40000 DOWAGER DUCHESS [Fierce, Condemning]: "I was poisoned!"
EP28:E32 40300-42200 DOWAGER DUCHESS [Accusing]: "And you... you knew!"
EP28:E33 43000-47400 CAMERA: Medium shot of the Duchess lunging forward from the pillows, gasping for breath as she points toward Catherine.
EP28:E34 43600-45300 DOWAGER DUCHESS [Choking, Weakening]: "Catherine knew!"
EP28:E35 45600-47000 DOWAGER DUCHESS [Gasping]: "They have been—"
EP28:E36 46800-48000 ACTION: The Duchess collapses back onto the pillows, coughing violently and clutching her chest.
EP28:E37 47400-52200 CAMERA: Wide shot as Juliana lunges across the room toward the bed, but the armed guard seizes her from behind and drags her back.
EP28:E38 48200-49700 JULIANA [Panicked, Screaming]: "Let me help her!"
EP28:E39 49500-52100 JULIANA [Desperate]: "She's still weak, you cannot leave her like this!"
EP28:E40 52200-56800 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Rupert smoothing down his black leather gloves, a chilling smile forming on his lips.
EP28:E41 52800-53600 BLOND NOBLEMAN [Smooth, Feigning Concern]: "You see?"
EP28:E42 54000-56600 BLOND NOBLEMAN [Sinister]: "The poison has clearly damaged her mind."
EP28:E43 56800-61300 CAMERA: Over-the-shoulder shot of Rupert leaning menacingly over the gasping Duchess in bed.
EP28:E44 57000-58700 DOWAGER DUCHESS [Hoarse, Straining]: "I am not delusional!"
EP28:E45 58600-60000 BLOND NOBLEMAN [Condescending, Whispering]: "Of course you are not."
EP28:E46 60100-61200 BLOND NOBLEMAN [Dismissive]: "You are merely confused."
EP28:E47 61300-66800 CAMERA: Medium profile tracking shot of Catherine walking deliberately toward Juliana, speaking with airy cynicism.
EP28:E48 61600-64800 CATHERINE [Amused, Mocking]: "How convenient that the only person who can prove the poison exists..."
EP28:E49 64900-66800 CATHERINE [Smug]: "...is the maid who claims to have discovered it."
EP28:E50 66800-70500 CAMERA: Low-angle medium shot of Rupert turning sharply toward the guard, his eyes icy and authoritative.
EP28:E51 67200-70200 BLOND NOBLEMAN [Commanding, Resolute]: "Take her away before she poisons the rest of this house."
EP28:E52 70500-72000 CAMERA: Tight close-up of Catherine's gloved hands grabbing the delicate chain around Juliana's neck.
EP28:E53 70800-72000 ACTION: Catherine ruthlessly yanks the silver locket off Juliana's neck.
EP28:E54 71200-72000 JULIANA [Crying Out]: "No!"
EP28:E55 72000-75300 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Catherine holding up the oval silver and amethyst pendant, inspecting it with disdain.
EP28:E56 72200-75100 CATHERINE [Insolent, Sneering]: "Where did a gutter rat like you find a silver locket?"
EP28:E57 75300-78900 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana crying out in agony, writhing in the guard's iron grip.
EP28:E58 75400-76400 JULIANA [Screaming, Weeping]: "Give it back!"
EP28:E59 76800-78600 JULIANA [Anguished]: "It belonged to my mother!"
EP28:E60 78900-82300 CAMERA: Low-angle shot tracking the silver locket as Catherine casually flings it across the stone corridor floor.
EP28:E61 79000-81900 CATHERINE [O.S.) (Cruel]: "A witch has no need for family heirlooms in the gallows."
EP28:E62 81000-82400 SOUND: Metallic clatter as the silver pendant bounces against the wooden baseboard.
EP28:E63 82300-86500 CAMERA: Medium shot of Juliana being dragged further into the doorway, staring helplessly toward her discarded locket.
EP28:E64 82500-84400 JULIANA [Heartbroken]: "My mother's locket!"
EP28:E65 86500-91000 CAMERA: Medium shot of Catherine walking toward the fallen leather-bound book and kneeling gracefully to pick it up.
EP28:E66 88000-91000 ACTION: Catherine lifts the heavy herbarium, dusting off the cover before opening its aged parchment pages.
EP28:E67 91000-93800 CAMERA: Tight close-up of Catherine reading the elegant cursive script inside the front cover.
EP28:E68 91200-92800 CATHERINE [Intrigued, Murmuring]: "Juliana..."
EP28:E69 93800-95000 CAMERA: Extreme close-up on the handwritten inscription: 'Juliana Ashcroft'.
EP28:E70 95000-97400 CAMERA: Medium shot of Juliana freezing in the doorway as she sees Catherine opening her mother's book.
EP28:E71 95200-97000 ACTION: Juliana gasps in horror, realizing her secret identity has been laid bare.
EP28:E72 97400-101200 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine raising her gaze slowly from the book, a wicked, triumphant grin spreading across her face.
EP28:E73 98200-100800 CATHERINE [Triumphant, Venomous]: "Lady Juliana Ashcroft."
EP28:E74 101200-107800 CAMERA: Medium two-shot as Catherine steps deliberately up to Juliana, circling her like a predator savoring its prey.
EP28:E75 101500-103700 CATHERINE [Mocking, Reveling]: "I knew I had seen those eyes before."
EP28:E76 104200-105600 CATHERINE [Cruel]: "The disgraced daughter..."
EP28:E77 105600-107800 CATHERINE [Scornful]: "...the girl thrown out of her own family home."
EP28:E78 107800-113000 CAMERA: Close-up two-shot of Catherine leaning inches from Juliana's face, whispering her humiliating past.
EP28:E79 108100-111000 CATHERINE [Taunting]: "The bride who married a penniless war veteran..."
EP28:E80 111100-113000 CATHERINE [Vicious]: "...because no respectable man would have her."
EP28:E81 113000-116400 CAMERA: Tight close-up of Juliana's eyes blazing with explosive fury and defensive loyalty.
EP28:E82 113300-115800 JULIANA [Screaming, Wildly Defiant]: "Do not speak about my husband!"
EP28:E83 116400-122000 CAMERA: Medium two-shot as Catherine throws her head back in derisive laughter, brandishing the herbarium book.
EP28:E84 116400-119100 CATHERINE [Laughing, Scornful]: "And look at you now. Scrubbing fireplaces in my house."
EP28:E85 119200-121800 CATHERINE [Mocking]: "What a magnificent fall, Lady Juliana."
EP28:E86 122000-124900 CAMERA: Medium shot of Rupert gesturing toward the exit with an outstretched arm.
EP28:E87 122000-124700 BLOND NOBLEMAN [Harsh, Authoritative]: "Drag her to the wet cells beneath the south tower."
EP28:E88 124900-128800 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine fanning open the illustrated botanical pages of the herbarium with gloved fingers.
EP28:E89 125000-125700 CATHERINE [Smug]: "And this?"
EP28:E90 125900-128700 CATHERINE [Gleeful]: "This book of weeds will hang her before the magistrate."
EP28:E91 128800-131200 CAMERA: Medium shot of Juliana thrashing frantically against the guard's grip, her arm reaching out toward the book.
EP28:E92 129100-131000 JULIANA [Screaming, Desperate]: "That book is my mother's life's work!"
EP28:E93 131200-136800 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Catherine smiling coldly, clutching the closed book against her bodice.
EP28:E94 131400-134200 CATHERINE [Icy, Threatening]: "Then perhaps you can explain every page to the magistrate..."
EP28:E95 134600-136700 CATHERINE [Fateful, Vengeful]: "...before he sends you to the gallows."
EP28:E96 136800-138500 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Juliana's wide, trembling eyes as the guard wrenches her backward into the dark hallway, cutting sharply to black.

EP=ep_029; timestamps are integer milliseconds
SOURCE_SHA256=bf00c3e50abaa8f00aebcb55c6a4520f26e9a987f22ab4975348ab092bdf6265
METADATA ONLY (not on-screen evidence): {'logline': "Thrown into the castle's subterranean wet cells as Catherine threatens to burn her mother's herbarium and frame her for witchcraft, Juliana breaks down in isolation before swearing that they will never take Alexander from her.", 'continuity_notes': "Follows directly from Episode 28 where Rupert ordered the guards to drag Juliana down to the wet cells while Catherine seized her mother's herbarium."}
SOURCE WARNINGS=[]
SCENE sc_001 0-20100 INT. CASTLE DUNGEON STAIRWELL – NIGHT
EP29:E1 0-2800 CAMERA: High angle tracking shot descending a spiral stone staircase illuminated by flickering wall torches and damp, glistening masonry.
EP29:E2 0-3500 SOUND: Dripping water echoes hollowly against stone steps alongside the shuffling scuffle of boots.
EP29:E3 2800-5100 CAMERA: Tracking shot facing two stern uniform guards hauling a struggling Juliana down the dark corridor by her arms.
EP29:E4 2900-5100 ACTION: Juliana resists furiously, her feet stumbling on the wet flagstones as the guards forcibly propel her forward.
EP29:E5 5100-7400 CAMERA: Medium low-angle shot of Catherine standing regally under an arched stone doorway, clutching the leather-bound herbarium.
EP29:E6 7400-11700 CAMERA: Tight close-up of Juliana's tearful face as she reaches an arm out toward Catherine in anguish.
EP29:E7 7400-11700 JULIANA [Desperate, Weeping]: "Catherine! Please! That book is my mother's only legacy!"
EP29:E8 11700-13200 CAMERA: Medium shot from behind Catherine as she stands motionless, watching Juliana being dragged away.
EP29:E9 13200-17300 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana turning her head back toward Catherine, screaming through tears.
EP29:E10 13200-17300 JULIANA [Pleading, Agonized]: "It contains years of her work! Her knowledge! Everything she left me!"
EP29:E11 17300-20100 CAMERA: Full shot of Catherine turning gracefully on the dungeon steps, holding the book loosely at her side.
SCENE sc_002 20100-83000 INT. DUNGEON CORRIDOR – CONTINUOUS
EP29:E12 20100-26800 CAMERA: Medium close-up pushing in on Catherine as she presents the worn botanical book with both gloved hands.
EP29:E13 21000-24000 CATHERINE [Mocking, Condescending]: "Your mother's little book of weeds?"
EP29:E14 24800-26700 CATHERINE [Cruel, Smug]: "You still call this a legacy?"
EP29:E15 26800-28900 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana held firmly between the guards, glaring back with fierce defiance.
EP29:E16 27100-28700 JULIANA [Defiant, Furious]: "It is medicine!"
EP29:E17 28900-31900 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Catherine smiling condescendingly.
EP29:E18 30400-31800 CATHERINE [Smooth, Patronizing]: "Of course."
EP29:E19 31900-37400 CAMERA: Overhead close-up of Catherine's gloved fingers flipping through the herbarium's delicate, hand-drawn floral remedies and annotations.
EP29:E20 31900-37300 CATHERINE [O.S.) (Disdainful, Calculating]: "Roots. Leaves. Powders. Strange mixtures written in a dead woman's hand."
EP29:E21 37400-40000 CAMERA: Medium shot of Catherine tucking the book under her arm, her eyes glinting with malicious intent.
EP29:E22 37700-40000 CATHERINE [Icy, Threatening]: "The magistrate will call it witchcraft."
EP29:E23 40000-41900 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana lunging against the guard's grip, her teeth bared in indignation.
EP29:E24 40100-41800 JULIANA [Furious, Shouted]: "You know that is a lie!"
EP29:E25 41900-44300 CAMERA: Medium shot of Catherine lifting her chin arrogantly against the stone backdrop.
EP29:E26 42000-44200 CATHERINE [Calm, Sinister]: "I know exactly what I need him to believe."
EP29:E27 44300-46900 CAMERA: Medium shot of Juliana thrashing frantically against the two guards.
EP29:E28 44400-46500 JULIANA [Screaming, Desperate]: "You cannot just destroy it!"
EP29:E29 46900-49800 CAMERA: Tight close-up of Catherine's eyes narrowing into an icy, venomous gaze.
EP29:E30 47300-49100 CATHERINE [Whispered, Malicious]: "I can burn it."
EP29:E31 49800-53600 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana's stricken expression, her eyes widening in horror.
EP29:E32 50100-53600 CATHERINE [O.S.) (Chilling, Relentless]: "And when they find your corpse at the end of the rope..."
EP29:E33 53600-56600 CAMERA: Side close-up of Catherine leaning slightly forward, her voice low and merciless.
EP29:E34 53800-56500 CATHERINE [Cruel, Resolute]: "...no one will remember what was written inside."
EP29:E35 56600-59200 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana screaming back in raw outrage.
EP29:E36 56700-59000 JULIANA [Enraged, Defiant]: "You are doing this because I saved the Duchess!"
EP29:E37 59200-63800 CAMERA: Medium low-angle shot of Catherine standing rigid in her silk gown, contempt etched across her features.
EP29:E38 59300-63400 CATHERINE [Scornful, Arrogant]: "I am doing this because women like you forget their place."
EP29:E39 63800-67000 CAMERA: Quick pan from Juliana's apron up to Catherine's face.
EP29:E40 64500-66500 CATHERINE [Cold, Venomous]: "You were cast out once."
EP29:E41 67000-69500 CAMERA: Extreme close-up on Catherine's smiling lips and cold blue eyes.
EP29:E42 67200-69100 CATHERINE [Menacing]: "You should have stayed forgotten."
EP29:E43 69500-71800 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana raising her chin, unwavering pride breaking through her tears.
EP29:E44 69800-71400 JULIANA [Steely, Resolute]: "My husband will find me."
EP29:E45 71800-74300 CAMERA: Medium shot of Catherine letting out a scornful laugh, tilting her head.
EP29:E46 72100-74300 CATHERINE [Scoffing, Amused]: "Your scarred soldier?"
EP29:E47 74300-78500 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine's face hardening into sharp mockery.
EP29:E48 74700-78100 CATHERINE [Derisive, Biting]: "What exactly do you think a penniless veteran can do against Ashbrook?"
EP29:E49 78500-80900 CAMERA: Medium shot as the guard clamps a heavy hand on Juliana's shoulder, shoving her forward.
EP29:E50 78700-80600 GUARD [Gruff, Dismissive]: "Move along, girl."
EP29:E51 80900-83000 CAMERA: Wide shot tracking behind the guards as they march Juliana down the vaulted, puddle-strewn corridor toward the heavy iron cell door.
SCENE sc_003 83000-116690 INT. CASTLE DUNGEON CELL – CONTINUOUS
EP29:E52 83000-86500 CAMERA: Wide shot inside the pitch-dark cell as the heavy iron door swings open.
EP29:E53 84000-86500 ACTION: The guards shove Juliana violently into the cell; she falls hard onto all fours across the cold, wet stone floor.
EP29:E54 85700-86500 JULIANA [Crying Out, Broken]: "Please!"
EP29:E55 86500-88000 SOUND: The heavy iron door slams shut with a deafening metallic thud, and the massive exterior bolt grates locked.
EP29:E56 86500-88800 CAMERA: Static shot of the locked iron door, deadlocked in total isolation.
EP29:E57 88800-93700 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana kneeling on the floor, clutching her chest as hyperventilation overtakes her.
EP29:E58 89500-93700 ACTION: Juliana trembles uncontrollably, her fingers digging into the collar of her rustic dress as terror washes over her.
EP29:E59 93700-96100 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Juliana's tear-drenched face crumpling in overwhelming grief.
EP29:E60 94200-95500 JULIANA [Sobbing, Heartbroken]: "Mother..."
EP29:E61 96100-99600 CAMERA: Medium shot as Juliana pushes herself off the wet stone floor and dashes toward the barred wicket of the heavy door.
EP29:E62 97300-99500 JULIANA [Desperate, Shouting]: "I have done nothing!"
EP29:E63 99600-102500 CAMERA: Tight profile close-up of Juliana gripping the rusted iron bars, screaming out into the empty stone corridor.
EP29:E64 99700-102300 JULIANA [Screaming, Hysterical]: "I saved her! I healed her!"
EP29:E65 102500-105900 CAMERA: Medium shot from inside the cell as Juliana pounds her fists rhythmically against the reinforced iron door.
EP29:E66 102500-105200 SOUND: Muffled, dull metallic clanging reverberates as Juliana hammers against the iron door.
EP29:E67 102600-105300 JULIANA [Shouting in Anguish]: "I saved the Duchess!"
EP29:E68 105900-109000 CAMERA: Medium shot of Juliana slumping down against the rough stone wall, pulling her knees to her chest while weeping softly.
EP29:E69 106500-108800 JULIANA [V.O.) (Sorrowful, Wounded]: "They took my mother's ledger..."
EP29:E70 109000-112800 CAMERA: Front medium shot of Juliana slowly rising to her feet, crossing her arms firmly across her chest as her tears stop and her expression hardens into steely resolve.
EP29:E71 109000-112600 JULIANA [V.O.) (Quiet Resolve, Unbreakable]: "They took her locket. But they will not take Alexander from me."
EP29:E72 112800-115500 CAMERA: Close-up of the dungeon's massive iron portcullis bars dropping down with finality.
EP29:E73 112800-114800 SOUND: A heavy iron portcullis crashes down with a massive echoing bang.
EP29:E74 115500-116690 CAMERA: Low-angle shot looking up at Juliana standing dignified in the center of the damp dungeon cell, gazing upward toward the overhead grate where faint beams of moonlight filter down, cutting sharply to black.

EP=ep_030; timestamps are integer milliseconds
SOURCE_SHA256=5535a6b12dd9085ead17b3b19968ca9f25f6d862c822cea65a417972ea3c1265
METADATA ONLY (not on-screen evidence): {'logline': 'When rumors of the poisoned Duchess begin spreading among the servants, Rupert and Catherine conspire with an elder nobleman to fabricate a witchcraft charge against Juliana, sealing her fate for the gallows.', 'continuity_notes': "Follows directly from Episode 29 where Juliana was locked away in the castle's subterranean wet cells, vowing never to let them take Alexander from her."}
SOURCE WARNINGS=[]
SCENE sc_001 0-47600 INT. CASTLE CORRIDOR – DAY
EP30:E1 0-5200 CAMERA: Low-angle tracking shot following polished black dress shoes and the tip of a gold-handled cane striding deliberately along a sunlit marble hallway, tilting up gradually to reveal an austere, grey-haired elder nobleman.
EP30:E2 0-4500 SOUND: Rhythmic, heavy footsteps and the sharp metallic click of a cane striking the polished stone floor.
EP30:E3 3000-5500 ACTION: The Elder Nobleman walks with stern, unhurried authority, dressed in an immaculate black tailcoat and dark vest with a gold pocket watch chain.
EP30:E4 5200-7500 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Rupert standing nervously beside ornate double doors, wearing black gloves and an embroidered dark coat, glancing up with anxiety.
EP30:E5 6800-7900 SOUND: A firm tap of the wooden walking stick halting against the floor.
EP30:E6 7500-13500 CAMERA: Two-shot profile of the Elder Nobleman facing Rupert in the vaulted corridor.
EP30:E7 8800-13300 ELDER NOBLEMAN [Cold, Accusatory]: "You have a rat in your cellar, Rupert. And the servants are beginning to smell it."
EP30:E8 13500-16900 CAMERA: Close-up of Rupert defensive and agitated.
EP30:E9 13600-16800 RUPERT [Defensive, Anxious]: "The Ashcroft girl is locked tight. Nobody knows she is down there."
EP30:E10 16900-26000 CAMERA: Medium close-up of the Elder Nobleman fixing Rupert with a piercing, contemptuous glare.
EP30:E11 17300-25800 ELDER NOBLEMAN [Stern, Disapproving]: "The kitchen maids are whispering. They see the soup bowls returned unwiped. They see your guards outside the lower grates."
EP30:E12 26000-29800 CAMERA: Medium shot of Rupert looking down, nervously pulling at his black leather gloves as dread creeps over his face.
EP30:E13 26500-29200 RUPERT [Muttered, Paranoid]: "She knows the Duchess was poisoned."
EP30:E14 29800-32000 CAMERA: Tight close-up on the Elder Nobleman's unyielding eyes narrowing in cold calculation.
EP30:E15 32000-33400 CAMERA: Tight close-up of Rupert swallows hard, breathless with dread.
EP30:E16 32100-33300 RUPERT [Fearful]: "If she speaks..."
EP30:E17 33400-39800 CAMERA: Medium two-shot as the Elder Nobleman lunges forward aggressively, stepping into Rupert's personal space.
EP30:E18 33400-35200 ACTION: The Elder Nobleman thrusts the gold knob of his walking stick directly against Rupert's chest, pinning him against the wall.
EP30:E19 33600-39800 ELDER NOBLEMAN [Fierce, Venomous]: "Then make certain she isn't! A peasant weed, Rupert! You do not store weeds in your cellar, you burn them!"
EP30:E20 39800-43800 CAMERA: Low-angle close-up of Rupert gasping softly, intimidated by the cane pressed firmly beneath his cravat.
EP30:E21 41800-43500 RUPERT [Faltering, Submissive]: "What are you suggesting?"
EP30:E22 43800-47600 CAMERA: Medium shot as the Elder Nobleman withdraws his cane and turns sharply toward the library doors.
EP30:E23 44800-47300 ELDER NOBLEMAN [Calculated, Ominous]: "We stop hiding the prisoner."
SCENE sc_002 47600-144500 INT. CASTLE STUDY / LIBRARY – CONTINUOUS
EP30:E24 47600-51000 CAMERA: Tracking shot from behind the Elder Nobleman as he pushes open the heavy double doors into the dark wood-paneled library.
EP30:E25 48000-50500 SOUND: The heavy creak of massive mahogany doors gliding open on brass hinges.
EP30:E26 51000-54600 CAMERA: Front medium shot of the Elder Nobleman pausing inside the library doorway, Rupert following behind him.
EP30:E27 51200-54000 ELDER NOBLEMAN [Deadpan, Sinister]: "We give them a reason to condemn her."
EP30:E28 54600-58800 CAMERA: Wide shot of Catherine standing regally before the roaring stone hearth, dressed in an ornate burgundy and gold brocade gown, slowly unfurling a red lace fan.
EP30:E29 57000-58800 CATHERINE [Inquiring, Sharp]: "You have a solution?"
EP30:E30 58800-62800 CAMERA: Side profile close-up of the Elder Nobleman speaking with icy confidence.
EP30:E31 59400-62500 ELDER NOBLEMAN [Ruthless]: "We use the law to destroy her."
EP30:E32 62800-64800 CAMERA: Close-up of Rupert looking bewildered.
EP30:E33 63100-64300 RUPERT [Confused]: "The law?"
EP30:E34 64800-73500 CAMERA: Tracking medium shot as the Elder Nobleman paces slowly behind the massive mahogany desk lined with books and a glass of whiskey.
EP30:E35 65300-72800 ELDER NOBLEMAN [Pragmatic, Scheming]: "A maid with herbs in her possession, a secret medicine, an unauthorized visit to the Duchess's chamber."
EP30:E36 70800-73200 ACTION: The Elder Nobleman leans both hands against the desk, leaning forward intently.
EP30:E37 73500-74800 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Catherine fluttering her fan beneath her chin, smirking approvingly.
EP30:E38 74800-82800 CAMERA: Medium shot framing the Elder Nobleman seated at the desk beside Catherine standing in the firelight.
EP30:E39 75000-82500 ELDER NOBLEMAN [Cold, Calculating]: "Give those facts to a magistrate in the right order, and she becomes a poisoner."
EP30:E40 82800-85600 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Catherine gently moving her fan, raising an intrigued brow.
EP30:E41 83200-85400 CATHERINE [Curious, Conniving]: "And if she claims she is a healer?"
EP30:E42 85600-88500 CAMERA: Tight close-up of the Elder Nobleman's face illuminated by warm firelight.
EP30:E43 85800-87800 ELDER NOBLEMAN [Sinister]: "Then call it witchcraft."
EP30:E44 88500-91800 CAMERA: Close-up of Rupert wide-eyed with shock at the severity of the plan.
EP30:E45 89000-91300 RUPERT [Stunned]: "Witchcraft is a capital charge."
EP30:E46 91800-94500 CAMERA: Straight-on close-up of the Elder Nobleman staring back without a flicker of remorse.
EP30:E47 92000-93400 ELDER NOBLEMAN [Unflinching]: "Precisely."
EP30:E48 94500-101900 CAMERA: Medium three-shot framing Rupert, the Elder Nobleman between them, and Catherine listening closely.
EP30:E49 94600-101800 ELDER NOBLEMAN [Authoritative, Command]: "Do not hide the evidence, manufacture it. Drag her before the magistrate tomorrow, frame the trial, buy the jury, and let the State hang her."
EP30:E50 101900-104400 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine smiling with malicious satisfaction, fluttering her fan.
EP30:E51 102200-103900 CATHERINE [Scheming]: "Her botanical ledger..."
EP30:E52 104400-106600 CAMERA: Close-up of the Elder Nobleman nodding slowly.
EP30:E53 104800-106000 ELDER NOBLEMAN [Confirming]: "Exactly."
EP30:E54 106600-109000 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine leaning slightly forward.
EP30:E55 107300-108800 CATHERINE [Inquiring]: "And the Dowager?"
EP30:E56 109000-116800 CAMERA: Medium shot of the Elder Nobleman gesturing dismissively with one gloved hand.
EP30:E57 109500-116500 ELDER NOBLEMAN [Dismissive]: "She is weak, confused. No magistrate will trust a dying woman's accusations against a respected household."
EP30:E58 116800-121900 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Rupert exhaling deeply, processing the horrifying certainty of their conspiracy.
EP30:E59 120000-121500 RUPERT [Hesitant]: "And Juliana?"
EP30:E60 121900-125100 CAMERA: Medium close-up of the Elder Nobleman staring sternly across the desk.
EP30:E61 122400-124900 ELDER NOBLEMAN [Cold, Resolute]: "She goes before the magistrate tomorrow."
EP30:E62 125100-133500 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine beaming with venomous glee, spreading her red fan wide.
EP30:E63 125500-133000 CATHERINE [Cruel, Exultant]: "She will hang. A perfect solution. The town will cheer as the witch's disgraced daughter faces the noose."
EP30:E64 133500-136800 CAMERA: Medium shot of Rupert pulling out the desk chair and seating himself with dark resolve.
EP30:E65 134100-136200 RUPERT [Resolute, Vengeful]: "I will write the arrest warrant myself."
EP30:E66 136800-144500 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of the Elder Nobleman's weathered face, his eyes cold and predatory in the firelight.
EP30:E67 137500-143500 ELDER NOBLEMAN [Chilling, Decisive]: "Tomorrow, she stops being a prisoner. She becomes a witch."
SCENE sc_003 144500-151210 INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
EP30:E68 144500-148500 CAMERA: High-angle shot peering down through the heavy iron dungeon grate into the flooded, pitch-black subterranean wet cells where water drips continuously.
EP30:E69 144500-151210 SOUND: Echoing, hollow water droplets splashing into dark pools beneath stone vaults, accompanied by a somber orchestral swell.
EP30:E70 148500-151210 CAMERA: Low-angle medium shot pushing in on Juliana huddled against the wet stone wall, chained by the wrists, shivering in wet rags as faint moonlight filters down through the grate above.
EP30:E71 148500-151210 ACTION: Juliana clutches a rough burlap rag to her trembling chest, her tear-stained face lifting upward in dread and fragile hope as the frame holds, cutting abruptly to black.

messages.content:
EP=ep_031; timestamps are integer milliseconds
SOURCE_SHA256=7c7df240ef6ad40a87f2d5514d857e60273642fba4a5bbbd0da899a68e969610
METADATA ONLY (not on-screen evidence): {'logline': "Catherine enters the wet cells armed with a red-hot iron and Juliana's late mother's botanical book, subjecting the chained heiress to ruthless psychological torment until Juliana's unyielding pride pushes Catherine to a violent brink.", 'continuity_notes': 'Follows directly from Episode 30 where Rupert and Catherine plotted to frame Juliana as a witch while Juliana huddled chained in the subterranean dungeon.'}
SOURCE WARNINGS=['sc_001: incomplete source coverage; gaps are unavailable']
SCENE sc_001 0-160000 INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
EP31:E1 0-2800 CAMERA: Static medium shot of the heavy, iron-studded dungeon door as the massive bolt loudly slides open.
EP31:E2 0-2800 SOUND: Heavy iron latch sliding back with an ominous, echoing metallic clang, followed by the deep groaning creak of the cell door swinging inward.
EP31:E3 2800-4200 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana huddled against the stone wall, bound in heavy iron chains, shivering in her torn apron and lifting her tear-streaked face in dread.
EP31:E4 2800-4200 ACTION: Juliana recoils against the damp stonework, her eyes wide with terror as light floods into the dark cell.
EP31:E5 4200-9500 CAMERA: Full shot framed through the arched doorway. Catherine stands imperiously in an ornate, gold-embroidered violet gown, holding a smoldering hot poker and a charred leather-bound book, flanked by two stone-faced guards with lanterns.
EP31:E6 6900-8800 CATHERINE [Cruel, Condescending]: "Look at you."
EP31:E7 9500-10500 CAMERA: Low-angle close-up of Juliana looking up from the stone floor, her gaze hardening despite her fear.
EP31:E8 10500-13800 CAMERA: Tight close-up of Catherine's face, bathed in the orange flickering glow of the red-hot branding iron, smiling with pure malice.
EP31:E9 10500-13800 CATHERINE [Mocking, Venomous]: "The great Lady Juliana Ashcroft."
EP31:E10 13800-17600 CAMERA: Over-the-shoulder wide shot past Catherine looking down at Juliana shackled helplessly on the wet stone floor.
EP31:E11 14000-17600 CATHERINE [Taunting]: "Chained in a dungeon like a common criminal."
EP31:E12 17600-20800 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana, her eyes glistening with unshed tears, speaking with quiet defiance.
EP31:E13 17800-20500 JULIANA [Defiant, Steady]: "You seem very pleased."
EP31:E14 20800-24500 CAMERA: Low-angle shot looking up at Catherine towering over Juliana, holding the glowing poker at her side.
EP31:E15 21000-23500 CATHERINE [Smug, Chilling]: "I am."
EP31:E16 24500-29000 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of the bent, white-hot tip of the poker radiating heat, with Catherine's face blurred in the background as she gazes down with predatory pleasure.
EP31:E17 25000-28900 CATHERINE [Whispering, Sinister]: "Because this is what you were always meant to be."
EP31:E18 29000-34800 CAMERA: Over-the-shoulder medium shot focusing on Juliana as Catherine presents the charred, singed pages of the botanical book.
EP31:E19 29300-34800 CATHERINE [Scornful]: "Your family dressed you like a lady. They educated you. They gave you a respectable name."
EP31:E20 34800-39000 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine's face breaking into an arrogant, haughty laugh.
EP31:E21 35000-38900 CATHERINE [Amused, Spiteful]: "[chuckles] And still you became a disgrace."
EP31:E22 39000-43000 CAMERA: Tight close-up of Juliana's fierce, unwavering gaze as she retorts without hesitation.
EP31:E23 39200-43000 JULIANA [Fierce, Unbroken]: "I became a disgrace when I refused to become cruel."
EP31:E24 43000-48500 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine scowling, cutting back to a shot of Juliana's bare, chained feet locked in iron manacles against the cold stone floor.
EP31:E25 43200-48500 CATHERINE [Cold, Bitter]: "No. You became a disgrace when Gerald left you standing at the altar."
EP31:E26 48500-54800 CAMERA: Medium shot from floor level looking up at Catherine leaning closer, savoring Juliana's humiliation.
EP31:E27 48900-50800 CATHERINE [Gloating]: "Do you remember?"
EP31:E28 49000-52000 ACTION: Juliana stares up, her breathing steadying as she refuses to break under Catherine's barbs.
EP31:E29 51000-54800 CATHERINE [Viciously Delighted]: "Everyone saw you. Everyone watched him chose Clarisse."
EP31:E30 54800-59000 CAMERA: Close-up of the red-hot iron hovering over the damp stone floor, rising steam and heat waves warping the air, before cutting to Catherine's gloating expression.
EP31:E31 55200-57500 SOUND: Faint sizzling and hissing as ambient moisture touches the scalding iron tip.
EP31:E32 55500-58800 CATHERINE [Quietly Venomous]: "And everyone watched you walk away alone."
EP31:E33 59000-65500 CAMERA: Close-up pushing in on Juliana's illuminated, dignified face.
EP31:E34 59200-61300 JULIANA [Proud, Measured]: "Gerald chose money."
EP31:E35 61500-63500 JULIANA [Resolute]: "Clarissa chose a coward."
EP31:E36 63800-65300 JULIANA [Unyielding]: "I chose myself."
EP31:E37 65500-67500 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine's face tightening in disgust.
EP31:E38 65600-67400 CATHERINE [Disgusted]: "You chose a beggar."
EP31:E39 67500-70500 CAMERA: Low-angle shot of Juliana lifting her chin with unwavering pride.
EP31:E40 67600-69800 JULIANA [Fierce, Proud]: "I chose a man."
EP31:E41 70500-73300 CAMERA: Medium shot of Catherine sneering down at her.
EP31:E42 70800-73200 CATHERINE [Contemptuous]: "A scarred nobody."
EP31:E43 73300-77600 CAMERA: Medium shot of Juliana sitting erect against the dungeon wall, her hands resting calmly in her lap.
EP31:E44 73500-77600 JULIANA [Resolute, Dignified]: "A man with more honor than the people sitting above this dungeon."
EP31:E45 77600-80500 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Catherine, holding the smoldering iron between them.
EP31:E46 77800-80200 CATHERINE [Incredulous, Mocking]: "You call that marriage?"
EP31:E47 80500-83200 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Juliana's clear blue eyes, shining with profound conviction.
EP31:E48 80800-83200 JULIANA [Pure, Sincere]: "I call it love."
EP31:E49 83200-88000 CAMERA: High-angle wide shot looking straight down through the ceiling iron grating into the deep dungeon shaft where Catherine looms over Juliana.
EP31:E50 83500-87400 CATHERINE [Mocking, Hysterical Laugh]: "[laughs] Love? Look where your precious love brought you."
EP31:E51 87500-91200 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana looking directly up past the glowing tip of the iron poker into Catherine's eyes.
EP31:E52 87800-91200 JULIANA [Firm, Piercing]: "To a place where I can still look you in the eyes."
EP31:E53 91200-94200 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine, her lips curling in indignant disbelief.
EP31:E54 91400-94200 CATHERINE [Incredulous, Offended]: "You think love makes you better than me?"
EP31:E55 94200-98200 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana speaking calmly and razor-sharp.
EP31:E56 94500-98200 JULIANA [Calm, Cutting]: "No. But cruelty certainly doesn't make you better than me."
EP31:E57 98200-103500 CAMERA: Medium shot of Catherine sweeping her arm out, flaunting her aristocratic privilege and opulence.
EP31:E58 98500-103300 CATHERINE [Incensed, Boastful]: "I have beauty, money, family, status! What do you have?"
EP31:E59 103500-108800 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana, her expression serene and grounded in moral superiority.
EP31:E60 103700-108500 JULIANA [Quiet, Powerful]: "Knowledge. Love. And people who need me."
EP31:E61 108800-110500 CAMERA: Tight shot of Catherine's gloved hands holding Juliana's mother's partially burned botanical volume, 'The Virtues of Plants & Herbs'.
EP31:E62 110200-111400 CATHERINE [Sneering, Derisive]: "[scoffs] Peasants? People?"
EP31:E63 111500-118200 CAMERA: Medium shot of Catherine casually holding the ancient book while pacing slowly before Juliana.
EP31:E64 111600-118200 CATHERINE [Arrogant, Elitist]: "That is why you were born in the wrong world. Women like me are meant to be admired. Women like you are meant to serve."
EP31:E65 118200-122500 CAMERA: Tight close-up of Juliana's face, tilting her head with an insightful, knowing smirk.
EP31:E66 118400-122000 JULIANA [Piercing, Provocative]: "Then why are you so desperate to make me kneel?"
EP31:E67 122000-124000 ACTION: Catherine's smug expression freezes, her eyes widening in momentary shock and fury as the blow lands squarely.
EP31:E68 124000-130800 CAMERA: Low-angle medium shot of Juliana, her voice ringing clearly through the subterranean chamber.
EP31:E69 124200-130500 JULIANA [Accusatory, Commanding]: "If you were truly powerful, Catherine, you wouldn't need me to bow."
EP31:E70 130800-133000 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine completely losing control, her aristocratic facade shattering into sheer rage.
EP31:E71 131000-132800 CATHERINE [Enraged Scream]: "Enough!"
EP31:E72 133000-134500 CAMERA: Close-up of the red-hot poker pressing directly down into the delicate open pages of the botanical book.
EP31:E73 133200-134500 SOUND: Hiss of scorched parchment and curling white smoke rising as paper blackens under extreme heat.
EP31:E74 134500-138000 CAMERA: Medium two-shot. Catherine holds the smoldering book right before Juliana's face.
EP31:E75 134500-138000 CATHERINE [Hateful, Malicious]: "This pathetic book is the only thing you still have from your mother."
EP31:E76 138000-140500 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Juliana, her emotional composure breaking into pure grief and panic.
EP31:E77 138000-140500 ACTION: Tears spill rapidly down Juliana's cheeks as she reaches forward in vain, restrained by her heavy iron chains.
EP31:E78 138400-140400 JULIANA [Desperate, Weeping]: "[gasping] Give it back!"
EP31:E79 140500-143800 CAMERA: Low-angle shot of Catherine grinning with sadistic triumph, looking down at Juliana's despair.
EP31:E80 140700-143800 CATHERINE [Gloating, Sadistic]: "There. Finally. Something still hurts you."
EP31:E81 143800-145500 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana screaming out in absolute anguish.
EP31:E82 144000-145500 JULIANA [Screaming, Agonized]: "No!"
EP31:E83 145500-151200 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Catherine slowly driving the glowing branding tip into the spine of the open book, watching the embers consume the pages.
EP31:E84 145600-151200 CATHERINE [Vicious, Final]: "One flame, and your mother's life's work becomes ash."
EP31:E85 151200-155200 CAMERA: Low-angle medium shot. Catherine lowers the charred book and suddenly swings the glowing orange iron tip straight up toward Juliana's face.
EP31:E86 151500-155200 ACTION: Juliana recoils back against the hard dungeon wall, gasping for breath in raw terror as the searing iron stops inches from her eyes.
EP31:E87 155200-160000 CAMERA: Extreme macro close-up of Juliana's wide, trembling eye. The brilliant orange ember of the hot poker reflects clearly in the center of her pupil, holding on the terrifying cliffhanger before an abrupt cut.

EP=ep_032; timestamps are integer milliseconds
SOURCE_SHA256=e35aeb60acdaeebbbee43d680bf3c910d1b48a08c7c141a727cc0b8649b15b53
METADATA ONLY (not on-screen evidence): {'logline': "Cornered and chained in the damp dungeon, Juliana shatters Catherine's cruelty with unshakeable dignity and the truth about love and worth, driving Catherine into a murderous fury.", 'continuity_notes': "Picks up immediately from Episode 31's cliffhanger where Catherine used a glowing branding iron to scorch Juliana's mother's herbal book."}
SOURCE WARNINGS=[]
SCENE sc_001 0-154380 INT. DUNGEON CELLS – CONTINUOUS
EP32:E1 0-3000 CAMERA: Close-up on the open botanical ledger lying on the wet stone floor as the glowing red branding tip sizzles against the delicate parchment.
EP32:E2 0-2800 SOUND: Sizzling, crackling sound of scorched parchment paper.
EP32:E3 3000-4500 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana, chained against the brick wall, tears glistening on her cheeks as she trembles in grief.
EP32:E4 3800-5200 CATHERINE [Mocking, Savoring]: "There it is."
EP32:E5 4500-7500 CAMERA: Low-angle medium shot of Catherine in her opulent velvet gown, clutching the hot poker with a sadistic sneer.
EP32:E6 7500-9200 CATHERINE [Whispering, Venomous]: "Fear."
EP32:E7 7500-10500 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine leaning slightly forward over the burning book, eyes glittering with malice.
EP32:E8 9800-13200 CATHERINE [Taunting]: "You have been so proud of that brave little face..."
EP32:E9 10500-13500 CAMERA: Wide shot showing Juliana chained against the cold dungeon wall, small and restrained beneath Catherine's towering shadow.
EP32:E10 13400-15800 CATHERINE [Smug, Dominant]: "...but now you are afraid."
EP32:E11 13500-16000 CAMERA: Medium shot of Catherine straightening up haughtily.
EP32:E12 16000-17000 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Juliana, her lips trembling in agonizing sorrow.
EP32:E13 16200-18800 CATHERINE [Cruel, Final]: "Say goodbye to your mother."
EP32:E14 17000-19000 CAMERA: Low-angle shot of Catherine swinging the flaming orange iron upward from the book.
EP32:E15 18800-20500 ACTION: Juliana's despair suddenly solidifies. Her jaw tightens, tears stopping as resolve takes over.
EP32:E16 19000-20500 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana looking up directly at Catherine, fear replaced by cold conviction.
EP32:E17 20200-22000 JULIANA [Defiant, Unbroken]: "Burn it."
EP32:E18 20500-23000 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana, sitting upright despite her heavy iron shackles.
EP32:E19 23000-25500 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine, her smug expression abruptly flickering with startled confusion.
EP32:E20 23800-24800 CATHERINE [Disconcerted]: "What?"
EP32:E21 25500-28500 CAMERA: Low-angle close-up of Juliana staring straight up into Catherine's eyes without flinching.
EP32:E22 25800-28800 JULIANA [Firm, Resolute]: "Burn the ledger. Burn every page."
EP32:E23 28500-30800 CAMERA: Wide shot of the wet dungeon floor, guards stationed by the heavy iron doorway in the background as Catherine holds the hot brand.
EP32:E24 29800-32800 JULIANA [Steely, Proud]: "You may destroy the book..."
EP32:E25 30800-33500 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine's face darkening with irritation.
EP32:E26 33500-36500 CAMERA: Medium low-angle shot of Juliana sitting amidst chains beneath the barred ceiling grate.
EP32:E27 33200-36200 JULIANA [Transcendent, Defiant]: "...you cannot destroy what my mother taught me."
EP32:E28 36400-38800 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine leaning down aggressively into Juliana's space, trembling with offended rage.
EP32:E29 36400-39100 CATHERINE [Spiteful, Hissing]: "You think a few herbs make you better than me?"
EP32:E30 38800-41000 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana looking steadily up into Catherine's furious glare.
EP32:E31 39200-42800 JULIANA [Calm, Cutting]: "No. Your cruelty does that for me."
EP32:E32 41000-43500 CAMERA: High-angle over-the-shoulder shot looking down at Juliana bound in heavy chains on the damp floor.
EP32:E33 43500-45500 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Catherine, baring her teeth in outrage.
EP32:E34 43400-45400 CATHERINE [Furious, Shouting]: "You still think you are better?!"
EP32:E35 45500-47800 CAMERA: Medium shot of Juliana, her chained hands clasped together in her lap.
EP32:E36 45600-47400 JULIANA [Serene, Grounded]: "I know what I am."
EP32:E37 47800-49000 CAMERA: Medium shot of Catherine scoffing with forced, derisive laughter.
EP32:E38 47800-49000 CATHERINE [Sneering, Mocking]: "A disgraced woman?"
EP32:E39 49000-52500 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana speaking with undeniable strength.
EP32:E40 49200-52400 JULIANA [Unwavering]: "A woman who survived. You cannot destroy me."
EP32:E41 52500-54400 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine brandishing the glowing tong in Juliana's face, spittle flying from her lips.
EP32:E42 52800-54200 CATHERINE [Screaming, Enraged]: "You are lying!"
EP32:E43 54400-58000 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana looking straight up, voice steady and clear.
EP32:E44 54600-58000 JULIANA [Measured, Emphatic]: "Gerald leaving me was the best thing he ever did for me."
EP32:E45 58000-60800 CAMERA: Full shot of the dungeon cell. Catherine stands rigidly tall while Juliana sits shackled on the ground.
EP32:E46 58200-61000 JULIANA [Contemplative, Scathing]: "He wanted a woman who looked beautiful beside his wealth."
EP32:E47 60800-64500 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Juliana's expressive blue eyes and tear-stained cheek.
EP32:E48 61100-66800 JULIANA [Passionate, Clear]: "He wanted a wife whose family could raise his name. He measured a woman's worth by what she could give him."
EP32:E49 64500-67000 CAMERA: Low-angle shot of Juliana leaning slightly forward against her chains.
EP32:E50 67000-69000 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine staring down, her eyes widening as Juliana's words pierce her facade.
EP32:E51 67200-68900 JULIANA [Unapologetic, Victorious]: "Let him have Clarissa."
EP32:E52 69000-71200 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana smiling with genuine liberation.
EP32:E53 69600-71200 JULIANA [Proud]: "He lost me."
EP32:E54 71200-73300 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Catherine's face contorting in sheer fury.
EP32:E55 71300-73200 CATHERINE [Shrieking, Vicious]: "You were rejected!"
EP32:E56 73300-75500 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana's calm, resolute face.
EP32:E57 73400-77600 JULIANA [Grounded, Powerful]: "I was freed. And I found a man who never asked me what I was worth."
EP32:E58 75500-77500 CAMERA: Wide shot of the cell, steam rising faintly in the cold subterranean air.
EP32:E59 77500-80000 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine sneering with dripping condescension.
EP32:E60 77800-79400 CATHERINE [Disdainful]: "Your soldier?"
EP32:E61 80000-82500 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana, her eyes glowing with genuine devotion.
EP32:E62 80200-82000 JULIANA [Tender, Certain]: "My husband."
EP32:E63 82500-84100 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine scowling with deep disgust.
EP32:E64 82500-84000 CATHERINE [Bitter]: "He is a nobody."
EP32:E65 84100-86500 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana smiling softly, totally untroubled.
EP32:E66 84200-86200 JULIANA [Warm, Defiant]: "Then I love a nobody."
EP32:E67 86500-89800 CAMERA: Low-angle shot focusing on Juliana's bare, chained feet locked in iron on the stone floor.
EP32:E68 86500-90200 JULIANA [Resonant, Moving]: "Because that nobody showed me more love than your entire world ever did."
EP32:E69 89800-92800 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Catherine gripping the branding rod tighter, her upper lip curling in fury.
EP32:E70 90100-92600 CATHERINE [Indignant, Sharp]: "You know nothing about my world."
EP32:E71 92800-97000 CAMERA: Medium shot of Juliana sitting in her tattered apron and chains, looking composed.
EP32:E72 93200-96600 JULIANA [Knowing, Sober]: "I know exactly what your world values."
EP32:E73 97000-99800 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Juliana's lips and eyes as she lists them with chilling precision.
EP32:E74 97600-99600 JULIANA [Listing, Deliberate]: "Beauty. Money."
EP32:E75 99800-101000 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Catherine's wide, stunned eyes reacting to the naked truth.
EP32:E76 101000-103700 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana looking up unflinchingly.
EP32:E77 101200-103500 JULIANA [Firm]: "Family. A perfect name."
EP32:E78 103700-107000 CAMERA: Low-angle shot of Catherine standing rigid in her gold and purple gown, the guard standing sentinel behind her.
EP32:E79 103800-107200 JULIANA [Continuing]: "And a woman who never embarrasses the people standing behind her."
EP32:E80 107000-108800 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine throwing her hands up in explosive defensiveness.
EP32:E81 107200-108800 CATHERINE [Shouting, Outraged]: "And what is wrong with that?!"
EP32:E82 108800-109400 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine's face twisting in absolute venom.
EP32:E83 109400-112500 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana looking serene.
EP32:E84 109500-112800 JULIANA [Gentle, Penetrating]: "Nothing. Until you have nothing left beneath it."
EP32:E85 112500-116000 CAMERA: Medium shot of Catherine standing motionless, holding the iron rod, struck to the core by the insult.
EP32:E86 112800-116000 JULIANA [Unrelenting]: "You have spent your whole life collecting things that make people bow..."
EP32:E87 116000-116800 CAMERA: Low-angle shot of Juliana's chained hands folded peacefully in her lap.
EP32:E88 116800-119500 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana looking up with quiet pity.
EP32:E89 116900-119500 JULIANA [Piercing]: "...but you have never learned how to make anyone love you."
EP32:E90 119500-121800 CAMERA: Medium shot of Catherine snapping entirely, raising the branding poker like a weapon and screaming.
EP32:E91 119600-121800 CATHERINE [Hysterical, Screaming]: "Silence! Silence!"
EP32:E92 121800-123000 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine's crazed, gasping face.
EP32:E93 121800-122800 CATHERINE [Shrieking]: "Why?!"
EP32:E94 122800-125000 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana crying out her defiance.
EP32:E95 123000-125200 JULIANA [Forceful]: "Because I am right!"
EP32:E96 125000-128500 CAMERA: Low-angle tracking shot of the red-hot branding tip trailing across the wet dungeon floor, steaming.
EP32:E97 125400-128800 JULIANA [Scathing, Direct]: "You want everyone to believe you are powerful."
EP32:E98 128500-131800 CAMERA: Medium shot of Juliana sitting under the cold skylight bars, her posture majestic despite her imprisonment.
EP32:E99 129000-131600 JULIANA [Continuing]: "You want everyone to fear you."
EP32:E100 131800-134800 CAMERA: Medium shot of Juliana looking directly at Catherine, gestures restrained by the heavy iron chains.
EP32:E101 132000-134000 JULIANA [Mocking, Direct]: "But look at you."
EP32:E102 134800-138500 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana, her eyes burning with fiery contempt.
EP32:E103 135000-138600 JULIANA [Stripping Her Bare]: "You have to threaten a chained woman to feel powerful!"
EP32:E104 138500-140400 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine trembling with uncontrollable rage, teeth bared.
EP32:E105 138600-140200 CATHERINE [Choking with Rage]: "You insolent—!"
EP32:E106 140400-142400 CAMERA: Medium shot of Catherine gripping the glowing tongs as Juliana continues speaking over her.
EP32:E107 140400-142300 JULIANA [Steely, Triumphant]: "You may have the title you have always wanted..."
EP32:E108 142400-146500 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana delivering the final emotional blow.
EP32:E109 142400-146500 JULIANA [Final, Condemning]: "...but you will never have the courage to earn what you demand from everyone else."
EP32:E110 146500-148000 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine's face twitching with sheer murderous madness.
EP32:E111 146600-148100 CATHERINE [Enraged, Shouting]: "You think you can lecture me?!"
EP32:E112 148000-150800 CAMERA: Medium shot of Catherine raising the branding iron high above her head with both hands.
EP32:E113 148000-150800 ACTION: Catherine hoists the searing branding rod over Juliana with frantic fury.
EP32:E114 148100-151200 CATHERINE [Screaming, Maniacal]: "Then let's see how brave you are when it touches your skin!"
EP32:E115 150800-152000 CAMERA: Medium shot of Catherine plunging the glowing orange poker straight toward Juliana's face.
EP32:E116 151200-154380 ACTION: Juliana gasps, freezing as the glowing tip of the iron thrusts forward, stopping mere millimeters from her right eye.
EP32:E117 152000-154380 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Juliana's wide, unblinking blue eye. The intense, fiery orange glow of the iron poker radiates inches from her cornea, holding on the heart-stopping cliffhanger as the frame cuts to black.

EP=ep_033; timestamps are integer milliseconds
SOURCE_SHA256=0012ba24a8fa997a1df93165c06c90dacf5bab6c76ceef791533e8747aec4ad6
METADATA ONLY (not on-screen evidence): {'logline': 'Under cruel coercion and threats to send her seven-year-old brother to the county gaol, a young maid is manipulated into giving false testimony framing Juliana for witchcraft.', 'continuity_notes': "Following Catherine's dungeon interrogation of Juliana, the conspiracy against Juliana deepens as an aristocratic lord forces a testimony of witchcraft out of the young maid whose brother Juliana saved."}
SOURCE WARNINGS=[]
SCENE sc_001 0-174040 INT. STUDY – NIGHT
EP33:E1 0-5200 CAMERA: Wide shot of a dimly lit, wood-paneled library study. An aristocratic lord in formal dark attire stands facing a young maid standing nervously by the open door.
EP33:E2 2500-4800 LORD [Cold, Authoritative]: "Your brother is breathing again."
EP33:E3 4000-6500 ACTION: The young maid steps inside, bowing with a submissive curtsy, keeping her head low and hands clasped.
EP33:E4 5200-8800 CAMERA: Medium close-up of the maid trembling as she raises her eyes hesitantly.
EP33:E5 6500-8500 MAID [Meek, Hesitant]: "Yes, my Lord."
EP33:E6 8800-12000 CAMERA: Medium shot of the Lord standing beside his mahogany desk, looking down with cold, calculating scrutiny.
EP33:E7 9500-11800 LORD [Probing]: "And who saved him?"
EP33:E8 12000-14800 CAMERA: Close-up of the maid's anxious, innocent face.
EP33:E9 13000-14500 MAID [Quiet, Truthful]: "Lady Juliana."
EP33:E10 14800-17800 CAMERA: Close-up of the Lord's hand slowly rotating the heavy gold signet ring on his pinky finger.
EP33:E11 15500-17500 LORD [Measured, Demanding]: "Tell me how."
EP33:E12 17800-21000 CAMERA: Medium close-up of the maid nervously wringing her apron fabric.
EP33:E13 19500-21000 MAID [Faltering]: "She... she used herbs."
EP33:E14 21000-23000 CAMERA: Close-up on the Lord leaning forward abruptly, his piercing gaze bearing down.
EP33:E15 21200-22800 LORD [Sharp, Intimidating]: "What herbs?"
EP33:E16 23000-26500 CAMERA: Close-up of the frightened maid looking down, shrinking back.
EP33:E17 24500-26200 MAID [Whispering, Nervous]: "I don't know."
EP33:E18 26500-29200 CAMERA: Low-angle shot looking up at the imposing Lord towering above her.
EP33:E19 27500-29000 LORD [Stern]: "You watched her."
EP33:E20 29200-32800 CAMERA: Close-up of the maid, tears beginning to glisten on her cheeks as she defends Juliana.
EP33:E21 29800-32000 MAID [Tearful, Sincere]: "I watched her save him."
EP33:E22 32800-36500 CAMERA: Medium tracking shot of the Lord turning away slowly past the lamp-lit desk toward the rain-streaked window.
EP33:E23 34000-36200 LORD [Coldly Dismissive]: "That is not what I asked."
EP33:E24 36500-40200 CAMERA: Medium two-shot framing the maid from behind as the Lord steps back toward her with commanding stillness.
EP33:E25 37500-40000 LORD [Accusatory]: "Did she use her mother's book?"
EP33:E26 40200-44200 CAMERA: Close-up of the maid trembling, tears spilling down her face.
EP33:E27 42200-43600 MAID [Quietly Weeping]: "Yes."
EP33:E28 44200-49200 CAMERA: Close-up of the Lord's sinister, unyielding face.
EP33:E29 44800-48800 LORD [Insistent, Cornering]: "Did she prepare things no physician had prescribed?"
EP33:E30 49200-52500 CAMERA: Medium shot of the maid clutching her hands together tightly, overwhelmed with guilt.
EP33:E31 50000-51600 MAID [Choked Sob]: "Yes."
EP33:E32 52500-56800 CAMERA: Close-up of the Lord's mouth curling into a sinister, predatory smile.
EP33:E33 53000-56500 LORD [Sly, Sinister]: "And did she perform anything unusual?"
EP33:E34 56800-59000 CAMERA: Close-up of the maid gasping, shaking her head vigorously in panic.
EP33:E35 57400-58800 MAID [Desperate, Denying]: "No!"
EP33:E36 59000-64200 CAMERA: Profile medium two-shot as the Lord looms inches from the maid's face.
EP33:E37 59000-61000 LORD [Low, Menacing]: "Think carefully."
EP33:E38 61200-63500 LORD [Ruthless]: "Your brother is still a pauper."
EP33:E39 64200-68800 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of the Lord's cold eyes and hawkish profile speaking with chilling finality.
EP33:E40 64400-68500 LORD [Threatening]: "One word from me, and the county gaol will take him before sunrise."
EP33:E41 68500-70000 ACTION: The maid gasps in sheer terror, her chest heaving as tears stream.
EP33:E42 68800-73200 CAMERA: Close-up of the maid clutching her chest with trembling hands, crying desperately.
EP33:E43 69500-73000 MAID [Begging, Heartbroken]: "Please, my Lord... he is only seven!"
EP33:E44 73200-75500 CAMERA: Close-up of the Lord staring down without an ounce of pity.
EP33:E45 73200-75000 LORD [Cold, Unwavering]: "Then help him."
EP33:E46 75500-79500 CAMERA: Close-up of the maid weeping profusely, cornered and helpless.
EP33:E47 76800-79000 MAID [Crying, Shattered]: "What do you want me to say?!"
EP33:E48 79500-84800 CAMERA: Wide shot of the study as the Lord stands calmly before the trembling servant.
EP33:E49 79600-80500 LORD [Deceptive]: "The truth."
EP33:E50 81000-84500 LORD [Leading, Deliberate]: "She drew something around the bed, did she not?"
EP33:E51 84800-89000 CAMERA: Close-up of the maid stammering through her tears.
EP33:E52 85500-88800 MAID [Trembling, Reluctant]: "She... placed dried herbs around him."
EP33:E53 89000-94800 CAMERA: Medium close-up of the Lord standing right beside her shoulder, whispering in her ear like an insidious specter.
EP33:E54 89000-90500 LORD [Hypnotic, Coercive]: "Around him."
EP33:E55 91000-92500 LORD [Coercive]: "Like a circle?"
EP33:E56 93000-94500 MAID [Faint, Defeated]: "Yes."
EP33:E57 94800-98500 CAMERA: Close-up from behind the maid as the Lord leans close to her ear.
EP33:E58 95000-98000 LORD [Whispering, Trap Snapping]: "And she opened her mother's book..."
EP33:E59 98500-100800 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of the maid's tear-drenched eyes and quivering lips.
EP33:E60 98500-100000 MAID [Sobbing]: "Yes."
EP33:E61 100800-104200 CAMERA: Close-up of the Lord delivering the final trap.
EP33:E62 101000-104000 LORD [Sinister]: "...and spoke words you could not understand."
EP33:E63 104200-107500 CAMERA: Close-up of the maid gasping out in desperate agony.
EP33:E64 104500-106500 MAID [Desperately Defending]: "She was praying!"
EP33:E65 107500-111800 CAMERA: Close-up of the Lord grinning with sinister triumph.
EP33:E66 108000-111500 LORD [Taunting]: "Praying... or chanting?"
EP33:E67 111800-113800 CAMERA: Close-up of the maid breaking down completely.
EP33:E68 112000-113500 MAID [Hysterically Sobbing]: "I don't know!"
EP33:E69 113800-119500 CAMERA: Medium shot as the Lord paces slowly, pointing his finger with clinical, legal precision.
EP33:E70 114000-116500 LORD [Calculating, Relentless]: "You saw a woman draw a circle of herbs."
EP33:E71 116800-119500 LORD [Relentless]: "You saw her use a forbidden book."
EP33:E72 119500-123500 CAMERA: Close-up profile of the Lord leaning in right in front of the sobbing maid.
EP33:E73 119800-122800 LORD [Condemning]: "You heard words you could not understand."
EP33:E74 123500-126800 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of the Lord's mouth and calculating eyes as he pronounces the lethal word.
EP33:E75 124500-126500 LORD [Deadly, Resolute]: "That is witchcraft."
EP33:E76 126800-131800 CAMERA: Medium two-shot as the maid steps forward, pleading passionately against his chest.
EP33:E77 126800-131500 MAID [Crying Out, Desperate]: "No! She saved Toby! She made him breathe again!"
EP33:E78 131800-134500 CAMERA: Close-up of the Lord calmly watching her futile resistance.
EP33:E79 132000-134000 LORD [Cold, Final]: "That will be your testimony."
EP33:E80 134500-137800 CAMERA: Close-up of the maid's face frozen in horrified realization.
EP33:E81 134500-137000 MAID [Gasping, Shocked]: "My testimony?!"
EP33:E82 137800-140500 CAMERA: Close-up of the Lord delivering the ultimatum without blinking.
EP33:E83 138000-140000 LORD [Unyielding]: "Before the magistrate."
EP33:E84 140500-144800 CAMERA: Close-up of the maid grabbing both sides of her head, screaming out in utter grief and guilt.
EP33:E85 140500-144000 MAID [Wailing, Tormented]: "I never said she was a witch!"
EP33:E86 144800-149200 CAMERA: Medium tracking shot of the Lord turning his back and walking back behind his desk.
EP33:E87 145000-146500 LORD [Chillingly Detached]: "You do not need to."
EP33:E88 146800-149000 LORD [Chillingly Detached]: "I have already written the story for you."
EP33:E89 149200-152200 CAMERA: Close-up of the maid clutching her cheeks, crying in heartbreak.
EP33:E90 149500-152000 MAID [Sobbing]: "She saved my brother..."
EP33:E91 152200-156200 CAMERA: Close-up of the Lord turning back, resting one hand upon the desk with cold finality.
EP33:E92 152500-156000 LORD [Inexorable]: "And now... you will save your brother."
EP33:E93 156200-159500 ACTION: The maid's knees buckle completely. She collapses forward onto the polished dark wood floor, groveling in total despair.
EP33:E94 156200-159500 CAMERA: High angle looking down as the maid falls prostrate on the floor.
EP33:E95 159000-161500 MAID [Weeping, Broken]: "I am sorry, Lady Juliana..."
EP33:E96 159500-163800 CAMERA: Low-angle shot of the Lord looking down dismissively at the prostrate maid.
EP33:E97 161800-164500 LORD [Cold, Merciless]: "Save your tears for the trial."
EP33:E98 163800-174040 CAMERA: Side medium shot of the maid kneeling crumpled on the floor in the dimly lit study, her face buried in both hands, weeping uncontrollably as the scene slowly fades into the dark silence.
EP33:E99 164500-174040 ACTION: The heartbroken maid weeps silently in the shadow of the desk, consumed by guilt and powerlessness.
