SCENE sc_001 0-190000 INT. COURTROOM – DAY
EP34:E1 0-2800 CAMERA: High wide establishing shot from behind the presiding judge looking down into the grand, sunlit courtroom filled with stern spectators, armed bailiffs, and Lady Juliana standing confined in the wooden prisoner's dock on the left.
EP34:E2 1200-7800 JUDGE [Booming, Authoritative]: "Lady Juliana Ashcroft, you are accused of witchcraft, unlawful healing, and poisoning."
EP34:E3 2800-7800 CAMERA: Medium close-up of the stern, elderly Judge seated at the high mahogany bench, resting both hands on the court documents.
EP34:E4 7800-13100 CAMERA: Close-up of the charred, ancient botanical grimoire resting on the bench, its scorched pages open to an illustration of a wild rose, as a finger firmly taps the text.
EP34:E5 9000-11200 SOUND: [A firm, hollow tap of a finger striking the parchment]
EP34:E6 9100-12600 JUDGE [O.S.) (Inquisitive, Severe]: "Do you deny possessing this book?"
EP34:E7 13100-15500 CAMERA: Low-angle medium close-up of Lady Juliana standing erect in the dock, her prisoner label pinned to her rustic buttoned gown, her expression resolute.
EP34:E8 13800-14800 LADY JULIANA [Calm, Unflinching]: "No."
EP34:E9 15500-19400 CAMERA: Low-angle medium shot of the Judge leaning over his elevated bench, staring down critically.
EP34:E10 15600-19200 JUDGE [Stern, Accusatory]: "Do you deny using its remedies?"
EP34:E11 19400-23800 CAMERA: Tight close-up of Lady Juliana's face, bruised cheekbone highlighting her calm defiance.
EP34:E12 20800-21800 LADY JULIANA [Firm]: "No."
EP34:E13 23800-27400 CAMERA: Medium shot of the aristocratic Lord standing at the railing in his tailored dark coat, turning slowly with a smirk of malicious satisfaction.
EP34:E14 27400-31700 CAMERA: Close-up of the Judge leaning forward across his bench, eyes narrowing with grim conviction.
EP34:E15 27500-31200 JUDGE [Hard, Pressing]: "Then you admit to practicing forbidden arts."
EP34:E16 31700-35300 CAMERA: Close-up of Lady Juliana looking upward with quiet dignity, her eyes luminous.
EP34:E17 33200-35100 LADY JULIANA [Proud, Dignified]: "I admit to healing the sick."
EP34:E18 35300-37400 ACTION: The Judge furiously raises his wooden gavel and strikes the sound block with sharp force.
EP34:E19 35400-36600 JUDGE [Furious, Shouting]: "Silence!"
EP34:E20 35800-37000 SOUND: [Sharp, echoing crack of the gavel slamming onto wood]
EP34:E21 35800-37400 CAMERA: Medium shot of the Judge slamming the gavel down on his bench.
EP34:E22 37400-42500 CAMERA: Tracking shot moving from the Judge on his bench as he points his outstretched arm across the courtroom floor toward the witness stand.
EP34:E23 37500-41200 JUDGE [Commanding]: "Prudence. You served beside the accused?"
EP34:E24 41000-43000 ACTION: Prudence the young maid stands trembling in the center of the courtroom floor, her head bowed in deep shame, clutching the sides of her apron.
EP34:E25 42500-44800 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Prudence looking up with tears streaming down her pale face.
EP34:E26 43200-44600 PRUDENCE [Trembling, Tearful]: "Yes, Your Honor."
EP34:E27 44800-49000 CAMERA: Medium close-up of the Judge leaning forward with folded hands.
EP34:E28 45300-48800 JUDGE [Probing, Formal]: "Did you witness Lady Juliana perform these treatments?"
EP34:E29 49000-51500 CAMERA: Profile over-the-shoulder shot from behind Prudence toward Lady Juliana standing bound in iron cuffs at the prisoner's dock.
EP34:E30 49100-50500 LADY JULIANA [Softly, Urgent]: "Tell the truth."
EP34:E31 51500-54800 CAMERA: Close-up of Prudence breaking down in tears, squeezing her eyes shut as guilt overwhelms her.
EP34:E32 53000-54200 PRUDENCE [Sobbing, Heartbroken]: "Yes."
EP34:E33 54800-57600 CAMERA: Close-up of Lady Juliana looking at her former maid, a momentary flicker of hurt passing through her eyes before settling into stoic composure.
EP34:E34 57600-60800 CAMERA: Medium profile shot of the Judge recording notes in the open court ledger with a feather quill.
EP34:E35 58200-60100 JUDGE [Measured, Stern]: "What did you see?"
EP34:E36 60800-64600 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Prudence clutching both hands to her chest in anguish.
EP34:E37 61300-64400 PRUDENCE [Choked with Tears]: "She used herbs... and her mother's book."
EP34:E38 64600-66800 CAMERA: Medium shot of the Judge leaning back slightly, pointing his hand accusingly.
EP34:E39 64800-66700 JUDGE [Pressing, Sharp]: "Did she draw strange markings?"
EP34:E40 66800-71800 CAMERA: Close-up of Prudence's tear-streaked face as she hesitates, her breath hitching.
EP34:E41 68200-71700 PRUDENCE [Faltering, Desperate]: "She... placed herbs around my brother's bed."
EP34:E42 71800-75800 CAMERA: Medium shot of the Judge pointing an outstretched index finger with piercing intensity.
EP34:E43 72100-75500 JUDGE [Accusatory, Forceful]: "And did she speak words you could not understand?"
EP34:E44 75800-81000 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Prudence weeping uncontrollably, her face contorted in unbearable remorse.
EP34:E45 78800-80500 PRUDENCE [Weeping, Shaken]: "Yes."
EP34:E46 81000-85200 CAMERA: Medium tracking shot of the Lord stepping into the open aisle of the courtroom with arms spread wide, turning triumphantly toward the Judge.
EP34:E47 81300-84900 LORD [Triumphant, Smug]: "Your Honor... the witness has confirmed the ritual."
EP34:E48 85000-87200 ACTION: Lady Juliana slams her cuffed hands against the wooden railing of the dock, her voice ringing out in indignant fury.
EP34:E49 85200-87400 CAMERA: Low-angle medium shot of Lady Juliana gripping the railing, leaning forward.
EP34:E50 85200-87200 LADY JULIANA [Passionate, Indignant]: "It was not a ritual!"
EP34:E51 87200-90200 ACTION: The Judge repeatedly hammers his gavel down onto the desk, roaring over her.
EP34:E52 87400-90500 CAMERA: Medium shot of the Judge striking the wooden block twice in rapid succession.
EP34:E53 87800-89200 SOUND: [Violent, resonant double bang of the wooden gavel]
EP34:E54 87900-90000 JUDGE [Bellowing]: "You will speak when addressed!"
EP34:E55 90500-93800 CAMERA: Medium shot of the Lord extending his palm toward the gallery with theatrical composure.
EP34:E56 91000-93200 LORD [Calm, Poisonous]: "We have further witnesses."
EP34:E57 93800-98200 CAMERA: Medium shot of an anxious townsman standing by the gallery pews, nervously wringing his woolen hat in his hands.
EP34:E58 94200-98000 TOWNSMAN [Nervous, Fearful]: "My wife took one of Lady Juliana's mixtures..."
EP34:E59 98200-99500 CAMERA: Close-up of the Judge glaring down expectantly.
EP34:E60 98300-99100 JUDGE [Sharp]: "And?"
EP34:E61 99500-102100 CAMERA: Close-up of the townsman's face tightening with coached distress.
EP34:E62 99800-101800 TOWNSMAN [Agitated]: "She became violently ill."
EP34:E63 102100-107300 CAMERA: Medium shot among the spectators as an elderly peasant woman stands up from the wooden bench, pointing an accusatory finger across the courtroom.
EP34:E64 102300-107000 OLD WOMAN [Shrill, Accusatory]: "My daughter drank one of her herbal preparations! She was sick for three days!"
EP34:E65 107300-110000 CAMERA: Side two-shot of the Lord stepping up to the dock, looming beside Lady Juliana as she looks him in the eye.
EP34:E66 108000-109800 LORD [Mocking, Smug]: "She calls it healing."
EP34:E67 110000-112800 ACTION: The Lord turns dramatically to face the entire assembly, gesturing toward the spectators.
EP34:E68 110000-112800 CAMERA: Medium shot of the Lord addressing the courtroom.
EP34:E69 110100-112600 LORD [Resonant, Vindicative]: "The people call it poisoning!"
EP34:E70 112800-115200 CAMERA: Close-up of Lady Juliana looking past him directly toward the gallery with sharp clarity.
EP34:E71 113200-115000 LADY JULIANA [Incisive, Defiant]: "What were their illnesses?"
EP34:E72 115200-117200 CAMERA: Low-angle close-up of the Lord looking down arrogantly over his shoulder.
EP34:E73 115300-116500 LORD [Dismissive]: "Irrelevant."
EP34:E74 117200-119800 CAMERA: Close-up of Lady Juliana gritting her teeth in fierce defiance.
EP34:E75 117400-119600 LADY JULIANA [Fierce]: "It is not irrelevant!"
EP34:E76 119800-123400 CAMERA: Low-angle medium shot of Lady Juliana standing tall against the courtroom window light, her chained hands resting on the balustrade as she addresses the entire hall.
EP34:E77 119900-123200 LADY JULIANA [Clear, Unyielding]: "Herbs are not magic! They are medicine!"
EP34:E78 123400-126800 CAMERA: Medium shot of the Judge sitting with steepled fingers upon his high bench.
EP34:E79 123600-126400 JUDGE [Coldly Inquisitive]: "You admit you administered them?"
EP34:E80 126800-129100 CAMERA: Close-up of Lady Juliana looking straight forward.
EP34:E81 127200-128200 LADY JULIANA [Direct]: "Yes."
EP34:E82 129100-131800 CAMERA: Medium shot of the Judge gesturing with an open hand.
EP34:E83 129300-131600 JUDGE [Challenging]: "Without the approval of a licensed physician?"
EP34:E84 131800-134600 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Lady Juliana shaking her head slightly, truth ringing in her voice.
EP34:E85 132100-134400 LADY JULIANA [Steely, Earnest]: "There was no physician willing to help them."
EP34:E86 134600-139200 CAMERA: Close-up of Lady Juliana's steady gaze.
EP34:E87 136200-138400 LADY JULIANA [Calm, Resolute]: "So I helped them."
EP34:E88 139200-142200 CAMERA: Medium close-up of the Lord smiling cynically as he turns back toward the magistrate.
EP34:E89 139600-142000 LORD [Derisive]: "Even now, she refuses to repent."
EP34:E90 142200-147400 CAMERA: Low-angle medium shot of the Judge holding his hand over the open law book.
EP34:E91 142400-147000 JUDGE [Grave, Stern]: "Lady Juliana, if you wish to save yourself, renounce these practices."
EP34:E92 147400-148900 CAMERA: Close-up of the burned grimoire resting on the green leather surface of the court table.
EP34:E93 148900-151200 CAMERA: Close-up of Lady Juliana lifting her chin without an ounce of hesitation.
EP34:E94 149800-150800 LADY JULIANA [Unyielding]: "No."
EP34:E95 151200-154800 CAMERA: Medium shot of the Judge lowering his brow with dark finality.
EP34:E96 151800-153800 JUDGE [Ominous, Warning]: "Think carefully."
EP34:E97 154800-156800 CAMERA: Low-angle close-up of Lady Juliana looking skyward through the arched court windows.
EP34:E98 155200-156400 LADY JULIANA [Firm, Resolute]: "I have."
EP34:E99 156800-162000 CAMERA: Medium shot of the Judge pointing an outstretched finger across the bench, his tone hardening into lethal severity.
EP34:E100 157000-161800 JUDGE [Severe, Imposing]: "You understand that refusal may be treated as proof that you knowingly practiced witchcraft?"
EP34:E101 162000-163600 CAMERA: Close-up of Lady Juliana unflinchingly accepting her fate.
EP34:E102 162100-163500 LADY JULIANA [Proud, Fearless]: "Then let it be."
EP34:E103 163600-166800 CAMERA: Medium shot of Prudence breaking into shattered sobs, pressing her apron to her face to muffle her tears.
EP34:E104 164000-166800 ACTION: Prudence buries her face in her stained white apron, shuddering with grief.
EP34:E105 166800-174400 CAMERA: Medium shot pushing into Lady Juliana's face as she speaks directly across the hall with compassionate, unwavering authority.
EP34:E106 167000-173600 LADY JULIANA [Passionate, Defiant]: "Do not be afraid. I will not call healing evil just because powerful people have decided to fear it."
EP34:E107 174400-176500 CAMERA: Medium close-up profile of the Lord, his smirk instantly freezing into an irritated, malevolent scowl.
EP34:E108 176500-178200 ACTION: The Judge furiously smashes his gavel down upon the sound block with a deafening crack.
EP34:E109 176500-178200 CAMERA: Close-up of the Judge slamming the wooden gavel down.
EP34:E110 176600-177600 SOUND: [Violent, resonant smash of the wooden gavel]
EP34:E111 177800-179400 JUDGE [Thunderous]: "Enough!"
EP34:E112 179500-184500 ACTION: The Judge rises to his full height behind the bench, towering over the silent court.
EP34:E113 179500-184500 CAMERA: Low-angle medium shot looking up at the imposing Judge as he stands formally to deliver the judgment.
EP34:E114 181000-184200 JUDGE [Booming, Solemn]: "Lady Juliana Ashcroft..."
EP34:E115 184500-190000 CAMERA: Over-the-shoulder shot from behind Lady Juliana in the prisoner's dock looking toward the Judge, who solemnly raises his right hand to pronounce the final sentence as the heavy silence hangs over the courtroom.
EP34:E116 185000-190000 ACTION: The Judge extends his raised hand high in judgment over Lady Juliana as the scene holds on her standing still and unbroken before fading to black.

EP=ep_035; timestamps are integer milliseconds
SOURCE_SHA256=07326970ef3d6f070ac1d6590c28721fda574046ea5e3885daec412a9f2d9ea6
METADATA ONLY (not on-screen evidence): {'logline': "Fleeing her captivity through a secret passage, Alexander's elderly mother treks through a bitter blizzard to a secluded cabin, where she tearfully reunites with her presumed-dead son and learns the horrifying conspiracy behind his supposed demise.", 'continuity_notes': "While Juliana faces trial and sentencing in the courtroom, this episode reveals Alexander's mother escaping confinement and tracking down Alexander in his mountain hideout, uncovering the dark treason that orchestrates both their fates."}
SOURCE WARNINGS=['sc_001: incomplete source coverage; gaps are unavailable', 'sc_003: incomplete source coverage; gaps are unavailable']
SCENE sc_001 0-15500 INT. STONE CORRIDOR - NIGHT
EP35:E1 0-5200 CAMERA: Medium tracking shot following an elderly hooded woman clutching an iron lantern as she stumbles anxiously through a damp subterranean stone tunnel.
EP35:E2 0-5200 ACTION: Alexander's mother, frail with silver hair under a dark hooded cloak, braces her hand against the rough stone wall, panting heavily in fear.
EP35:E3 5500-8500 ALEXANDER'S MOTHER [Determined, Breathless]: "I will not die in that house."
EP35:E4 9000-12800 CAMERA: Close-up on her trembling, weathered hands gripping a mossy stone bolt set into a heavy iron plate on the stone wall.
EP35:E5 9500-12800 ACTION: She uses all her strength to shove the stone bolt upward, disengaging the hidden lock mechanism.
EP35:E6 11200-13000 SOUND: Heavy stone grating and metallic latch clanging as the lock releases.
EP35:E7 13000-15500 ACTION: The heavy stone doorway swings inward, and the elderly woman ducks low, crawling through the opening into the cold night outside.
SCENE sc_002 15500-27500 EXT. SNOWY FOREST / CABIN - NIGHT
EP35:E8 15500-19500 CAMERA: Wide atmospheric shot of a deep, snow-covered pine forest at night. In the distance stands a small secluded log cabin nestled under towering snowy trees.
EP35:E9 15500-19500 ACTION: Alexander's mother plods through the thick snow, leaning heavily on a wooden walking stick, her dark cloak dusted with snow.
EP35:E10 16000-19500 SOUND: Howling winter wind and crunching of footsteps in deep snow.
EP35:E11 19500-24000 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Alexander's mother arriving beside the frosted wooden door frame under sharp hanging icicles, shivering violently from the freezing cold.
EP35:E12 21000-23000 ALEXANDER'S MOTHER [Whispering, Weary]: "This must be the place."
EP35:E13 24000-27500 CAMERA: Close-up on her wool-gloved hand unlatching the icy wooden door handle and pushing it open.
EP35:E14 24800-27000 SOUND: Creak of cold wooden hinges opening.
SCENE sc_003 27500-157500 INT. SECLUDED CABIN - CONTINUOUS
EP35:E15 27500-30800 CAMERA: Panning shot from the open doorway revealing the warm, dimly lit cabin interior, settling on Alexander standing over a rustic wooden table by lantern light.
EP35:E16 28500-30800 ACTION: Alexander, wearing a rugged trench coat, his scarred face framed by long dark hair, stands studying an unfolded tactical map before snapping his head up in alarm.
EP35:E17 30800-33800 CAMERA: Medium shot of Alexander's mother stepping across the threshold, holding up her burning lantern, her eyes wide with shock.
EP35:E18 33800-36500 CAMERA: Extreme close-up on Alexander's scarred left cheek and wide, disbelieving blue eyes.
EP35:E19 36500-40500 CAMERA: Close-up on his mother's tear-streaked face as her chin trembles and tears spill down her cheeks.
EP35:E20 37000-40000 ALEXANDER'S MOTHER [Sobbing, Stunned]: "Alexander!"
EP35:E21 40500-44200 CAMERA: Close-up on Alexander as his hard expression crumbles into utter astonishment.
EP35:E22 42500-44200 ALEXANDER [Breathless, In Disbelief]: "Mother?"
EP35:E23 44200-47500 ACTION: She drops her walking staff and rushes forward, throwing her arms around Alexander's neck. He pulls her tightly into his chest.
EP35:E24 45500-48000 ALEXANDER'S MOTHER [Weeping, Overwhelmed]: "You're alive."
EP35:E25 48000-49800 ALEXANDER [Gentle, Choked Up]: "Mother."
EP35:E26 50000-55500 ACTION: She leans back slightly, her frail hand reaching up to gently cup his bearded, scarred cheek, staring into his eyes in disbelief.
EP35:E27 52500-55000 ALEXANDER'S MOTHER [Tearful, Heartbroken]: "I buried you."
EP35:E28 56500-58000 ALEXANDER [Soft, Somber]: "I know."
EP35:E29 59500-66000 ALEXANDER'S MOTHER [Anguished, Accusing]: "They told me you died. They told me your entire regiment was destroyed."
EP35:E30 66500-71000 CAMERA: Close-up on Alexander's hardened, shadowed profile, his jaw tight with grim memories.
EP35:E31 68500-70800 ALEXANDER [Dark, Resigned]: "Most of them were."
EP35:E32 71500-74000 ALEXANDER'S MOTHER [Searching, Desperate]: "Then how did you survive?"
EP35:E33 74200-78000 CAMERA: Side profile of Alexander as his eyes look into the distance, haunted by the past.
EP35:E34 75000-77500 ALEXANDER [Grim, Quiet]: "I wasn't supposed to."
EP35:E35 78000-82500 ACTION: Alexander steps over to the wooden table, looking down at the parchment map spread out under the lantern.
EP35:E36 79000-83000 ALEXANDER [Solemn]: "Three years ago, I was sent to the Iberian front."
EP35:E37 83000-87000 CAMERA: Close-up of Alexander's weathered face looking down pensively as he recounts the mission.
EP35:E38 83000-89000 ALEXANDER [Steady, Focused]: "It was a classified Crown mission. We were investigating a British officer selling military secrets to French spies."
EP35:E39 87000-89800 ACTION: Alexander's scarred finger points to a red-circled location on the parchment map marked near Madrid.
EP35:E40 89800-92000 CAMERA: Close-up on his mother, gasping with wide, horrified eyes.
EP35:E41 89800-91500 ALEXANDER'S MOTHER [Shocked]: "A traitor?"
EP35:E42 92000-93200 ALEXANDER [Cold, Firm]: "Yes."
EP35:E43 93500-97500 CAMERA: Medium shot framing both of them across the wooden table bathed in amber lantern glow.
EP35:E44 94500-97000 ALEXANDER [Grave]: "We were close to finding him."
EP35:E45 98500-101000 ALEXANDER [Hardened]: "Then came the ambush."
EP35:E46 101200-104200 CAMERA: Close-up on Alexander's scarred hand clenching into a fist, furiously crumbling the parchment map beneath his knuckles.
EP35:E47 101500-104200 ALEXANDER [Bitter, Painful]: "My men were slaughtered."
EP35:E48 104200-106500 CAMERA: Close-up of his mother clutching at her throat, tears glistening in her eyes.
EP35:E49 104500-106000 ALEXANDER'S MOTHER [Trembling, Anxious]: "And you?"
EP35:E50 107000-110000 ALEXANDER [Hollow]: "I was shot. Left for dead."
EP35:E51 110000-113500 CAMERA: Medium shot of his mother placing both hands on the table, leaning forward in disbelief.
EP35:E52 111000-113000 ALEXANDER'S MOTHER [Pleading, Astonished]: "How did you escape?"
EP35:E53 113500-118000 CAMERA: Close-up on Alexander, his eyes dark with the harrowing memory.
EP35:E54 114000-118000 ALEXANDER [Somber, Low]: "I crawled away from the battlefield, half dead, alone."
EP35:E55 118200-122000 ALEXANDER [Continuing]: "I survived because the men who came looking for me believed I was already dead."
EP35:E56 122000-125500 CAMERA: Close-up on his mother as her expression shifts to profound bewilderment and outrage.
EP35:E57 122000-125500 ALEXANDER'S MOTHER [Aghast, Stunned]: "Then why did they never tell us?"
EP35:E58 125500-129500 CAMERA: Close-up on Alexander's intense, piercing gaze.
EP35:E59 126000-129500 ALEXANDER [Ominous, Deliberate]: "Because someone wanted you to believe I was dead."
EP35:E60 129500-130500 ALEXANDER'S MOTHER [Breathless]: "Who?"
EP35:E61 130500-134000 ACTION: Alexander turns away toward the frosted window, staring out into the dark raging blizzard outside.
EP35:E62 131000-134000 ALEXANDER [Brooding]: "I spent three years trying to find out."
EP35:E63 134000-136800 ACTION: Alexander abruptly pushes away from the window, storming back toward the table with burning rage.
EP35:E64 134000-137000 ALEXANDER [Fierce, Resolute]: "The ambush was not an accident."
EP35:E65 137000-144000 ACTION: He leans heavily over the wooden table, looming close as his fury boils over.
EP35:E66 137000-140500 ALEXANDER [Vehement, Enraged]: "Someone ordered my men to die."
EP35:E67 141000-144000 ALEXANDER [Darkly Intimating]: "Someone wanted me erased."
EP35:E68 144000-145000 ALEXANDER'S MOTHER [Gasping, Terrified]: "Who?"
EP35:E69 145000-150500 CAMERA: Tight close-up on Alexander's scarred, grim visage, his voice dropping to a deadly chill.
EP35:E70 145500-150000 ALEXANDER [Deadly, Chilling]: "The men behind it... are the same men ruling Ashwood now."
EP35:E71 150500-157500 CAMERA: Close-up on his mother's face as the horrifying realization hits her, her mouth open in a soundless gasp of sheer dread as the scene holds and slowly fades.
EP35:E72 150800-157500 SOUND: A sudden, ominous orchestral crescendo swells dramatically into silence.

messages.content:
EP=ep_036; timestamps are integer milliseconds
SOURCE_SHA256=20e03164760e2aef2f6425e045f839e61841ebc2c378c7938803790bd19fc224
METADATA ONLY (not on-screen evidence): {'logline': 'Learning from his mother that Rupert and Catherine framed Juliana for witchcraft and sentenced her to death right after their upcoming wedding, Alexander vows to return from the dead and reclaim everything stolen from him.', 'continuity_notes': "Picking up immediately from the revelation in Episode 35 that the men ruling Ashwood orchestrated Alexander's ambush, Alexander learns of Juliana's imprisonment and looming execution."}
SOURCE WARNINGS=[]
SCENE sc_001 0-200750 INT. SECLUDED CABIN – NIGHT
EP36:E1 0-4200 CAMERA: Medium two-shot across the weathered wooden table lit by the warm glow of an oil lantern, framing Alexander and his mother leaning inward in the dimly lit cabin.
EP36:E2 0-3800 ACTION: Alexander's mother leans forward with both hands on the rustic table, searching her son's scarred face in disbelief.
EP36:E3 800-3700 ALEXANDER'S MOTHER [Whispering, Distraught]: "Then why did they never find you?"
EP36:E4 4200-8500 CAMERA: Close-up on Alexander, his dark combat scar prominent as his eyes burn with steady, cold intensity.
EP36:E5 4800-8200 ALEXANDER [Cold, Bitter]: "Because they made certain no one would look."
EP36:E6 8500-12800 CAMERA: Medium close-up on Alexander's mother, her hood framing her pale, weathered face as shock deepens across her features.
EP36:E7 9500-11200 ALEXANDER'S MOTHER [Trembling]: "Who?"
EP36:E8 12800-17500 CAMERA: Side profile shot of Alexander gazing toward the open doorway before slowly turning back to face his mother directly.
EP36:E9 13500-17000 ALEXANDER [Grave, Sinister]: "Sterling... and Rupert."
EP36:E10 17500-20800 CAMERA: Tight close-up on Alexander's mother as her breath hitches and her eyes widen in pure horror.
EP36:E11 17600-19800 ALEXANDER'S MOTHER [Gasping, Stricken]: "Rupert?"
EP36:E12 20800-23600 CAMERA: Wide shot of the wooden cabin interior. Alexander stands upright opposite his mother across the lantern-lit map.
EP36:E13 21000-23500 ALEXANDER [Stern, Resolute]: "They knew where I was."
EP36:E14 23600-29000 CAMERA: Close-up on Alexander leaning over the table, his eyes locked onto his mother as suppressed rage surfaces.
EP36:E15 23700-28800 ALEXANDER [Fierce]: "My position was leaked to the French... before I could expose what I had discovered."
EP36:E16 29000-31900 CAMERA: Close-up of Alexander's mother clutching the collar of her dark cloak, her chest heaving with agony.
EP36:E17 29200-31700 ALEXANDER'S MOTHER [Horrified]: "They gave you to the enemy?"
EP36:E18 31900-35800 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Alexander straightening his posture, his jaw set hard.
EP36:E19 32000-34500 ALEXANDER [Deadpan, Resolute]: "They gave them my location."
EP36:E20 35800-38900 CAMERA: Extreme close-up on Alexander's eyes and scarred cheek, teeth bared in contempt.
EP36:E21 36200-38700 ALEXANDER [Spitting with Contempt]: "They wanted the investigation buried."
EP36:E22 38900-41500 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Alexander's mother leaning over the map, her voice cracking.
EP36:E23 39100-41400 ALEXANDER'S MOTHER [Shattered]: "And when you disappeared...?"
EP36:E24 41500-44800 CAMERA: Close-up on Alexander, his voice low and cutting.
EP36:E25 41600-43700 ALEXANDER [Cold]: "They declared me dead."
EP36:E26 44800-48800 CAMERA: Medium shot from the side of the wooden table as his mother brings both hands up to cover her mouth in overwhelmed grief.
EP36:E27 45300-48500 ALEXANDER [O.S.) (Grave]: "They falsified what remained of the reports."
EP36:E28 45300-48800 ACTION: Alexander's mother presses her trembling hands against her lips, tears brimming in her eyes.
EP36:E29 48800-52000 CAMERA: Tight close-up on his mother weeping openly, her ring catching the warm lamplight as she lowers her hand to her heart.
EP36:E30 49000-51800 ALEXANDER'S MOTHER [Tearful, Bitter]: "And Rupert took Ashbourne."
EP36:E31 52000-55500 CAMERA: Tight close-up on Alexander's piercing blue-grey eyes, unwavering and hardened by years of exile.
EP36:E32 52500-55300 ALEXANDER [Darkly]: "While the world mourned a dead heir."
EP36:E33 55500-58800 CAMERA: Close-up on his mother's sorrowful gaze lifting toward him.
EP36:E34 56000-58500 ALEXANDER'S MOTHER [Choked with Tears]: "And I mourned you."
EP36:E35 58800-60800 CAMERA: Medium shot of Alexander looking down, his harsh features softening momentarily with sorrow.
EP36:E36 59200-60400 ALEXANDER [Softly]: "I know."
EP36:E37 60800-64200 CAMERA: Medium close-up on his mother bowing her head toward the rustic tabletop, weeping in utter despair.
EP36:E38 60900-63800 ALEXANDER'S MOTHER [Sobbing]: "I trusted them."
EP36:E39 64200-67500 CAMERA: Wide shot as Alexander stands tall beside the weeping mother seated at the table.
EP36:E40 65100-67300 ALEXANDER [Gentle yet Firm]: "You trusted family."
EP36:E41 67500-71000 CAMERA: Profile close-up of Alexander stepping closer to the door, staring out into the falling snow.
EP36:E42 67800-70500 ALEXANDER [Resentful]: "They used that trust against you."
EP36:E43 71000-74800 CAMERA: Alexander steps back toward the table, leaning in urgently toward his mother.
EP36:E44 72100-74700 ALEXANDER [Urgent, Anxious]: "Mother... Juliana..."
EP36:E45 74800-78200 CAMERA: Medium close-up on Alexander leaning both hands on the table, desperate for answers.
EP36:E46 74900-78100 ALEXANDER [Intense]: "She went into Ashbourne Manor to save you. She never came back."
EP36:E47 78200-81800 CAMERA: Tight close-up on Alexander's strained, furrowed brow.
EP36:E48 78800-81700 ALEXANDER [Tremulous]: "I thought perhaps she stayed with you."
EP36:E49 81800-84000 CAMERA: Close-up of his mother looking up at him, agony and hesitation washing over her face.
EP36:E50 82000-83800 ALEXANDER'S MOTHER [Hesitant, Trembling]: "Alexander..."
EP36:E51 84000-86500 CAMERA: Quick push-in close-up on Alexander, his eyes snapping open in sudden panic.
EP36:E52 84400-85500 ALEXANDER [Alarmed]: "What?"
EP36:E53 86500-90000 CAMERA: Close-up on his mother, tears shining in the amber lamplight.
EP36:E54 87200-89800 ALEXANDER'S MOTHER [Choked]: "She did come to me."
EP36:E55 90000-93200 CAMERA: Medium two-shot as Alexander bends over the table, crowding his mother with fierce desperation.
EP36:E56 91000-93100 ALEXANDER [Demanding]: "Is she still at Ashbourne?"
EP36:E57 93200-96500 CAMERA: Close-up on Alexander's mother shutting her eyes and weeping, shaking her head in deep anguish.
EP36:E58 93500-95800 ALEXANDER'S MOTHER [Sobbing]: "No..."
EP36:E59 96500-99000 CAMERA: Medium shot as Alexander towers over her, his breathing turning ragged.
EP36:E60 96800-98500 ALEXANDER [Desperate]: "Then where is she?"
EP36:E61 99000-103500 CAMERA: Tight close-up on Alexander's mother crying out in wretched guilt and horror.
EP36:E62 99500-103200 ALEXANDER'S MOTHER [Wailing]: "They arrested her!"
EP36:E63 103500-105800 CAMERA: Close-up on Alexander, his expression freezing in complete shock.
EP36:E64 104000-105500 ALEXANDER [Stunned]: "Arrested?"
EP36:E65 105800-110000 CAMERA: Medium close-up as his mother clutches Alexander's forearms with desperate, pleading hands.
EP36:E66 105900-109800 ALEXANDER'S MOTHER [Despairing]: "Rupert and Catherine accused her of poisoning me!"
EP36:E67 110000-114000 CAMERA: Close-up on Alexander, absolute fury erupting across his scarred face.
EP36:E68 111800-113800 ALEXANDER [Shouting, Incredulous]: "But she saved you!"
EP36:E69 114000-117000 CAMERA: Close-up on his mother, clutching her chest in grief.
EP36:E70 114200-116500 ALEXANDER'S MOTHER [Weeping]: "I told them!"
EP36:E71 117000-119500 CAMERA: Medium shot of Alexander clenching his fists at his sides, trembling with rage.
EP36:E72 117500-119300 ALEXANDER [Furious]: "You told them the truth!"
EP36:E73 119500-123000 CAMERA: Close-up on his mother as she cries out, devastated by the memory of the kangaroo court.
EP36:E74 119800-122500 ALEXANDER'S MOTHER [Agonized]: "They called her a witch!"
EP36:E75 123000-127500 CAMERA: Frontal medium shot of Alexander standing frozen, the weight of the realization crashing down on him.
EP36:E76 123800-126800 ALEXANDER [Horrified]: "Juliana... is in a cell?"
EP36:E77 127500-130800 CAMERA: Close-up of his mother clutching her temple, reeling in remembered trauma.
EP36:E78 127800-130500 ALEXANDER'S MOTHER [Weak, Trembling]: "She was taken before a magistrate."
EP36:E79 130800-132000 CAMERA: Tight shot of Alexander, his eyes wild with terror for his wife.
EP36:E80 130900-131800 ALEXANDER [Barking]: "And?!"
EP36:E81 132000-135000 CAMERA: Close-up on his mother breaking down into inconsolable sobs.
EP36:E82 132200-134400 ALEXANDER'S MOTHER [Weeping]: "They condemned her."
EP36:E83 134500-135200 ALEXANDER [O.S.) (Gasping]: "No."
EP36:E84 135000-139000 CAMERA: Close-up on his mother looking up through her tears, delivering the horrifying reality.
EP36:E85 136000-138800 ALEXANDER'S MOTHER [Solemn, Shattered]: "She is to be executed."
EP36:E86 139000-142000 CAMERA: Wide shot of the cabin as Alexander stands stiff as iron, stunned by the looming death sentence.
EP36:E87 140200-141500 ALEXANDER [Guttural, Demanding]: "When?"
EP36:E88 142000-145800 CAMERA: Close-up on his mother, her hand clutched tightly against her throat.
EP36:E89 143200-145500 ALEXANDER'S MOTHER [Trembling]: "After the wedding."
EP36:E90 145800-148500 CAMERA: Close-up on Alexander, narrowing his eyes in lethal suspicion.
EP36:E91 146500-148000 ALEXANDER [Cold, Menacing]: "What wedding?"
EP36:E92 148500-152000 CAMERA: Profile close-up of his mother looking at him across the lantern light.
EP36:E93 148800-151500 ALEXANDER'S MOTHER [Grim]: "Rupert... and Catherine's."
EP36:E94 150500-153000 SOUND: A sudden dramatic metallic swell underscores the impending deadline.
EP36:E95 152000-156500 CAMERA: Frontal close-up on his mother, solemn and resolute in her warning.
EP36:E96 153500-156000 ALEXANDER'S MOTHER [Deadly Serious]: "Two days from now."
EP36:E97 156500-160000 CAMERA: Profile shot of Alexander as dark realization settles over his face, turning to a grim, predatory glare.
EP36:E98 156800-159800 ALEXANDER [Simmering with Fury]: "They are marrying in two days..."
EP36:E99 160000-163000 CAMERA: Tight, terrifying close-up on Alexander's eyes flashing with murderous wrath.
EP36:E100 160500-163000 ALEXANDER [Deadly, Throaty]: "...and killing my wife afterward."
EP36:E101 163000-167000 CAMERA: Medium shot as his mother urgently grabs Alexander's coat, pleading with him.
EP36:E102 163200-166800 ALEXANDER'S MOTHER [Pleading, Terrified]: "Alexander, you cannot go back there alone!"
EP36:E103 167000-171000 CAMERA: Close-up on Alexander, towering over her, immovable and consumed by purpose.
EP36:E104 168500-170800 ALEXANDER [Grave, Seething]: "They already took my name."
EP36:E105 171000-174000 CAMERA: Close-up on Alexander stepping forward, his voice rising with lethal thunder.
EP36:E106 171600-173600 ALEXANDER [Roaring with Conviction]: "They stole my home!"
EP36:E107 174000-177000 CAMERA: Tight close-up on his furious, bared teeth and wild eyes.
EP36:E108 174200-176800 ALEXANDER [Venomous]: "And now they have taken Juliana!"
EP36:E109 177000-179500 ACTION: Close-up of Alexander's gloved hand clenching into a tight, leather-creaking fist.
EP36:E110 177500-179200 SOUND: The sharp, taut creak of leather straining under monstrous grip strength.
EP36:E111 179500-184000 CAMERA: Tracking shot following Alexander as he turns his back on the warmth of the cabin and walks boldly toward the open double barn doors.
EP36:E112 180000-184000 ACTION: Alexander stands framed in the doorway, staring out into the vast, snow-covered pine forest under the cold moonlight.
EP36:E113 182000-183500 ALEXANDER [Calm, Chilling]: "Two days."
EP36:E114 184000-188000 CAMERA: Medium shot from inside the cabin, showing his mother clutching her chest, looking after Alexander's imposing silhouette standing at the threshold of the blizzard.
EP36:E115 184500-187800 ALEXANDER [Vow of Vengeance]: "Then they have two days to celebrate."
EP36:E116 188000-192500 CAMERA: Side profile close-up on Alexander as his breath fogs into the icy winter night air, his jaw clenched tight.
EP36:E117 189500-192200 ALEXANDER [Low, Menacing Promise]: "Because before that wedding begins..."
EP36:E118 192500-200750 CAMERA: Tight side profile close-up of Alexander's battle-scarred cheek and burning gaze as he makes his final declaration.
EP36:E119 193000-196800 ALEXANDER [Cold, Thunderous Finale]: "...their dead Duke is coming home."
EP36:E120 197000-200750 ACTION: Alexander stares resolutely ahead into the dark, snowy woods as the camera holds on his grim, determined expression before cutting to black.
EP36:E121 197000-200750 SOUND: A heavy, ominous orchestral swell builds to a thunderous cliffhanger sting and reverberates into silence.

messages.content:
EP=ep_037; timestamps are integer milliseconds
SOURCE_SHA256=a76d8261a5e8423038f50c4f78f9dfd15fe90fbbc900e06f579de5e943163e2e
METADATA ONLY (not on-screen evidence): {'logline': "As Rupert and Catherine issue wedding invitations paired with Juliana's public execution decree to terrorize the county, Juliana endures starvation in the dungeon, refusing to break her spirit.", 'continuity_notes': "Following Alexander's vow to return in two days to disrupt the wedding, Rupert and Catherine prepare to cement their coup by inviting high society to celebrate their nuptials and witness Juliana's execution."}
SOURCE WARNINGS=[]
SCENE sc_001 0-34500 INT. ASHBRIDGE MANOR - GRAND CORRIDOR – DAY
EP37:E1 0-5500 CAMERA: Low-angle shot tilting down to a polished mahogany table as a white-gloved servant places a tall stack of wax-sealed wedding invitations onto a silver tray.
EP37:E2 1500-3200 SOUND: The crisp tap of heavy cardstock envelopes being set down onto silver.
EP37:E3 5500-9500 CAMERA: Medium two-shot framed symmetrically down the vaulted, sunlit hallway. Blond Nobleman Rupert stands tall in a black embroidered frock coat, facing Catherine in an ornate pink gown.
EP37:E4 6000-9300 BLOND NOBLEMAN [Rupert) (Cold, Calculating]: "Every important family in the county should witness it."
EP37:E5 9500-12500 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine looking down at the invitations, her braided blonde hair immaculately pinned, before she raises her eyes with a slight smirk.
EP37:E6 10800-12400 CATHERINE [Inquiring, Smug]: "The wedding?"
EP37:E7 12500-15000 CAMERA: Close-up on Rupert, his sharp aristocratic features set in cold conviction.
EP37:E8 12800-14800 BLOND NOBLEMAN [Rupert) (Authoritative]: "The transfer of Ashbridge."
EP37:E9 15000-18800 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Catherine picking up one of the invitations, turning it over in her gloved hands with predatory delight.
EP37:E10 15600-18800 CATHERINE [Gloating]: "After the ceremony, no one will question who owns this house."
EP37:E11 18800-23200 CAMERA: Intense close-up of Rupert leaning in slightly, his eyes narrowing with venomous malice.
EP37:E12 19000-23000 BLOND NOBLEMAN [Rupert) (Sinister, Ruthless]: "And no one will question what happened to the woman who tried to stop us."
EP37:E13 23200-26500 CAMERA: Tight close-up of Catherine as a cruel sneer twists her lips.
EP37:E14 23800-26400 CATHERINE [Venomous Satisfaction]: "Juliana's execution comes after the wedding."
EP37:E15 26500-30000 CAMERA: Wide shot framing the two conspirators beneath the towering archways of the estate.
EP37:E16 26600-29800 CATHERINE [Gleeful]: "Perfect timing. It will be a feast for our guests."
EP37:E17 30000-32500 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Rupert turning his gaze toward the grand entrance.
EP37:E18 30200-32200 BLOND NOBLEMAN [Rupert) (Decisive]: "Send the invitations."
EP37:E19 32500-34500 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine looking sideways with narrowed eyes.
EP37:E20 32800-34500 CATHERINE [Spiteful]: "Especially to the Ashcrofts."
SCENE sc_002 34500-88000 INT. NOBLE MANOR - PARLOR – DAY
EP37:E21 34500-37000 CAMERA: Wide tracking shot down a palatial marble hall as a butler carries a silver tray toward double doors.
EP37:E22 37000-39800 CAMERA: Medium shot inside an opulent drawing room with a roaring fireplace. Lady Clarissa sits gracefully in an emerald satin gown as the butler presents the tray.
EP37:E23 37000-39800 BUTLER [Formal]: "Lady Clarissa, an invitation from Ashbridge Manor."
EP37:E24 39500-44000 ACTION: Clarissa takes the cream envelope, breaks the red wax seal with her gloved thumbs, and slides out the heavy card.
EP37:E25 44000-46800 CAMERA: Close-up of Clarissa's face lighting up with malicious excitement, the warm hearth flickering in the background.
EP37:E26 44500-46500 LADY CLARISSA [Amused, Thrilled]: "Catherine's wedding."
EP37:E27 46800-49500 CAMERA: Medium two-shot as her dark-haired husband steps up behind her chair, crossing his arms.
EP37:E28 47000-49200 NOBLEMAN [Observant]: "So it is finally official."
EP37:E29 49500-53000 CAMERA: Close-up of Clarissa smiling down at the calligraphy.
EP37:E30 50000-52800 LADY CLARISSA [Mockingly Reverent]: "Lady Catherine Ashbridge."
EP37:E31 53000-56000 CAMERA: Medium shot as Clarissa unfolds the second page attached to the invitation, her expression shifting to intrigue.
EP37:E32 54000-56200 LADY CLARISSA [Intrigued]: "And after the ceremony..."
EP37:E33 56200-57200 NOBLEMAN [Curious]: "What?"
EP37:E34 56800-58500 ACTION: Clarissa hands the letter upward to him. He takes it and looks down at the bold heading.
EP37:E35 58500-62000 CAMERA: Close-up of the nobleman reading, his eyes widening in shock before breaking into a grin.
EP37:E36 58800-61800 NOBLEMAN [Reading in Awe]: "The sentencing of the condemned."
EP37:E37 62000-65500 CAMERA: Close-up of Clarissa turning back to the fire, laughing softly with dark delight.
EP37:E38 62800-65500 LADY CLARISSA [Gloating, Mocking]: "They want the families to witness it."
EP37:E39 65500-69000 CAMERA: Medium shot of the nobleman holding the invitation, chuckling at the audacity.
EP37:E40 66500-68800 NOBLEMAN [Fascinated]: "A public execution after a wedding."
EP37:E41 69000-72500 CAMERA: Medium profile shot of Clarissa gazing back at him over her shoulder.
EP37:E42 69500-72200 LADY CLARISSA [Chilling, Sharp]: "Not just an execution. A warning."
EP37:E43 72500-75500 CAMERA: Close-up of the nobleman's stern face, leaning down.
EP37:E44 73000-74200 NOBLEMAN [Curious]: "To whom?"
EP37:E45 75500-82500 CAMERA: Close-up on Clarissa taking the letter back into her gloved fingers, her eyes gleaming with aristocratic cruelty.
EP37:E46 77000-81800 LADY CLARISSA [Contemptuous, Scornful]: "To every woman who thinks she can rise above the place she was given."
EP37:E47 82500-88000 CAMERA: Wide shot of the parlor as Clarissa tosses the invitation dismissively onto the side table and looks directly toward the viewer.
EP37:E48 83000-87500 LADY CLARISSA [Smug Triumph]: "Juliana's ruin will be a lesson. And we will be there to watch."
SCENE sc_003 88000-116500 INT. ASHBRIDGE DUNGEON – CONTINUOUS
EP37:E49 88000-92000 CAMERA: Wide, dim shot of the subterranean stone dungeon. Juliana sits slumped against a weeping stone wall on the wet floor, dressed in a tattered prison smock, illuminated only by faint overhead moonlight piercing a ceiling grate.
EP37:E50 88500-92000 SOUND: Rhythmic water drips splashing onto stagnant dungeon puddles and a low, mournful ambient drone.
EP37:E51 92000-95500 CAMERA: Close-up on Juliana's bruised hand, locked in a heavy iron shackle chained to the wall, trembling as she hesitates inches away from a dirty earthen bowl filled with murky liquid.
EP37:E52 93500-95500 ACTION: Juliana curls her fingers back, pulling away from the foul sustenance in defiance.
EP37:E53 95500-100500 CAMERA: Tight close-up of Juliana's dirty, tear-stained face. Her eyes squeeze shut as tears stream down her cheeks from overwhelming physical agony and hunger.
EP37:E54 96000-99500 JULIANA [Weak, Whispering through Tears]: "They think hunger will make me surrender."
EP37:E55 100500-103500 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Juliana's blue eyes snapping open, blazing with unyielding defiance.
EP37:E56 100800-103200 JULIANA [Fierce Resolve]: "They think fear will make me beg."
EP37:E57 103500-108500 CAMERA: Full shot of Juliana using her bare hands against the slimy stone floor to drag herself upright to her knees, chains rattling loudly.
EP37:E58 104000-107000 SOUND: The harsh scrape and clatter of heavy iron chains dragging across wet stone.
EP37:E59 105500-107800 JULIANA [Straining, Defiant Gasps]: "I will not!"
EP37:E60 108500-113500 CAMERA: Low-angle shot looking up at Juliana as she thrusts her chin high toward the iron ceiling grate, bathed in cold shafts of light.
EP37:E61 109000-112500 JULIANA [Passionate Defiance]: "They can take my name. They can take my home."
EP37:E62 113500-116500 CAMERA: Tight close-up of Juliana's iron-shackled hand reaching out and gripping the massive iron ring anchored into the dungeon pillar with crushing determination.
EP37:E63 113600-116200 JULIANA [Indomitable Spirit]: "They cannot take who I am!"
SCENE sc_004 116500-156470 INT. NOBLE MANOR - PARLOR – NIGHT
EP37:E64 116500-120000 CAMERA: Medium two-shot in the dimly lit parlor, illuminated by the warm glow of the fireplace. Clarissa now wears a deep blue velvet gown, reclining in an armchair beside the nobleman.
EP37:E65 117200-119800 NOBLEMAN [Quietly Skeptical]: "Do you think she'll actually be executed?"
EP37:E66 120000-124500 CAMERA: Close-up of Clarissa giving a slight, dismissive scoff before turning to him with cold certainty.
EP37:E67 120500-124200 LADY CLARISSA [Dismissive, Certain]: "After what she has been accused of? Of course."
EP37:E68 124500-127000 CAMERA: Medium close-up of the nobleman looking down pensively at the open execution clause on the table.
EP37:E69 124800-126500 NOBLEMAN [Musing]: "She was always stubborn."
EP37:E70 127000-132500 CAMERA: Close-up on Clarissa's face hardening with bitter resentment.
EP37:E71 127500-132000 LADY CLARISSA [Bitter, Cold]: "That was her greatest mistake. She could have accepted what happened. She could have disappeared quietly."
EP37:E72 132500-136000 ACTION: Clarissa rises from her armchair holding a cut crystal glass filled with dark red wine, pacing toward the fireplace.
EP37:E73 132500-141500 CAMERA: Medium tracking shot showing Clarissa standing tall beside her husband, her posture regal and vindictive.
EP37:E74 134000-141000 LADY CLARISSA [Venomous Monologue]: "Instead she married a nobody, played healer to peasants, challenged people above her. And now the whole county will watch her pay for it."
EP37:E75 141500-147500 CAMERA: Tight close-up on Clarissa's face glowing in the firelight. Her lips curl into a merciless smile as she lifts the crystal glass to her mouth and drinks.
EP37:E76 142500-146500 LADY CLARISSA [Chilling Proclamation]: "Let them see what happens when a woman forgets her place."
EP37:E77 145500-148000 ACTION: Clarissa takes a slow sip of the red wine, her eyes gleaming with dark relish.
EP37:E78 147500-156470 CAMERA: Slow push-in on the dark polished tabletop where the open invitation lies beside the wax seal. The bold Gothic lettering "EXECUTION CLAUSE" sits beneath the gold crest, while the fire dances reflected on the mahogany.
EP37:E79 148000-156470 SOUND: A deep, ominous cello rumble builds alongside the crackle of the fireplace into an unresolved, tension-filled cliffhanger sting before fading out.

messages.content:
EP=ep_038; timestamps are integer milliseconds
SOURCE_SHA256=03e0ee85f8752256ba57786e7857c8c7e9f49b24b40d8ae900c4a6f5a00b5926
METADATA ONLY (not on-screen evidence): {'logline': "A compassionate guard secretly feeds Juliana bread in the dungeon, strengthening her resolve to protect Alexander's secrets just as distant wedding bells signal the start of Rupert's nuptials and her impending execution.", 'continuity_notes': "Following Rupert and Catherine's cruel announcement pairing their wedding with Juliana's public execution, Juliana remains starved in the subterranean dungeon awaiting her fate."}
SOURCE WARNINGS=[]
SCENE sc_001 0-87910 INT. DUNGEON CELL – DAY
EP38:E1 0-4000 CAMERA: Medium profile shot of Juliana slumped on the damp stone floor of her dark dungeon cell, her wrists bound in heavy iron shackles and chains draped over her lap.
EP38:E2 0-3500 ACTION: Juliana sits motionless against the cold masonry, weak and visibly drained from starvation, her eyes cast downward.
EP38:E3 3200-6000 SOUND: Echoing, heavy bootsteps approach down the corridor outside the cell.
EP38:E4 4000-7500 CAMERA: Tight close-up on Juliana's profile as her head turns toward the corridor, her blue eyes widening with cautious alarm.
EP38:E5 5000-7500 ACTION: Juliana blinks, lifting her gaze toward the heavy iron bars.
EP38:E6 7500-11000 CAMERA: Medium shot through the cell bars as a Guard in a black collared uniform with silver buttons halts outside.
EP38:E7 8500-11000 ACTION: The Guard pauses, glancing over his shoulder into the gloomy corridor to ensure he is unobserved.
EP38:E8 11000-15500 CAMERA: Low-angle shot focusing on the wet flagstones at the base of the cell door.
EP38:E9 11000-15500 ACTION: The Guard kneels down and slips a small loaf of rustic bread through the bottom gap between the iron bars, nudging it inside before withdrawing his gloved hand.
EP38:E10 15500-17500 CAMERA: Low-angle close-up of Juliana crawling forward across the stone floor toward the bread, her gaze fixed on the offering in disbelief.
EP38:E11 16000-17300 JULIANA [Breathless, Bewildered]: "Why?"
EP38:E12 17500-21500 CAMERA: Medium close-up of the Guard looking through the vertical bars with quiet compassion.
EP38:E13 17500-20300 GUARD [Subdued, Sincere]: "Because no one should die hungry."
EP38:E14 20500-22000 GUARD [Urgent, Whispered]: "Eat it before they see."
EP38:E15 21500-23200 CAMERA: Over-the-shoulder shot through the cell bars as the Guard turns and walks swiftly away into the dark corridor.
EP38:E16 21800-23200 ACTION: The Guard's silhouette retreats into the shadows.
EP38:E17 23200-30500 CAMERA: Tight shot following Juliana's trembling, shackle-bound hands as she reaches out and drags the loaf toward her chest.
EP38:E18 23500-27500 ACTION: Juliana clutches the bread tightly with both hands, tears welling in her eyes.
EP38:E19 26000-27500 JULIANA [Choked Up, Tearful]: "Thank you."
EP38:E20 27800-31000 ACTION: Starving and overcome with emotion, Juliana presses the bread to her lips and tears off a desperate, ravenous bite.
EP38:E21 30500-35000 CAMERA: Close-up profile of Juliana chewing the bread, tears rolling down her soot-streaked cheek.
EP38:E22 31000-34500 ACTION: Juliana chews hungrily, closing her eyes as the agonizing reality of her plight hits her anew.
EP38:E23 34500-36500 JULIANA [Sorrowful, Whispering]: "Alexander..."
EP38:E24 35000-39500 CAMERA: Low-angle wide shot of Juliana seated against the damp stone wall beneath high overhead iron ceiling grates, clutching the half-eaten bread in her lap.
EP38:E25 36800-39000 JULIANA [Yearning]: "...are you safe?"
EP38:E26 39500-45500 CAMERA: Intimate close-up of Juliana looking upward, her tear-stained face filled with raw anguish.
EP38:E27 40000-43000 JULIANA [Desperate, Trembling]: "Do you even know what happened to me?"
EP38:E28 43200-45200 JULIANA [Grief-Stricken]: "Do you know they condemned me?"
EP38:E29 45500-51000 CAMERA: Tight macro shot on Juliana's chin and throat as she presses a trembling hand against her chest.
EP38:E30 45500-47500 JULIANA [Fearful, Pleading]: "What if I die here?"
EP38:E31 47800-50500 JULIANA [Heartbroken]: "What if I never see you again?"
EP38:E32 48500-51000 ACTION: A heavy tear drips down from her jaw, falling into the dark dampness below.
EP38:E33 51000-55500 CAMERA: Medium close-up profile of Juliana closing her eyes, drawing a deep breath to steady herself.
EP38:E34 51500-53500 JULIANA [Fervent Prayer]: "Keep him safe."
EP38:E35 53800-55300 JULIANA [Resigned]: "Wherever he is."
EP38:E36 55500-60500 CAMERA: Frontal medium shot of Juliana kneeling upright, her right hand pressed firmly over her heart, her posture transforming into quiet dignity.
EP38:E37 55500-57000 JULIANA [Determined]: "Let him live."
EP38:E38 57500-60500 JULIANA [Steely]: "And if I have only one thing left to give..."
EP38:E39 60500-64000 CAMERA: Tight close-up of Juliana turning toward the cell wall, her blue eyes flashing with fierce loyalty.
EP38:E40 60800-62500 JULIANA [Defiant, Unshakable]: "I will not give them my husband."
EP38:E41 62800-64200 JULIANA [Resolute]: "I will not betray him."
EP38:E42 64000-67000 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Juliana's closed eyelids as she takes a sharp, startled breath.
EP38:E43 64500-66500 ACTION: Juliana's eyes snap wide open in sudden realization as a deep resonant toll reverberates from above.
EP38:E44 64800-87000 SOUND: Solemn, resonant church bells begin tolling rhythmically from the cathedral above, echoing deep into the stone dungeon.
EP38:E45 67000-70500 CAMERA: Low-angle shot looking up past Juliana kneeling on the wet floor toward the barred iron skylight above her cell.
EP38:E46 69000-70300 JULIANA [Startled Whisper]: "Bells."
EP38:E47 70500-72500 CAMERA: Wide tracking shot as Juliana scrambles to her feet, chains clinking loudly against her skirts.
EP38:E48 71000-73500 ACTION: Juliana rushes toward the front of the cell, clutching the iron bars with both hands.
EP38:E49 72500-78500 CAMERA: Medium profile shot of Juliana gripping the heavy iron bars, gazing down the corridor toward the source of the sound.
EP38:E50 72800-74200 JULIANA [Realizing]: "The wedding."
EP38:E51 74500-75800 JULIANA [Grim]: "It's beginning."
EP38:E52 76000-78500 JULIANA [Somber, Steely]: "Then I suppose I'm next."
EP38:E53 78500-84500 CAMERA: Close-up between the vertical iron bars framed directly on Juliana's face. The terror in her eyes softens into an unexpected, brave smile of enduring faith.
EP38:E54 81000-84000 ACTION: Juliana grips the bars tightly, her lips curving into a warm, defiant smile as she whispers her husband's name.
EP38:E55 82500-84000 JULIANA [Hopeful, Tender]: "Alexander..."
EP38:E56 84500-87910 CAMERA: Dramatic cut to black.
EP38:E57 84500-87910 SOUND: A sharp, high-tension dramatic swell strikes and echoes out into silence alongside the fading toll of the distant church bells.

messages.content:
EP=ep_039; timestamps are integer milliseconds
SOURCE_SHA256=9880b70ecdcada1fcb110b33761a1bdfdf96ccad454ef181cd47d641bb68e500
METADATA ONLY (not on-screen evidence): {'logline': "While Alexander's loyal men infiltrate and neutralize the royal guards stationed outside the cathedral, Alexander sheds his rugged disguise, dons his ducal regalia, and marches forth to reclaim his house and rescue Juliana.", 'continuity_notes': "Picks up as the wedding bells toll for Rupert and Catherine's ceremony. While Juliana prepares for execution in the dungeon below, Alexander's coordinated strike to liberate the cathedral and reclaim his birthright begins."}
SOURCE WARNINGS=[]
SCENE sc_001 0-13800 EXT. COBBLESTONE STREET - DAY
EP39:E1 0-4600 CAMERA: Low-angle tracking shot from behind wagon wheels framing laborers unloading wooden crates from a horse-drawn cart in the bustling town square.
EP39:E2 0-4600 ACTION: Men in work clothes stack wooden crates onto the back of a large carriage as horses snort restlessly in the morning mist.
EP39:E3 4600-7100 CAMERA: Medium close-up profile shot of a vigilant scout in a dark brimmed hat holding reins and surveying the street.
EP39:E4 4600-7100 ACTION: The scout stands quietly by a wooden rail, keeping a sharp eye on passing civilians.
EP39:E5 7100-9600 CAMERA: Artistic framing through the spokes of a large wooden wagon wheel looking out across the cobblestones toward church spires in the distance.
EP39:E6 9600-13800 CAMERA: Close-up of a disguised loyalist adjusting his flat cap, followed by a low-angle tracking shot of two men walking briskly over the wet cobblestones.
SCENE sc_002 13800-24200 EXT. CATHEDRAL ENTRANCE & ALLEY - CONTINUOUS
EP39:E7 13800-15800 CAMERA: Wide symmetrical establishing shot of the grand Gothic cathedral entrance flanked by armed royal guards in red uniforms and bearskin hats standing on stone steps.
EP39:E8 13800-15800 ACTION: Four royal guards in red ceremonial tunics and tall black bearskin hats stand rigidly at attention with rifles on the grand cathedral staircase.
EP39:E9 15800-18000 CAMERA: Medium shot in a nearby alleyway where two loyalist conspirators huddle beside bundles of hay, discreetly passing a folded message.
EP39:E10 18000-22400 CAMERA: Close profile two-shot of the two loyalist soldiers watching the cathedral spires in the distance.
EP39:E11 18300-19900 LOYALIST SCOUT [Low, Urgent]: "Six at the front."
EP39:E12 20200-21800 LOYALIST FIGHTER [Grave]: "Four more inside."
EP39:E13 22400-24200 CAMERA: Medium over-the-shoulder shot of the two men conferring as townsfolk pass in the foreground.
EP39:E14 22500-23200 LOYALIST SCOUT [Focused]: "And the east gate?"
EP39:E15 23300-24200 LOYALIST FIGHTER [Determined]: "Ours."
SCENE sc_003 24200-50000 EXT. CATHEDRAL ENTRANCE - CONTINUOUS
EP39:E16 24200-29600 CAMERA: Wide crane shot panning down as a horse-drawn cart loaded with cut firewood pulls up along the wet stone pavement in front of the cathedral steps.
EP39:E17 24200-29600 ACTION: A lone driver in rugged attire guides the horse cart slowly toward the sentries guarding the arched entryway.
EP39:E18 29600-32400 CAMERA: Medium two-shot of the royal sentry stepping forward and extending a white-gloved hand to halt the cart.
EP39:E19 29800-30600 ROYAL SENTRY [Commanding]: "Stop!"
EP39:E20 30800-32400 CART DRIVER [Meek, Deferential]: "Firewood for the kitchens, sir."
EP39:E21 32400-36500 CAMERA: Fast dynamic medium shot as the cart driver suddenly lunges off the wooden bench.
EP39:E22 32800-36500 ACTION: The driver leaps off the cart, striking the sentry across the chest, seizing his neck, and tackling him violently against the wooden carriage wheel.
EP39:E23 33100-36000 SOUND: Dull physical thuds and scuffling boots on wet stone as the guard groans in surprise.
EP39:E24 36500-42800 CAMERA: Medium close-up as a second loyalist emerges from behind the doorway, wrapping his arms around the remaining royal guard's throat from behind.
EP39:E25 37000-42500 ACTION: The loyalist locks the sentry into a tight sleeper hold, clamping a hand firmly over his mouth until his eyes roll back and he goes limp.
EP39:E26 41000-42200 LOYALIST FIGHTER [Whispering, Cold]: "Sleep."
EP39:E27 42800-46800 CAMERA: Wide high-angle shot overlooking the stone cathedral steps where both royal guards lie unconscious on the fallen autumn leaves while more men slip inside the opened doors.
EP39:E28 46800-50000 CAMERA: Medium low-angle shot of the two loyalist fighters looking up into the overcast sky outside the stone sanctuary.
EP39:E29 47000-48100 CART DRIVER [Relieved, Firm]: "The road is clear."
EP39:E30 48200-49200 LOYALIST FIGHTER [Resolute]: "Tell the Duke."
SCENE sc_004 50000-68500 INT. WOODEN CABIN - DAY
EP39:E31 50000-52800 CAMERA: Close-up framed into a cracked wooden wall mirror reflecting Alexander with long unkempt hair, a thick beard, and combat scars across his cheek.
EP39:E32 50000-52800 ACTION: Alexander stares solemnly at his rugged reflection, his expression dark and resolute.
EP39:E33 52800-55800 CAMERA: Tilt-down medium close-up over a wooden table displaying a pristine navy-and-gold embroidered ducal uniform, ornate lion crest brooch, white cravat, razor, and scissors.
EP39:E34 55800-59800 CAMERA: Medium profile shot of Alexander lifting the metal shears beside the window light, raising them toward his hair.
EP39:E35 56500-59800 ACTION: Alexander snips through his overgrown locks, shedding the years of exile and camouflage.
EP39:E36 57200-60800 SOUND: Rhythmic, metallic snips of heavy shears cutting through thick hair.
EP39:E37 59800-61200 CAMERA: Medium shot as Alexander trims his beard at the jawline.
EP39:E38 61200-66600 CAMERA: Medium shot framed in the mirror of Alexander now handsomely groomed, his trimmed beard framing his fierce, scarred features.
EP39:E39 62000-66600 ACTION: Alexander lightly traces the jagged combat scar across his cheek, eyes burning with reclaimed power.
EP39:E40 62000-62800 ALEXANDER [Deep, Steely Resolve]: "Enough hiding."
EP39:E41 63000-65500 ALEXANDER [Dark, Unforgiving]: "They buried Alexander Ashwin three years ago."
EP39:E42 65600-66900 ALEXANDER [Fierce, Commanding]: "Today, he comes home."
EP39:E43 66600-68500 CAMERA: Medium shot of Alexander lifting his royal navy-blue embroidered ducal coat from the wooden bench.
SCENE sc_005 68500-98410 EXT. WOODEN OUTPOST / SNOWY PATH - DAY
EP39:E44 68500-71800 CAMERA: Wide tracking shot through double wooden barn doors opening outward onto a vast, snow-covered landscape as Alexander steps forward into the light.
EP39:E45 68500-71800 ACTION: Alexander emerges in full ducal splendor—dressed in an immaculate navy tailcoat lined with gold embroidery, double-breasted brass buttons, and a crisp white cravat.
EP39:E46 71800-74800 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Alexander's hand adjusting the ornate golden lion crest pinned at his cravat.
EP39:E47 74800-77800 CAMERA: Medium low-angle shot as a loyalist soldier drops down onto one knee before him in the snow.
EP39:E48 75800-77200 LOYALIST [Reverent, Submissive]: "Your Grace."
EP39:E49 77800-82500 CAMERA: Close-up profile of Alexander, his breath pluming in the winter cold, his eyes hardened like steel.
EP39:E50 80500-82200 ALEXANDER [Authoritative, Command]: "Secure the chapel."
EP39:E51 82500-85200 CAMERA: Medium close-up of the soldier rising and snapping a crisp military salute.
EP39:E52 83800-85200 LOYALIST [Resolute]: "Yes, Your Grace."
EP39:E53 85200-95000 CAMERA: Slow dramatic tracking shot moving backward in front of Alexander as he strides purposefully through the deep snow, the wooden chapel looming in the distance behind him.
EP39:E54 85500-87200 ALEXANDER [Powerful, Roaring Defiance]: "No more hiding."
EP39:E55 87500-90200 ALEXANDER [Fierce, Unyielding]: "I am taking back my house."
EP39:E56 90200-95000 ACTION: Alexander marches forward unstoppably, his long coat fluttering in the winter wind as his icy gaze locks forward.
EP39:E57 95000-98410 CAMERA: Dramatic push-in close-up directly onto Alexander's scarred, fierce face as he speaks with absolute conviction.
EP39:E58 95000-98000 ALEXANDER [Passionate, Unstoppable Vow]: "And I am bringing my wife home."
EP39:E59 97800-98410 ACTION: Alexander's eyes burn with furious determination as the screen cuts sharply to black.

EP=ep_040; timestamps are integer milliseconds
SOURCE_SHA256=9b116fc10ed5209d6d3a109f10f574cd6f4a1b680f5e1cf66a99e6f02b7b51e0
METADATA ONLY (not on-screen evidence): {'logline': "High society gathers at the grand cathedral for Rupert and Catherine's lavish wedding, while the conspirators ensure every exit is sealed to seal Juliana's execution—unaware that Alexander's retribution is already at their gates.", 'continuity_notes': 'Picks up right after Alexander commands his men to secure the chapel and vows to reclaim his house and rescue Juliana; inside the cathedral, the wedding guests arrive and the conspirators finalize their sinister plot.'}
SOURCE WARNINGS=['sc_001: incomplete source coverage; gaps are unavailable']
SCENE sc_001 0-34200 EXT. CATHEDRAL STEPS – DAY
EP40:E1 0-4800 CAMERA: Wide establishing shot looking up at the imposing stone Gothic cathedral as noble guests in formal Regency attire ascend the grand steps.
EP40:E2 0-4800 SOUND: Somber cathedral bells tolling and the distant murmur of arriving carriages.
EP40:E3 4800-8500 CAMERA: Medium wide shot of an ornate black and gold royal carriage pulling up to the cobblestone courtyard. A footman in white gloves steps forward and opens the carriage door.
EP40:E4 5500-7400 FOOTMAN [Formal, Resonant]: "The Harrington family."
EP40:E5 8500-12200 CAMERA: Medium shot as Lord Harrington in a tailored black tailcoat and white waistcoat steps down from the carriage, turning to extend his gloved hand to Lady Harrington, who gracefully descends.
EP40:E6 10000-12400 ACTION: Lady Harrington takes his hand and steps onto the pavement, clutching a velvet reticule.
EP40:E7 12400-17300 LADY HARRINGTON [Smug, Impressed]: "Look at them. Every noble family in the county is here today."
EP40:E8 12400-19000 CAMERA: Medium two-shot tracking slightly as Lord and Lady Harrington pause arm-in-arm, taking in the gathering crowd of high society.
EP40:E9 19000-23000 CAMERA: Low-angle shot from behind as they ascend the stone steps toward the arched cathedral entrance.
EP40:E10 19200-23000 LORD HARRINGTON [Ambitious, Proud]: "And soon, we'll be connected to the Duchess of Ashburgh."
EP40:E11 23000-26200 CAMERA: Tight close-up profile of Lady Harrington, her eyes glistening with cruel satisfaction in the soft sunlight.
EP40:E12 23200-26000 LADY HARRINGTON [Malicious, Taunting]: "Imagine Juliana seeing this."
EP40:E13 26200-30000 CAMERA: Tight close-up of Lord Harrington looking down at her, his expression cold and ruthless.
EP40:E14 26200-28900 LORD HARRINGTON [Sinister, Dismissive]: "She won't be seeing anything for long."
EP40:E15 29000-29900 LADY HARRINGTON [Pleased, Cold]: "Good."
EP40:E16 30100-33200 LORD HARRINGTON [Chuckling, Scornful]: "This place has always been unlucky for Juliana."
EP40:E17 32800-34200 ACTION: Lady Harrington lets out a soft, amused laugh as they reach the heavy wooden cathedral doors.
SCENE sc_002 34200-49800 INT. CATHEDRAL – CONTINUOUS
EP40:E18 34200-40500 CAMERA: Dramatic tracking shot following Lord and Lady Harrington from behind as they stride down the candlelit aisle of the cathedral toward their reserved pew.
EP40:E19 34400-39000 LADY HARRINGTON [Vindictive, Pious]: "She stands beneath God's watch and still gets exactly what she deserves."
EP40:E20 40500-42200 ACTION: Lord and Lady Harrington slide gracefully into the polished wooden pew, smoothing their garments.
EP40:E21 40500-45200 CAMERA: Medium profile shot of the couple seated in the pew, looking toward the grand altar.
EP40:E22 42000-44000 LADY HARRINGTON [Anticipatory, Eager]: "We have an excellent view."
EP40:E23 44100-45200 LORD HARRINGTON [Inquiring, Subdued]: "Of the wedding?"
EP40:E24 45200-49800 CAMERA: Close-up two-shot as Lady Harrington turns her head toward Lord Harrington with a dark, knowing smirk.
EP40:E25 45300-48300 LADY HARRINGTON [Chilling, Sarcastic]: "And everything that comes after it."
SCENE sc_003 49800-78500 INT. CATHEDRAL – ALTAR & BALCONY – CONTINUOUS
EP40:E26 49800-55800 CAMERA: Medium shot of Rupert, the Blond Nobleman, standing before the altar draped in floral garlands. He wears an ornate silver-embroidered black formal coat and nervously adjusts his pristine white gloves.
EP40:E27 50800-53200 BLOND NOBLEMAN [Nervous, Determined]: "Everything must go perfectly."
EP40:E28 53200-55800 ACTION: Rupert smooths the lapels of his coat, checking his posture as he waits for the bride.
EP40:E29 55800-58200 CAMERA: Medium shot up on the stone balcony overlooking the nave, where an elder conspirator nobleman in black gloves stands gripping a cane.
EP40:E30 58200-63800 CAMERA: High-angle wide shot looking down from the balcony across the entire cathedral filled with guests, candles lining the central aisle, and royal guards standing at attention.
EP40:E31 63800-69500 CAMERA: Medium shot on the balcony as a Royal Guard in red uniform and tall bearskin hat steps up and bows respectfully to the elder nobleman.
EP40:E32 65000-66800 ELDER NOBLEMAN [Stern, Scheming]: "All entrances are covered?"
EP40:E33 66900-68200 ROYAL GUARD [Obedient, Firm]: "Every one, my Lord."
EP40:E34 68300-69300 ELDER NOBLEMAN [Calculating]: "Good."
EP40:E35 69500-74500 CAMERA: Over-the-shoulder shot from behind the elder nobleman, his gloved hand resting on the stone balustrade, looking down upon the altar and seated aristocrats.
EP40:E36 69800-74200 ELDER NOBLEMAN [Ruthless, Victorious]: "By sunset, Ashburgh will have its new Duke and Duchess."
EP40:E37 74500-78500 CAMERA: Tight, menacing close-up on the elder nobleman's face as a cold, sinister smile spreads across his lips.
EP40:E38 74800-77400 ELDER NOBLEMAN [Deadly, Uncompromising]: "And its witch will be dead."
SCENE sc_004 78500-110080 INT. CATHEDRAL – CONTINUOUS
EP40:E39 78500-81000 SOUND: The heavy creak of massive wooden cathedral doors swinging open, accompanied by swelling bridal organ music.
EP40:E40 78500-81000 CAMERA: Wide symmetrical shot down the candlelit aisle as the double doors part, flooding the cathedral with brilliant golden daylight.
EP40:E41 81000-82500 CAMERA: Close-up of Rupert turning his head sharply, his eyes widening in awe.
EP40:E42 82500-85800 CAMERA: Framed wide shot of Catherine silhouetted in the bright doorway, wearing a breathtaking cream and gold imperial bridal gown with puffed sleeves and an exquisite sheer veil.
EP40:E43 85800-90800 CAMERA: Majestic high-angle wide tracking shot following Catherine from behind as her magnificent cathedral-length veil trails down the aisle between seated guests.
EP40:E44 90800-94500 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Lady Harrington leaning forward from her pew, utterly captivated.
EP40:E45 92000-94200 LADY HARRINGTON [Awestruck, Whispering]: "She looks like a queen."
EP40:E46 94500-97500 CAMERA: Medium shot of Rupert at the altar, a proud, possessive smile breaking across his handsome face.
EP40:E47 97500-102800 CAMERA: Full shot as Catherine reaches the top of the altar steps. Rupert steps forward and takes her gloved hands into his.
EP40:E48 100000-102800 BLOND NOBLEMAN [Enamored, Flattering]: "You look more queen than bride."
EP40:E49 102800-110080 CAMERA: Tight two-shot profile of Catherine and Rupert clasping hands intimately, gazing into each other's eyes with shared aristocratic vanity.
EP40:E50 105000-109000 CATHERINE [Smug, Coquettish]: "And you look better in silk than you ever did as an ignored cousin."
EP40:E51 109000-110080 ACTION: Rupert and Catherine exchange conspiratorial, triumphant smiles at the altar as the solemn organ chord holds and the scene cuts to black.

EP=ep_041; timestamps are integer milliseconds
SOURCE_SHA256=80e99739af6910a1947da7e3b729f9a79f1acc371d8d09c2f8028786b1c3a6ef
METADATA ONLY (not on-screen evidence): {'logline': "At the height of Catherine and Rupert's lavish wedding, Juliana is paraded before high society in chains to be publicly disgraced—until a deafening explosion shatters the cathedral entrance, heralding Alexander's vengeful assault.", 'continuity_notes': "Follows Episode 40 where Rupert and Catherine met at the altar; Catherine halts the vows to stage a public humiliation of Juliana, unaware that Alexander's forces are already detonating the cathedral gates."}
SOURCE WARNINGS=[]
SCENE sc_001 0-96090 INT. CATHEDRAL – CONTINUOUS
EP41:E1 0-1800 CAMERA: Wide symmetrical shot looking down the candlelit, flower-strewn aisle toward the altar where Rupert, Catherine, and the Priest stand.
EP41:E2 1800-4500 ACTION: Catherine abruptly pulls away from Rupert and raises her white-gloved hand high, commanding silence from the congregation.
EP41:E3 1800-2800 CATHERINE [Imperious, Commanding]: "Wait."
EP41:E4 4500-8500 CAMERA: Medium shot tracking Catherine as she pivots toward the seated aristocracy, her veil floating gracefully behind her.
EP41:E5 4900-8200 CATHERINE [Haughty, Loud]: "Before I become Duchess of Ashburgh..."
EP41:E6 8500-13000 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine's face, her lips curling into a sadistic, triumphant sneer.
EP41:E7 8500-12700 CATHERINE [Cruel, Resonant]: "...I want everyone to see what happens to a woman who dares defy this family."
EP41:E8 13000-15500 CAMERA: Two-shot profile of Rupert and Catherine. Rupert turns to her with mild caution.
EP41:E9 13200-14000 BLOND NOBLEMAN [Subdued, Inquiring]: "Catherine..."
EP41:E10 14000-15300 CATHERINE [Callous, Projecting]: "Bring her in."
EP41:E11 15500-17500 SOUND: Heavy wooden creak of the cathedral double doors swinging open.
EP41:E12 15500-20000 CAMERA: Wide shot from behind the altar down the aisle as the great church doors slowly open, revealing the silhouette of three figures against the daylight.
EP41:E13 17500-20000 ACTION: Juliana, dressed in a coarse drab prison dress with a numbered identification badge, is marched forward by two armed constables holding her by the arms.
EP41:E14 20000-22800 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Juliana's scarred, dirtied wrists bound tight in heavy iron shackles.
EP41:E15 22800-26000 CAMERA: Intense close-up of Juliana's bruised, dirt-streaked face. Her piercing blue eyes burn with fierce dignity despite her captive state.
EP41:E16 26000-28800 CAMERA: Medium shot of Catherine standing beside the altar, watching Juliana's entrance with gloating satisfaction.
EP41:E17 26800-28400 CATHERINE [Smug, Taunting]: "There she is."
EP41:E18 28800-30000 CAMERA: Medium tracking shot of Juliana marching between the stern constables down the central aisle toward the altar.
EP41:E19 30000-34000 CAMERA: Medium shot of a seated aristocratic couple in the pews, whispering and sneering behind an ivory lace fan.
EP41:E20 30500-31600 NOBLEWOMAN [Gleeful, Whispering]: "Look at her."
EP41:E21 31700-33800 NOBLEMAN [Mocking, Chuckling]: "She actually came back to the chapel."
EP41:E22 34000-36800 CAMERA: Close-up of the noblewoman giggling with hand over mouth, glancing spitefully at the disgraced bride.
EP41:E23 34800-36800 NOBLEWOMAN [Scornful, Smug]: "Not as a bride this time."
EP41:E24 36800-39800 CAMERA: Medium shot of two senior aristocrats in the carved choir stalls, resting on their canes and nodding in smug agreement.
EP41:E25 39800-43800 CAMERA: Close profile of Juliana as she halts in the center aisle, lifting her chin proudly to face the sneering onlookers.
EP41:E26 41000-44200 CATHERINE [O.S.) (Derisive, Projecting]: "Lady Juliana Ashcroft. Look around."
EP41:E27 43800-48500 CAMERA: High-angle wide shot showing Juliana flanked by guards in the center of the lavishly decorated nave, dwarfed by the grand cathedral.
EP41:E28 45000-48000 CATHERINE [V.O.) (Mocking, Resonant]: "This is the world you thought you belonged to."
EP41:E29 48500-52800 CAMERA: Low-angle medium shot of Catherine gesturing broadly from the altar steps, looking down upon Juliana like an empress.
EP41:E30 48600-52400 CATHERINE [Spiteful, Boastful]: "And now they can all see what you truly are."
EP41:E31 52800-57800 CAMERA: Medium shot of Juliana standing firmly between the guards, calmly meeting Catherine's venomous gaze.
EP41:E32 54800-57500 ACTION: Juliana looks around the cathedral at the sea of pompous faces, then raises her eyes straight back to Catherine with utter disdain.
EP41:E33 57800-60800 CAMERA: Tight close-up on Juliana's bruised, unshaken face.
EP41:E34 58000-60500 JULIANA [Defiant, Unbowed]: "You needed an entire chapel to feel powerful over one chained woman?"
EP41:E35 60800-64000 CAMERA: Dramatic low-angle full shot looking up at Juliana, her posture straight, imposing, and regal despite the heavy chains.
EP41:E36 61000-63500 CATHERINE [O.S.) (Murmured, Cold]: "Still arrogant. Still standing."
EP41:E37 64000-68500 CAMERA: Full shot of Catherine turning back to Rupert at the altar, dismissing Juliana's defiance as beneath her.
EP41:E38 64500-65400 CATHERINE [Dismissive]: "Come."
EP41:E39 68500-70500 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine's and Rupert's gloved hands clasping together over the velvet altar cushion.
EP41:E40 70500-75000 CAMERA: Medium two-shot of Catherine gazing up adoringly into Rupert's eyes, her tone intoxicatingly intimate.
EP41:E41 70500-74800 CATHERINE [Intimate, Ambitious]: "Soon, there will be nothing left between us and the Ashburgh title."
EP41:E42 75000-77500 CAMERA: Close-up of Rupert's face breaking into a calculating, ambitious grin.
EP41:E43 75800-77000 BLOND NOBLEMAN [Quietly Triumphant]: "Nothing."
EP41:E44 77500-80500 CAMERA: Medium shot of the elderly Priest opening the leather-bound liturgical book between Rupert and Catherine.
EP41:E45 78000-79300 PRIEST [Solemn, Polite]: "Shall we?"
EP41:E46 80500-81800 CAMERA: Wide shot centered down the aisle toward the massive closed entrance doors.
EP41:E47 81000-85500 SOUND: Ear-splitting detonation, shattering stone, wood splintering violently into kindling, followed by terrified screams of the congregation.
EP41:E48 81800-84000 ACTION: A violent fireball bursts inward as the entire cathedral entrance explodes, blasting the massive double doors and masonry into flying shrapnel and billowing smoke.
EP41:E49 81800-84500 CAMERA: Rapid series of panic shots: aristocratic guests ducking behind pews, covering their heads in terror, women shrieking as plaster rains down.
EP41:E50 84500-88500 CAMERA: Medium shot of Catherine and Rupert at the altar. Catherine gasps in horror, clutching her veil as debris rains over her bridal gown while Rupert spins around in shock.
EP41:E51 88500-92000 CAMERA: Medium wide shot of Juliana standing motionless in the middle of the aisle while thick smoke and dust billow from the demolished archway behind her.
EP41:E52 89000-93500 ACTION: Silhouetted armed figures emerge through the smoke and rubble of the breached doorway. Juliana slowly turns her head, glancing back toward the light.
EP41:E53 92000-96090 CAMERA: Extreme close-up pushing in on Juliana's bruised face. Her expression shifts from grim resolve into awe, breathless realization, and blooming hope as the orchestral score swells into an abrupt cliffhanger.
