messages.content:
EP=ep_042; timestamps are integer milliseconds
SOURCE_SHA256=338a2e4416e23ccbdd35fce7a7bef8fe67e442cb023bacc55ae9a3f512aca696
METADATA ONLY (not on-screen evidence): {'logline': 'Emerging from the smoke of the shattered cathedral gates in full ducal regalia, Alexander confronts Rupert, wins the loyalty of the royal guards, and is proclaimed the rightful Duke of Ashburn by his weeping mother.', 'continuity_notes': "Directly follows Episode 41 where Alexander's forces breached the cathedral entrance; Alexander now steps through the ruins, halting the wedding and unmasking Rupert's illegitimate reign."}
SOURCE WARNINGS=['sc_001: incomplete source coverage; gaps are unavailable']
SCENE sc_001 0-77800 INT. CATHEDRAL – CONTINUOUS
EP42:E1 0-10500 CAMERA: Low-angle shot through drifting smoke and rubble across the stone floor, tilting up as polished boots step over splintered wood, revealing an imposing nobleman in a gold-embroidered navy coat.
EP42:E2 1000-10500 ACTION: Alexander strides deliberately through the pulverized cathedral doorway. Dressed in the regal ducal coat with gold braided cuffs and a lion crest, his scarred face is set with cold, unyielding authority.
EP42:E3 11200-12600 BLOND NOBLEMAN [Shocked, Trembling]: "Who are you?"
EP42:E4 12800-14600 ALEXANDER [Low, Resonant]: "You already know."
EP42:E5 14600-16600 CAMERA: Close-up on Juliana, her manacled hands clutching at her smock as tears well in her eyes.
EP42:E6 15000-16400 JULIANA [Breathless, Tearful Whisper]: "Alexander..."
EP42:E7 16600-17900 CAMERA: Close-up on Alexander, his gaze softening momentarily toward her.
EP42:E8 16800-17900 ALEXANDER [Gentle, Reassuring]: "Juliana."
EP42:E9 17900-21500 CAMERA: Medium shot of Rupert descending the altar steps, furiously pointing toward Alexander.
EP42:E10 18000-21200 BLOND NOBLEMAN [Furious, Hysterical]: "Guards! Arrest this imposter!"
EP42:E11 21500-23400 CAMERA: Medium shot of the royal guardsman standing rigidly in red uniform and bearskin cap, resting his white-gloved hand on his sabre.
EP42:E12 22000-23400 ROYAL GUARD [Stoic, Defiant]: "We will not."
EP42:E13 23400-26500 CAMERA: Close-up on Rupert, veins bulging in his neck as his composure shatters.
EP42:E14 23500-25200 BLOND NOBLEMAN [Screaming, Outraged]: "I said arrest him!"
EP42:E15 25500-26500 BLOND NOBLEMAN [Desperate, Unhinged]: "Why?!"
EP42:E16 26500-28800 CAMERA: Close-up on the Royal Guard holding his upright blade with unwavering conviction.
EP42:E17 26700-28800 ROYAL GUARD [Firm, Reverent]: "Because we know who he is."
EP42:E18 28800-30400 CAMERA: Medium shot of Catherine clutching her father's arm, her bridal bouquet drooping as panic seizes her face.
EP42:E19 29000-30300 CATHERINE [Trembling, Apprehensive]: "Rupert..."
EP42:E20 30400-33800 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Rupert gripping the edge of a pew for balance, his eyes wild with terror.
EP42:E21 30500-33800 BLOND NOBLEMAN [Denial, Shaken]: "You cannot be him. Alexander died!"
EP42:E22 33800-39900 CAMERA: Wide tracking shot behind Alexander as he advances down the center aisle, silhouetted against the ruins of the cathedral nave.
EP42:E23 34000-39800 ALEXANDER [Cold, Commanding]: "And yet, here I stand. That is the lie you built your life upon."
EP42:E24 39900-44800 CAMERA: Medium shot of an elderly silver-haired woman in simple ivory robes stepping into the aisle, her hands outstretched in trembling awe.
EP42:E25 40200-42500 ALEXANDER'S MOTHER [Choked with Tears]: "Alexander..."
EP42:E26 44800-48000 ACTION: Alexander halts his march as his mother reaches him, placing her frail hands gently upon his chest.
EP42:E27 48000-49000 ALEXANDER [Soft, Reverent]: "Mother."
EP42:E28 49000-54000 ACTION: His mother gently cradles Alexander's scarred cheek, tears streaming down her face as guests in the background watch in stunned silence.
EP42:E29 49200-53800 ALEXANDER'S MOTHER [Overcome, Loving]: "Look at you... my beautiful boy."
EP42:E30 54000-63500 CAMERA: Medium two-shot framed down the ruined nave between Alexander and his mother.
EP42:E31 54000-61800 ALEXANDER'S MOTHER [Tearful, Proud]: "I saw you again... but seeing you like this... I see my son as he was always meant to be."
EP42:E32 62000-64000 ALEXANDER [Tender, Resolute]: "I have come home, Mother."
EP42:E33 64000-72500 ACTION: Alexander's mother turns toward the gathered nobility and guards, raising her chin and pointing proudly toward Alexander.
EP42:E34 64200-72400 ALEXANDER'S MOTHER [Ringing, Authoritative]: "Let everyone hear me! This is my son... Alexander Ashburn. The rightful Duke of Ashburn!"
EP42:E35 72500-73800 CAMERA: Medium shot of Rupert cowering on the altar steps beside Catherine and her father, utterly defeated.
EP42:E36 73800-77800 CAMERA: Tight close-up on Alexander, his hand resting on the hilt of his sabre as his eyes burn with fierce, cold retribution.
EP42:E37 73800-77500 ALEXANDER [Grim, Vengeful]: "And now, Rupert... we settle what you stole."

EP=ep_043; timestamps are integer milliseconds
SOURCE_SHA256=38bc44fd0e20af8d7d020f5616476647014c1fb0e0dff1bd0a59f77cf36d9bb9
METADATA ONLY (not on-screen evidence): {'logline': "When Rupert frantically orders Alexander's arrest, the royal guards refuse and salute the true Duke, before damning Crown intelligence documents expose Rupert and Lord Sterling's treasonous plot.", 'continuity_notes': 'Follows directly from Episode 42; inside the ruined cathedral, Alexander confronts Rupert before the congregation, armed with evidence from the Crown to reclaim his rightful title.'}
SOURCE WARNINGS=[]
SCENE sc_001 0-114960 INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL – CONTINUOUS
EP43:E1 0-3800 CAMERA: Medium close-up on Rupert Ashburn standing before the altar, trembling with mounting panic and rage.
EP43:E2 600-2400 BLOND NOBLEMAN [Hysterical, Panicked]: "You're lying!"
EP43:E3 2400-3900 ACTION: Rupert lunges forward, his facial features contorting in venomous desperation.
EP43:E4 3800-8000 CAMERA: Tracking shot swinging around Rupert as he turns toward the royal guards stationed along the aisle, pointing furiously down the center of the hall.
EP43:E5 3900-7400 BLOND NOBLEMAN [Shrieking, Frantic]: "This man is an imposter! Arrest him!"
EP43:E6 8000-10500 CAMERA: Wide symmetrical shot framing Alexander Ashburn standing immovable in the center of the cathedral, flanking lines of red-coated guards on both sides.
EP43:E7 8200-10500 ACTION: Alexander stands completely composed in his dark embroidered aristocratic coat, staring Rupert down with unyielding authority.
EP43:E8 10500-13500 CAMERA: Extreme close-up on Rupert's furious face, veins bulging at his temples.
EP43:E9 10500-13200 BLOND NOBLEMAN [Enraged, Screaming]: "I said arrest him!"
EP43:E10 13500-16200 CAMERA: Medium shot on the Royal Guard Captain in ceremonial bearskin uniform standing steadfast.
EP43:E11 13800-16000 ACTION: The Guard Captain brings his ceremonial sword upright to attention, his expression stern and resolute.
EP43:E12 14200-15800 ROYAL GUARD [Firm, Defiant]: "We will not."
EP43:E13 16200-17800 CAMERA: Low-angle shot looking down along the polished stone floor as the guard's sword tip grounds firmly between Rupert and the guards.
EP43:E14 16200-18000 BLOND NOBLEMAN [Outraged, Stunned]: "I am Lord Rupert Ashburn!"
EP43:E15 17800-19200 CAMERA: Medium close-up on Rupert thumping his chest in indignant disbelief.
EP43:E16 18100-19000 BLOND NOBLEMAN [Desperate]: "Your Duke!"
EP43:E17 19200-21800 CAMERA: Medium shot framing the Guard Captain and Alexander in profile.
EP43:E18 19200-21600 ACTION: The Guard Captain snaps a crisp salute toward Alexander.
EP43:E19 19200-21500 ROYAL GUARD [Calm, Resolute]: "No. He is your Duke."
EP43:E20 21800-24000 CAMERA: Medium shot on Catherine in her bridal gown and Lord Henry Sterling seated in the front pew, both frozen in stunned shock.
EP43:E21 22000-24000 ACTION: Lord Sterling clutches his gold-headed walking cane tightly, his jaw clenching as tension spreads through the church.
EP43:E22 24000-26000 CAMERA: Medium shot on Rupert spinning toward the gathered congregation, his hands flailing.
EP43:E23 24100-25800 BLOND NOBLEMAN [Desperate, Flustered]: "You have all been deceived!"
EP43:E24 26000-28000 CAMERA: Medium close-up on Alexander, commanding and icy.
EP43:E25 26100-28000 ALEXANDER [Cold, Authoritative]: "Then let the Crown decide."
EP43:E26 28000-30000 CAMERA: Close-up on Alexander's hands holding an official War Office document bundle sealed with red wax and ribbon.
EP43:E27 28200-30000 ACTION: Alexander brings forth the dossier stamped "WAR OFFICE - TOP SECRET" with the royal crest.
EP43:E28 30000-33800 CAMERA: Medium shot of Alexander holding up the sealed parcel before the room.
EP43:E29 30000-33400 ALEXANDER [Grave, Powerful]: "These were delivered to me under the seal of the Crown."
EP43:E30 33500-34500 ALEXANDER [Commanding]: "Read the first."
EP43:E31 33800-35000 CAMERA: Close-up on Lord Sterling looking sideways, his face pale with rising dread.
EP43:E32 35000-37000 CAMERA: Two-shot of Alexander handing the dossier to a Crown Military Magistrate wearing white gloves and a high-collared black uniform.
EP43:E33 35200-37000 ACTION: The Crown Official receives the dossier solemnly with both hands.
EP43:E34 37000-42800 CAMERA: Medium close-up on the Crown Official opening the binder and reading aloud.
EP43:E35 37200-38600 SOUND: Crisp sound of parchment turning.
EP43:E36 37800-42500 CROWN OFFICIAL [Clear, Formal]: "Military Intelligence Report, Iberian front, three years ago."
EP43:E37 42800-43900 CAMERA: Close-up on Rupert staring wide-eyed, completely petrified.
EP43:E38 43900-47800 CAMERA: Medium close-up on the Crown Official continuing the official reading.
EP43:E39 44000-47400 CROWN OFFICIAL [Solemn, Objective]: "Duke Alexander Ashburn's unit was ambushed after his location was compromised."
EP43:E40 47800-50800 CAMERA: Frontal medium shot of the Crown Official turning a page as the congregation listens in breathless silence.
EP43:E41 47800-50800 CROWN OFFICIAL [Accusing, Measured]: "The report identifies the leak as deliberate."
EP43:E42 50800-54800 CAMERA: Wide shot across the rubble of the cathedral floor showing Rupert crumbling in fear against the choir railing.
EP43:E43 51000-54400 CROWN OFFICIAL [Voice Continuing]: "Information regarding the Duke's position was transmitted through British channels."
EP43:E44 51800-54800 ACTION: Rupert staggers backward, his knees buckling as he leans his weight heavily on the stone balustrade.
EP43:E45 54800-57000 CAMERA: Close-up on Rupert clinging to the stone pillar, his breath shallow and terrified.
EP43:E46 55000-56500 BLOND NOBLEMAN [Whispering, Terrified]: "No..."
EP43:E47 57000-60000 CAMERA: Medium shot on Alexander stepping forward, thrusting the secondary dossier forward.
EP43:E48 58500-60000 ALEXANDER [Cold, Implacable]: "Read the names."
EP43:E49 60000-63000 CAMERA: Medium close-up on the Crown Official reading the concluding section.
EP43:E50 60600-62500 CROWN OFFICIAL [Deliberate, Damning]: "Lord Henry Sterling."
EP43:E51 63000-64500 CAMERA: Quick pan to Lord Sterling stiffening in his pew, then the Crown Official.
EP43:E52 63100-64200 CROWN OFFICIAL [Continuing]: "Rupert Ashburn."
EP43:E53 64500-66000 CAMERA: Extreme close-up on Rupert's horrified eyes darting in sheer terror.
EP43:E54 66000-68800 CAMERA: Close-up on the Dowager Duchess covering her mouth in agonizing disbelief.
EP43:E55 66500-68000 DOWAGER DUCHESS [Shaken, Devastated]: "My God..."
EP43:E56 68800-71200 CAMERA: Low-angle shot on Alexander towering over the fallen Rupert.
EP43:E57 69000-71300 ALEXANDER [Furious, Thunderous]: "You sold my men to the enemy."
EP43:E58 71200-72700 CAMERA: Close-up on Rupert waving his hands defensively, hyperventilating.
EP43:E59 71400-72700 BLOND NOBLEMAN [Desperate, Denying]: "I didn't!"
EP43:E60 72700-74800 CAMERA: Low-angle tracking push-in on Alexander raising the red-ribboned war document toward the cathedral arches.
EP43:E61 72800-75200 ALEXANDER [Resonant, Accusatory]: "And when you believed I was dead..."
EP43:E62 74800-76000 CAMERA: Quick reaction shot on Rupert gasping on the steps.
EP43:E63 76000-77800 CAMERA: Tight close-up on Alexander's scarred, furious face.
EP43:E64 76100-77600 ALEXANDER [Venomous]: "You took my title."
EP43:E65 77800-81000 CAMERA: Extreme close-up on the Crown Official's gloved thumb cracking the red wax seal open.
EP43:E66 78000-79400 SOUND: Brittle snap of breaking sealing wax.
EP43:E67 81000-85000 CAMERA: Full shot of the Crown Official standing amidst church debris reading the death register.
EP43:E68 81500-85800 CROWN OFFICIAL [Grave, Official]: "Official death confirmation was filed three months after the ambush."
EP43:E69 85000-88000 CAMERA: Two-shot of the Crown Official in the background and Alexander's dark silhouette in the foreground.
EP43:E70 86000-88500 CROWN OFFICIAL [Continuing]: "Duke Alexander Ashburn was declared dead."
EP43:E71 88000-93200 CAMERA: Wide majestic shot capturing the entire nave, the rows of horrified guests, and the ruined cathedral windows.
EP43:E72 88600-93000 CROWN OFFICIAL [Loud, Authoritative]: "His estate and title were subsequently transferred under false authority."
EP43:E73 93200-96500 CAMERA: Medium close-up on Rupert clutching his chest as if choking on his own lies.
EP43:E74 93400-96400 BLOND NOBLEMAN [Screaming, Desperate]: "I was told he was dead!"
EP43:E75 96500-99800 CAMERA: Low shot following Alexander's heavy boots stepping steadily up the stone steps toward the altar.
EP43:E76 96800-99800 ALEXANDER [Cold, Penetrating]: "You were told exactly what you needed to hear."
EP43:E77 99800-102200 CAMERA: Medium shot on Rupert whirling around in a frenzy, pointing his finger toward Lord Sterling.
EP43:E78 100000-102200 BLOND NOBLEMAN [Frantic, Betraying]: "Sterling handled the report!"
EP43:E79 102200-103400 CAMERA: Alexander turns his head sharply toward the side pews.
EP43:E80 103400-104800 CAMERA: Medium shot of Lord Henry Sterling silently slipping out of his seat and making a break toward the side exit.
EP43:E81 104800-106500 CAMERA: Close-up on Catherine peering out from under her bridal veil in shock.
EP43:E82 104800-106200 CATHERINE [Shocked, Murmuring]: "My Lord?"
EP43:E83 106500-109800 CAMERA: Medium shot of Lord Sterling frantically unlatching the heavy oak church door and pulling it open.
EP43:E84 107000-109000 SOUND: Heavy iron latch clicking open and wooden door creaking.
EP43:E85 109800-112800 CAMERA: Reverse angle from inside the doorway showing a stern British Police Constable standing directly outside, blocking the passage.
EP43:E86 110400-112500 POLICE CONSTABLE [Firm, Sardonic]: "Going somewhere, Lord Sterling?"
EP43:E87 112800-114960 CAMERA: Extreme close-up on Lord Sterling's face frozen in pure terror, his jaw agape as his escape is completely cut off, holding until fade to black.

EP=ep_044; timestamps are integer milliseconds
SOURCE_SHA256=d6578a980e20d1c89412d7828db835a3076dbe6b8555a2d0cdb7b54ad747e256
METADATA ONLY (not on-screen evidence): {'logline': 'As Lord Sterling and Rupert are apprehended by the Crown, Catherine pleads with Alexander for their past love, only to be coldly rejected as he walks toward his chained bride, Juliana.', 'continuity_notes': "Picks up immediately from Episode 43's cliffhanger at the church side exit; Lord Sterling's escape is blocked by the Police Constable, leading into the downfall of the conspirators."}
SOURCE WARNINGS=[]
SCENE sc_001 0-13800 INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - SIDE ENTRANCE – DAY
EP44:E1 0-3200 CAMERA: Low-angle shot framing the towering stone archway as a stern Police Constable steps through the heavy open doors, blocking Lord Sterling's path.
EP44:E2 0-3200 ACTION: The Police Constable strides firmly down the steps and halts right in front of Lord Sterling, holding his ground.
EP44:E3 3200-8600 CAMERA: Medium two-shot of the Police Constable towering over Lord Sterling.
EP44:E4 3300-8200 POLICE CONSTABLE [Authoritative, Stern]: "Lord Henry Sterling, you are under arrest by order of the Crown."
EP44:E5 8600-11400 CAMERA: Close-up on Lord Sterling's trembling, indignant face.
EP44:E6 9100-11200 LORD STERLING [Snarls, Outraged]: "You have no authority!"
EP44:E7 11400-13800 CAMERA: Close-up on the Constable's black-gloved hands holding out a thick, red-ribboned dossier stamped with the Crown's royal wax seal.
EP44:E8 11400-13200 POLICE CONSTABLE [Cold, Definite]: "I have more than enough."
SCENE sc_002 13800-70500 INT. RUINED CATHEDRAL - ALTAR & NAVE – CONTINUOUS
EP44:E9 13800-16400 CAMERA: Wide shot of the ruined nave littered with rubble as royal redcoat guards surround the aisle, forcing Rupert down onto his knees.
EP44:E10 14000-16400 ACTION: A royal redcoat guard firmly forces Rupert down into the stone dust.
EP44:E11 14000-16800 BLOND NOBLEMAN [Frantic, Shouting]: "Get your hands off me! Catherine!"
EP44:E12 16400-19400 CAMERA: Close-up on Rupert struggling fiercely against the white-gloved grip of the guard pinning his shoulder.
EP44:E13 17400-19300 BLOND NOBLEMAN [Desperate, Screaming]: "Do something!"
EP44:E14 19400-22000 CAMERA: Medium close-up on Catherine beneath her bridal veil, looking downward in conflicted silence.
EP44:E15 21800-24400 ACTION: Catherine's satin-gloved hand clenches tightly into a trembling fist against the folds of her ornate gown.
EP44:E16 22000-24400 CAMERA: Close-up on Catherine's gloved hand tightening into a fist.
EP44:E17 24400-27800 CAMERA: Wide shot as Catherine gathers her heavy train and steps away from Rupert, walking toward Alexander who stands watching her stoically.
EP44:E18 25200-28000 CATHERINE [Shaken, Tearful]: "Alexander... I thought you had died."
EP44:E19 27800-31200 CAMERA: Close-up on Catherine's face, tears glistening in her eyes as grief breaks through her composure.
EP44:E20 28400-31000 CATHERINE [Choked, Weeping]: "Do you know what this did to me?"
EP44:E21 31200-32400 CAMERA: Medium shot on Alexander standing tall in his ducal coat, his gaze utterly detached.
EP44:E22 31200-32400 CATHERINE [O.S.) (Pleading]: "I mourned you."
EP44:E23 32400-34000 CAMERA: Profile close-up of Catherine as a tear slips down her cheek.
EP44:E24 32400-34000 CATHERINE [Vulnerable, Trembling]: "I waited for you."
EP44:E25 34000-35800 CAMERA: Medium shot of Catherine standing in the center of the aisle before the seated congregation.
EP44:E26 34200-38800 CATHERINE [Heartbroken]: "For three years, I believed the man I loved was buried somewhere across the sea."
EP44:E27 35800-38800 CAMERA: Tracking two-shot over Alexander's shoulder as Catherine approaches him pleadingly.
EP44:E28 38800-41200 CAMERA: Close profile two-shot as Catherine gently reaches her gloved hand up to Alexander's bearded cheek.
EP44:E29 38900-41200 CATHERINE [Whispering, Longing]: "I never stopped loving you."
EP44:E30 41200-42800 ACTION: Alexander abruptly pulls his face back, refusing her touch and leaving her hand suspended in mid-air.
EP44:E31 41200-42800 CAMERA: Close-up on Catherine's empty gloved hand trembling in the empty space between them.
EP44:E32 42800-46400 CAMERA: Close-up on Catherine lowering her hand, stunned and deeply hurt by his rejection.
EP44:E33 44200-46400 CATHERINE [Breathless, Hurt]: "You don't remember?"
EP44:E34 46400-49000 CAMERA: High-angle shot looking down at Catherine in the foreground, with Rupert held under guard in the background.
EP44:E35 46600-48800 CATHERINE [Desperate, Demanding]: "I was supposed to be your Duchess!"
EP44:E36 49000-51000 CAMERA: Medium two-shot of Catherine and Alexander confronting each other.
EP44:E37 49200-51000 ALEXANDER [Cold, Implacable]: "You were never my Duchess."
EP44:E38 51000-53000 CAMERA: Extreme close-up on Catherine's tearful face.
EP44:E39 51100-52800 CATHERINE [Sobbing, Pleading]: "But I loved you!"
EP44:E40 53000-55600 CAMERA: Medium close-up on Alexander, his scarred jaw set firm.
EP44:E41 53000-55500 ALEXANDER [Scornful, Biting]: "You loved the Duke you thought you would marry."
EP44:E42 55600-59000 CAMERA: Close-up on Catherine, gasping in protest.
EP44:E43 56200-58200 CATHERINE [Defiant, Pained]: "No!"
EP44:E44 59000-62400 CAMERA: Medium shot as Catherine clutches her chest, pouring her heart out.
EP44:E45 59800-62400 CATHERINE [Passionate, Crying]: "I loved you before all this!"
EP44:E46 62400-63800 CAMERA: Close-up on Alexander tilting his head slightly, his gaze piercing through her.
EP44:E47 62500-63400 ALEXANDER [Skeptical, Cutting]: "Did you?"
EP44:E48 63800-65000 CAMERA: Close-up on Catherine, rendered speechless by his doubt.
EP44:E49 65000-67800 CAMERA: Tilt-up shot starting from heavy iron chains resting on the wooden floor up to the shackled wrists of Juliana dressed in her rustic grey gown.
EP44:E50 67800-69600 CAMERA: Wide shot from behind Catherine as Alexander turns his back on her and walks resolutely down the rubble-strewn aisle toward Juliana standing in chains at the doorway.
EP44:E51 68000-69600 ACTION: Alexander walks away from Catherine toward Juliana, who waits solemnly by the cathedral entrance.
EP44:E52 69600-70100 CAMERA: Medium close-up on Juliana looking down at her chained hands, lifting her gaze gently.
EP44:E53 70100-70500 CAMERA: Extreme close-up on Catherine's horrified, bewildered expression as she realizes who Alexander chose.
EP44:E54 70100-70400 CATHERINE [Gasping, Incredulous]: "Her?!"

EP=ep_045; timestamps are integer milliseconds
SOURCE_SHA256=3424e374024cd00f62363ff74cc760257a974bf2c966796922d6ee99beade3db
METADATA ONLY (not on-screen evidence): {'logline': 'Alexander frees Juliana from her chains and proclaims her the Duchess of Ashburton before the stunned congregation, only for an ecclesiastical authority to burst in and declare their marriage legally invalid.', 'continuity_notes': "Picks up directly from Episode 44's climax where Alexander walked away from Catherine towards Juliana standing in chains at the church doorway."}
SOURCE WARNINGS=[]
SCENE sc_001 0-48900 INT. CATHEDRAL NAVE – CONTINUOUS
EP45:E1 0-3000 CAMERA: Full tracking shot following behind Alexander as he walks down the rubble-covered stone aisle toward Juliana.
EP45:E2 0-2800 ACTION: Alexander strides purposefully down the cathedral aisle, ignoring the watching nobles as Juliana stands shackled in her rustic grey dress near the entrance.
EP45:E3 2800-5000 CAMERA: Medium close-up on Juliana looking down at her chained hands, tears welling in her eyes.
EP45:E4 3200-4800 JULIANA [Whispering, Tearful]: "Alexander..."
EP45:E5 5000-8500 CAMERA: Medium shot as Alexander stops in front of Juliana and sinks onto one knee before her.
EP45:E6 5200-7800 ACTION: Alexander drops to one knee before Juliana, looking up at her with profound devotion.
EP45:E7 7400-8900 ALEXANDER [Gentle, Reassuring]: "Look at me."
EP45:E8 8800-9900 CAMERA: Low angle close-up of Juliana looking down into Alexander's eyes with rising disbelief.
EP45:E9 9900-12200 CAMERA: Close-up on Alexander's hands as he unfastens the heavy iron lock and releases the chains from Juliana's bruised wrists.
EP45:E10 10200-11800 SOUND: Heavy iron clanking as the shackles fall away.
EP45:E11 12200-15000 CAMERA: Close-up on Juliana's tear-streaked face as she stares intently into his eyes.
EP45:E12 12500-14300 JULIANA [Breathless, Overcome]: "Your eyes..."
EP45:E13 15000-21800 CAMERA: Close-up profile of Alexander as Juliana reaches out her trembling hand to touch his bearded cheek and jawline.
EP45:E14 15200-18500 ACTION: Juliana places her palm against Alexander's beard, feeling his scarred face as recognition dawns.
EP45:E15 17100-18700 JULIANA [Emotional, Realizing]: "It's you."
EP45:E16 19400-21500 ALEXANDER [Solemn, Loving]: "It was always me."
EP45:E17 21800-24500 CAMERA: Medium shot as Alexander stands up and drapes a heavy crimson ducal mantle lined with ermine over Juliana's shoulders.
EP45:E18 21900-24200 ACTION: Alexander places the ducal cloak over Juliana's rustic gown, adjusting it gently over her shoulders.
EP45:E19 22900-24400 JULIANA [Shocked, Wondering]: "You're the Duke?"
EP45:E20 24500-27200 CAMERA: Close-up on Alexander looking intensely into her eyes.
EP45:E21 24600-27400 ALEXANDER [Firm, Resonant]: "Alexander Ashburton. The rightful Duke of Ashburton."
EP45:E22 27200-29800 CAMERA: Close-up on Juliana, tears of awe spilling over her cheeks.
EP45:E23 27600-29600 JULIANA [Incredulous, Moved]: "All this time?"
EP45:E24 29800-35800 CAMERA: Close-up two-shot as Alexander tenderly cradles Juliana's cheek in his gloved hand.
EP45:E25 30200-33000 ALEXANDER [Tender, Deep]: "You chose me when you believed I was nobody."
EP45:E26 33200-34900 JULIANA [Sincere, Loving]: "I chose you because you were kind."
EP45:E27 35100-36800 ALEXANDER [Low, Passionate]: "You chose me when I had nothing."
EP45:E28 35800-38500 CAMERA: Medium shot framed between them as Alexander holds her face with both hands, the crowd watching in stunned silence.
EP45:E29 37000-38700 JULIANA [Resolute, Warm]: "I chose you because you had honor."
EP45:E30 38500-42000 CAMERA: Tight close-up on Alexander looking deep into Juliana's blue eyes.
EP45:E31 38800-41800 ALEXANDER [Earnest, Devoted]: "And I chose you because you saw the man before the title."
EP45:E32 42000-48900 CAMERA: Extreme close-up as Alexander and Juliana rest their foreheads and noses together in an intimate embrace.
EP45:E33 42200-48500 ACTION: Alexander and Juliana close their eyes, breathing together with their foreheads pressed gently against one another.
EP45:E34 43800-46000 JULIANA [Soft, Heartfelt]: "I loved you before I ever knew who you were."
EP45:E35 46100-48800 ALEXANDER [Soft, Vowing]: "And I loved you before I ever dared to tell you."
SCENE sc_002 48900-86500 INT. CATHEDRAL – CONTINUOUS
EP45:E36 48900-51800 CAMERA: Medium shot as Alexander turns back toward the altar, where Catherine stands in her disheveled wedding gown.
EP45:E37 49000-51500 ACTION: Catherine takes a desperate step forward, clutching her skirts and weeping.
EP45:E38 49800-51500 CATHERINE [Pleading, Desperate]: "Alexander..."
EP45:E39 51800-58200 CAMERA: Medium shot as Alexander steps right up to Catherine, towering over her with righteous fury.
EP45:E40 54000-58000 ALEXANDER [Furious, Cold]: "You poisoned my mother. You tortured my wife."
EP45:E41 58200-62500 CAMERA: Extreme close-up split profile between Alexander's angry face and Catherine's gasping, terrified expression.
EP45:E42 58200-59800 CATHERINE [Gasping, Lying]: "I didn't know!"
EP45:E43 60000-62400 ALEXANDER [Thunderous, Biting]: "You knew exactly what you were doing!"
EP45:E44 62500-67000 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Alexander turning slightly toward the gathered congregation as his voice rings across the cathedral.
EP45:E45 62600-66800 ALEXANDER [Booming, Condemning]: "You hurt the two women who mattered most to me: my mother, and my wife."
EP45:E46 67000-71200 CAMERA: Close-up on Catherine's devastated, terrified face as the word shatters her entire worldview.
EP45:E47 68800-70500 CATHERINE [Trembling, Stunned]: "Wife?!"
EP45:E48 71200-74500 CAMERA: Grand wide shot of the ruined cathedral nave as Alexander takes Juliana's hand and walks her proudly down the center aisle.
EP45:E49 71200-74500 ACTION: Alexander and Juliana advance side-by-side between the rows of shocked aristocratic guests.
EP45:E50 71500-74000 ALEXANDER [Authoritative, Resounding]: "Before the Crown and before God..."
EP45:E51 74500-80500 CAMERA: Medium shot as Alexander stops in the center of the nave and raises Juliana's hand high above their heads.
EP45:E52 74600-80000 ACTION: Alexander hoists Juliana's hand triumphantly into the air, presenting her to the nobility.
EP45:E53 74800-80400 ALEXANDER [Proclaiming, Powerful]: "Lady Juliana Ashcroft is my lawful wife... and the Duchess of Ashburton!"
EP45:E54 80500-83500 CAMERA: Close-up on Rupert and Mary standing in the pews, their eyes wide with horrified disbelief.
EP45:E55 81500-83000 RUPERT [Gasping, Shellshocked]: "Juliana?!"
EP45:E56 83500-86500 CAMERA: Wide shot of Alexander and Juliana standing proudly together, exchanging a loving gaze amid the awestruck crowd.
SCENE sc_003 86500-121750 INT. CATHEDRAL ENTRANCE – CONTINUOUS
EP45:E57 86500-90500 CAMERA: Wide tracking shot down the cathedral aisle as the massive wooden entrance doors slam open, framed by blinding daylight and mist.
EP45:E58 86500-88200 SOUND: Loud, echoing thud of cathedral doors swinging open violently.
EP45:E59 87500-91000 ACTION: A Catholic Bishop in dark vestments steps through the cathedral doors accompanied by an armed Crown officer.
EP45:E60 88400-90800 HIGH PRIEST [Booming, Stern]: "No one will bow yet!"
EP45:E61 90800-93000 CAMERA: Low-angle shot on Alexander and Juliana turning in alarm toward the rear of the cathedral.
EP45:E62 93000-101200 CAMERA: Medium shot of the High Priest striding down the aisle, holding up an official royal parchment bearing red wax seals.
EP45:E63 93200-101000 ACTION: The Priest holds up the sealed royal proclamation, holding his rosary beads as he marches forward.
EP45:E64 93200-101100 HIGH PRIEST [Commanding, Severe]: "This ceremony was performed without a Crown marriage license, by a priest without authority to sanctify a ducal union."
EP45:E65 101200-105800 CAMERA: Close-up on the High Priest unfolding the document, reading aloud to the congregation.
EP45:E66 101500-105500 HIGH PRIEST [Stern, Official]: "These vows were never entered into the Royal Matrimonial Register."
EP45:E67 105800-108800 CAMERA: Medium shot of Alexander shielding Juliana behind him as the Crown officer approaches with drawn sword.
EP45:E68 106200-108800 HIGH PRIEST [O.S.) (Harsh, Resolute]: "Before the Crown, you are not Duchess of Ashburton."
EP45:E69 108800-113200 CAMERA: Close-up of the High Priest scowling directly at Juliana with unyielding authority.
EP45:E70 109000-113000 HIGH PRIEST [Unyielding, Condemning]: "You are not Alexander Ashburton's lawful wife."
EP45:E71 113200-117500 CAMERA: Close-up two-shot of Juliana gasping in terror, clutching Alexander's hand tightly as Alexander glares at the Priest.
EP45:E72 113500-117200 ACTION: Juliana looks up at Alexander in sudden panic, her fingers gripping his leather-gloved hand.
EP45:E73 117500-121750 CAMERA: Slow push-in close-up on Catherine beneath her veil, her initial despair morphing into a cold, venomous, triumphant smile as the episode cuts.
EP45:E74 118000-121750 ACTION: Catherine raises her chin, a vindictive smirk spreading across her lips as she realizes her rival's claim has just been torn to pieces.

EP=ep_046; timestamps are integer milliseconds
SOURCE_SHA256=0be3f531f43e86d3e33d345721484e16c73d7c066a20333d08f888a60d957e14
METADATA ONLY (not on-screen evidence): {'logline': "The High Priest places the sanctuary under Crown seizure and invalidates Alexander and Juliana's wedding for lack of royal license, prompting Alexander to demand a ten-day ecclesiastical trial while Catherine schemes to destroy them.", 'continuity_notes': "Picks up directly from Episode 45's cliffhanger where the High Priest stormed into the church with royal guards and challenged the legality of Alexander and Juliana's marriage."}
SOURCE WARNINGS=[]
SCENE sc_001 0-143880 INT. ASHBURTON ESTATE CHAPEL – CONTINUOUS
EP46:E1 0-3500 CAMERA: Full shot of Alexander and Juliana standing side by side before the altar, their hands tightly clasped beneath the soaring stained-glass windows.
EP46:E2 0-3500 ACTION: Alexander holds Juliana's hand resolutely as Juliana gazes toward the church aisle where the intrusion unfolds.
EP46:E3 3500-5800 CAMERA: Medium close-up of an elderly noblewoman seated in the pew, clutching her chest with anxious apprehension.
EP46:E4 5800-7100 CAMERA: Medium shot of Catherine in her lavish bridal gown, her fists clenched tightly in silent fury.
EP46:E5 7100-11000 CAMERA: Wide tracking shot down the ruined nave aisle as the High Priest marches forward flanked by armed royal guards with halberds.
EP46:E6 7800-11000 SOUND: Heavy armored footsteps and boots crunching against loose stone debris.
EP46:E7 11000-13800 CAMERA: Medium shot of the High Priest holding up a wax-sealed document before his chest, flanked by two armed guards.
EP46:E8 11500-16800 HIGH PRIEST [Booming, Authoritative]: "By Royal command, this sanctuary is placed under immediate Crown scesion."
EP46:E9 13800-17200 CAMERA: Close-up of the High Priest's fingers breaking the crimson wax seal and string on the war office envelope.
EP46:E10 15000-16800 SOUND: Crisp tear of wax and parchment string snapping open.
EP46:E11 17200-20500 CAMERA: Low-angle medium shot of the High Priest opening the yellowed War Office document.
EP46:E12 17300-20400 HIGH PRIEST [Stern, Commanding]: "None shall leave until every witness is accounted for."
EP46:E13 20500-22800 CAMERA: Wide shot of Alexander and Juliana standing defiant at the altar as congregation members watch in silence.
EP46:E14 20600-22800 HIGH PRIEST [O.S.) (Cold, Accusatory]: "You married this woman as a nameless beggar..."
EP46:E15 22800-26800 CAMERA: Medium close-up of the High Priest holding the decree, his gaze burning with disdain.
EP46:E16 22900-26500 HIGH PRIEST [Scornful, Harsh]: "...in a hedge ceremony no clerk in England ever recorded."
EP46:E17 26800-30500 CAMERA: Full shot of the High Priest brandishing the letter aloft in the center of the chapel nave.
EP46:E18 26800-31800 HIGH PRIEST [Resonant, Dismissive]: "Three years later, the beggar is revealed to be a Duke. The marriage does not rise with him."
EP46:E19 30500-34200 CAMERA: Medium shot of Alexander turning toward Juliana, placing a protective hand on her arm.
EP46:E20 32500-34500 ACTION: Juliana places her hand over Alexander's as he steps forward to shield her.
EP46:E21 34200-37000 CAMERA: Close-up of Alexander, his scarred face hardening with unwavering conviction.
EP46:E22 34300-36700 ALEXANDER [Gravely, Firm]: "She married the man... not the title."
EP46:E23 37000-42800 CAMERA: Low-angle shot looking up at the High Priest as he raises the parchment toward the vaulted ceiling.
EP46:E24 37300-42500 HIGH PRIEST [Harsh, Derisive]: "The church married a vagrant to a ruined lady. It never married the Duke of Ashburton to anyone."
EP46:E25 42800-47000 CAMERA: Medium shot of the High Priest lowering the document, raising a single finger in admonishment.
EP46:E26 42800-47000 HIGH PRIEST [Rigid, Formal]: "No Crown license was sought, because no one thought to ask leave for a Duke to marry."
EP46:E27 47000-49000 CAMERA: Two-shot of Juliana and Alexander listening intently, Juliana's eyes flashing with hurt and defiance.
EP46:E28 47100-49000 HIGH PRIEST [O.S.) (Sharp]: "No licensed clergyman presided..."
EP46:E29 49000-52200 CAMERA: Close-up of the High Priest glaring intently.
EP46:E30 49000-52200 HIGH PRIEST [Scathing]: "...because a frightened village priest has no authority to bind a peer."
EP46:E31 52200-58200 CAMERA: Medium shot pushing into a close-up as the High Priest thrusts the royal War Office proclamation directly into the camera.
EP46:E32 52200-58000 HIGH PRIEST [Thundering]: "And no clerk in London ever entered your name in the Royal register, because as far as the Crown knew, Alexander Ashburton was already dead."
EP46:E33 58200-62800 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana lifting her chin, tearful yet burning with righteous fury.
EP46:E34 58500-62500 JULIANA [Fierce, Defiant]: "I didn't ask this church for permission to survive, Father."
EP46:E35 62800-65800 CAMERA: Medium two-shot of Juliana standing proudly beside Alexander.
EP46:E36 62900-65500 JULIANA [Passionate, Resolute]: "I won't ask it for permission to love."
EP46:E37 65800-71000 CAMERA: Close-up of the High Priest looking down, a sinister, condescending smirk gracing his lips.
EP46:E38 66800-70500 HIGH PRIEST [Condescending, Venomous]: "Love doesn't make a Duchess, girl. Paper does."
EP46:E39 71000-76800 CAMERA: Slow push-in medium close-up on Juliana, her voice trembling with intense indignation.
EP46:E40 71400-74300 JULIANA [Accusatory, Pained]: "Then look at this floor honestly, for once."
EP46:E41 74400-76600 JULIANA [Voice Breaking, Passionate]: "A church called me unworthy."
EP46:E42 76800-78000 CAMERA: Quick cut to the High Priest maintaining a smug, impenetrable stare.
EP46:E43 76800-78000 JULIANA [O.S.) (Bitter]: "A church chained me."
EP46:E44 78000-85800 CAMERA: Extreme close-up on Juliana's face as she shouts at the priest.
EP46:E45 78100-81000 JULIANA [Furious, Resolute]: "Now a church calls my marriage a lie!"
EP46:E46 81100-85500 JULIANA [Shouting, Triumphant]: "God married us, Father! You are just angry no one asked you first!"
EP46:E47 85800-89200 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Catherine leaning against a stone archway, whispering with venomous mockery.
EP46:E48 86100-89000 CATHERINE [Malicious, Taunting]: "Careful, healer. The floor isn't finished with you."
EP46:E49 89200-92500 CAMERA: Close-up of the High Priest pressing the document against his chest, his eyes darkening with anger.
EP46:E50 89300-92400 HIGH PRIEST [O.S. / Low, Threatening]: "Careful, girl. You mistake my patience for weakness."
EP46:E51 92500-96000 CAMERA: Low-angle shot of the High Priest stepping up the altar steps toward them.
EP46:E52 92200-96200 HIGH PRIEST [Commanding, Severe]: "God did not marry you. A frightened parishioner did, without leave, without license, without the Crown's blessing!"
EP46:E53 96000-96800 CAMERA: Brief insert of Catherine smirking as she watches from the side.
EP46:E54 96800-100500 CAMERA: Wide shot of the High Priest waving the letter overhead before the congregation.
EP46:E55 96800-100400 HIGH PRIEST [Booming, Threatening]: "And I have the power to undo in one hearing what took you three years to steal!"
EP46:E56 100500-101800 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine listening eagerly.
EP46:E57 101800-106800 CAMERA: Profile medium shot of Alexander confronting the High Priest face-to-face at the foot of the altar.
EP46:E58 101800-106500 ALEXANDER [Cold, Resolute]: "A Duke's marriage is judged by the Crown's peerage court, not by a parish priest's seal."
EP46:E59 106800-111800 CAMERA: Low-angle two-shot of the High Priest staring up into Alexander's imposing frame.
EP46:E60 107000-111500 HIGH PRIEST [Stern, Unflinching]: "The High Religious Council rules on matters of holy matrimony. That includes yours."
EP46:E61 111800-118500 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Alexander glaring with icy authority.
EP46:E62 112000-118200 ALEXANDER [Defiant, Commanding]: "Then let it prove that in ten days, before witnesses. Not with six halberds pointed at me in my own chapel."
EP46:E63 118500-124000 CAMERA: Wide profile two-shot of the High Priest and Alexander locked in an intense standoff before the altar.
EP46:E64 118800-123600 HIGH PRIEST [Chilling, Victorious]: "Ten days. And if the council rules against you, this county watches you lose her twice."
EP46:E65 124000-126500 ALEXANDER [Steely, Unfazed]: "I'll take that wager over your decree."
EP46:E66 126500-127200 CAMERA: Quick reaction shot of the elderly woman in the pew gripping her beads in distress.
EP46:E67 127200-133500 CAMERA: Wide shot from behind the guards as they surround Alexander and Juliana, halberds and swords pointed inches from Alexander's chest.
EP46:E68 127200-133200 ALEXANDER [Thunderous, Imposing]: "Lower them! Or explain to the Crown why its own bailiffs raised iron on the Duke it just confirmed!"
EP46:E69 133500-138800 CAMERA: Medium shot of the High Priest extending his hand toward the guards, commanding them to stand down.
EP46:E70 134000-136000 ACTION: The guards slowly lower their weapon points away from the Duke.
EP46:E71 134200-138500 HIGH PRIEST [Ominous, Warning]: "Ten days, Duke. Choose your witnesses well."
EP46:E72 138800-140500 CAMERA: The High Priest turns sharply on his heel and strides past the guards toward the church exit.
EP46:E73 139000-142000 SOUND: Shuffling boots and clattering armor as the royal guards turn and retreat down the ruined aisle.
EP46:E74 140500-143880 CAMERA: Slow pan to Catherine standing in her bridal gown beside the sunlit aisle, watching the priest depart before turning to camera with a wicked, predatory smile.
EP46:E75 141200-143800 CATHERINE [Whispering, Malicious]: "Ten days is plenty of time."

METADATA ONLY (not on-screen evidence): {'logline': "While Alexander reassures Juliana of their unbreakable bond amid the council's opposition, a destitute Catherine begs for sanctuary at Ashbourne—only for Juliana to offer her survival under the strict humiliation of a scullery maid.", 'continuity_notes': "Follows Episode 46's ecclesiastical challenge by the High Priest. While Catherine plots in secret to remain on the estate, the morning brings her disgrace to light as Juliana decides her fate."}

SCENE sc_001 0-21500 INT. ESTATE CHAMBERS – NIGHT
EP47:E1 0-1800 CAMERA: Low-angle focus on a dripping candle burning on a wooden table beside a dark window looking out into the misty night.
EP47:E2 1800-8500 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Catherine in a lace nightgown and lilac robe, holding a goblet of red wine with cold determination.
EP47:E3 1800-8200 CATHERINE [Calculated, Defiant]: "Rupert is rotting in the undercroft cells. Not me. I intend to stay on this estate."
EP47:E4 8500-14800 CAMERA: Two-shot framing Catherine in the background with a muscular, bare-chested conspirator standing in shadow beside her.
EP47:E5 8800-14500 CONSPIRATOR [Low, Warning]: "Alexander will scour the grounds at first light. The High Council has already blocked the marriage registry."
EP47:E6 14800-18300 CAMERA: Close-up profile of Catherine leaning close to the man's shoulder, her eyes burning with ambition.
EP47:E7 15000-18200 CATHERINE [Commanding, Scheming]: "Then you will make sure I remain inside these walls."
EP47:E8 18300-21500 CAMERA: Silhouette shot against the tall arched window as Catherine turns her back to him.
EP47:E9 18500-21200 CATHERINE [Ruthless, Focused]: "Keep the council paralyzed. I will do the rest."
SCENE sc_002 21500-55500 INT. DUKE'S BEDCHAMBER – MORNING
EP47:E10 21500-23200 CAMERA: Atmospheric wide pan across the spacious master bedroom, daylight spilling softly through tall Gothic windows onto the hearth fire.
EP47:E11 23200-26500 CAMERA: Medium shot of Alexander and Juliana sitting together on the edge of the velvet bed, dressed in morning robes.
EP47:E12 23400-26800 JULIANA [Anxious, Trembling]: "What if Father Thomas sways the High Council?"
EP47:E13 26500-30500 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana's distressed face, tears shimmering in her eyes as she looks up at Alexander.
EP47:E14 27000-30300 JULIANA [Vulnerable, Fearful]: "What if they strip your title? Because of me?"
EP47:E15 30500-35000 ACTION: Juliana looks down at her hands, turning over her scarred palms shaped by years of herbal work.
EP47:E16 31000-35200 JULIANA [Despairing]: "I am only a healer. The lords will never accept me."
EP47:E17 35500-37500 CAMERA: Profile shot as Alexander reaches out and firmly clasps Juliana's trembling hands in his own.
EP47:E18 35800-37800 ALEXANDER [Gentle, Resolute]: "Look at me, Juliana."
EP47:E19 37500-42500 CAMERA: Close-up of Alexander raising his scarred hand to tenderly cradle Juliana's cheek.
EP47:E20 38200-42500 ALEXANDER [Fierce, Loving]: "You saved my mother's life. You stood by me when I had nothing."
EP47:E21 42500-45800 CAMERA: Tight close-up on Alexander's gaze locking onto Juliana's tearful eyes.
EP47:E22 43000-45500 ALEXANDER [Deep, Unwavering]: "You are my wife."
EP47:E23 45500-48000 ACTION: Alexander gently pulls Juliana closer, his hands resting securely on her shoulders.
EP47:E24 45800-54800 ALEXANDER [Authoritative, Steadfast]: "You were my wife before that priest ever opened his mouth. And we will stand before the King and God again within ten days. Nothing breaks that."
SCENE sc_003 55500-83500 EXT. ASHBOURNE COURTYARD – DAY
EP47:E25 55500-56800 CAMERA: Wide establishing shot of the rain-drenched cobblestone courtyard surrounded by imposing Gothic arches.
EP47:E26 56800-60000 CAMERA: Medium shot of Lady Ashbourne leaning heavily on her walking cane, glaring down at Catherine who kneels in the mud.
EP47:E27 56800-59800 LADY ASHBOURNE [Sharp, Contemptuous]: "You dare show your face in Ashbourne courtyard?"
EP47:E28 60000-63500 CAMERA: High-angle shot looking down at Catherine in her disheveled burgundy gown, clutching her skirts and weeping profusely.
EP47:E29 60500-63400 CATHERINE [Desperate, Weeping]: "I have nowhere to go, Your Grace."
EP47:E30 63500-67000 CAMERA: Low-angle shot tracking Catherine clutching her chest in agony.
EP47:E31 63500-66800 CATHERINE [Sobbing, Pleading]: "London closed its doors! My family disowned me!"
EP47:E32 67000-71500 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Lady Ashbourne, her gloved hand resting on her cane as she delivers her cold judgment.
EP47:E33 67200-71200 LADY ASHBOURNE [Cold, Unforgiving]: "She aided the poison in my veins. Cast her into the road."
EP47:E34 71500-74800 CAMERA: Medium shot of Vaughn drawing his baton, ready to seize Catherine from behind.
EP47:E35 71800-74800 VAUGHN [Gruff, Ready]: "One command, Your Grace, and I drag her past the gates."
EP47:E36 74800-78800 CAMERA: Wide shot as Alexander strides purposefully into the courtyard alongside Juliana, his coat billowing behind him.
EP47:E37 75200-78500 ALEXANDER [Furious, Decisive]: "Do it, Vaughn! Throw her past the estate perimeter!"
EP47:E38 78800-81800 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine collapsed on the wet stones, looking up with tear-streaked panic.
EP47:E39 78800-81800 CATHERINE [Hysterical, Screaming]: "Please, Alexander! Have mercy!"
EP47:E40 81800-83500 CAMERA: Medium shot of Juliana raising her right hand firmly to halt the guard.
EP47:E41 82200-83400 JULIANA [Clear, Authoritative]: "Stop."
SCENE sc_004 83500-134000 INT. ASHBOURNE GREAT HALL / VESTIBULE – CONTINUOUS
EP47:E42 83500-86500 CAMERA: Medium shot of Alexander turning toward Juliana in sheer disbelief.
EP47:E43 84000-86500 ALEXANDER [Indignant, Protective]: "Juliana, she tried to destroy you!"
EP47:E44 86500-88000 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana maintaining serene poise.
EP47:E45 86700-87800 JULIANA [Calm, Composed]: "She did."
EP47:E46 88000-91000 CAMERA: Medium tracking shot as Juliana steps gracefully past Alexander toward Catherine.
EP47:E47 88200-91000 JULIANA [Dignified, Principled]: "But Ashbourne does not throw beggars into the mud."
EP47:E48 91000-95000 ACTION: Juliana walks to a side bench, picks up a rough servant's apron and a heavy iron ring of keys, and turns back to face Catherine.
EP47:E49 91500-95000 JULIANA [Steely, Direct]: "If you seek shelter in this house, Catherine, you earn it."
EP47:E50 95500-98800 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine's face turning from despair to offended shock.
EP47:E51 96000-98800 CATHERINE [Incredulous, Stunned]: "You want me? As a guest?"
EP47:E52 98800-101200 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana staring straight into Catherine's eyes without blinking.
EP47:E53 99200-101000 JULIANA [Unflinching, Firm]: "As a scullery maid."
EP47:E54 101200-104800 CAMERA: Medium shot of Catherine recoiling in disgust, looking around at the gathered estate retainers.
EP47:E55 101500-104500 CATHERINE [Outraged, Venomous]: "You expect me to scrub floors before these commoners?"
EP47:E56 104800-108500 CAMERA: Dramatic profile two-shot of Juliana standing inches away from Catherine, dominating the confrontation.
EP47:E57 105200-108500 JULIANA [Measured, Commanding]: "You will scrub the floors you walked on as an impostor."
EP47:E58 108500-111500 CAMERA: Juliana extends the ring of iron keys outward in her fist.
EP47:E59 108800-111500 JULIANA [Stern, Demanding]: "You will scrub the manor hearths at dawn."
EP47:E60 111500-114500 CAMERA: Close profile two-shot of the two women locked in an intense psychological battle.
EP47:E61 111800-114500 JULIANA [Unforgiving]: "You will scour the kitchen grease until midnight."
EP47:E62 114500-118500 CAMERA: Juliana presents the rough hemp apron and heavy keys right to Catherine's face.
EP47:E63 114800-118500 JULIANA [Stern, Final]: "One complaint from the housekeeper, and you are cast out with nothing."
EP47:E64 118500-121800 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine's trembling lips, humiliated tears spilling down her heavily made-up cheeks.
EP47:E65 119200-121600 CATHERINE [Choked, Humiliated]: "You humiliate me."
EP47:E66 121800-127500 CAMERA: Medium shot of both women standing beneath the cathedral vaulting of the hall.
EP47:E67 122200-127200 JULIANA [Calm, Sovereign]: "I offer you bread and honest labor. Take the apron, or leave the county."
EP47:E68 127500-131500 CAMERA: Extreme close-up on Catherine's trembling hands as she reaches out, taking the coarse apron and clattering iron keys, pressing them desperately against her chest.
EP47:E69 128500-131200 CATHERINE [Broken, Defeated]: "I accept, Your Grace."
EP47:E70 131500-134000 CAMERA: Wide shot down the vaulted stone hall as Catherine prostrates herself entirely upon the floor before Alexander, Juliana, and Lady Ashbourne, humbled to the stone as the scene cuts to black.

EP=ep_048; timestamps are integer milliseconds
SOURCE_SHA256=877b9ef4386e0bdc3b9103964979388eca1eb9c5341f835d6b203412fc6db624
METADATA ONLY (not on-screen evidence): {'logline': "While feigning submission after her public humiliation, Catherine schemes in secret, plotting to use the council's ten-day reprieve to strike back at Alexander and Juliana with the aid of Father Thomas.", 'continuity_notes': "Directly follows Episode 47's public disgrace where Catherine bowed to Juliana and accepted the position of a maid; in private, Catherine sheds her feigned defeat and initiates her counter-plot."}
SOURCE WARNINGS=['sc_002: incomplete source coverage; gaps are unavailable']
SCENE sc_001 0-26700 INT. CATHERINE'S CHAMBERS – NIGHT
EP48:E1 0-4500 CAMERA: Medium shot tracking slightly as Catherine stands beside a tall mullioned stone window, silhouetted against the moonlight over the distant castle spires.
EP48:E2 0-3000 ACTION: Catherine, adorned in an ornate dark burgundy gown with braided golden hair, gazes out the dark window before turning slowly with a cold, venomous smirk.
EP48:E3 2400-7500 CATHERINE [Vindictive, Cold]: "Two words, and that healer's crown rolls right back into the gutter where it belongs."
EP48:E4 4500-8500 CAMERA: Close-up on Catherine's profile and jewelry as she speaks with calculating contempt.
EP48:E5 7800-12300 ACTION: Catherine glides across the chamber past a roaring stone hearth, picking up an orange from a silver platter on the table.
EP48:E6 8000-12300 CATHERINE [Scheming]: "Ten days. He gave himself ten days to fix it."
EP48:E7 12300-20000 CAMERA: Medium close-up frontal shot of Catherine turning directly toward the viewer, her expression tightening into ruthless determination.
EP48:E8 12600-14900 CATHERINE [Intense, Measured]: "Ten days for the council to sit."
EP48:E9 15000-18500 ACTION: Catherine raises a gloved index finger, emphasizing each point with sinister precision.
EP48:E10 15100-17200 CATHERINE [Calculating]: "Ten days for witnesses to be gathered."
EP48:E11 17400-19700 CATHERINE [Dark, Threatening]: "Ten days for a decree to be undone."
EP48:E12 20000-26700 CAMERA: Slight push-in on Catherine as she clenches her fist against her chest, her eyes blazing with malice.
EP48:E13 20100-23700 CATHERINE [Menacing, Resolute]: "Ten days is not a wall, Alexander. It's a door."
EP48:E14 23900-26500 CATHERINE [Chillingly Calm]: "And doors can be closed from the other side."
SCENE sc_002 26700-80000 INT. CATHERINE'S CHAMBERS – CONTINUOUS
EP48:E15 26700-30800 CAMERA: Medium shot over Catherine's shoulder seated before her vanity mirror as the chamber door eases open and Agnes enters quietly.
EP48:E16 26800-29500 ACTION: Agnes, dressed in a grey maid's dress and white apron, steps inside with cautious hesitation and clasps her hands.
EP48:E17 29200-30800 AGNES [Hushed, Submissive]: "You sent for me, my lady?"
EP48:E18 30900-32000 CATHERINE [Commanding, Sharp]: "Lock it."
EP48:E19 32000-33900 CAMERA: Close-up on Agnes's hands turning the ornate iron key in the wooden door's brass lock.
EP48:E20 32300-33800 SOUND: Heavy metallic click of an iron key latching into a deadbolt.
EP48:E21 34000-36500 ACTION: Catherine strides forward and firmly grasps Agnes by both hands, stepping uncomfortably close.
EP48:E22 34000-43000 CAMERA: Two-shot profile of Catherine towering over Agnes in the candlelight.
EP48:E23 34200-37100 CATHERINE [Fierce, Hissing]: "Everyone in that chapel saw me humiliated today."
EP48:E24 37300-39000 CATHERINE [Spiteful, calculating]: "Good. Let them remember it."
EP48:E25 39200-43000 CATHERINE [Sinister, Predatory]: "Grief makes people careless, and carelessness is exactly what I need from that household right now."
EP48:E26 43000-46800 CAMERA: Over-the-shoulder close-up on Agnes, her brow furrowed in anxious alarm.
EP48:E27 43300-46800 AGNES [Anxious, Whispering]: "My lady... the Duke has bailiffs watching every road out of the county."
EP48:E28 46800-51500 CAMERA: Close-up on Catherine, a smug, venomous smile spreading across her painted lips.
EP48:E29 47000-51300 CATHERINE [Confident, Devious]: "I'm not leaving the county, Agnes. I'm going back into that house."
EP48:E30 51500-58200 CAMERA: Medium tracking shot following Catherine as she releases Agnes and stalks across the room toward the window sill.
EP48:E31 52000-55000 CATHERINE [Pleased, Scheming]: "Father Thomas did his part beautifully today."
EP48:E32 55200-58200 CATHERINE [Calculated, Demanding]: "Now I need him to do a little more before that hearing convenes."
EP48:E33 58200-61000 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Agnes glancing nervously over her shoulder.
EP48:E34 58500-60600 AGNES [Apprehensive]: "If someone sees him come to you..."
EP48:E35 61000-66900 CAMERA: Close-up on Catherine spinning around from the window, her jaw set in terrifying firmness.
EP48:E36 61800-64000 CATHERINE [Stern, Threatening]: "Then no one sees him."
EP48:E37 64300-66900 CATHERINE [Authoritative]: "That is precisely your job tonight."
EP48:E38 66900-73500 CAMERA: Medium shot as Catherine picks up a heavy velvet coin purse and places it firmly into Agnes's awaiting open palms.
EP48:E39 67500-69000 SOUND: Dull clinking of heavy gold coins inside a leather pouch.
EP48:E40 67800-70500 CATHERINE [Hushed, Commanding]: "Send for the priest. Tonight."
EP48:E41 70800-73400 CATHERINE [Firm, Final]: "And make sure no one sees him arrive."
EP48:E42 73500-76800 CAMERA: Wide shot of Agnes curtsying swiftly, stashing the pouch into her apron, and hurrying out through the heavy wooden door into the darkness.
EP48:E43 76800-80000 CAMERA: Exterior shot looking through the dark diamond-paned window frame at Catherine standing motionless in the warm candlelight, staring outward into the night with cold, unyielding ambition as the scene fades to black.

messages.content:
EP=ep_049; timestamps are integer milliseconds
SOURCE_SHA256=7b96649d2e272da28d82c5cf18c7915d4f09117e5d7632a04625a333d554016e
METADATA ONLY (not on-screen evidence): {'logline': 'Meeting Father Thomas in an abandoned wing of the manor before dawn, Catherine orchestrates a calculated conspiracy to stall the council hearing and extract inside intelligence, sealing their treasonous alliance with intimate assurance.', 'continuity_notes': 'Directly follows Catherine sending Agnes to fetch Father Thomas under cover of darkness; now in Episode 49, Father Thomas slips into the secluded wing for their covert rendezvous.'}
SOURCE WARNINGS=[]
SCENE sc_001 0-144750 INT. FORGOTTEN MANOR WING - NIGHT
EP49:E1 0-5200 CAMERA: Wide tracking shot down a dark, derelict hallway lined with dust-sheet draped furniture and peeling wallpaper. At the far end, a door creaks open, revealing a cloaked figure stepping in.
EP49:E2 1000-4500 SOUND: Hinges creaking softly followed by the muffled thud of a heavy wooden door clicking shut.
EP49:E3 1800-5200 ACTION: Father Thomas, clad in a hooded dark mantle over priestly black robes, secures the door behind him and steps into the shadows of the abandoned corridor.
EP49:E4 5200-7000 CAMERA: Medium shot on Catherine, draped in a dark hooded cloak over a lavish crimson bodice, holding a brass candlestick aloft.
EP49:E5 5400-6800 CATHERINE [Quietly Chiding]: "You took your time."
EP49:E6 7000-8800 CAMERA: Over-the-shoulder shot past Father Thomas's cloaked back looking toward Catherine illuminated in warm candlelight.
EP49:E7 8800-15500 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Father Thomas under his black hood, his stern face framed by the clerical collar and silver crucifix resting on his chest.
EP49:E8 9000-15200 FATHER THOMAS [Low, Measured]: "Agnes is thorough. She made me wait for a groom to finish his rounds before she'd let me past the stables."
EP49:E9 15500-19800 CAMERA: Close-up profile of Catherine, turning with a slight, knowing smirk.
EP49:E10 15800-18800 CATHERINE [Pleased, Cold]: "Good. That's what I pay her for."
EP49:E11 19800-22000 CAMERA: Medium two-shot as Catherine steps forward and sets the heavy candleholder onto a small round table draped in grey cloth between them.
EP49:E12 20000-22000 ACTION: Catherine sets down the brass candleholder, the flame flickering across their faces.
EP49:E13 22000-27500 CAMERA: Tight close-up on Father Thomas's face, the candlelight dancing in his calculating eyes.
EP49:E14 22200-27200 FATHER THOMAS [Grave]: "No shadows tonight, Catherine. Just us and an empty wing."
EP49:E15 27500-33200 CAMERA: Close-up on Catherine, her blonde ringlets peeking from beneath her velvet hood as she smiles faintly.
EP49:E16 27800-33000 CATHERINE [Unfazed]: "You didn't need them the first time, either. I just prefer my secrets thorough."
EP49:E17 33200-41800 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Father Thomas, glancing down momentarily before fixing his piercing gaze back on her.
EP49:E18 33500-41500 FATHER THOMAS [Dry, Cynical]: "A priest and a disgraced bride meeting before dawn in her bedchamber. I'd say thoroughness served us both rather well."
EP49:E19 41800-46800 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine's face hardening into a stern, focused expression.
EP49:E20 42000-46500 CATHERINE [Assertive, Warning]: "It will keep serving us as long as neither of us gets careless. No one in this house so much as suspects your face belongs to that morning. Let's keep it that way."
EP49:E21 46800-48500 CAMERA: Close-up on Father Thomas listening impassively.
EP49:E22 48500-53000 CAMERA: Medium wide two-shot across the candlelit table, Catherine leaning slightly forward.
EP49:E23 48800-52800 CATHERINE [Scheming]: "Today went better than either of us planned for. The whole court watched you humiliate her."
EP49:E24 53000-59800 CAMERA: Medium close-up on Father Thomas as he turns his head slightly, scanning the dusty shadowed recesses of the abandoned room.
EP49:E25 53200-59500 FATHER THOMAS [Reflective, Brooding]: "Fitting choice, this room. A place the family forgot for a conversation they mustn't remember."
EP49:E26 59800-62800 CAMERA: Close-up on Catherine, her lips curling into an amused, knowing smile.
EP49:E27 60000-62500 CATHERINE [Amused]: "You always did have a taste for symbolism."
EP49:E28 62800-67200 CAMERA: Medium shot of Father Thomas, a subtle smirk breaking through his austere demeanor.
EP49:E29 63000-67100 FATHER THOMAS [Intimate, Candid]: "And you always did have a taste for using me. It's why we suit each other."
EP49:E30 67200-72400 CAMERA: Close-up on Catherine, her expression turning razor-sharp and commanding.
EP49:E31 67400-72200 CATHERINE [Strict, Urgent]: "Then make certain the council remembers that for the full ten days, not just the first hour."
EP49:E32 72400-77000 CAMERA: Side profile close-up on Father Thomas, his brow furrowing with impatient resolve.
EP49:E33 72600-76800 FATHER THOMAS [Direct]: "What is it you actually need from me, Catherine? Say it plainly, for once."
EP49:E34 77000-84000 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Catherine raising one hand slightly, emphasizing her terms.
EP49:E35 77200-83800 CATHERINE [Calculating, Determined]: "First, the hearing stays unresolved as long as possible. Every extension, every delay, every excuse to reconvene."
EP49:E36 84000-91400 CAMERA: Frontal close-up of Catherine raising two fingers in the candlelight, her eyes burning with ruthless intent.
EP49:E37 84200-91200 CATHERINE [Fierce, Uncompromising]: "Second, I want to know what the council knows before it decides anything. Every argument, every witness, every whisper against her."
EP49:E38 91400-94200 CAMERA: Close-up on Father Thomas absorbing the audacity of her demand.
EP49:E39 91600-94000 FATHER THOMAS [Skeptical]: "You want eyes inside the council chamber itself?"
EP49:E40 94200-98000 CAMERA: Close-up low angle on Catherine, tilting her chin up in defiant pride.
EP49:E41 94400-97800 CATHERINE [Haughty, Imperious]: "I want eyes and ears everywhere that decides my future."
EP49:E42 98000-103800 CAMERA: Full two-shot of Catherine and Father Thomas facing off across the small table in the cavernous hallway.
EP49:E43 98200-102500 ACTION: Father Thomas clasps his hands behind his back, turning slightly away to ponder the gravity of her words.
EP49:E44 98300-103200 CATHERINE [Bitterly Resolute]: "Is that so unreasonable coming from a woman the church itself just humiliated back into relevance?"
EP49:E45 103800-113000 CAMERA: Medium shot on Father Thomas turning back around to face her, his countenance etched with genuine concern.
EP49:E46 104200-112800 FATHER THOMAS [Wary, Grave]: "If I keep the hearing open, if I feed you every word spoken behind those doors, what happens to me when the Duke finds out a crowned priest conspired against him?"
EP49:E47 113000-118000 CAMERA: Medium two-shot tracking closer as Catherine steps closer toward him.
EP49:E48 113200-117800 CATHERINE [Seductive, Reassuring]: "Then make certain he doesn't find out. You're careful. I've seen how careful."
EP49:E49 118000-124800 CAMERA: Tight close-up on Father Thomas's intense, brooding face.
EP49:E50 118200-124500 FATHER THOMAS [Stern, Stark]: "Careful men still hang, my lady, when the crime is treason against a Duke the King himself just restored."
EP49:E51 124800-128800 CAMERA: Close-up on Catherine, her lips parting into an alluring, promising smile.
EP49:E52 125000-128500 CATHERINE [Tempting]: "Careful men who help me also get remembered."
EP49:E53 128800-134500 CAMERA: Split focus close-up between Father Thomas's intense gaze and Catherine leaning in close, whispering with lethal conviction.
EP49:E54 129200-134200 CATHERINE [Whispering, Promising]: "A grateful Duchess collects debts differently than a desperate one."
EP49:E55 134500-139800 CAMERA: Medium two-shot as Father Thomas extends his open right hand between them.
EP49:E56 135000-139500 ACTION: Father Thomas slowly raises his right hand, palm turned upward in invitation and pact.

METADATA ONLY (not on-screen evidence): {'logline': "Following their illicit passion in the abandoned manor wing, Catherine negotiates Father Thomas's corrupt silence with territorial control—unaware that Agnes has walked in and witnessed their scandalous intimacy.", 'continuity_notes': 'Directly follows Episode 49, where Father Thomas and Catherine sealed their covert alliance in the secluded wing; now, their secret affair deepens into political extortion before being shattered by an unexpected witness.'}
SOURCE WARNINGS=[]
SCENE sc_001 0-70500 INT. ABANDONED BEDCHAMBER – PRE-DAWN
EP50:E1 0-1800 CAMERA: High overhead birds-eye shot looking straight down at the unkempt bed, where Catherine lies curled in a silk chemise against Father Thomas's bare chest.
EP50:E2 0-2000 ACTION: Father Thomas lies flat on his back, breathless, while Catherine rests beside him, her fingers tracing across his bare skin.
EP50:E3 1800-7000 CAMERA: Low-angle medium close-up on Catherine looking down adoringly into Father Thomas's face, a single candle flickering in the dark background.
EP50:E4 1800-5800 CATHERINE [Playful, Seductive]: "A man in your collar isn't supposed to have that much left in him, Thomas."
EP50:E5 5800-7200 ACTION: Catherine runs her hand gently down his chest, smiling with triumphant affection.
EP50:E6 7000-11800 CAMERA: Close-up on Father Thomas turning his head toward her on the pillow, his voice raspy and dry.
EP50:E7 7200-11200 FATHER THOMAS [Low, Ironical]: "A man in my collar isn't supposed to be in this bed at all."
EP50:E8 11800-15800 CAMERA: Close-up pushing in on Catherine as she leans lower over his face, her gaze sharpening with dangerous intimacy.
EP50:E9 12000-15500 CATHERINE [Intense, Whispering]: "Then let's stop pretending this was only appetite."
EP50:E10 15800-18800 CAMERA: Medium two-shot from the side as both sit up in bed, sheets pulled up around their waists.
EP50:E11 16800-18500 CATHERINE [Direct, Transactional]: "Name your price."
EP50:E12 18800-26500 CAMERA: Medium profile close-up on Father Thomas sitting up tall and bare-chested, Catherine resting her hand firmly over his heart.
EP50:E13 19400-25000 FATHER THOMAS [Calculated, Demanding]: "The west territory. Tax collection, all of it. Routed through my office."
EP50:E14 26500-30500 CAMERA: Slight pull back as Catherine pulls her hand back slightly, staring at him in disbelief.
EP50:E15 27200-30200 CATHERINE [Scoffing, Incredulous]: "That's not absolution, Thomas. That's a fortune."
EP50:E16 30500-35800 CAMERA: Two-shot centering on Father Thomas leaning toward her, his expression resolute and uncompromising.
EP50:E17 31000-35000 FATHER THOMAS [Steady, Cold]: "Absolution is free. Discretion has a price."
EP50:E18 35800-39800 CAMERA: Tight profile close-up between their faces, golden candlelight illuminating Catherine's jaw as she raises her hand to touch his cheek.
EP50:E19 36500-39400 CATHERINE [Soft, Calculating]: "Unsupervised. In your hands alone."
EP50:E20 39800-43000 CAMERA: Tight close-up as Father Thomas reaches up and firmly clasps Catherine's hand at his neck.
EP50:E21 40400-42500 FATHER THOMAS [Grave]: "For as long as it holds."
EP50:E22 43000-48500 CAMERA: Medium close-up as Catherine breaks into a knowing, seductive smile and taps his chest with her index finger.
EP50:E23 43200-48000 CATHERINE [Softly, Teasing]: "Done. You told yourself this ends when the hearing does."
EP50:E24 48500-54500 CAMERA: Close-up on Father Thomas letting out a soft, self-deprecating chuckle before meeting her eyes with smoldering hunger.
EP50:E25 49800-54000 FATHER THOMAS [Chuckle, Resigned]: "I've told myself that since the dawn in your bedchamber, and here we are again."
EP50:E26 54500-59800 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of their lips almost grazing, warm candlelight catching the edges of their profiles.
EP50:E27 54800-56500 CATHERINE [Murmuring]: "In another room no one uses?"
EP50:E28 56800-59200 FATHER THOMAS [Whispering]: "Perhaps I like rooms no one uses."
EP50:E29 59800-65500 CAMERA: Close-up profile as Catherine slides both hands into the dark hair at the back of his neck, pulling him closer.
EP50:E30 60300-64800 CATHERINE [Low, Carnal]: "Or perhaps discretion isn't the only thing you've developed a taste for."
EP50:E31 65500-70500 CAMERA: Medium two-shot as Father Thomas pulls Catherine into a fierce, suffocating embrace, burying his face in her neck while she clings to his broad shoulders.
EP50:E32 65800-70500 ACTION: Catherine closes her eyes in surrender as Father Thomas holds her tight against his naked chest, lost in their forbidden entanglement.
SCENE sc_002 70500-80000 INT. MANOR CORRIDOR – CONTINUOUS
EP50:E33 70500-73500 CAMERA: Medium tracking shot following Agnes as she walks cautiously down the dimly lit stone corridor, holding a black iron lantern.
EP50:E34 70800-73500 ACTION: Agnes scans the desolate hallway nervously, her lantern casting elongated shadows against the wall.
EP50:E35 73500-76500 CAMERA: Over-the-shoulder shot behind Agnes as she stops dead in front of an open doorway, peering inside.
EP50:E36 74000-76500 ACTION: Through the crack of the door, Agnes sees Catherine and the shirtless priest locked in an intimate, passionate embrace upon the bed.
EP50:E37 76500-78500 CAMERA: Tight close-up on Agnes's face, drained of all color, her eyes bulging in pure terror.
EP50:E38 76800-78500 ACTION: Agnes's jaw drops open in shock as she stifles a cry.
EP50:E39 77200-78600 SOUND: Sharp, terrified gasp catching in Agnes's throat.
EP50:E40 78500-80000 CAMERA: Frantic backward tracking close-up on Agnes stumbling back into the shadows of the hallway, horrified by the lethal secret she has uncovered before an abrupt cut to black.
